Name: Abrahamic Family House
Description: A cultural and religious complex containing a mosque, church and synagogue.
Reviews:
Abrahamic Family House is built on a truly meaningful and visionary idea. Bringing the Abrahamic religions together through a mosque, a church, and a synagogue in one place is powerful, courageous, and genuinely inspiring. The architectural language is strong, and the intention behind the project deserves real respect.

That said, the experience could be much richer. Inside, visitors naturally want to spend more time — to learn, reflect, and understand. Adding more educational content would elevate the place significantly: basic information about each religion (origins, historical development, sacred texts, core beliefs), supported by books, audio guides, and short videos, would make the visit far more engaging and memorable.

Visitor experience is another area that needs improvement. Entrance and exit flows should be smoother and more intuitive, and unfortunately the staff attitude did not reflect the spirit of the project. In a place built on dialogue, respect, and coexistence, staff should be noticeably more welcoming, polite, and helpful. First impressions matter a lot in a space like this.

Overall, the idea is excellent and globally important. With stronger content and a more refined service approach, Abrahamic Family House could become a truly world-class center for culture, learning, and interfaith understanding. || The Abrahamic Family House is an impressive and unique landmark that promotes interfaith understanding. Architecturally, it’s stunning, with beautifully designed spaces for a mosque, church, and synagogue, all within the same complex. The modern design blends elegance with symbolism, making it a visually striking place to visit.

The atmosphere is peaceful and respectful, and walking around the complex gives a sense of harmony and unity. While it’s more of a cultural and spiritual site than a tourist attraction with lots to do, it’s still worth visiting to appreciate the architecture, the message it represents, and the serene surroundings.

That said, the entry experience could be handled much better. They ask for your passport to enter, which I really don’t understand, and when I went through security, an Indian security guard flipped through my passport, I didn’t appreciate this at all and gave him a rude stare. The security guards definitely require further training; DO NOT go through people’s personal belongings!! || The Abrahamic Family House is a truly remarkable space and a powerful symbol of coexistence and mutual respect. The architecture of the mosque, church, and synagogue is breathtaking in its own way — elegant, serene, and deeply thoughtful. Each building reflects its faith tradition beautifully while maintaining a shared sense of harmony across the entire complex.

The atmosphere is calm and contemplative, making it a meaningful place not just to visit, but to reflect. The staff were exceptionally courteous, welcoming, and helpful, taking the time to guide visitors respectfully and answer questions with clarity and warmth.

An inspiring landmark in Abu Dhabi that combines architectural excellence with an important message of unity. Highly recommended for anyone visiting the city. || Discovering unity in diversity at the Abrahamic Family House in Abu Dhabi. 🕊️ A beautiful space where a mosque, church, and synagogue stand side-by-side as a symbol of peace and human fraternity. A must-visit for anyone seeking a moment of reflection and a deeper understanding of our shared humanity. || We visited the Abrahamic Family House and it was genuinely one of the most peaceful and meaningful places we’ve been to in the UAE. The complex includes a mosque, church, and synagogue, all beautifully designed and equal in size, which really speaks to the message of unity and coexistence.

We joined one of the free guided tours, and it was definitely worth it - our guide shared interesting details about each space and the symbolism behind the architecture. Each building felt special in its own way, but what stood out most was how calm and reflective the whole place felt.

The design is minimalist but stunning - clean lines, soft light, and open spaces that invite you to slow down and think. The gardens and open courtyards in between add to the sense of peace.

If you’re in Abu Dhabi, I’d really recommend visiting. It’s not just about religion - it’s about respect, understanding, and shared humanity. Just make sure to book your slot online in advance and dress modestly (they do provide abayas if needed, but it’s better to go prepared).

Name: Abu Dhabi Corniche
Description: A long waterfront promenade with beaches, cycling paths and city views.
Reviews:
It’s a safest beach. Clean and good atmosphere.  It’s an artificial beach so there don’t have a waves. And life guards are there. There have a separate for families and single. Family has a ticket system. Opposite there has a parking and Road crossings tunnel also there. And Public bus stop also there. We can swim until sunset. Sunset view is very beautiful seance. || Corniche beach 🏖️ is good place for swimming and fun with friends. The weather was sunny ☀️ because of winter but in summer maybe you'll get sun burn. If you like peaceful and nature corniche beach is perfect. || "Abu Dhabi Corniche,, Where sunset colors meet sea breeze vibes!  A perfect blend of beauty and calm.
"Corniche magic...  Golden sunsets, sparkling waters, and city lights twinkling in Abu Dhabi's favorite spot. || In Abu Dhabi, where the sun holds sovereign sway,
A shore of beauty waits to grace the day.
The Corniche Beach, in flawless, clean design,
A spot where peace and tranquil joys entwine.
No spot so perfect for the weary soul,
To rest, relax, and let the moments roll.
For families, friends, or those who walk alone,
A safe, soft sanctuary, finely grown.
The crystal waters, clear as purest light,
The gentle sands, a prospect shining bright,
And views that soothe the spirit in its plight,
An emblem of creation's silent might.
Here, ample comforts are bestowed on all:
For limbs that walk, or cycling paths that call;
The cleansing showers, and rooms where garments change,
And nearby cafés, offering a pleasant range.
But lo! the dying sun, in colors steeped,
A stunning vision, as the shadows crept.
The world in silent admiration stands,
To watch the glory fall on these fair lands.
A haven perfect, where the heart may find

Name: Abu Dhabi Falcon Hospital
Description: A specialist falcon hospital offering educational visitor tours.
Reviews:
Absolutely worth visiting. No matter if you have family and kids or you are just by yourself. An 2-hour tour provides you with sufficient information about falcons nature, life cycle, species, feeding etc. You can also sneak and watch the daily work of the clinic. All in very pleasant and entertaining way! Hasan, our friendly guide was able to catch our attention and answered all the questions. Groupie are not big, so you can enjoy it! There is also a chance to hold a falcon on your arm with glove on it and have a picture. One of the best experience in Abu Dhabi. Really worth its prize! || An absolutely wonderful experience for those new to falconry!.
Lead by Master Tour Guide Mr Hassan, the medical staff and technicians provide a hands on experience and personal touch throughout!
A must see in Abu Dhabi ! || This was a highlight of my trip to Abu Dhabi. It's incredible to see close and personal these amazing birds and much more. The tour is fantastic and you'll be able to see what's going on behind the close doors - literally. Everyone was soooo friendly and willing to explain procedures and answer our questions. What a spectacular facility and very, very unique experience. Besides holding and patting the birds, I was able to feed one as well. What a great memories I'll have. Highly  highly recommend visiting this place, besides the falcons you'll enjoy the free roaming peacocks as well ;) || highlight of my trip to Abu Dhabi the tour is a must do. So interesring and to see these Falcons up close is amazing. Falcon in the photo is not hurt just sleeping whilst they had their nails cut. || This was a really cool experience! I wasn’t very familiar with falcons and the connection between UAE and these beautiful birds. Well, let me tell you, after spending 90 min with the staff during their tour, I walked out of there with so much respect and information, memories and things I’ve learned I will never forget! Please go check it out! What a great way to support a great organization that helps and supports so many animals in need! Absolutely beautiful! Totally worth it! Ask for Hassan being your guide!!

Name: Abu Dhabi National Exhibition Centre
Description: A large exhibition and conference venue hosting public shows and events.
Reviews:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5)
As an advertising and exhibition stand contractor, we have had the opportunity to work at ADNEC Centre Abu Dhabi on numerous occasions, both as exhibitors and as booth builders for our clients. Most recently, we participated in major events such as the Emirates and ISNR exhibitions with our own stand, which gave us firsthand experience of the venue's operations and support services.
Over the years, we have also built exhibition stands for many of our clients at various events hosted at ADNEC. Based on our experience, ADNEC is one of the most exhibitor-friendly and contractor-friendly venues in the UAE. Access to the halls, logistics coordination, loading and unloading processes, and booth construction activities are generally smooth and well organized.
The venue management team, event organizers, and support staff are always professional and cooperative. The security team maintains high safety standards while remaining helpful and approachable, creating a positive working environment for exhibitors, contractors, and visitors alike.
Compared to many other exhibition venues, ADNEC offers an excellent balance of efficiency, accessibility, and professionalism. This is one of the reasons why we always enjoy working here and look forward to future events at the venue.
Based on our extensive experience as both exhibitors and stand contractors, ADNEC Centre Abu Dhabi deserves a well-earned 5 out of 5 stars. Highly recommended for exhibitions, conferences, and large-scale events. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ || 1.Good place to attend exhibitions
2. Plenty of parking are there but still there will be traffic congestion during peak hours.
3.Many events will happen at the same time.
4. Well maintained
5. It is used for exhibitions only. || Had a great experience at ADNEC Centre Abu Dhabi. The venue is very spacious, well organized, and perfect for exhibitions and events. Clean environment, easy parking, and excellent facilities made the visit smooth and enjoyable. One of the best event venues in Abu Dhabi! || Exhibition center in Abu Dhabi where most exhibitions take place. not very far from Dubai. Driving time is 1hr:30 min from Downtown Dubai. Very well managed and organised || Honestly, one of the most impressive and professionally organized exhibition venues in the UAE. The scale of the venue, cleanliness, parking management, and overall organization are all top-tier. Whether it’s a major international exhibition, conference, or public event, everything usually runs very smoothly and professionally.

Name: Adrenark Adventure
Description: An indoor adventure park with climbing, obstacle and family activities.
Reviews:
Amazing place with lot of activities for kids who grew up above 110cm, while best for 130cm and higher.

Indoor carts, slides, nets, cave, trampoline, bounce castle and many more.
This Ramadan - great offer aed 200 for max package till March 16. Hurry up! || The center has 16 games, many are rope course, climbing, karting, and many more. You can buy different packages, starting with 6 games to an unlimited package. Preferred you arrive early to have enough time for all the games, specially that the place host birthdays, so games might be booked for the birthday guests. There are trucks for pizza kids meals, popcycles and  a small baqala. Fazaa applies, but not to all packages. Uma was very helpful and patient!! || We had a great day celebrating our sons 8th birthday recently. Kids had an amazing time with amazing food. The park host Kaypee did a great job taking kids on all rides and keeping them active even in the party room. Parents were tension free. The team was super supportive to any change in the last moment. Thank you Adrenark for the good memories you created. || The Ultimate Birthday Blast!
​We recently celebrated my son's birthday at Adrenark Adventure Park, with small family gathering! The venue delivered an unforgettable experience, and everyone left with a huge smile.
​The park boasts an incredible number of attractions, ensuring high-energy fun and zero dull moments for kids of all ages. For parents, the park has couple of options for food and coffee, however the place (Al Qana) is surrounded by many wonderful restaurant's and amenities that are a lifesaver: great food options and dedicated coffee shops with good seating make it completely convenient, especially during winter season when the weather is nice for seating outdoor.
Adrenark is the ideal weekend escape for families with kids and go-to place for birthday venue. Highly recommended! || We celebrated the birthday of our kids here everything was amazing! Great appreciation to Joanna for the amazing adventures and entertaining the kids and their friends with games and guidance

Name: Al Bateen Beach
Description: A public beach popular for swimming, paddling and sunset views.
Reviews:
Al Bateen Beach Park is one of our favorite spots in Abu Dhabi and truly one of the best places for families. The beach sand is clean and white, the area is well-maintained, and security is always present, which makes it feel very safe. It’s a peaceful place to relax, walk, and enjoy quality time with family. Highly recommended! || I stopped by here in the early morning on my drive home from Hudayriyat, just to check it out. Overall? It’s okay.

Let’s start with the big win: there are so many shells here! (Oh yeah, my inner shell-collector was thrilled). However, you definitely need swim shoes because the ground is not barefoot-friendly. As for the view? Honestly, let's just not even talk about that. Moving on.

They have a nice playground and one of those stone foot massage paths. Seriously, who are the superhuman people walking on those? I previously attempted the one at the Corniche and failed miserably. Seeing this one just gave me flashbacks.

But wait, how the hell is the public drinking water station here so ice-cold?! I wish I could get that temperature at home during the summer instead of the lukewarm bath water that comes out of my house taps. || Al Bateen Beach is clean, well-maintained, and family-friendly. There’s a small, safe area for kids to play, excellent service and maintenance, a dedicated fishing spot, and a wide beach suitable for swimming. Free drinking water is available throughout. Simple, organized, and very well managed. || Bateen Beach is a very cozy and peaceful beach, perfect if you are looking for a calm place to relax. It’s relatively small but offers beautiful scenic views. The beach is very clean, well maintained, and not crowded, which makes it ideal for families and picnics. There are free-to-use huts, sufficient parking, and a lifeguard on duty, so safety and convenience are well taken care of. There is also a mosque located near the parking area,

One unique feature that really stood out for me was the foot reflexology pathway. It’s something different and very nice to see, and many people were actually using it. Overall, it’s a great spot to spend quality time with family, enjoy the views, and have a relaxed day.

So far my favourite beach in Abu Dhabi. || Peaceful place especially on the weekdays before 4 pm. Many comfortable benches to seat and pavilions to have a picnic. Needs more kiosks for tea/coffee and snacks. Washrooms are clean. Free water available. Free parking. Security. Great for families and friends gathering. Only jetski can be loud

Name: Al Fay Park
Description: A biodiversity-focused city park with native plants and recreation spaces.
Reviews:
Hidden Gem in Al Reem Island

This is easily one of the most underrated and best maintained parks in Al Reem Island. From the outside, it looks like a regular neighborhood park, but once you step inside, you'll discover a beautifully landscaped green space with winding walking paths, small hills, lush gardens, and plenty of shaded seating areas.

One of the things I love most is the variety of activities available for all age groups. The park features multiple half basketball courts, a skate park, badminton area, table tennis tables, football space, volleyball/handball courts, and a well equipped children's play area. Whether you're looking to exercise, play sports, or simply relax, there's something for everyone.

The walking tracks are excellent both inside and around the park. The internal paths are particularly scenic, surrounded by greenery and attractive landscaping, making them perfect for a morning or evening walk.

Facilities are surprisingly good for a public park. There are clean toilets, free drinking water stations, vending machines offering snacks and juices, and plenty of seating and picnic style gathering spots where families and friends can enjoy food together.

Another huge advantage is the availability of free parking nearby, which makes visiting very convenient.

Overall, this park feels like a hidden oasis in the middle of the city. It's clean, peaceful, family friendly, and offers far more amenities than many larger parks. Highly recommended for families, fitness enthusiasts, walkers, and anyone looking for a relaxing green space on Al Reem Island. || I absolutely love visiting Al Fay Park on Al Reem Island — it’s one of my favourite green spaces in Abu Dhabi! 🌿 The park is beautifully landscaped with over 2,000 native plants and trees, creating a refreshing, almost forest-like atmosphere right in the heart of the city. It’s a breath of fresh air compared to the typical urban environment, and really cool thanks to the smart design that naturally reduces temperature and noise.

There’s something for everyone here — from jogging and cycling paths to basketball courts, skate areas, mini-golf, and even a kids’ play zone. It’s great for families, solo walks, or just chilling with friends. The open spaces and shady spots make it perfect for a weekend outing or early morning exercise.

The vibe is always positive and the park feels well maintained and clean. Whether you’re into sports, relaxation, nature walks, or just want a peaceful place to unwind, Al Fay Park delivers. Highly recommend for anyone visiting or living in Abu Dhabi! 🌳✨ || Amazing place! lots of things to do! They have basketball, badminton, and volleyball courts, kids play area, wall climbing, skate park and a Hiking trail. Its like mini forest within the bustling city! || Al Fay Park on Reem Island is such a lovely surprise!  Whether you’re here for a quick walk, a family outing, or just to unwind after a long day, this little urban escape has everything you need.I love how clean, modern, and beautifully designed the space is. The walking paths are wide and perfect for a relaxed stroll, the lighting in the evenings gives it such a safe and cosy vibe, and the greenery is so calming. Kids absolutely adore the open play areas, and there’s enough space for everyone to enjoy without feeling crowded, but its not a park with slides or swings, since it has a sports vibe.What makes this park special is the atmosphere — peaceful mornings, lively afternoons, and gorgeous sunsets over the nearby towers. Reem mall is situated across for a bite to eatIt’s the kind of place that becomes part of your weekly routine without you even realizing it. A perfect blend of nature, city views, and community vibes. I love watching people enjoy the basket ball area and gym during the cooler months. The tables and chairs are lovely for a picnic. || I highly recommend this park to anyone looking for a great outdoor experience. It's perfect for families, couples, and individuals. It's offers various activities.Visitors praise its well-maintained grounds and scenic paths.The playground area is fantastic, with safe and fun equipment for kids to enjoy.Scenery is lovely, with plenty of trees.

Name: Al Forsan International Sports Resort
Description: A sports resort offering karting, shooting, equestrian and water activities.
Reviews:
Al Forsan Sports Resort in Khalifa City is an outstanding destination for families and sports lovers. The go-karting experience is perfectly organized, thrilling, and safe for all ages. The resort offers a friendly, welcoming atmosphere with excellent facilities, making it ideal for quality family time and fun-filled outings. || Absolutely amazing place to try carting and shooting real guns. Such a professional bunch of people who work by the books and kind. Best time to cart is post 2 pm and for shooting is between 10 AM and 2 PM. No online bookings so reach there early and have fun. || I was there for a team event. We paid for the Shooting and gokarting package. Staff were really friendly and professionals.

Prior to  entering the shooting range the staff briefly explained the basics, safety and about the weapon.
We were given 15 practice bullets and 10 bullets for scoring. It was a great experience. || Super cool place !! We had a great time shooting clay plates I recommend shooting clay plates our instructor was extremely knowledgeable and he made our experience that much more better thanks || I visited Abu Dhabi on New Year’s as my friend lives there. On the 1st of January, we went to Al Forsan, and from the restaurant view, I could see the karting track—it was calm, quiet, and very pleasant to watch.
The brunch and breakfast were really good, making it a nice spot to visit if you’re in Abu Dhabi. It’s conveniently located just before entering the main Abu Dhabi area, which makes it an easy and enjoyable stop.

Name: Al Qana
Description: A waterfront leisure destination with dining, entertainment and attractions.
Reviews:
Nice place for a relaxed evening in Abu Dhabi. Clean, well organized, and right on the water. Good mix of cafes and restaurants, and the atmosphere at night is calm and enjoyable. Easy parking as well. Worth a visit. || The real magical place. It’s lively, breezy, and perfect for a long waterfront walk with views of the Grand Mosque.
National aquarium & Butterfly garden doom is more attractive spot in Abudhabi.

Parking space is just opposite to this location. Parking free || We had been to Al qana before to visit national aquarium. Now it has added butterfly garden as well. This time we witnessed the spectacular Led hydrofly show. Looking forward for more. || One of the most beautiful places to be in Abu Dhabi. With plenty of great restaurants, many activities to do, such as the Aquarium of Abu Dhabi, the Butterfly garden, Biggest Cinema of Abu Dhabi and so much more…
It is amazing for a long walk and this place is also very kids friendly. 100% recommended. || Al Qana,Is a beautiful waterfront destination in Abu Dhabi that offers a lovely blend of relaxation, entertainment, and dining options.

**Atmosphere:** The moment you arrive, you’re greeted by stunning views of the water, which creates a peaceful and inviting environment. The area is well-designed, with wide pathways perfect for walking, jogging, or cycling. The landscaping is lush, featuring greenery and colorful flowers that enhance the scenic beauty.

**Activities:** There are plenty of activities to enjoy at Al Qana. Families can take advantage of the playgrounds for children, while adults may appreciate the fitness areas and outdoor gyms. You can also rent bikes or electric scooters to explore the area at your own pace.

**Dining:** Al Qana boasts a variety of restaurants and cafes that cater to different tastes. Whether you're in the mood for traditional Arabic cuisine or international dishes, you’ll find something delicious to satisfy your hunger. Many of the dining spots have outdoor seating, allowing you to enjoy your meal while taking in the beautiful views.

**Events:** The location often hosts events and activities, especially on weekends. From cultural festivals to live music performances, there’s always something happening that adds to the lively atmosphere.

**Accessibility:** The promenade is easily accessible, making it a great spot for families, tourists, and locals alike. There are plenty of parking spaces available, and the area is designed to accommodate visitors of all ages.

**Overall Experience:** A visit to Al Qana is a delightful experience. Whether you’re looking for a relaxing stroll by the water, a fun day with family, or a nice meal with friends, it’s a fantastic place to unwind and enjoy the beauty of Abu Dhabi. If you’re in the city, Al Qana is definitely worth a visit!

Name: Al Wathba Fossil Dunes
Description: A protected landscape of naturally formed fossil dunes.
Reviews:
The Fossil dunes are now closed until further notice. When it opens,  It is a good place to visit especially towards the sunset time. It is better to go in the evening as it is in  the desert and it will be very hot during day time. It is located 1 hr from Abu Dhabi city || A must -visit attraction, at least for residents and at least once.
The site contains an organized set of trails (more than 1 km long in total) which you can walk along and have a close look at the fossil dunes.
Then you can have a cup of coffee or snack at the small on-site food trucks if after 4pm when they open.
If you visit in daylight, you get the chance to view the entire site to a long distance  360° around and is preferable to be in winter.
If your visit in the evening, you get the chance to the dunes illuminated, a unique spectacle.
No 4WD car needed.
No entrance fee. || It’s cool to see the fossilised dunes up close. These fossil dunes are naturally formed structures with wind, sand, and time. It's worth taking a decent camera and visiting this place. We went in after noon so faced too hot and tired. There's not much to do. 2 main issues are the distance far away from the city and the empty surroundings with no any kind of shop around. If you go make sure you have petrol, water and food needed. There are toilets there and the parking is free. There is no entrance fee, so you can visit and enjoy that area. I would suggest visiting the evening or night. At night, dunes are more attractive with lights. Dunes near areas are in protective space and no entry. Also, they made a path way for all accessible areas. || A good tourist attraction well maintained by environment agency. Good place for photography and eco tourism destination.
Try to reach before sunset.  So that you can get amazing views of fossil dunes. Entry is free.
Evening lighting is very nice here.
Wash room facility and cafe available.
We went in sunday.  In the map it was showing closes at 4 pm, But it was open. || The place is worth visiting, few restrictions not to cross out of the boundaries kept but was fun and walk was fantastic too.
No entrance fees required.
Cafe and food tracks will be opened evening "not sure" .

Name: Al Wathba Wetland Reserve
Description: A protected wetland known for flamingos, walking trails and birdwatching.
Reviews:
A wonderful conservation effort to protect birds, especially flamingos. The reserve is peaceful, well maintained, and home to many beautiful species.
Free entry and a scenic 3 km walking trail make it a perfect place to visit with family and friends. Highly recommended for nature lovers. 🌿🦩 || Very nice place for natural evening walk and watch some birds. View of flamingos are awesome. Walkway about 3km and closing around 5.00pm. Thanks to Mr.Salem who welcomes the visitors. || If you are looking for a relaxing nature walk with a bit of bird watching, this place will surely be for you.

We tried the flamingo trail which is approximately more than 3 kms. We completed the trail in about 1 hour and 30mins but for others they might be able finish it in 45mins. Resting is more important to us, we’re not running on a marathon anyways.

Al Wathba Wetland Reserve is open from 8am to 4pm daily except monday. They are only open during winter season and close during summer. || Really wonderful place to visit. There are two roads, one of the long 3 km (my opinion more interesting than the short one), you can see flamingo and the other birds there. There are several wood houses, don't be afraid to enter and open the small window in the house that gives you a pretty cool view. Also, during the walk, you can find different types of plants, flowers, trees.
On the other road (which is short 1.5km) you can find lizards, but unfortunately, I didn't see anyone.
That is also a cool place to have a rest from the busy city, lovely quiet.
Don't forget to wear a hat and take water with you.
I asked personnel about timing. It's open from 8 am till 6 pm, last entry at 4 pm. At the end of March, it will be closed for the summer season and will be open in November. Hurry up!
Thank you for reading and have a lovely day! || Very nice view of flamingos and very well preserved wildlife near to the Abu Dhabi city very easy access to the location. The view is so beautiful feels very good the weather is bit hot carrying is best idea and some snacks

Name: Berklee Abu Dhabi
Description: A contemporary music, arts and education centre on Saadiyat Island.
Reviews:
Berklee Abu Dhabi is a world-class center for creativity and performing arts. The facilities are state-of-the-art, featuring incredible studios and performance spaces. The atmosphere is inspiring and professional, making it a premier destination for musicians and artists in the region. Truly a landmark for talent development in Saadiyat Island || I was part of the Berklee Abu Dhabi Pearl program and I had an amazing time learning from the likes of Miklos Malek, Roger Ryan and Nikolai Mishchenko.

Miklos really elevated my standards of production and mixing and the program was incredible for learning the experience of creating a complete song from scratch.

I am continuing my journey at Berklee Valencia and Boston and will always remember my days at Berklee Abu Dhabi very fondly! || Berklee Abu Dhabi has been my second home since already almost 5 years! 🙂 I feel like all professors and staff became my family, everyone is so kind and attentive ❤️
I have done the Pearl program there, as well as piano, vocal and mixing and production classes. Every instructor: Samvel, Shilpa and Miklos - were so professional, doing their best for the students.
I adored all of the classes!
I even too the mixing class twice 🙂 because I was completely a beginner at the start - and with careful guidance of Miklos Malek after the first semester I understood that I love mixing and that there is much more to learn, and having this opportunity at berklee to learn from the best - one could not miss it 🙂 and truly, after the second semester of mixing - I did understand everything much better and can now make decent mixes of my original demos.
Also, one should not miss the introductory masterclass on mixing my Miklos Malek at berklee Abu Dhabi. It was the most informative masterclass I have had. Specially for those really interested and able to listen to his advices. 👍
I also really liked to vocal classes with Shilpa and plan to continue 🙂
I would like to sincerely thank all the berklee Abu Dhabi team ❤️ || Amazing experience and knowledge … I had the chance to take the mixing and mastering course with Miklos malek a pretty decent mixing and mastering engineer. He is very knowledgeable and his way of teaching is very unique and he’s patience is remarkable and wants you to have fun as well as doing this. I highly recommend the mixing course || During my recent tour of Berklee Abu Dhabi, located in the heart of the Cultural District on Saadiyat Island, I was genuinely impressed by the vibrant atmosphere and the institution’s commitment to excellence in contemporary music, dance, and theater.

I had the privilege of being shown around by their staff, who gave me an insightful behind-the-scenes look into this inspiring collaboration between Berklee College of Music and the Department of Culture and Tourism – Abu Dhabi.

The center offers an impressive range of workshops, masterclasses, and ensemble programs, all led by world-class artists and educators. From songwriting and music production to performance coaching and industry insights, everything is designed to nurture real-world creative skills.

What stood out to me were the cutting-edge facilities—from high-tech recording studios to intimate performance spaces. These resources aren’t just for show; they give students a chance to engage directly with the tools and settings they’ll encounter in their professional careers.

One unique feature I learned about is the PEARL Certificate Programme—a competitive, immersive training course that covers not just the creative side of music but also marketing, entrepreneurship, and the business behind it all.

What I loved most was the sense of community. The center regularly hosts performances by students, alumni, and visiting international artists, creating a truly collaborative and culturally rich environment.

Berklee Abu Dhabi isn’t a traditional university—it’s a launchpad. A hub where creativity meets opportunity, and where the next wave of Middle Eastern and global artists are being shaped.

Highly recommended for anyone passionate about the performing arts or looking to immerse themselves in a world-class creative environment. 🌟

Name: Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental

Reviews:
We had a wonderful family holiday at Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental. The hotel is beautiful, the rooms were spotless, and the service was outstanding from start to finish.

Highly recommended! 😊 || I've been to Episodes Café, and I received such a warm welcome that I honestly wasn't expecting, especially since the last food orders had already closed and there were only two minutes left to order drinks.

Mennallah was the one who served me, and she made sure I could still enjoy my favorite Matcha Milkshake. I was craving something sweet for dessert, but unfortunately, I couldn't order one. Thank you, Mennallah, for your kindness and excellent service || During our stay the situation in the region suddenly became very uncertain, and what this hotel and its team did for their guests during that time was simply extraordinary. From the very first moment the staff showed an incredible level of kindness, professionalism and calm. No matter how stressful things must have been behind the scenes, every single person we encountered kept smiling and made sure the guests felt safe and cared for.
We travel a lot and stay in many hotels around the world, but we have honestly never experienced service like this before. Every question was answered patiently, every concern was taken seriously and the team went out of their way to help wherever they could. You could truly feel that they cared.
The hotel itself feels like a magical place. Beautiful, peaceful and incredibly welcoming. During a very tense time it felt like a safe haven for everyone staying there.

Thank you for taking such incredible care of us during a difficult moment. We will never forget the kindness we experienced here.

We hope to come back one day under calmer circumstances. Until then, we are simply very grateful. || I’ve traveled pretty extensively and I have yet to experience a hotel quite like this. It’s as if you are in the court of a king from the moment you walk in. Any and all luxury from around the globe is available at Emirates Palace. Care for some butterfly pea tea from Laos while having a pastry prepared by a French artisan? Absolutely. How about our array of every single date fruit imaginable? Name: Emirates Park Zoo
Description: A family zoo with animal encounters and educational activities.
Reviews:
We visited Emirates Park Zoo & Resort to celebrate my fiancée's birthday, and the entire experience exceeded our expectations.
Even though we booked at the last minute and the resort was fully booked, the team went above and beyond by upgrading us to a Premium Deluxe Room. From the moment we arrived, the welcome was warm, the check-in process was smooth, and the staff were incredibly helpful and attentive throughout our two-day stay.
The animals were clearly very well cared for, and the zoo keepers were friendly, knowledgeable, and passionate about what they do. The resort itself was peaceful and relaxing, making it the perfect place for a special celebration.
What made our stay truly unforgettable was the thoughtful surprise from the resort. Knowing it was my fiancée's birthday, they sent a complimentary birthday cake to our room, which was such a kind and heartfelt gesture.
The highlight of our visit was definitely the sea lion show. Ryan and the entire training team made the celebration even more memorable by wishing my fiancée a happy birthday during the show. Their professionalism, warmth, and generosity made us feel truly special.
A heartfelt thank you to everyone at Emirates Park Zoo & Resort for making this birthday celebration so memorable. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a unique, relaxing, and unforgettable experience. The hospitality, care, and dedication of the entire team are truly exceptional. || We stayed at Emirates Park Zoo in Abu Dhabi for a family staycation.
Visiting the zoo at night was a special experience, and my child was very happy and excited.
We stayed near the giraffe area, and opening the door to see giraffes right in front of us was amazing.

Feeding the camels was the most fun experience for me.

We enjoyed this place, and it became a wonderful family memory for us.
I would love to visit again.
Thank you so much! || WOW, where do you start with such an incredible experience.

5* experience!
Special shout out to the African drummers who were just fantastic with the kids and also for making a birthday wish come true for my 10 year old. || We recently enjoyed a fantastic staycation that included complimentary tickets to the zoo, and it turned out to be a perfect getaway! The accommodation was comfortable and relaxing, offering a much needed break from the daily routine.
The highlight was definitely the zoo visit. It was well organized, family friendly, and full of exciting animal encounters. From majestic lions to playful monkeys, every moment was engaging and memorable. The free tickets were a thoughtful touch that added great value to the overall experience.
Highly recommended for anyone looking to unwind without traveling far this staycation offers both relaxation and adventure in one package. || ​If you are looking for the best family-friendly activity in Abu Dhabi, Emirates Park Zoo is a must-visit! We spent over 3 hours here and honestly could have stayed longer—there is so much to see and do for both kids and adults.
​The Highlights:
​The Elephant Show: This was truly the star of the day! Seeing the elephants up close was such a special experience. They are majestic creatures, and the show was both educational and entertaining for the kids.
​Kid-Friendly Interaction: My kids absolutely loved how interactive everything is. From feeding the giraffes to the petting zoo area, it’s a very "hands-on" experience compared to other zoos.

Name: Etihad Arena
Description: A large indoor venue hosting concerts, sports and live entertainment.
Reviews:
Etihad Arena is a state of the art entertainment venue in Abudhabi. It is well located near the swanky Yas bay area. It is a very popular spot for big comcerts and other events. There is ample seating, while the top gallery is not very  comfortable, but provides  an excellent view of the stage. The lighting and sound system is excellent. There are  three levels of seating amd well accessible. There is ample food, snacks and drinks outlets.  The parking area takes us directly into the Yas bay. With a little walk we can reach the entrance. Please watch out for the prohibited items, lest you have to leave it at the counter. We recently visited for the AT Rahman concert and really enjoyed the show. The ticketing system can be imrpoved to be more transparent. || Etihad Arena is a wonderful indoor entertainment venue. The arena is modern, well-organized, and offers excellent views from almost every seat. The atmosphere during the fights was absolutely electric, with amazing energy from the crowd. Covering Solana Breakpoint from here was a great experience for us at SolanaFloor. Definitely a venue that supports high-quality events and media work.

Name: Ferrari World Abu Dhabi
Description: A Ferrari-themed indoor amusement park with rides and motorsport attractions.
Reviews:
We had an amazing time at Ferrari World! It was thrilling, enjoyable, and truly suitable for all ages.
Initially, I thought my 4-year-old son would not enjoy it much because most people talk about the big roller coasters. To my surprise, he had a fantastic time and was thrilled with the rides he was eligible for. There is also a dedicated area for young children with activities and rides to keep them entertained.
For thrill seekers, Flying Aces was the highlight of the day. The ride delivers an incredible adrenaline rush and is a must-try for anyone who loves roller coasters.
The food at Mamma Rossella was also excellent and exceeded our expectations.
The only disappointment was that Formula Rossa, the world's fastest roller coaster, was closed for maintenance during our visit. However, there were still plenty of exciting attractions to enjoy, and it did not take away from the overall experience.
Overall, Ferrari World offers the perfect mix of family fun and high-adrenaline attractions. Whether you visit with young kids, teenagers, or adults, there is something for everyone. Highly recommended!
Tips: Buy your tickets in advance, install the Yas Island app, and enable FacePass on your tickets before arrival to reduce entry and ride access times. || Ferrari World Abu Dhabi.

We had a fantastic experience and wanted to pass along our appreciation for such a high-quality attraction.

The park exceeded our expectations in every regard. Formula Rossa was undoubtedly the highlight of the day, providing an unforgettable adrenaline rush, and we were pleasantly surprised by how much we enjoyed the Karting Academy. Despite Flying Aces being closed during our visit, there was more than enough variety to keep our entire group—including the younger children—fully engaged for the whole day. The Junior GT driving school and the interactive 4D shows were particular favorites for the kids.

We also wanted to commend your staff for their professionalism and cheerful service. The park was exceptionally clean, well-organized, and the air-conditioned facilities made the visit very comfortable. It is rare to find a destination that caters so effectively to both extreme thrill-seekers and families with small children.

Thank you for providing such a memorable experience for our group. We highly recommend Ferrari World to anyone visiting Yas Island and look forward to returning in the future. || We visited Ferrari World Abu Dhabi as part of a group outing and had a really enjoyable experience, especially if you enjoy thrill rides and high-speed attractions.

The highlight of the day was the world’s fastest roller coaster, which delivered an intense and unforgettable rush. The park offers a solid variety of attractions, making it easy to spend a full day exploring and moving between different experiences.

The Karting Academy was a pleasant surprise and turned out to be one of the most entertaining activities of the visit. Although Flying Aces was closed during the trip, there was still more than enough to enjoy throughout the day.

Overall, it’s a strong theme park experience, especially for anyone who enjoys speed, adrenaline, and high-energy rides. || Visiting Ferrari World Abu Dhabi today with our family was an absolute blast! From the moment we stepped inside the iconic red roof, we were immersed in a high-energy, world-class experience that exceeded all expectations.

The park is incredibly well-organized, spotlessly clean, and surprisingly family-friendly. While it's famous for record-breaking rides like Formula Rossa—the world's fastest roller coaster—there was so much more for everyone in our group, including younger children. Our kids loved the Junior GT driving school, Junior Grand Prix, and the interactive 4D shows. It was wonderful to see them giggle with joy and feel like little champions.

The staff were professional, attentive, and genuinely cheerful, making safety feel seamless and fun. We also appreciated the variety of dining options, shaded rest areas, and the smooth ride operations—barely any unexpected downtime.

Beyond the thrills, the Italian-themed details, live entertainment, and simulator experiences added a layer of polish you'd expect from a top global attraction. We left with huge smiles, tired legs, and a camera roll full of happy faces.

Whether you're an adrenaline junkie or visiting with little ones, Ferrari World delivers a five-star, high-octane day out for the whole family. Highly recommended – we can't wait to come back! || Such a great place for thrill seekers. Plenty of rides for raising your adrenaline. You have everything here fast and slow rides. Great setting of Italian streets. Some of the virtual experiences could use a upgrade in the video quality as the videos seem dates for today's clarity. But the roller coaster rides especially the flying aces is AMAZING. Rossa is also good considering how fast it goes.

Name: Heritage Village Abu Dhabi
Description: A reconstructed traditional village showing crafts, desert life and local heritage.
Reviews:
A nostalgic glimpse into traditional Emirati life, the Emirates Heritage Village is one of those places that has been part of Abu Dhabi for years. It seems to be undergoing some changes recently — the animals have been moved and a few areas look like they’re being updated — but it still remains a meaningful cultural stop.The entrance is free, which makes it easy to wander in and explore at your own pace. Inside, you’ll find small workshops, traditional huts, and a museum showcasing local culture, clothing, crafts, and the history of how life once looked in the UAE. The displays are simple but informative, and they always bring a sense of appreciation for the country’s roots.

There are also several little shops where you can buy souvenirs, handmade items, and thoughtful gifts. It’s a great place to take visitors who want something authentic to take home.One of my favorite parts is the beautiful view of the water — the Corniche stretching out in front of you, with the traditional boats and calm sea creating a peaceful backdrop. You can sit for a moment and enjoy the breeze, especially in the late afternoon when the light is soft.

Despite the ongoing changes, Emirates Heritage Village still holds a special charm. It’s a quiet cultural corner of the city that blends history, arts, and a lovely waterfront setting. || Heritage Village in Abu Dhabi is a fantastic place to experience the UAE’s rich culture and traditions. The village beautifully showcases traditional Emirati life, with authentic displays of Bedouin tents, handicrafts, and local markets. Walking through the site gives a real sense of the country’s heritage and history.
The staff are welcoming and happy to explain the exhibits, and you can even watch artisans at work — from pottery to weaving. It’s both educational and visually captivating, making it perfect for families, tourists, and photography enthusiasts alike.
A peaceful and cultural escape in the heart of Abu Dhabi — definitely worth a visit! || Heritage Village was a good and enriching visit. We bought fridge magnets from there, which felt nice as it supports the local market, even though there are only a few stalls. The village also has small museums that showcase Arabian pearl mining heritage, traditional tools, and beautiful embroidery work on clothing.

Behind the Heritage Village, there’s a small beach with great views, making it a pleasant spot to relax and enjoy the surroundings. Overall, it’s a nice place to visit if you’re interested in local culture and history. || In my experience, Emirates Heritage Village is a wonderful place to explore the traditional culture and history of the UAE.
The location is peaceful, and the village showcases old-style houses, crafts, and traditional tools. The view of the Abu Dhabi skyline from the beach area is also beautiful.

The staff are friendly, and there are many small shops where you can buy handmade crafts and souvenirs. It’s a good place for families, tourists, and anyone who wants to learn about Emirati heritage.

Overall, a calm, educational, and enjoyable spot to visit in Abu Dhabi. || I recently visited the Emirates Heritage Village and was disappointed with the experience. As a visitor from the UK, I was keen to learn more about Emirati history and culture; however, I found the site somewhat lacking in information.

While there were several pleasant displays, the venue felt more geared towards photo opportunities and gift shops than providing a truly educational experience.

The experience is free and there is also free parking at the entrance.

Name: Jubail Mangrove Park
Description: A mangrove boardwalk and nature attraction focused on coastal ecosystems.
Reviews:
Jubail Mangrove Park is a wonderful place to relax and enjoy nature. The wooden walkway through the mangroves offers a peaceful and calming experience, making it perfect for an evening stroll. The sunset views were absolutely stunning, with the golden light shining through the mangrove trees and creating a beautiful atmosphere.

If you’re looking to escape the city’s hustle and spend some quiet time surrounded by nature, this is definitely a place worth visiting. || Jubail Mangrove Park is one of Abu Dhabi’s absolute hidden gems and a place that truly deserves more appreciation. The entire experience is peaceful, beautifully organized, and deeply refreshing, offering visitors a rare chance to connect with nature in such a calm and well-maintained setting. The boardwalk is thoughtfully designed, the surroundings are pristine, and every part of the park reflects care, planning, and respect for the environment.

What makes this place even more special is how effortlessly it combines ecological preservation with public accessibility. It allows families, tourists, fitness enthusiasts, and nature lovers to enjoy the mangroves without disturbing their natural beauty. The views are stunning, especially during sunrise or sunset, and the atmosphere feels almost therapeutic.

Hats off to the Abu Dhabi government for maintaining this absolute gem with such dedication and vision. Spaces like Jubail Mangrove Park are a testament to how urban development and environmental conservation can go hand in hand. It is clean, serene, educational, and genuinely uplifting. Whether you are looking for a quiet walk, a scenic outing, or simply a break from city life, this park is a must-visit. Abu Dhabi should be proud of this remarkable destination. || Beautiful Mangrove with a very nice elevated walkway. Much larger and in better care than Dubai’s mangrove. Perfect to watch the sun set. Tickets are 20aed and can be purchased on location with no waiting time. Parking is free. Just across the Royal stables. || What a beautiful place! Big thanks to our driver Munavar for a great tour! My parents were impressed with the park, all the information about mangrove trees and other flora and fauna.
Highly recommend! || My girlfriend and I had an amazing sunset kayaking experience at Jubail Mangrove Park. It was our first time kayaking, and we were a little nervous at the beginning, especially my girlfriend, but our guide Clavice was incredibly kind, patient, and supportive. He encouraged us throughout the trip and made us feel comfortable and confident. The sunset views through the mangroves were breathtaking, and the whole experience was peaceful, relaxing, and unforgettable. Thank you, Clavice, for making our first kayaking adventure so special. Highly recommended!

Name: Kai Beach Saadiyat
Description: A managed beach destination with swimming and leisure facilities.
Reviews:
Amazing experience.  Saadiyat island has the best beaches in UAE. Kai beach is super clean, the staff is very attentive,  water is magical,  turquoise and crystal clear. Parking is generous,  gets full quickly though but there are a lot of spaces.
The food was great, we had nicoise salad, one of the best,  and dynamite shrimps. They also serve freshly squeezed juices , yummm and refreshing. Definitely coming back. || Had a really nice experience at Kai Beach overall. I actually tried to come the day before, but it was already at full capacity. However, the lady at the reception was very kind and helpful and suggested another nearby beach club since I had driven all the way from Dubai, which I really appreciated.

The next day, I came early in the morning to make sure I could get a spot and finally experience Kai Beach — and honestly, it was worth it. I paid AED 225, including AED 100 redeemable on food and beverages at the restaurant, which I found reasonable for the experience.

The beach staff were very attentive and professional. The guys helped clean the sand off my sunbed before I settled in, which was a nice touch. The beach itself is absolutely beautiful — crystal clear water, stunning turquoise color, and honestly it feels like being on a tropical island.

The restaurant food was also great. I tried the Salmon Poke Bowl and really enjoyed it.

The amenities are clean and nice overall, but one thing I noticed is that there’s no mirror or hairdryer in the shower/changing area. You have to go to the toilet section just to find a mirror and brush your hair. Also, no towels are provided, so definitely bring your own towel. Luckily, I had mine with me, otherwise you need to purchase one there.

The only downside during my visit was the beach service timing. I ordered water and a fresh juice from my sunbed, and it took more than 40 minutes to arrive. Under the heat, when you’re thirsty, that wait feels very long. To be fair, the team apologized and offered me a complimentary juice, which I genuinely appreciated. Still, I think improving the service speed would make the experience even better.

That said, the entire team was polite, welcoming, and extremely professional throughout the day.

Overall, I would definitely come back 10000% and I’ll absolutely recommend Kai Beach to my friends. || I always wanted to visit Kai Beach Saadiyat and had really high expectations - but unfortunately, the reality didn’t live up to them.

From the entrance, everything looked absolutely beautiful and aesthetic - the ambiance gives that perfect “island getaway” vibe at first. However, once you actually get to the beach area, the experience quickly changes. It was extremely crowded, and there were crows everywhere, which made it hard to relax.

Despite the AED 150 entry fee, they don’t even provide towels, which is quite disappointing. The cabanas in front are chargeable, while the ones in the back without any roof are free - which doesn’t make much sense.

We ordered food, and it took 40 minutes (and a follow-up call) for a simple poke bowl to arrive a honestly, it would have been faster to order through Talabat. The staff seemed careless and not attentive at all, often passing tasks to one another instead of helping. Even the security guards didn’t seem very alert, spending more time on their phones than actually supervising the area.

The only real highlight of the visit was the water itself - crystal clear and beautiful - but that’s thanks to Saadiyat Island, not the beach club. || Had an amazing time at Kai Beach! 🌊
A big thank you to Karnajit for sharing such wonderful social media content with us. We truly enjoyed every moment — delicious food, refreshing drinks, and a beautiful beach view that makes you want to stay forever.

It was also perfect for our recovery after the Dubai Marathon 🏅 — relaxing vibes, great food, and the calming beach atmosphere were exactly what we needed.

The place is relaxed and welcoming, ideal for unwinding and recharging. Definitely a spot to visit if you love good food, great drinks, and a stunning beach setting. 💙

Can’t wait to come back! || The beach is amazingggg very clean and the food is delicious but the staff look like they are forced to work. They have an attitude which didn’t make me feel welcome. I was scared to order a second time 😂 they also don’t provide towels, all other beaches do! The ticket costs AED150 and AED50 is redeemable for drinks only which you have to order it yourself they won’t deliver it to your sunbed. I would explore nearby beaches for a better experience.

Name: Khalifa Park
Description: A large public park with gardens, museum spaces and family recreation.
Reviews:
ADQ'26. Held at Khalifa Park was a very entertaining family carvinal. Enough option for kids to play, games games to win, enough food options. ADQ companies showcased attractive activities for children with ample freebies. Ofcourse can't forget the open cinema experience. Overall great fun with family. || I went to the ADQ event with my Family. Paid 40 Aed per person for whole event that's a cool thing.
But for the stalls inside they require kids to be present before giving the free item's
And when I brought my 3 kids they give me only one piece
And all the other families even get more than their family members count.
That's very bad and rude behaviour || The park is clean, peaceful, and well-maintained with plenty of green space and shaded areas. Entrance fee is only 2 AED, and the train ride costs around 10 AED for 2 pax. It’s perfect for walking, relaxing, BBQs, picnics, or simply unwinding with family and friends. Lots of parking is available, and the peaceful atmosphere with no noise makes it a refreshing and affordable place to visit. Definitely worth the visit. || It’s an iconic park that is well taken care of. I usually visit it in the afternoons, quiet and caters for different ages. My gym is placed in there so I go there at least three times a week. || Khalifa Park in Abu Dhabi is a popular and well-regarded destination, offering a variety of attractions and amenities for visitors of all ages.

Khalifa Park, named in honor of His Highness Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed Al Nahyan, is one of the largest and most popular parks in Abu Dhabi. Spread across 500,000 square meters, it opened in 2007 and provides a family-friendly green space escape while being conveniently located near popular tourist attractions and residential communities.

​Cultural Library: Offers a space for reading and learning.
​Maritime Khalifa Park Museum: Showcases maritime history.
​Murjan Splash Park: A fun-filled water park for children.
​Mini Train Rides: A popular way for kids to tour the park.
​Open Auditorium: Hosts events and performances.
​Ponds and Fountains: Provide a serene environment for relaxation.
​Time Tunnel: A unique ride that takes visitors through historical scenes of the UAE.
​Aquarium: Features a series of small aquariums with various fish and sea life.
​BBQ Facilities: Available for visitors to enjoy outdoor cooking.
​Playgrounds: For children to enjoy.
​Amenities and Facilities:
​Food Trucks: Onsite food trucks offer quick bites like shawarma, sandwiches, and juices.
​Parking: Ample parking is available.
​Accessibility: The park is wheelchair-accessible with ramps, elevators, and wheelchair-friendly pathways. Wheelchairs are also available for rent.
​Wi-Fi: Free Wi-Fi access is available throughout the park.
​Pets: Pets are not allowed inside the park.

The park offers a blend of natural beauty and modern amenities, making it a versatile spot for both leisure and play. The entrance fee is affordable, with AED 2 for adults and children over 3 years old, though some attractions inside the park may have separate fees.

Name: Louvre Abu Dhabi
Description: A universal art museum presenting works from different cultures and periods.
Reviews:
Louvre Abu Dhabi is one of the most remarkable cultural destinations in the UAE. The architecture alone is worth the visit, with its iconic dome creating beautiful patterns of light throughout the museum. The collection is thoughtfully curated, bringing together artworks and historical artifacts from different civilizations and time periods in a way that tells a global human story.

The galleries are spacious, well organized, and easy to explore at your own pace. The staff are professional and helpful, and the museum is exceptionally clean and well maintained. The waterfront location adds to the experience, offering stunning views and a peaceful atmosphere. Whether you are interested in art, history, or architecture, this museum provides an inspiring and memorable visit. Highly recommended for residents and tourists alike. || I had an amazing experience with Namimarine! The catamaran ride was beautiful, clean, and very comfortable. Watching the sunset and seeing the views around Louvre Abu Dhabi from the water was unforgettable. The staff were friendly, professional, and made the whole experience enjoyable from start to finish. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a unique and relaxing experience in Abu Dhabi! I would also like to thank 🙏 Nikin and Nael for their outstanding customer service and hospitality. They made the experience even more enjoyable 🙏❤️ || Louvre Abu Dhabi is a remarkable blend of art, culture, and architecture. The museum's iconic dome and stunning waterfront setting create a memorable experience even before you enter the galleries.

The exhibits are thoughtfully curated, offering fascinating insights into human history and creativity across different civilizations. I was particularly impressed by how seamlessly the collections connect cultures and time periods.

A special appreciation to the staff, who were courteous, professional, and always ready to assist visitors. Their warm hospitality added greatly to the overall experience.

A must-visit destination in Abu Dhabi for anyone interested in art, history, or simply outstanding architecture. || Louvre Abu Dhabi is one of those places where architecture alone already feels like an exhibition. Calm, elegant, and quietly powerful—it’s not just a museum you walk through, but an experience you slow down for.

The galleries are beautifully curated, connecting human history across cultures and time rather than separating art by country. You’ll move from ancient civilizations to modern masterpieces in a way that feels thoughtful and surprisingly emotional. The atmosphere is peaceful, never overwhelming, making it perfect for both art lovers and casual visitors.

What really steals the show is the iconic dome. Sunlight filters through it like a soft “rain of light,” constantly changing as the day goes on—standing underneath it feels almost meditative.

Little facts you’ll love:
•	The dome is made of 8 layers of geometric patterns, creating that signature light effect.
•	The museum sits on the water, inspired by traditional Arabic medinas surrounded by the sea.
•	It’s the first universal museum in the Arab world, telling global stories instead of regional ones.
•	The dome weighs roughly the same as the Eiffel Tower—but floats visually like a cloud.

Peaceful, inspiring, and beautifully designed. Louvre Abu Dhabi isn’t loud or flashy—it’s confident, poetic, and unforgettable. || A brilliant cultural landmark that beautifully connects global histories. The architecture alone is stunning, but the chronological galleries are the true highlight.
The collection of Egyptian artifacts is deeply impressive, offering a fascinating look at ancient craftsmanship. Walking through the halls to see classical Roman and Greek sculptures alongside an excellent selection of paintings makes for an unforgettable experience.
A world-class museum that masterfully bridges Eastern and Western art. It is an absolute must-visit on Saadiyat Island.

**Booked the 70AED ticket in advance. Went on Sunday at 10am and spent 4 hours. No waiting time and not overcrowded. Place is clean, neat and properly organized.

Name: Manarat Al Saadiyat
Description: A cultural centre hosting art exhibitions, workshops and community events.
Reviews:
A Cultural Gem in Abu Dhabi — Manarat Al Saadiyat

I visited Manarat Al Saadiyat hoping to catch the Studio Ghibli Exhibition. While it was sad to learn the show had been postponed, I feel blessed that I still got to experience the gallery.

I had the chance to see the kids’ art workshops in action, and I was genuinely impressed by the skillful paintings created by the students. It’s wonderful how Manarat Al Saadiyat gives opportunities to the new generation of artists and nurtures their creativity. The space itself is beautiful and inspiring for all ages.

Special thanks to Ibrahim for his warm welcome and thoughtful guidance, and to Aseel for making the visit so pleasant with her kindness. Both of you made a disappointing change turn into a memorable experience.

I’ll definitely be back for the Ghibli exhibition when it opens. Highly recommended for art lovers and families! || We love visiting Manarat Al Saadiyat as a family. The staff are always friendly and welcoming. We visit the art drop in regularly and are always pleased with the range of art activities to work through. We were recently invited to join an after school childrens workshop using clay and resin which the children loved doing. Liz was very patient with the children and the creations at the end were lovely. We will definitely do more workshops in the future, as well as continuing to enjoy the rest of the art studio. || Manarat Al Saadiyat is a beautiful and inspiring place that combines art, culture, and creativity in a modern setting.
The exhibitions are well curated, the facilities are excellent, and the staff are welcoming and helpful. Whether you’re interested in contemporary art, photography, workshops, or cultural events, there is always something interesting to explore.
The atmosphere is peaceful and family-friendly, making it a great place for both residents and visitors. Highly recommended for anyone looking to experience Abu Dhabi’s vibrant cultural scene. || Manarat Al Saadiyat is a place I’ve been visiting for three years now, and every time it fills me with a fresh wave of inspiration.
I visited the gallery yesterday, and once again I was impressed by the exceptional level of organization and attention to detail. You can truly feel the respect for art and for the audience.

Many of the works on display stunned me with their depth and professionalism. It’s clear that the curators carefully select each exhibition, creating a space where you don’t just view art - you experience it.

As an artist, I deeply appreciate cultural initiatives like this. I sincerely wish exhibitions of this level were held more often and lasted longer, as they genuinely enrich the creative community.

I highly recommend visiting, whether you’re an art lover or simply seeking a place to recharge with new ideas and emotions🎨✨ || Manarat Al Saadiyat is a wonderful space for art lovers and visitors alike. The gallery offers free entry, making art and exhibitions accessible to everyone. The exhibitions are thoughtfully curated, showcasing diverse artistic expressions in a calm and inspiring environment. The space itself is beautifully designed, open, peaceful, and perfect for taking your time to truly engage with the artwork. It’s an ideal place to relax, reflect, and enjoy culture, especially if you’re looking for a meaningful and enriching experience without any cost. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Saadiyat Island.

Name: Mangrove National Park
Description: A protected mangrove area offering kayaking and wildlife viewing.
Reviews: An amazing experience at Mangrove Marine National Park! The place is peaceful and surrounded by beautiful nature. Kayaking through the mangroves was truly relaxing and unique. The water is calm, and the environment is very clean and well maintained. Perfect spot for nature lovers and adventure at the same time. Highly recommended || Awesome experience. Ensure you are going at high tide to get the full experience. We had a blast, and || Love love love the experience. We checked the tide forecast and we could enjoy a high tied in the mangroves. Cool experience || I visited recently it was such a peaceful escape. Being surrounded by mangroves and calm water felt completely different from the usual city vibe. The air was fresh, the scenery was beautiful, and everything felt untouched and natural. It's the perfect place to slow down, enjoy the quiet, and reconnect with nature. I left feeling relaxed and refreshed. Definitely a special experience. || Calm peaceful place with lot of nature's sounds..best for a evening walk entry fee is 15 AED, beautiful sunset can be watched

Name: Marsana Hudayriyat
Description: A waterfront leisure district with dining, beach access and activities.
Reviews:
marsana in hudayriyat is honestly one of those places where you can spend the whole day without running out of things to do. the atmosphere is relaxing, the whole area is clean and beautifully maintained, and everything feels well thought out — from the shaded walkways to the open green spaces.

the kids’ splash park is a winner, especially with the shaded areas that make it bearable even in hotter months. plenty of play zones, open lawns, photo spots, and good seating everywhere. it’s the kind of place where the kids can run around safely while the adults just unwind and enjoy the breeze.

the food truck and restaurant options are plenty as well, and the whole vibe of the place is just calm and welcoming. the beachfront access is another huge plus (some paid some free)— you get that nice sea view without feeling crowded.

overall, it’s one of the best family-friendly destinations in abu dhabi. clean, organised, peaceful and full of things to explore. definitely a spot we’ll keep coming back to. || ​Such a cool new destination! Marsana is perfect for families looking for a relaxed outing. Great food options, plenty of play space for the kids, and really convenient parking. Whether you want to get in the water sports or just grab a bite by the beach, it’s got a really nice. Paid beach area with all facilties available. || Clean and beautiful beach with lot of activities and ambience is superb.One of the best spot for holiday enjoyment with family.. || The place is well kept and solemn. Perfect for quiet walks, run, or if you just want to catch some peace.

They have free EV car chargers too ☺️ || Marsana at Hudayriyat is a lively and beautifully designed waterfront destination perfect for dining and relaxing. With a variety of restaurants and cafés overlooking the beach, it offers a vibrant yet peaceful atmosphere. The seating areas are comfortable, the surroundings are clean and well organized, and the sea view adds a special charm—especially in the evening. A great spot to enjoy good food and quality time with family and friends.

Name: Nation Riviera Beach Club
Description: A private beach and leisure club along the Corniche.
Reviews:
My experience at St. Regis was excellent. It’s a beautiful place to relax, unwind, and enjoy the summer atmosphere. The service was outstanding and truly deserves a 10/10 rating. One of the details I really appreciated was how the staff handed out cold towels with a refreshing menthol scent, which was perfect for the warm weather. They also provided ice buckets filled with bottled water, a thoughtful touch that made the experience even more comfortable. Overall, St. Regis offers a premium and relaxing experience with exceptional hospitality. It’s definitely a place I would recommend and look forward to visiting again. || Stunning beach club. Truly feels high end and attention to detail is evident. Staff are all very welcoming and friendly, and you are never short of a towel or water bottle here. The pool area is classy and brings out the best of the area it is in. Lovely beach area with clean sand and comfortable bed options. The gym is good for your average gym goer. More advanced lifters would maybe struggle to get a good workout with limited weights but does the trick. || An exceptional Lunch at Cabana Bar & Grill! 🌅 The food was absolutely delicious — the brisket sandwich was out of this world, tender and packed with flavor. There were also plenty of great options for kids, making it a perfect spot for families.

A special mention goes to Bhaskar, whose outstanding service made our visit even better. He was attentive, kind, and made sure everything was perfect from start to finish.

Fantastic food, wonderful atmosphere, and top-notch service — couldn’t recommend it more! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ || Always great service, special mention for Vincent as he's awesome 😎 food and drinks are good quality and reasonably priced.

Changing facilities and pool are clean and well looked after, beach is immaculate. || Had an amazing lunch here! The place is absolutely top-tier and the vibe is great. The staff was wonderful, but a special shout-out goes to Bhaskar—he was fantastic and made the experience even better. Highly recommended

Name: Observation Deck at 300
Description: A high-rise observation lounge with panoramic city and Corniche views.
Reviews:
I had a wonderful time at Observation Desk Etihad Towers. Amazing views of Abu Dhabi downtown and near islands. Good selection of soft drinks, fresh juices, coffee and pastries || Absolutely stunning! The Observation Deck at 300 on the 74th floor of Etihad Towers is a must-do in Abu Dhabi. At 300 meters up, you get the highest 360-degree panoramic views of the city — the sparkling Arabian Gulf, the iconic Corniche, Emirates Palace, and the sprawling skyline all in one breathtaking sweep.
It’s a breathtaking experience, you get to see how fast and massive Abu Dhabi and the UAE in general grew in just 54 years! || Disappointing experience.  Booked several months in advance but when arrived was told there was a private function.

No one seemed to know what to do.  Eventually we were put in a loft to the 45th floor.  When got out of lift the concierge wasn't expecting us and had to explain the whole situation again.  They said they could provide an afternoon tea and we were sat by a window with amazing views.

Afternoon Tea was very tasty.  Shame about the stained table cloth.

Not the experience I had booked and paid for several months in advance. || A must see. it's located on the 74th floor of Tower 2 at Conrad Abu Dhabi Etihad Towers, offering panoramic views from a height of approximately 300 meters (984 feet), making it Abu Dhabi's highest vantage point for 360-degree cityscapes, the Arabian Gulf, and the Corniche. || don’t miss the observation deck at 300 of Etihad towers if you’re in abu dhabi.
you can see Abu Dhabi’s skyline and overview of the city.

Name: Pixoul Gaming
Description: An indoor gaming and esports entertainment venue at Al Qana.
Reviews:
Pixoul Gaming Abu Dhabi is easily one of the most exciting entertainment destinations in the city. The moment you walk in, you can feel the futuristic vibe, with immersive lighting, high-end gaming setups, and a wide variety of experiences that go far beyond a typical gaming center.

What really stands out is the diversity, from advanced VR adventures to classic arcade games and modern console setups, there’s something for everyone, whether you’re a hardcore gamer or just looking to have fun with friends or family. The VR experiences in particular are incredibly immersive and unlike anything you’d find in a regular gaming lounge. || What an amazing place. If your children are having a birthday then this is perfect. Rania is fantastic and took care of us from booking to packing up after a fabulous 3 hr party. So much fun! Thanks!! || We celebrated my son, Syed Samir’s, birthday on 31st January 2026, and I would like to express our sincere appreciation for the exceptionally well-organized and thoughtfully planned event. The celebration truly exceeded our expectations.

I would especially like to acknowledge Ms. Rani for her outstanding support and cooperation. From the very first enquiry through to the successful execution of the event, she was extremely helpful, professional, and reassuring. Initially, I was a bit hesitant about hosting my son’s birthday at Pixoul, but Ms. Rani’s confidence and commitment convinced us—and we are truly glad we trusted her. The entire experience was far better than we had anticipated, and this was largely due to her dedicated efforts.

In addition, I would like to commend the entire team involved in the event. Everyone was courteous, attentive, and ensured that the service and overall experience were excellent.

Overall, we are extremely satisfied and will certainly recommend Pixoul Gaming to our friends and family. We also look forward to celebrating future birthdays at Pixoul, thanks to the highly cooperative and professional team—especially Ms. Rani, whom our entire family thanks from the bottom of our hearts.

Thank you once again, and see you soon.

I strongly recommend this place. || We recently hosted a gaming party and it was an amazing experience!
There was a great set up in the party room. Rania was fantastic as the party entertainer. She was energetic, engaging, and did a great job leading the party games and keeping all the kids involved and excited throughout the event.
The children especially loved the VR experiences and PC games, which were a huge hit from start to finish. There was something for everyone, and the variety of games kept the kids entertained the entire time. The atmosphere was fun, lively, and perfectly suited for a memorable celebration.
Thank you to Rania and the team for making the party such a success. The kids had an incredible time, and we would highly recommend this venue for any gaming-themed birthday party! || Great for birthday celebrations. Kids loved it, staff friendly and cooperative and did alot in a very short notice. Highly appreciated.

Name: Qasr Al Hosn
Description: Abu Dhabi's oldest stone building and a major heritage landmark.
Reviews:
For me personally, the Emirates is a country of culture, mutual respect, and kindness. I cannot imagine life here without the Al Hosn Festival. Every year, I look forward to it with excitement. Once it begins, I visit two or even three times just to fully experience it and carry those beautiful memories with me for the rest of the year.

This country truly represents goodness and love. It is something deeply admirable and worthy of appreciation. Thank you for the warmth, the hospitality, and the beautiful spirit that makes this place so special. || Al Hosn Festival is a wonderful annual celebration of Emirati heritage, culture, and creativity. The festival showcases local handicrafts, traditional items, cuisine, and cultural experiences, and the 2026 edition lived up to the same high standards as always.

The arrangements were excellent and very well organized, with plenty of traditional performances, engaging display stalls, and a great mix of local and fusion food outlets.
