One of the standout highlights was the painting exhibition by local artists, along with the free guided tour of the Postal Stamps Museum.

Our guide was extremely welcoming and knowledgeable, beautifully narrating the history and evolution of stamps and postal services in UAE history. A truly enriching experience and a must visit festival for anyone interested in Emirati culture and heritage. || Beautiful palace/fortress in the middle of the city. There’s a great exhibition at the entrance providing the backdrop to visiting the actual palace! There’s building itself is beautifully designed with cleverly designed windows towers to bring coolness in during the hot weather! Plenty of shady areas to shield from the heat! || For photographers. Don’t take your camera with you. The security guards will come and tell you to put it away. If you want to take photos with your camera then you have to email them first and get permission to post. It doesn’t make any sense but that’s the rules. Otherwise it’s a pretty place. There should be a little water pond in there but this time there was not sick thing. The place is very photogenic. You’d have amazing background for your photos. But yes. Get permission first if you want to do it with your professional camera. || A stunning piece of history right in the middle of modern Abu Dhabi. Qasr Al Hosn is a beautiful contrast of the old and the new. Even if you only walk around the exterior, the architecture of the watchtower and the white fort is incredible. It is a very peaceful and well-preserved site that tells the story of the city's beginnings. A must-see for anyone visiting the downtown area."

Name: Qasr Al Watan
Description: The UAE presidential palace visitor attraction with grand halls and exhibitions.
Reviews:
Qasr Al Watan – impressive, but crowded and restrictive

Qasr Al Watan is an interesting place to visit, but be prepared. Compared to my first visit, things have changed a lot. I went again during the Christmas season, and it was extremely crowded. We waited at least one hour just to get in.

Dress code matters. Do not wear anything that could be considered too short or too revealing. If your outfit doesn’t meet their standards, you can be refused entry, no discussion.

The palace itself is huge and very impressive architecturally. Visually, it’s powerful and worth seeing. However, the experience involves a lot of waiting and moving through long lines, which takes away from the visit.

Once you’re done, you leave the site by shuttle bus that takes you back to the exit area or parking. Logistics are well organized, but it still feels very controlled.

Bottom line: worth visiting for the architecture and symbolism, but expect crowds, strict rules, and patience-testing queues, especially during peak season. || a must see especially those visiting abu dhabi  first time, this place has a massive halls and garden place, high ceilings and the arts displayed inside. I recommend to go around 4pm for tour inside and watch the palace in motion light show which usually starts at 7:45pm || Without a doubt one of the coolest places I’ve seen. The palace is breathtaking. So many beautiful details to take in and the scale of it is extraordinary. A must-visit in Abu Dhabi, and I say that as a resident here. The dance between the golden and blue colors in this palace is so elegant. Catch the sunset once you exit because it gives a calm feeling to the place. Got a coffee on my exit, there’s sandwiches and icecream available too which is really cool. Outdoor seating area and fountains are amazing. A complete package. I can’t recommend this palace enough. || Qasr Al Watan is absolutely breathtaking. The architecture is stunning, and the entire palace has such a serene, peaceful energy. You could easily spend a whole day wandering through the halls and gardens just soaking it all in. A truly beautiful and must-see experience! || This presidential palace is the very definition of LUXURY.

It is truly breathtaking to see it all. Each room has its own charm and character. And learning about its entire history is absolutely incredible.

Regarding the dress code, shoulders and knees must be covered for both men and women.

I 100% recommend this stop in Abu Dhabi. Affordable price and zero regrets during the visit.

Name: Reem Central Park
Description: A waterfront urban park with play areas, sports spaces and walking paths.
Reviews:
Reem Park is one of my favourite places to unwind. Even though it’s surrounded by buildings, the moment you enter, it feels peaceful and relaxing. There’s so much to do for everyone — kayaking by the mangroves, basketball, skating, table tennis, and plenty of open grass areas to stretch out, relax, or have a picnic.

Families, runners, dog walkers, and friends all enjoy the space together. The beach area is a lovely touch, and the water fountain adds such a calming atmosphere. I also love the little café and the food trucks — perfect for grabbing a coffee or a quick bite while enjoying the outdoors.

Parking is paid and a bit limited, but having it on site is convenient.Overall, Reem Park is a vibrant community spot with something for all ages. Whether you want to move, unwind, or socialise, this park really brings people together. Highly recommended! || Al Reem Central Park is one of the nicest spots in Abu Dhabi for a walk or just to unwind. The combination of waterfront views, greenery, and the city skyline gives it a really calm and refreshing atmosphere. The walking and jogging tracks are well designed, making it perfect for daily exercise, especially in the early morning or around sunset.

It’s also very family-friendly, with plenty of open spaces and play areas, and there are good café and dining options nearby if you want to sit and relax afterward. The park is clean, well maintained, and feels safe at all times.

It can get quite busy in the evenings and on weekends, so going earlier in the day makes a big difference. Overall, it’s a great addition to Abu Dhabi and definitely one of the best places to spend some quality time outdoors. || Reem Central Park is one of the best outdoor spaces on Reem Island and a great spot for all ages.

The park has dedicated sports areas, including basketball and football courts, a skate park, and wide walking and jogging paths that are perfect for daily exercise or evening strolls. The walkways are well-designed and very pleasant, especially during cooler hours.

There are several cafés and restaurants around the park, along with small cabins offering ice cream, snacks, and fast food, which makes it easy to spend hours there without needing to leave.

For water and outdoor activity lovers, kayaking and paddling are available, and you can even find horse riding activities, which adds a unique experience compared to other parks in the city.

Clean, spacious, family-friendly, and lively—highly recommended for sports, relaxation, and social time. 🌿🏀🚶‍♀️🍦 || Al Reem Central Park is a clean, well-maintained, and enjoyable destination for all ages. The park offers long walking paths, plenty of children’s play areas, and a large skate park. There are many clean washrooms conveniently distributed throughout the park. Visitors can enjoy sea activities such as kayaking and water bikes, along with several food, coffee, and ice cream outlets. Parking is paid, but overall the experience is excellent and well worth the visit. || Just love the park loads for kids to do, lots of options for the mangroves and the beach is good at parts. Some bits don't have that much sand but the main bit is really good.
Dogs allowed too and my boy loves going in for a paddle

Name: Reem Mall
Description: A shopping and leisure mall featuring retail, dining and indoor attractions.
Reviews:
Al Reem Mall is a fantastic addition to Abu Dhabi. The mall is modern, spacious, and beautifully designed with a great selection of retail stores and dining options. Everything feels clean and well organized, and parking is very convenient. It’s perfect for shopping, family outings, or just spending a relaxed afternoon. Highly recommended. || ​Reem Mall is a fantastic addition to Abu Dhabi's retail landscape. Located on Reem Island, it's incredibly spacious with a fantastic variety of brands that cater to every shopping need. The mall is designed for easy access, making your visit smooth and enjoyable from the moment you arrive. Whether you're looking for casual wear or diverse dining options, you'll find it all in a modern, comfortable setting. It truly provides a comprehensive retail and lifestyle experience right in the heart of the capital || ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Reem Mall is truly one of the best shopping and lifestyle destinations in Abu Dhabi! The mall is very spacious, clean, and beautifully designed, making it comfortable to walk around even during busy times.👑💚💯🫶

There is a great mix of international brands, restaurants, and entertainment options for all ages. I especially love how family-friendly it is — from shopping to dining and fun activities, everything is in one place.💚👑🇦🇪

The atmosphere is relaxing, not too crowded, and the facilities are well-maintained. Parking is also very convenient, which makes every visit stress-free.
🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟👉🇦🇪
Highly recommended for anyone looking for a complete shopping, dining, and leisure experience in Abu Dhabi. Definitely worth visiting again and again! 💯✨👑👉🇦🇪🫶 || Great shopping experience at Reem Mall. The mall is modern, spacious, and very clean with a great mix of shops, restaurants, and entertainment. Perfect for families and friends. The highlight is Snow Abu Dhabi, which offers a unique winter experience in the city. Highly recommended! || EL& N- Shakshouka was great, tasted fresh and delicious. Spanish latte and latte were average for the price paid and less quantity.
Hot chocolate was average.
Almond croissant and tres leches cake are a must try!
Great ambiance.

Name: Saadiyat Beach
Description: A natural white-sand beach on Saadiyat Island.
Reviews:
Saadiyat Beach is a protected area, carefully preserved for its natural beauty, and normally all visitors are required to pay an access fee according to publicly available information online (if i was not wrong). My way of accessing it was by dining at one of the beachfront hotels. After our meal, the staff kindly allowed us to take a walk along the beach, though swimming and the use of hotel facilities are reserved strictly for hotel guests. Even so, it was still a wonderful experience to feel the soft white sand and the gentle waves at your feet—an excellent way to appreciate the beauty of Saadiyat without disturbing its protected environment. || One of the most beautiful beaches in the UAE. If you visit, please be responsible and help keep it clean. Unfortunately, plastic waste is increasingly affecting the area, so please take your rubbish with you and leave the beach better than you found it.
This beach used to be a haven for sea turtles, which would nest among the dunes and vegetation. Sadly, their numbers have declined over the years . Significant efforts are being made to restore and protect their habitat, and we can all contribute by respecting the environment and reducing pollution. || First of all, it's NOT A PUBLIC beach anymore. There is no such at Saadiyat Island. This one is called Mamsha and deserves its cost. Very clean and comfortable. I was able to negotiate the price (~90AED) as I planned to spend not more than 3 hours. They provide with a beach towel and a bottle of water. To me it was the most amazing view I've ever swam with.. || We spent a great day at this beach. The waters are crystal clear, clean and have an incredible turquoise colour I've never see anywhere else. The sand is soft and white and there's staff looking after the facilities all the time.

There's a fee to access the beach, facilities and have a beach bed with an umbrella.  Overall, I'd recommend it to anyone looking for a peaceful spot. || All access to the sea here is paid, costing more than fifty US dollars.

It seems like the big hotels on this island have lobbied for their own interests and kicked out ordinary people.
I can't run, take a swim, and then run on.

Name: SeaWorld Yas Island
Description: A marine-life theme park with animal habitats, rides and educational exhibits.
Reviews:
Superb experience. Worth a visit. Real value for the money. Felt like a never ending ocean realms. 5 yo 7 hours needs to explore the entire facility as it seems to be the world’s largest indoor marine life theme park.

Meant for all age group. Everyone in the family  will definitely enjoy the time you spend inside.

Recommended to buy the tickets online and complete the bio matrix registration in the app prior to visit. This may save a lot of waiting time at the entry point.

Visit & explore !! || As a visitor, SeaWorld Abu Dhabi feels truly amazing and unforgettable.

From the moment you enter, everything is beautiful, well-organized, and fully air-conditioned, which makes the experience very comfortable, especially in Abu Dhabi’s weather. The park is clean, spacious, and designed in a way that both adults and children can enjoy without feeling tired or rushed.

What I loved most is how SeaWorld perfectly mixes fun and learning. Watching marine animals up close, walking through the huge aquarium, and seeing how well the animals are cared for is truly impressive. The exhibits are informative yet simple, so even kids understand and enjoy them. For adults, it feels calming, educational, and inspiring.

The rides are exciting but not overwhelming. Kids have many playful and colorful areas just for them, while adults can enjoy thrilling rides, shows, and peaceful ocean views. The Endless Ocean aquarium is breathtaking and easily one of the best highlights of the park.

Food options are good, staff are friendly and helpful, and everything feels safe and family-friendly. Overall, SeaWorld Abu Dhabi is not just a theme park — it’s an emotional, educational, and joyful experience.

👉 As a visitor, I would say SeaWorld Abu Dhabi is one of the best theme parks for families, where kids have fun, adults relax, and everyone leaves with beautiful memories. || Its the best. Children friendly & adult too😂 not only the fantastic sea creatures you will see there, theres even a rides to enjoy and the mascots are friendly. I can share, is that i came back from my childhood days the moment i stepped in, to this huge “aquarium” . It’s indoor so good togo even in summer. For adult it’s safe for the roller coaster. Amazing Sea-world Abudhabi. Great experience 2026 || Amazing place, polite and professional staff, one of the top place to go

SeaWorld is an amazing place to visit with friends and family. I recommend planning at least 5 hours to explore all the areas, as it is a huge attraction spread across five floors, with many animals and entertainment experiences.

I highly recommend visiting Hypersphere 360 — it’s an incredible and fun experience.

Be ready for a winter-like atmosphere with the penguins; it’s such a beautiful and refreshing area.

We also had the chance to watch the dolphin show, which was very impressive. We hope the animals are well cared for by the company.

You will also have the opportunity to take beautiful photos next to the 20-meter-tall glass wall, “Endless Ocean,” where many fish live in the massive aquarium. || Spent the day at SeaWorld Abu Dhabi with my kids and it was honestly a wow experience. The aquarium is huge, with so many attractions, animations, and amazing aquatic animals to see.

We loved the cold habitat section with the seals and the white fox. There are also nice places to eat inside, and the Indian food we had was really good.

We missed the mermaid show, so better check the timings before going. A great family experience in Abu Dhabi!

Name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
Description: A major mosque known for its architecture, craftsmanship and cultural visitor programme.
Reviews:
Six of us found time off a conference and went by car from Dubai to AbuDhabi.
It’s good to register online as the confirmation is needed at various points within the mosque.
Everything is very systematic. The way is through a mall from where one can buy souvenirs & also purchase the dress requirements at entry.
The mosque is break-taking beautiful. It’s in all white marble and is decorated using semi precious stone shapes of climbers & flowers.
Another interesting feature is that the marble pieces are joined in a way that it leaves a gap around itself on the surface to facilitate at time of a flood. It’s very amazing.
It also has a gorgeous green carpet which covers the floor under the colourful chandelier. It’s the 2nd largest in the world and it’s truly a piece of art.
The washrooms are quite beautifully decorated too. It has splendid mosaic work pieces on walls and spotlessly clean.
The hallways and the entire mosque houses a fragrance which is circulated by the air conditioning and it’s so appealing to senses.
Want to visit again. || Warning: Grander than you think and more peaceful than you can feel.
​Getting There from Dubai
Reaching the mosque via public transit is straightforward. Take the Dubai Metro to the Ibn Battuta station, and from there, catch either the E101 or E102 bus to Abu Dhabi for 30 AED. Depending on the route, you will be dropped off at either the airport or the Central Bus Station. From there, you can take a local bus directly to the mosque (a quick heads-up: it will surely be fully packed) or simply take a cab.
​The Experience
Whether you are taking the time to pray inside or just visiting to take in the sheer architectural beauty, the atmosphere is unforgettable. We visited during Ramadan, arriving between the Asr and Maghrib prayers, and it was simply lovely. It was so heartwarming to witness Iftar food being distributed to more than 10,000 people daily. Staying for the Taraweeh prayers in such a serene, magnificent environment was the absolute cherry on top.
​The History
Envisioned by the UAE's founding father to unite diverse Islamic cultures, construction on the mosque began in 1996. It took 11 years and thousands of global artisans to bring it to life before it officially opened its doors in 2007.
​The Architecture
The design is a breathtaking blend of Mughal, Persian, and Moorish styles. Built from glowing white Macedonian marble, the scale is incredible—featuring 82 domes, over 1,000 columns, and the world's largest hand-knotted carpet. The 24-carat gold and Swarovski crystal chandeliers are stunning, and the exterior lighting even changes to match the phases of the moon. || Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque is truly one of the most breathtaking places I have ever visited. The moment you enter, everything feels calm, peaceful, and majestic. The architecture is absolutely stunning – the white marble, the intricate floral designs, the massive domes, and the beautiful chandeliers make it feel like something out of a dream.
The attention to detail is unbelievable. Every corner is so well maintained and spotless. Walking inside, you automatically feel a sense of serenity. The reflections around the mosque during sunset are magical.
The entire experience is very well organised, and the staff are polite and helpful. It’s not just a religious place, but also a cultural and architectural masterpiece. Whether you’re spiritual or not, this place leaves a lasting impression.
A must-visit in Abu Dhabi. It’s one of those places that makes you pause, slow down, and just admire beauty in its purest form. || Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque is truly one of the most breathtaking places I have ever visited. The moment you enter, everything feels calm, peaceful, and majestic. The architecture is absolutely stunning – the white marble, the intricate floral designs, the massive domes, and the beautiful chandeliers make it feel like something out of a dream. || The Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque in Abu Dhabi is truly a masterpiece of architecture and design. The precision and finishing of the buildings are exceptional, with every detail carefully crafted, from the marble work to the intricate patterns. The mosque is very clean, well-maintained, and peaceful.
It is also an excellent place for photography. The white marble structure, beautiful reflections, and grand interior provide stunning photo opportunities, especially during sunset or evening lighting.
This is a perfect destination for a short visit, as you can comfortably explore and enjoy the mosque within around two hours. Overall, it is a must-visit place in the UAE, whether for its spiritual atmosphere, architectural beauty, or photography experience.

Name: Snow Abu Dhabi
Description: An indoor snow park inside Reem Mall.
Reviews:
Nice indoor snow park, especially for families and kids. It’s smaller than Ski Dubai since there’s no ski slope, but it offers more activities and play areas which makes it great for all ages. The temperature inside is very cold 🥶

The rental suits are warm and include socks, boots, and gloves, but warm hats aren’t provided so bring your own. My package included hot chocolate and lunch, I had the hot chocolate inside to keep warm and lunch at their restaurant, which was convenient. Snowfall isn’t continuous and is only turned on before opening to fill the area. Overall a good experience. || An absolutely amazing experience at Snow Abu Dhabi! ❄️ The place is beautifully designed with a magical winter theme, and everything is maintained perfectly. The temperature, snow quality, and attractions were all top-notch. Staff were friendly and helpful throughout, making the visit even more enjoyable. It’s a perfect destination for families, kids, and even adults who want to experience real snow in Abu Dhabi. Highly recommended for a fun and unforgettable day! || The park is very clean, well organized, and the snow activities are enjoyable for both adults and children. As soon as you enter, you feel like you are in a winter village with beautiful decorations and real snow everywhere. My family especially enjoyed the snow slides and playing in the snow area. The staff were friendly and helpful, and the safety measures were very good.
The temperature inside is very cold, but they provide jackets, boots, and gloves which makes it comfortable to stay longer. || Snow Abu Dhabi was such a magical experience ❄️✨ From the snow rides to the icy atmosphere, everything felt like a winter wonderland in the middle of the UAE. The staff were friendly, the park was super clean, and there were plenty of fun activities for both kids and adults. Perfect spot for a fun family day or hanging out with friends. Definitely worth visiting for a unique escape from the heat! || Snow Abu Dhabi is a unique winter-themed destination right in the desert! I really enjoyed the zipline and snow slides—they’re so much fun. The park isn’t very big, but it’s incredibly well-engineered; even though the outside temperatures are extremely high, inside it’s a snowy wonderland. Perfect for families, kids, or anyone wanting a fun and cool escape from the heat. A magical experience and definitely worth visiting!

Name: Soul Beach
Description: A managed beachfront destination on Saadiyat Island.
Reviews:
Mamsha Beach is a beach club that only offers beach access, but honestly, it doesn’t need anything else. The sea here is absolutely spectacular and is what truly steals the show.

One thing I really liked is that you can order food from the surrounding restaurants, so you have plenty of options to choose from. In my case, I didn’t love what I ordered, but I think that had more to do with the restaurant than the beach club itself.

As for the service, everything was great, and the beach is simply incredible. A perfect place to spend the day enjoying the sea in Abu Dhabi. || 5/5  Amazing Experience at Mamsha Beach, Saadiyat Island.
I visited Mamsha Beach, Saadiyat Island last week, and it was truly an amazing experience!
I had paid 200 AED for weekend Sunday morning .Everything was well organized  the beach was very clean, and the staff took great care of every detail. They provided fresh and clean towels, and one of the team members came to clean the bed and umbrella.

It was my first visit, and it turned into a truly memorable experience. I really enjoyed so much and will definitely visit again soon. || Mamsha was amazing. Sea is unbelievable color. It’s clean and nicely arranged. We had a lunch at one of the restaurants and was great day overall. At the entrance you get towel and the water. Not too crowded. Nice will be back. || Absolutely loved Mamsha Beach! It was my first time visiting and I’ll definitely be planning another trip. We booked the cabana beds for 600 AED which were super spacious and incredibly comfortable. They came with towels, a bottle of still water, a bottle of sparkling water, plus fruit and nuts, which was such a lovely touch.

The staff were all really friendly and accommodating. I loved the concept of being able to order food from different restaurants and have it delivered straight to your bed. There’s so much choice, making it perfect for a full day out.

The water is absolutely stunning and the sand is so soft. Honestly one of the nicest beach experiences I’ve had.

A special mention to Ghazi, who looked after me and my husband. He couldn’t do enough for us, was always on hand to help, and made the experience even better with his friendly conversation. Highly recommend Mamsha Beach for a relaxing and luxurious day out! || Mamsha Saadiyat is not just a beach. It is my personal oasis in the city, where every visit turns into a celebration of the body and senses.

Here you are greeted by a soft sun lounger, as if created for an afternoon rest. And as a gift - a chilled bottle of water and a fluffy towel, so nice that you want to wrap yourself in it with your head.

Water... its color cannot be described in words. Clean, shining, aquamarine - like a drawn filter, only real. You want to dive into it and not get out.

Only the lazy have not compared this place to the Maldives 🌴

Clean, bright changing rooms, showers, everything is thought out to the smallest detail. The staff is polite, unobtrusive, but attentive, as if they sense in advance what you want.

The only thing that is a pity is that they only work until 19:00. And I really want to stay under the evening sun, when the beach becomes even more beautiful...

Of all my walks along the beaches of Abu Dhabi, this is definitely my favorite.

Mamsha is a place where you don't rest.

You dissolve.

I've been here many times, but only today I decided to write a review. After 2 years of living here, this place never gets boring.

I highly recommend visiting, it's worth every dirham spent.

There are free ground-level and paid underground parking spaces.

Name: The Founder's Memorial
Description: A public memorial honouring Sheikh Zayed with landscaped spaces and artwork.
Reviews:
The Founder’s Memorial in Abu Dhabi is one of the most meaningful and beautifully designed landmarks in the UAE, offering visitors a peaceful and inspiring environment to reflect on the legacy of the late Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan, the founding father of the nation. From the moment you arrive, the atmosphere feels calm, respectful, and thoughtfully curated. The entire space is designed to honor Sheikh Zayed’s values, vision, and timeless contributions to the country, and it does so in a way that feels elegant and deeply impactful.

The highlight of the memorial is certainly “The Constellation,” a stunning three-dimensional art installation that uses thousands of geometric shapes suspended in the air to form Sheikh Zayed’s portrait. Both during the day and at night, the artwork looks breathtaking, but the evening view is truly magical. The soft lighting creates a serene glow that makes the portrait appear almost alive, and it remains one of the most striking pieces of public art in the UAE.

The surrounding garden and walkways are beautifully landscaped, with quiet sitting areas and detailed plaques sharing stories, principles, and memories of Sheikh Zayed. The combination of water features, greenery, and open space creates a perfect environment for peaceful reflection. || Such a beautiful even romantic place during Ramadan time. The warm glow of little lamps under the trees with Etihad Towers and the Memorial structure on the background is absolutely amazing. The workers even sweeping the ground at night to make it spotless. || The memorial features a sanctuary garden with benches and a traditional ancient irrigation system known as the “falaj.” You will also discover a heritage garden home to numerous medicinal desert plants, as well as an elevated walkway offering breathtaking views over the Arabian Gulf, the city’s stunning skyline, and the centerpiece of the Founder’s Memorial: the Constellation.
It is free and open at all times.
It’s beautiful, I highly recommend it. || Visited the Founder’s Memorial , such a cozy and peaceful place. The atmosphere in winter is amazing, very calm and relaxing.

The low lights make it even better, especially in the evening. There’s also a coffee shop called The Bench, and honestly it’s one of the best.

Really nice spot to unwind and enjoy the vibe. || It was incredible to experience up close, hearing the history behind it made it even more fascinating. It’s well worth adding to your Abu Dhabi itinerary.

Name: The National Aquarium Abu Dhabi
Description: A large aquarium featuring marine habitats, wildlife and conservation education.
Reviews:
We had an amazing experience at the National Aquarium Abu Dhabi! My kids joined the Junior Marine Biology Program (AED 199), and it was such a fun and educational experience for them. The activities included turtle feeding, boat rides, lab observations, reptile sessions, and even learning about marine rehabilitation.

A special thank you to Daniel, who facilitated the program so well. He was incredibly friendly, patient, and very knowledgeable with the kids, making the whole experience engaging and enjoyable. Parents are also allowed to stay with the kids by purchasing the general entry ticket (AED 110), which was great.

After the program, the kids also enjoyed snorkeling in the 5-meter tank for AED 199, which was an unforgettable experience. I personally did the diving experience in the same tank surrounded by hammerhead sharks and so many beautiful ocean creatures. With over 350 species and around 46,000 animals, the aquarium is truly spectacular.

There are different diving options available, and our dive master Rajan was absolutely incredible — professional, friendly, and made the entire experience safe and exciting.

Highly recommended for both kids and adults. A perfect mix of education, adventure, and family fun! 🐠🦈✨ || Had a wonderful time at the National Aquarium Abu Dhabi. The exhibits are impressive, well-maintained, and filled with a fascinating variety of marine life from around the world. Every section offers something unique, making the experience both entertaining and educational. The atmosphere is relaxing, the staff are friendly, and the entire facility is beautifully designed. It’s a great place to learn about ocean life while enjoying quality time with family and friends. A memorable experience for both kids and adults, and definitely one of the must-visit attractions in Abu Dhabi. Highly recommended! || I visited the National Aquarium Abu Dhabi and was absolutely amazed from beginning to end. We bought our tickets online but there wasn't a long queue. The experience is thoughtfully designed and beautifully immersive, with a sequence of themed rooms that take you through dramatic underwater environments, from a broken airplane to a shipwreck, and even a sunken submarine.
The scale of the place is incredible. The aquarium is home to around 46,000 animals from more than 300 species, representing marine life from tropical reefs to deep ocean habitats across 10 different themed zones.  This includes an astonishing variety of fish, rays, turtles, and many other creatures, so you’re constantly discovering something new as you walk through.
About halfway through the visit there’s a small café, perfect for a quick break before you reach the highlight: the large walk-through aquarium. This final section is about five metres deep, with four different species of shark swimming overhead — an unforgettable way to end the journey.
Even the smallest details are charming, like the ocean-themed toilets with shell-shaped sinks, which add a fun touch.
There were a few groups of screaming overly excited children but they moved on quite quickly. For most of the rooms we were by ourselves. There is wifi and massage chairs which was a bit too rough.We spent about 90 mins here.Whether you love marine life or just enjoy spectacular, thoughtfully curated attractions, the National Aquarium is truly worth a visit. || I'm really glad we visited this wonderful place! My family really had a great time, and one of the reasons why we went here is to show my kids the very much alive sea friends inside! My son really enjoyed and was amazed. We also loved the fact that they have a rescue sanctuary inside, and they'll give you a tour around it. It's really worth it. || I really enjoyed my visit to the National Aquarium. I highly recommend purchasing the combo ticket that includes Beyond the Glass and the Butterfly Garden—it’s absolutely worth it and provides the complete experience.

What impressed me most was learning about the work that happens behind the scenes, including how the team quarantines and cares for animals, supports conservation efforts, and helps protect the ecosystem. It was inspiring to see examples such as rescuing and treating sick turtles before releasing them back into their natural habitat.

The Butterfly Garden was also beautiful and enjoyable. It would be even better if it were expanded to be a bit larger in the future.

Overall, my daughter was extremely happy with the visit, and we had a wonderful family experience. I would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting Abu Dhabi.

Name: Umm Al Emarat Park
Description: A landscaped urban park with gardens, animal areas and family facilities.
Reviews:
An entrance fee is required. Overall, the park is well maintained, supports a variety of park programs, and offers many things to see and experience.
The planting areas have very little exposed soil, dirt, or sand, so the park feels very green and lush. There are many trees, with a good variety of species, as well as many shrubs and groundcovers. The planting is well maintained and in good condition. There are flowering plants throughout the park, and in some areas, the scent of flowers creates a pleasant atmosphere. Because of this, the park felt more like a botanical garden than a typical public park.
There are water features in several areas, and multiple play areas are distributed throughout the park. Large lawn areas open up in the center, providing good spaces for running around and playing. There are many picnic tables along the pathways, and different types of shaded spaces are also well distributed throughout the park.
The park has clear qualities that distinguish it from other nearby parks, while also maximizing its function as a public park. It is a nice place to visit. || Beautiful and well-maintained park in Abu Dhabi. Online ticket price is only 10 AED per person which is very reasonable. The atmosphere is peaceful and family-friendly. Perfect place for walking, relaxing, taking photos and videos. The greenery, fountains, and evening views are amazing. Clean facilities and organized environment. Highly recommended for families and friends. 🌳📸✨ || I visited a lot of parks, but Umm Al Emarat Park, has a kind of different (good) atmosphere.

After buying my ticket and arranging my camera permit I was able to enjoy this park. Especially the Wisdom Garden is very special. It's a kind of place of meditation as well.

The park is not very big, but absolutely worth the visit and I will be definitely come back! || Umm Al Emarat Park in Abu Dhabi is widely regarded as a great urban oasis and family-friendly green space. The Children’s Garden features water-play areas like splash fountains and a “wadi” to cool off. Animal Barn / Petting Zoo: Kids can feed or ride ponies, camels, and interact with smaller animals (rabbits, goats, etc.) There’s a large Amphitheatre for events, concerts, or community gatherings. The Shade House is a unique elevated structure with 40+ plant species, offering great views. There is a small entrance fee. According to Visit Abu Dhabi, it costs AED 10. || Sounds like you had a wonderful time! Umm Al Emarat Park in Abu Dhabi is indeed a beautiful "green oasis" known for its lush landscapes and family-friendly atmosphere.While "Chit Rand" doesn't appear to be an official name of a section within the park, you might be referring to one of its iconic features:The Shade House: A towering structure with multiple viewing platforms that offer panoramic views of the park.The Wisdom Garden: A serene area with marble slabs and beautiful greenery.The Promenade: A scenic walkway that often hosts the vibrant "Park Market".Your positive review will definitely help others looking for a great place to relax or play. If you're ready to share your experience, just tap the "Post" button at the bottom of your screen.Would you like to know about any upcoming events or the best cafes to visit at the park next?

Name: W Abu Dhabi - Yas Island
Description: A landmark hotel built over Yas Marina Circuit with distinctive architecture.
Reviews:
We would like to take a moment to thank the wonderful team at Garage W.

As Yas Island residents, my daughters and I have been regular guests for years. Every Sunday after our tennis session, we look forward to our breakfast buffet, which has become one of our favorite family traditions. We also choose Garage W to celebrate special occasions such as Mother’s Day, birthdays, and other family milestones.

While the food, atmosphere, and beautiful views are always exceptional, it is the people who make us return week after week.

The team consistently makes us feel welcome, valued, and remembered. My daughters are always greeted with genuine warmth and kindness. They know them by name, take the time to chat with them, and always make them feel special.

Over the years, they have surprised the girls with special mocktails and included them in memorable moments. During brunches, the chefs often give them the honour of ringing the bell to announce dessert time, something they absolutely love and look forward to every visit.

Saru, Augustine, Constantine, Roshan, and Sandeep are just a few of the many wonderful people who make Garage W such a special place. Their kindness, professionalism, attention to detail, and genuine care never go unnoticed.

We truly appreciate the effort that each member of the team puts into creating such a welcoming experience. It is the little things, done consistently over the years, that have created so many wonderful memories for our family.

Thank you for making us feel at home, for always looking after us so well, and for helping create moments that my daughters will remember for years to come. || Amazing views and great hospitality!
Spent two nights at the W Yas Island and loved it. Check-in was a breeze even though we arrived very late at night. The hotel is super clean and the rooms are incredibly comfortable. Breakfast every morning was amazing! A huge highlight is the location right next to the circuit. The views are unmatched. Thanks to the friendly staff for making our stay so pleasant! || Had a great stay at W Abu Dhabi – Yas Island. The room was fantastic, and the breakfast buffet was excellent with plenty of options. The unlimited park package was amazing value and made our trip even better.

A special thanks to Roshni for explaining all the hotel amenities and park access so well. Because of her help, we ended up visiting 3 parks instead of the 2 we had planned. Also, thank you to Rene from the bell team for being so helpful with our luggage.

The only downside was the noise from racing activities at Yas Marina Circuit on Saturday night, which made it difficult for us and our child to sleep. The swimming pool was also under maintenance during our stay.

Overall, a very enjoyable stay and a great hotel for families visiting Yas Island. || I am a frequent vistor to their saloon Saal. Amazing service, super stylists and team. Right from reception team, they are warm welcoming and sincere. Sometimes I go to get hairwash for the brilliant massage that Bimala does! Highly recommended.
Also their valet service is excellent. Courteous staff. Himayat is very good, polite and helpful. Thank you
Keep it up || Wow what an amazing hotel! Last year we stayed at Ritz Carlton Grand Canal and this year we stayed at W Hotel Yas Marina.

Bit of a confusion at check in, no map or info given about where the pool was etc but once over those hurdles, we had an amazing time.

Service was brilliant from all in Garage, Papas Taverna and Brooklyn Chop House restaurants. Sandeep really looked after us at the Garage.

Ebru and her team ensure our needs were catered for being vegetarian. The food in all restaurants was probably the best weve had. Garage had a wide variety of cusine options and overlooked the race track. Only disappointment was vegetarian variety at the NYE gala but that was our last night and by then we'd over eaten every day so was ok having a few things here and there but for the price I would have expected more.

Breakfast buffet the biggest we'd seen and again the most variety. We saw a few people come in their pyjamas (noticeably those from India) which shouldn't be allowed as there was a sign. Definitely quieter before 9am.

Using the shuttle on Yas, its convenient to get to the mall or theme parks.

Name: Warehouse421
Description: An independent arts and design centre with exhibitions and public programmes.
Reviews:
Great exhibition centre hosting a few exhibitions while I was there and also have a small cafe with a conducive environment if you want to get some work done. Theres also an outdoor lounge area (check out the interesting fountain structure!) which is great for non summer days. || Amazing place!
I attended the sund printing workshop with Adele it was amazing

But what actually really satisfied me was Rasha the receptionist! Very helpful it's so refreshing to deal with helpful customer service agents!

She actually helped a lot
She deserves 5 stars || Visited Warehouse421 at the art campus and genuinely loved the experience. The space is beautifully curated — minimal, intentional, and full of surprising installations that are worth your time. One of the highlights was the interactive art wall where visitors could leave behind doodles, thoughts, or random expressions. I added my bit too — it’s raw, communal, and constantly evolving, which makes it feel alive.

The campus also has a cozy café with great coffee, making it easy to hang around and take it all in without rushing. Whether you’re into art or just curious, this place has something to offer. Definitely recommend dropping by if you’re in Abu Dhabi. || This place has such a wonderful vibe for studying! It's quiet and peaceful, making it easy to focus on your work. The aesthetic is so inviting too! And let’s not forget the adorable cats hanging out by the entrance—they're like sweet little angels that make your visit even better! || The overall atmosphere of the venue was undeniably captivating. I decided to visit alone after coming across the "And The Mirrors Are Many" exhibition on Instagram, and it was a pleasant surprise to discover several other equally interesting exhibitions.

One experience that truly touched my heart was "The Living Archive." They gave me a recycled seed paper card to write down a precious memory, and planting it in those pots outside felt truly heartfelt and meaningful.

In all honesty, my visit was an absolutely wonderful experience. The place had an authentic charm that has me eager to return for more.

Name: Warner Bros. World Abu Dhabi
Description: An indoor theme park based on Warner Bros. characters and fictional worlds.
Reviews:
Warner Bros. World is a fantastic place for families with young children. The character stage shows, meet-and-greets, and themed attractions make it a magical experience for kids.

The moment you step inside, it feels like entering a completely different world. The indoor design is impressive, and the ceilings are so well done that they give the feeling of being outdoors under a real sky.

Overall, we had a great experience and enjoyed the atmosphere, shows, and attractions. However, after visiting Ferrari World, we found some of the rides a bit slow and less thrilling. This is understandable as the park is primarily designed for children and families.

If you have young kids, Warner Bros. World is definitely worth a visit and offers a fun-filled day for the whole family. || This is truly a world‑class amusement park. It’s incredible how they’ve managed to build the entire experience indoors, making it comfortable to enjoy in any season. The rides are close to each other, so you don’t waste time walking long distances.

Some rides did shut down briefly, but the staff handled it well and got them running again quickly. There are plenty of amazing rides—perfect for adrenaline lovers as well as families with kids. Honestly, there wasn’t a single ride that I didn’t enjoy.

Just come prepared to stand in long queues, especially during holidays. But by the end of the day, you’ll leave feeling happy, satisfied, and full of great memories. || Amazing park, very well executed design and concept. The queues here are much less than Ferrari, IMG, and motiongate, still I'd advise maximizing game time when the park opens and closes. There are both thrill and family rides. Don't miss the closing show few monutes before 8 pm.

Thrill Rides
Road runner 8.5/10 ❤‍🔥
Joker Funhouse 4/10

Family Rides
Flinstone 7.5/10
Scoopy Doo 6.5/10
Ani Mayhem 8.5/10 ❤‍🔥 || I had an absolutely amazing experience at Warner Bros. World™ Yas Island, Abu Dhabi. This place is truly something special — it brings adults back to their childhood while giving kids an unforgettable adventure at the same time.

The rides are incredibly well-designed, modern, and immersive. Each attraction feels like stepping into a completely different world, with stunning details and smooth execution. You don’t just go on rides here — you live the experience.

The park itself is very spacious and well-organized, which makes moving around comfortable and enjoyable even during busy times. Everything is clean, vibrant, and thoughtfully designed.

One thing that really stood out to me was the coffee — it was excellent. The barista was highly skilled, and the Lavazza beans were fresh and full of flavor. It honestly felt like a premium café experience inside a theme park.

The restaurants inside are also fantastic, offering great variety and quality food that exceeded expectations.

A special thank you to Bruno, the barista, for his professionalism and for making such a great cup of coffee. Also, big thanks to Valeria for her warm attitude, helping us choose the cake, and taking our order with a smile. And I’d like to thank Jojo as well for her attentiveness, for taking the time to listen, and for explaining the different rides to us — it really enhanced our visit.

Overall, this place is absolutely worth visiting. Whether you’re young or just young at heart, you will have a great time here. || Warner Bros Abu Dhabi, Yas Island is a wonderful indoor attraction with a great variety of rides and games for different age groups. The facilities are clean, well-maintained, and the overall experience is enjoyable for families and children.
My only concern is the crowd management. During peak times and long weekends, the park becomes extremely crowded, and waiting times for popular rides can exceed an hour. Since it is an indoor venue, the experience can feel less comfortable when it is overcrowded.
I would recommend visiting on regular weekdays rather than during long weekends to fully enjoy the attractions.

Name: Yas Bay Waterfront
Description: A waterfront entertainment district with dining, nightlife and events.
Reviews:
It’s a wonderful place to relax and enjoy stunning views. The atmosphere is peaceful, making it a perfect spot to unwind and spend quality time. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a refreshing and enjoyable experience. || Yas Bay is one of the best waterfront destinations in Abu Dhabi. The atmosphere is lively yet relaxing, especially in the evening when the weather is nice. The promenade is clean, modern, and perfect for a sunset walk with beautiful sea views.
There are plenty of restaurants and cafés with great variety, whether you’re looking for casual dining or something more upscale. It’s also home to Etihad Arena, which makes the area even more exciting during events and concerts.

Overall, Yas Bay is a great place to hang out with friends or family. Highly recommended! || Great waterfront spot for a relaxed evening on Yas Island. The sunset views are beautiful and there are plenty of good restaurants to choose from. If there’s a concert or event happening, the whole place feels lively and energetic. Overall it has a nice holiday vibe, perfect for a chill night out. || An absolutely wonderful place! It offers a stunning and unique view over Yas Bay, creating a calm and refreshing atmosphere. There is a great variety of restaurants and cafés serving both Western and Eastern cuisines, catering to all tastes. The promenade along the corniche is truly charming—perfect for a relaxing walk. It’s an ideal spot for a peaceful outing and also very family-friendly. Yacht transportation services are available as well, adding a special and enjoyable touch to the overall experience. || I visited the Yas Bay Waterfront for the 54th UAE National Day celebrations in 2025, it offered spectacular fireworks.

The main festivities on this day were free to attend, beginning in the afternoon, transforming the promenade with cultural zones, a Flag Garden featuring 54 flags, falconry displays, and traditional performances.

The grand finale each night is a breathtaking fireworks display at 9:00 PM, painting the sky above the water in the colours of the UAE flag. This is the perfect spot to celebrate the spirit of the Union with family and friends.

Name: Yas Beach
Description: A leisure beach with swimming, water sports and dining.
Reviews:
Had an amazing experience at Elias Beach! 🌊☀️ The atmosphere was beautiful, relaxing, and very clean. The staff were friendly and welcoming, and the food & drinks were delicious. It’s the perfect place to relax and enjoy the beach vibes. Definitely coming back again. Highly recommended! 🤍 || Spent the day at Yas Beach and honestly, it was such a vibe 🤍

The beach is super clean, the water is calm and perfect for swimming, and the whole atmosphere feels really relaxed but still a bit luxurious. There are plenty of sunbeds, great music playing in the background, and the staff are very attentive.

Food and drinks were good. It’s the kind of place where you can fully switch off, enjoy the sun, and just have a slow, beautiful day.

Definitely recommend if you want a chill beach day in Abu Dhabi 🌊✨ || Hello everyone
I recently visited this place and had such a wonderful experience. The atmosphere is incredibly relaxed and peaceful, making it the perfect place to unwind and enjoy the ocean views. The music selection is excellent.

The ambiance is just right, lively enough to feel vibrant, but still calm and comfortable. What truly made the visit special was the staff. Every member of the team was genuinely kind, attentive, and welcoming, always ready to help with a smile.

Overall, it’s the perfect place if you’re looking for good music, a great atmosphere, a peaceful environment, and outstanding service. || Ila by Yas Beach in Abu Dhabi It’s such a good spot if you’re looking for a mix of fun and tranquility. The beach is super clean, the water is clear, and the whole place feels really well taken care of.

What I liked most is that even with music and people around, it still feels peaceful and relaxing. You can properly switch off and just enjoy the sun and the views, especially at sunset,it’s beautiful. The sunbeds are comfy, there’s plenty of space, and the atmosphere is chilled but still social.

Food and drinks were great, and the staff were friendly and attentive. Definitely a really nice, calm spot to spend the day with friends or just by yourself. || The beach as a whole is very nicely arranged. However, the beach as a beach is bad, you won't be able to swim in the sea, it's really dirty and resembles a bar.
And in general, everything else is very nicely arranged. Sun loungers, beds, pool, bar for drinks, restaurant, everything.
Entrance per person is 130 dirhams and you can drink whatever you want for 50 dirhams. Or you have a promotion, a bed for two people for a total of 300 dirhams and you can eat and drink whatever you want for 300 dirhams.
They are very nice, fast service and cultural waiters.
The bathrooms are nicely arranged, there are also showers, hairdryers, places to change clothes.
All praise.

Name: Yas Mall
Description: A large shopping and entertainment mall on Yas Island.
Reviews:
Its an oasis amidst thronged market places across UAE. All facilities vizWheel Chair,Rest Rooms,etc r..parexcellence.
Its spacious well managed as well as maintained!
All possible International brands are here with competitive accent.
Ramadaan Festive Grace is visible here.
Famous Restaurants are available with their specialities.Fraari World Entrance is there and at the gate itself it gives you a glimpse of Swings,etc.over there.
Parking and other facilities are there.Free Parking is available for three hours duration! This is a master stroke move to decongest the throng in busier days/ occasion.
Its a Quality Place to give full value of your valuable Money and presence!!!
SuryaKant Sharma || Absolutely loved visiting Yas Mall 🤩😍😍
The mall is huge super clean and has an amazing mix of shopping and restaurants and cafes and entertainment all in one place.
The atmosphere feels modern and lively and there is always something fun to do.
Perfect for families friends or even a solo day out.

👌👌The connection to Ferrari World Abu Dhabi makes the experience even cooler.😍😅🏁🏁

You can find everything from luxury brands and luxury restaurants to affordable stores and affordable restaurants.👌

Definitely one of the best malls in Abu Dhabi and in the whole Emirates a must visit on Yas Island dont miss you will regret missing it ✨🛍️❤️ || Everything in One Place.

A shopper’s paradise! Huge selection of brands from Zara to Apple, and the layout is bright and spacious. The connection to Ferrari World makes it the perfect hub for a full day out. Definitely one of the best malls in the UAE. || Yas Mall is a large, modern shopping destination on Yas Island offering a great mix of international brands, restaurants, and entertainment. It’s clean, well-organized, and family-friendly, with plenty of dining options and a cinema.
It can get busy on weekends, but overall it’s an excellent place for shopping and leisure. || The best mall in Abu Dhabi. Lots of stores and options - also many entertainment options. I particularly like City Challenge, a very unique and fun venue, and Avobar, an extremely delicious and healthy restaurant.

Name: Yas Marina
Description: A waterfront marina with restaurants, boats and views of Yas Marina Circuit.
Reviews:
Whether you are a hardcore motorsport fan or just looking for an unforgettable experience in Abu Dhabi, Yas Marina Circuit is an absolute must-visit. The venue is completely world-class, pristine, and stunningly designed.
What Made It Incredible:
The Track Activity: I did one of the driving experiences, and it was a total rush. Driving on an actual F1 track with professional instructors who push you to get the most out of the car was worth every single dirham. The safety protocols are top-notch, making you feel confident going fast.
The Atmosphere & Views: Walking around the marina sector of the track with the iconic W Abu Dhabi hotel spanning across it is breathtaking. The night lighting makes the entire venue look incredibly futuristic and magical.
Flawless Organization: From parking and registration to the actual track time, everything runs like clockwork. The staff are incredibly passionate, welcoming, and knowledgeable. || Great place for happy hour and dinner, but bring a layer!

I recently visited Yas Marina and it remains one of the best spots on the island for a complete evening out. The transition from happy hour to dinner here is seamless, with a fantastic range of venues like Diablito for tapas, The Aquarium for seafood, and Stars 'N' Bars for a more casual American vibe.

The views of the yachts and the illuminated W Abu Dhabi hotel are stunning, and the general energy of the place is always upbeat. Most of the bars have excellent happy hour deals that make the usually "Abu Dhabi-priced" drinks a lot more reasonable.

One tip for visitors: While the afternoon sun is warm, it can get surprisingly chilly once the sun goes down, especially with the breeze coming off the water. If you're planning to sit outside to enjoy the marina views (which you definitely should), I’d highly recommend bringing a light jacket or pashmina to stay comfortable through dinner.

Highlights:
Vibe: Vibrant, stylish, and perfect for groups or dates.

Dining: Great variety of cuisines within a short walking distance.

View: Unbeatable views of the F1 track and luxury yachts.

Pro-Tip: Watch for the nightly light displays that reflect beautifully on the water. || Yas Marina is a great place to walk around, relax, and enjoy the views of the water and luxury yachts. The area is clean, modern, and well designed, with a nice mix of restaurants, cafes, and shops along the waterfront. It’s especially nice in the evening, when the lights come on and the atmosphere feels more lively. || Love going here! Have been a member of the Captains Club since 2020 and have always been so impressed with the staff and cleanliness of the area. Unfortunately this evening was disrupted with an employee who said I was driving the boat too fast - when I pressed him he switched to saying the Captain’s Club has not given me instructions and they are a problem. Not exactly sure of his purpose and he could not define it to me. His name is Rhori and I would suggest avoiding him if at all possible. He can certainly make a wonderful evening less than perfect. || Another amazing place to visit and hangout while in Abu Dhabi! The vibe was great!!

Name: Yas Marina Circuit
Description: A Formula One circuit offering motorsport events and driving experiences.
Reviews:
Had an absolutely electrifying experience at Yas Marina Circuit. From the moment I entered, I could feel the energy and excitement in the atmosphere. The entire venue is world-class, beautifully maintained, and perfectly organized. The marina views, especially during night, are simply breathtaking.

Being at the home of the iconic Abu Dhabi Grand Prix feels truly special. The track lighting at night gives the circuit a futuristic and premium vibe. || I came here for the passenger experience, and what a thrilling ride! My driver reached 240 km/h at one point. It was incredible. I highly recommend it to anyone!

Just a heads-up - you need to book at least 1 month in advance to secure a spot. You can also book a similar experience with newer cars at the Dubai Autodrome if you're in that area. || Had a surreal experience running around this f1 track at sunset. Would 100% recommend this for anyone looking to walk run or cycle. You can go round the track as many times as you like and it’s such a great free family friendly activity || Visited the Yas Marina Circuit in the evening for their walking session and absolutely loved the experience. The atmosphere around the track was amazing, especially with the cool evening weather and beautiful views. They also have cycling sessions and other activities scheduled on weekdays, which makes it a great spot even if you’re not visiting for an F1 race. There’s also a small museum where you can see the race cars and get a closer look at the track. A must-visit place in Abu Dhabi for sports and motorsport lovers. || We attended the circuit during the F1 Grand Prix and it was a great experience. The staff is great, and there are plenty of food options. The team layout and views are amazing. Along with the great views, it has some of the best grand stands we’ve sat in. They are huge, with plenty of space and comfortable seating.

Name: Yas Waterworld
Description: A large waterpark with slides, pools and Emirati pearl-diving themes.
Reviews:
What a great place to escape the heat and relax! The atmosphere is refreshing, comfortable, and perfect for spending quality time with family and friends. Whether you're looking to unwind after a busy day, enjoy the cool surroundings, or simply take a break from the hot weather, this place is definitely worth visiting. The environment is clean, welcoming, and enjoyable for people of all ages. It's one of those spots where you can sit back, recharge, and create wonderful memories. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a refreshing getaway from the heat! || Yas Waterworld Abu Dhabi is an absolutely fantastic waterpark, and even though I’ve visited bigger waterparks around the world, this one still deserves a full 5-star rating for its overall experience, organization, and the noticeable improvements they continue to make year after year. What makes it stand out isn’t size — it’s how clean, smooth, and well-managed everything is from the moment you walk in.

One of the first things I noticed is how updated and refreshed the park looks. Many areas have clearly been upgraded — brighter colours, cleaner pools, improved shading, and more comfortable seating zones for relaxing. The slides feel well-maintained, the water temperature is perfect, and the entire park looks polished and taken care of. Even the small details, like locker efficiency and staff coordination, show how much effort the team puts into giving guests a seamless experience.The variety of rides is excellent. Whether you enjoy high-adrenaline slides or more relaxing attractions, there’s something for everyone. Dawwama, the giant tornado slide, remains a must-try — the drop, the spin, and the funnel are always exciting. The Bandit Bomber roller-coaster-style ride feels smoother compared to before and gives amazing views of the whole park. Family raft rides, the wave pool, body slides, tube slides, and the lazy river are all very well maintained and enjoyable. Even during busy times, the lines move quickly thanks to good organization by the staff.The kids’ areas look upgraded too, with brighter paint, fresh water features, and softer safety flooring. It’s a great place for families, and the lifeguards are alert and professional everywhere, making the environment feel very safe.

One thing I really appreciate is the cleanliness of the entire park. From the pools to the pathways to the dining areas, everything is consistently spotless. The food options have also improved — better menus, more shaded seating, and faster service. Whether you want something quick or a full meal, the options are convenient and reasonably priced for a theme park.

Customer service deserves a special mention. Staff are friendly, patient, and helpful. They guide guests clearly, manage lines well, and maintain a positive atmosphere throughout the park. Even simple things like setting up life jackets, giving directions, or helping with lockers are handled with professionalism and kindness.

Because the park is fully outdoors, the improved shading and cooling areas make a big difference, especially on hotter days. There are more places to relax, refill water, and take breaks between rides. Everything is designed to make the day comfortable from start to finish.

Location-wise, being on Yas Island is perfect — easy parking, clean surroundings, and the option to combine the day with other attractions like Warner Bros. World or Ferrari World.

Overall, Yas Waterworld might not be the biggest waterpark I’ve ever visited, but it is definitely one of the most enjoyable and well-run. The upgrades, cleanliness, friendly staff, and ride quality make it a top choice for anyone visiting Abu Dhabi. A full day here feels refreshing, fun, and genuinely worthwhile. Highly recommended for families, tourists, groups of friends, and anyone looking for a great day out. || OMG. What a massive complex.

We’ve visited all the other Yas theme parks, leaving this one for last, and I am almost speechless. Just… wow.

To be completely honest, I have a massive fear of water. There’s no sugarcoating it: I am absolutely terrified of it. That’s why I wasn’t exactly pushing hard to visit a water park! But as every parent knows, having kids means willingly signing up for things you would otherwise avoid at all costs.

The other Yas parks had already trained me to handle crazy rides (which took some time, but at least those were dry or just had a minor splash!). Yas Waterworld, however, is a whole different beast. The park is huge, but the staff? Incredible. Friendly, helpful, and honestly, every single one of them is a hero to me. I truly hope they get paid a great salary.

After our family visit, I actually went back to the park alone to face my fears head-on. The staff was so amazing—they gently nudged and encouraged me into trying rides I would have normally run away from! 🙂

I am still genuinely curious how there isn't an ambulance permanently stationed out front. To my terrified brain, the whole place looks like an accident waiting to happen, but that's probably just me and my phobias talking.
10/10 would survive again! || Unfortunately I was not able to take many photos and videos during our visit.  Basically because we were too busy having fun.

We visited during Eid holidays which obviously increases the amount of people in the park.  Also considering it to be summer in UAE, the heat was a bit much but bearable.

The waterpark is massive and very easy to get lost.  I suggest that they add more signage, but really doesnt affect the appeal of the park.

I believe that they have close to 100 attractions / slides at the park.  We only managed to enjoy around 40 of them.  Some were too high and frightening for my daughter and I, so we didn't bother attempting.  Those that we tried were exhilarating.  Some were even did more than once.

During Eid with more people present, we did have to wait up to 20 minutes on some rides.  I would have liked if their was shade over hanging the stairs and queue lines.  We got more burnt waiting in queue more than anywhere else.

Overall, the facilities are outstanding.  Well maintained and clean, fun and exciting, with something around every corner.  I really do recommend this waterpark.  I would be tempted to visit again, although the prices are quite high. || One of the most amazing experiences we had on Yas Island was at Waterworld🏝️ . There was so much fun, so many surprises, and countless exciting water rides that made us feel nothing but joy, excitement, and adventure ❤️ . The staff were always smiling, welcoming, and friendly, making the experience even more enjoyable  😍 . Miral never fails to surprise us with its incredible attractions and experiences 🎉 , and one of the best of them is Waterworld. 🥰

Name: Zayed Sports City
Description: A major sports complex with stadiums, ice rink and recreational facilities.
Reviews:
Visiting here is due to Mubadala Abu Dhabi Open. Here it contains all kinds of arenas and facilities for different sports. Really amazing.

Everything is well organized and the most important thing is that here is friendly for public transportation. Very convenient to reach by different lines and ways.

From the top to see the whole scene, very beautiful. And wish here can be better and better!❤️ || ADNOC 2025 at Zayed Sports City – Exceptionally Well Organized

ADNOC 2025, organized at Zayed Sports City, was exceptionally well planned and executed. We truly enjoyed being part of the 5 km Family Fun Run, which was a wonderful experience for participants of all ages.

The parking arrangements were excellently managed at Wahat Al Karamah. We arrived early at around 4:15 AM, and the process was smooth and hassle-free. The shuttle service was well coordinated, allowing us to reach Zayed Sports City comfortably and on time.

Upon arrival, we were impressed by the wonderful crowd turnout and the high level of discipline and coordination maintained throughout the event. The atmosphere was energetic, positive, and family-friendly, making the entire experience even more enjoyable.

Overall, ADNOC 2025 stood out for its outstanding organization, efficient logistics, and vibrant community spirit. It was truly a memorable event, and we thoroughly enjoyed every moment of participating in the Family Fun Run. 👏🏃‍♂️🏃‍♀️ || Zayed sport city have massive comfortable bowling section  & Free space  .It was great experience to do bowling there and enjoy it. || It is one of the most iconic sports venues in the capital. The stadium itself is impressive, and the whole complex feels energetic, especially during major matches or events.

I've been there for both football and other activities, and the atmosphere is always lively. The facilities are well maintained, and there's a good range of sports options available, from tennis to ice skating.

It's more than just a stadium, it's place where the community comes together for sports and events. Definitely a landmark for anyone who enjoys live games or staying active in Abu Dhabi. || I went for the opera there was ample parking . The security guard were very friendly, but the place is so big you can easily get lost just because of so many entrances.

Name: teamLab Phenomena Abu Dhabi
Description: An immersive art environment combining digital technology, light and physical space.
Reviews:
Actually worth the money. Was great! Took 2 hours to go through. Very dark so nice to come out into the sunshine at the end. There is an additional exhibit inside which is the japanese tea room - 45dhs each for a drink which had a glass that lit up and had noise effects. Worth it since this is the sort of place you come once. Make sure you have clothes that are just above the knees or can be rolled up since the water exhibit is high calf height. I found it very meditative. Loved it. || teamLab Phenomena is a great place for family fun and entertainment. There are many interesting activities, and the whole place is designed to be enjoyable for both kids and adults.

It’s also a perfect spot for taking pictures. There are many creative and colorful areas that make your photos look amazing. 📸

The atmosphere is fun and welcoming, and we had a great time there. I highly recommend it for families and anyone looking for a unique experience! 😊✨ || What an amazing place in Abu Dhabi. Whole family loved it. Amazing laser and water displays. Even the prayer room and toilets were amazing. Warm Seated Toto toilets. Truly amazing day out. || An amazing place for both kids and adults, with each section featuring a different theme and plenty to explore. We spent over three hours here and thoroughly enjoyed every moment. A fun and engaging experience for the whole family, with something interesting around every corner. || It was an incredible experience overall. The visuals were absolutely stunning 🤩 , and the entire space felt immersive and thoughtfully designed and executed. Each room flowed beautifully and really pulled you into the art theme.

I highly recommend getting the Undistracted tickets it makes a huge difference being able to enjoy everything without crowds or distractions and the little ones. Also, wearing shorts is a must for the water experience, since you’ll definitely get your feet wet, however towels are provided by them.

Such a unique and memorable experience. Totally worth it and very friendly staff overall !!

Name: Al Ain Adventure
Description: An adventure destination offering rafting, surfing, kayaking and aerial activities.
Reviews:
We had such a fantastic time at Al Ain Adventure! The rafting experience was absolutely thrilling and so much fun. The water activities were well-organized, exciting, and very safe. It was the perfect place to enjoy adventure.

A big thank you to the amazing staff Narayan, Sujina, and Indra. They were very friendly, professional, and supportive throughout all the activities. They made sure we felt safe and comfortable, especially during rafting, and their positive energy made the experience even better.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for fun water adventures with excellent service. We will definitely come back again! || Al Ain Adventure is one of the best water sports parks I have ever visited and an excellent destination for families, friends, and adventure lovers. The park offers a fantastic variety of activities, including kayaking, rafting, duckies, a wave pool, swimming pools, and fun water-based jumping activities that keep both children and adults entertained throughout the day.

The facilities are exceptionally well designed, clean, and well maintained, creating a very enjoyable and comfortable environment for visitors. The changing rooms and shower facilities were spotless during my visit, and the overall layout of the park makes it easy to move around and enjoy different attractions.

One of the things I appreciated most was that the queues were not long, allowing visitors to enjoy the activities without spending too much time waiting. The wave pool in particular creates excellent waves and adds a lot of excitement to the experience. There is also a restaurant on site, making it convenient to spend an entire day there with family and loved ones.

Visitors should note a few important details before going. Closed-toe shoes are required for activities such as kayaking, rafting, and duckies. In addition, lockers are available for AED 35, and they use a specific locking system, meaning personal padlocks cannot be used.

Overall, Al Ain Adventure offers an exciting, safe, and memorable experience for all ages, and I would definitely recommend visiting if you are in Al Ain. || Loved our rafting session at Al Ain Adventure Centre! Ms. Sujina shreshta did a brilliant job guiding us — her skill, encouragement, and adventurous spirit made it one of the best experiences we’ve had. Thank you for the great time! || Best experience ever! Shout out to Krishna, our amazing rafting guide -he made it memorable and adventurous. Overall the place was such a good place to relax and enjoyable for friends/family. || We had a fantastic experience at Al Ain Adventure. The activities are both exciting and scary but safe, making it a great spot for families and thrill-seekers alike.

What really stood out, though, was the exceptional service from the staff—especially Sujina and Narayan. They were incredibly friendly, attentive, and went above and beyond to ensure we had a smooth and enjoyable experience. Their professionalism and positive attitude truly made a difference.

Highly recommend visiting, and big thanks again to Sujina, Narayan and their whole team for making the day even more memorable!

Name: Al Ain Camel Market
Description: A traditional livestock market known for camels and regional trading culture.
Reviews:
Now, this is a site! Hundreds of camels (often over 600), but also sheep and goats, of all shapes and sizes, holed up in around 56 pens. When I went there, around 8am, I was the only visitor. Men working there will offer you a tour and photo opportunities for a tip. If you accept, make sure you negotiate beforehand, as they tend to be kind of extortionate. I did the tour by myself, no bother at all. The place is dusty, noisy, and smelly, but that shouldn't come as a surprise and it is SO worth a visit!!!

Al Ain camel market is located about 8kms south of the city centre. Entrance is free
Location is reachable by public bus, like all major attractions in Al Ain and since day tours can be quite expensive, the public bus system is a great alternative. Buses are fast, modern, reliable, frequent and cheap. Grab a free-of-charge temporary HAFILAT transport card at Abu Dhabi airport arrivals lounge and charge it with 20 AED, it'll be of use throughout the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. || Al Ain CAmel Market is the biggest camel market in the UAE. It's a unique place where camels can be bought to make meat. You can have a walk through the market and see the everyday local life. An authentic emirates place to see. || You could find variety of camels, sheep, goats. It is a fantastic experience, specially for children. || This was one of the highlights of my trip to Al Ain. I really enjoyed this livestock market. They have a huge number of camels from many vendors. There are camels of all ages for sale. There are also goats, sheep and cattle for sale. There are numerous supply stores with hay and building supplies for making corrals with bamboo, wreeds and rope. There is fire wood also. It's a tradition to cook meats etc with wood fires. I highly recommend seeing this market. || My family and I recently visited Al Ain Camel Market and had a wonderful time. The market itself was very interesting and we enjoyed learning about the operations of the market.

What made our visit particularly memorable was the kindness and hospitality shown to us by the Pakistani and Afghan men we met there. They were extremely friendly and helpful, offering to take pictures of us with the camels and explaining how the market operates. We truly appreciated their warmth and generosity.

Overall, I would highly recommend a visit to Al Ain Camel Market, not just for the fascinating market itself, but also for the opportunity to meet and interact with people from different cultures who are so welcoming and hospitable.

Name: Al Ain Equestrian, Shooting & Golf Club
Description: A sports complex offering equestrian, shooting, golf and leisure facilities.
Reviews:
The staffs were nice. The locker room, bathroom and toilets were okay. The golf course itself is well maintained, the greens were on the hard side but not too fast. The layout is quite challenging and fun to play. || It's a very good golf course.  But it's too far from the Abu Dhabi city.  It takes me near 2 hrs Taxi to get there. || best field for airaoft at uae !! mmm here was perfect, the place is very huge, there’s a lot of facilities || I have visited 2 times with my friends and family, the experience was fantastic. A lot of activities for kids as well as adults. Tasty food in the restaurants inside. Peaceful environment away from city buzz makes it a perfect place to spend relax time with your family and friends. Fantastic place. || I recently visited Al Ain Equestrian, Shooting & Golf Club for a site inspection, and I was truly impressed. The property is huge, beautifully maintained, and very well planned, offering a wide range of facilities all in one place.

Walking around the venue was a great experience—the open spaces, greenery, and overall layout make it ideal for events, leisure, and recreational activities. The atmosphere is calm yet vibrant, and you can really feel the scale and versatility of the club.
