Special thanks to Aisha Agha for taking me around and for the warm hospitality. I had a great time exploring the area and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a premium venue in Al Ain, whether for events, sports, or a relaxing day out. Definitely worth a visit!

Name: Al Ain National Museum
Description: A museum presenting archaeology, ethnography and the history of Al Ain.
Reviews:
I had a wonderful experience during the museum tour. The visit was very well organized, informative, and engaging from start to finish. Our tour guide, Ms Shamma Alneyadi, was extremely knowledgeable, professional, and passionate, which made the tour enjoyable and easy to follow. The workshop session was equally impressive, thanks to Ms Shamsa Almheiri, who delivered it with clarity, enthusiasm, and great interaction. Overall, it was a memorable and enriching experience, and I highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting the museum 🌸💌 || Sultan Fort in Al Ain is a beautiful glimpse into the UAE’s rich heritage. The traditional mud-brick architecture and peaceful surroundings give you a real sense of history and culture. Located next to the Al Ain Museum and oasis, it’s a perfect spot for anyone interested in the origins of the region.

It’s also a lovely sunset viewpoint—the golden hour here adds a special charm, making the whole place feel calm and magical. A peaceful, educational, and truly worthwhile place to visit. || Visiting Al Ain Museum was a truly enriching experience and one I would highly recommend to anyone interested in culture, history, and heritage. The museum is exceptionally well designed and beautifully curated, showcasing remarkable artefacts from the Iron Age dating back nearly 3,000 years.

The exhibitions offer a fascinating insight into the rich history and traditions of Al Ain, including the ingenious Falaj water transmission and irrigation system, which reflects the region’s deep connection with sustainable water management and agriculture.

One of the highlights was the “Education Room,” where visitors can engage in hands-on activities and create different types of artefacts, making the experience especially enjoyable for children and families. The staff were welcoming, knowledgeable, and always happy to help, which added greatly to the overall visit.

The museum shop also deserves special mention, offering a selection of beautifully crafted items and souvenirs inspired by local heritage and culture.

Overall, Al Ain Museum is a wonderful destination for both adults and children. I would suggest allowing around 2–4 hours to fully appreciate the exhibitions and activities. A memorable and worthwhile visit. || I had heard quite a bit about how this place, originally inaugurated by the late Sheikh Zayed, was recently renovated and reopened to the public. I decided to visit and was pleasantly surprised by the amount of UAE history it showcases. At first, it felt like mainly an archaeological site, but as I explored further, I discovered many other ancient items that were once used by the early people of the UAE. It was genuinely nice to see these humble beginnings and compare them to where the country is today.
The entry fee with Fazza was AED 33 and parking was free and spacious. Accessibility for people of determination was thoughtfully planned and easy to navigate. There is also a small shop inside where souvenirs are sold.
One of the highlights for me was the interactive displays placed throughout the museum. They explain things like how pots were made, how date palms were grown, and other traditional processes. These are especially engaging for the current generation who prefer learning through screens and hands-on interactions.
Anyone interested in history or geography will enjoy this place the most, as it offers a detailed look into the roots and evolution of the UAE. || Today I visited al ain museum and honestly I did not expect to learn this much. I booked a Tour with Mira and I didn’t really plan ahead to do so but it was the best thing I did. She walked us through the beginning of the museum’s history down to the smallest detail of all the collections. Every area was better than the other, and I got to know the essence of Al Ain from start to finish. Really I recommend you to book it, because you will learn about how beautiful this place is and its rich history.

Name: Al Ain Oasis
Description: A UNESCO-listed oasis with shaded paths and traditional falaj irrigation.
Reviews:
So happy to see this place developed from when I first visited almost a decade ago. There's free parking available and the entrance is also free. Lots of cafes in the main entrance which adds the overall vibes of the place. You can also rent bicycle or tricycle and explore the pavements road in between the farm. There's even a free shuttle bus from the Oasis to Al Ain Museum. You can actually walk to the museum from here it's lovely. || Absolutely breathtaking experience at Al Ain Oasis 🌴✨

One of the most beautiful, peaceful, and culturally rich destinations in Al Ain. The oasis offers a perfect combination of nature, heritage, relaxation, and outdoor activities, making it an unforgettable experience for families, friends, tourists, residents, and visitors from different nationalities around the world.

The biking experience inside the oasis was truly amazing — relaxing, scenic, and refreshing while surrounded by thousands of palm trees, beautiful pathways, and natural greenery. The atmosphere feels calm, clean, and incredibly rejuvenating, especially for people who enjoy nature and peaceful surroundings.

The cafés and restaurants inside the oasis provide a cosy and authentic dining experience with delicious food, refreshments, coffee, and traditional date products. The date café experience was especially memorable, offering high-quality local flavors and a welcoming ambiance perfect for relaxing after exploring the oasis.

There are also wonderful souvenir shops where visitors can buy beautiful gifts, traditional products, handicrafts, dates, and memorable items representing the culture and heritage of the UAE. Everything is very organized, clean, secure, and well-maintained, making the entire visit smooth and enjoyable.

Highly recommended for sightseeing, biking, photography, cultural exploration, relaxation, family bonding, and discovering the natural beauty of Al Ain. Truly one of the most iconic and must-visit destinations in the UAE with exceptional experiences, hospitality, and unforgettable views 🌍💚🚲✨ || Beautiful and peaceful place to visit! Al ain Oasis is perfect for a relaxing walk surrounded by nature and palm trees. Very clean, well maintained, and great for families. A wonderful escape from the city ,  highly recommended. || The place holds a rich history and is considered one of the oldest oases in the UAE, reflecting traditional ways of life and the traditional falaj irrigation system in a simple and engaging way. The nature there is very peaceful, with shaded pathways surrounded by palm trees. There’s also an immersive light experience that adds a unique and beautiful touch to the overall visit. || Al Ain Oasis is a peaceful place to walk among the greenery and palm trees. You can also rent bikes at the entrance if you prefer cycling. Free entrance.

Name: Al Ain Safari
Description: A guided safari experience within Al Ain Zoo.
Reviews:
Feelin the real Desert vibes. Overall is good. Food is okay. Washroom need to be improved. || Not much to do, kinda waste of a day with the poor camels being dragged around for rides and boring few (3) activities.

Food was decent though || Wonderful experience! A complete fun! || Good place but lo quality maintenance

Name: Al Ain Zoo
Description: A large zoo focused on Arabian wildlife, conservation and family education.
Reviews:
Our first visit to Al Ain Zoo was truly an unforgettable experience. I went there with my family and friends, and from the beginning until the end, we enjoyed every moment.
We were already impressed at the entrance because of the honesty and kindness of the staff. The local ladies at the ticketing counter returned the extra payment made by our senior mother, which we truly appreciated.
Inside the zoo, the staff welcomed us with warm smiles that made us feel comfortable right away. Special thanks to Gilbert, Chito, and Junmark for patiently assisting us, answering our questions, and guiding us throughout the day.
We also had fun with the amazing face painting by Liza and Glen they were very talented and friendly!
Our trip from Dubai was absolutely worth it, and we will definitely recommend this place to our friends. Thank you for such a memorable experience. 5 stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ || Visiting Al Ain Zoo in January was perfect. The weather was mild and comfortable, making it ideal for walking through such a vast park. To really do the visit justice, give yourself plenty of time. The zoo is huge, and if you’re with kids, plan for at least three hours, if not half a day, to explore without rushing. With expansion underway for a new African elephant habitat, it’s clear the zoo continues to grow and improve.

There’s an impressive variety of animals. The hippos, rhinos, crocodiles, and zebras caught my attention early on. The aviary stood out, featuring a wide range of colorful and exotic bird species in a spacious walk-through setting that lets you observe them up close. There were also hands-on educational opportunities, including brief encounters with an owl (nice 270 degrees head turn) and even the chance for visitors to touch a snake.

The safari truck ride was decent, perhaps a bit less thrilling than expected, but still enjoyable. A real highlight was briefly feeding the giraffes, which was a memorable experience.

Food options were plentiful, with restaurants, fast-food outlets, and kiosks scattered throughout. We had Mexican food, which hit the spot. The free train ride was a lifesaver, especially for families, offering a relaxing way to navigate the expansive grounds. Overall, had a good time. || We absolutely loved our visit to the zoo! It was such a beautiful and memorable experience from start to finish. The highlight for us was feeding the giraffes — it felt so magical and special to be that close to such gentle and amazing animals. Our daughter was the happiest we’ve ever seen her, and that made the day even more special. It truly made our day unforgettable! We’re still smiling thinking about it. Highly recommend this place to everyone! || Visited Al Ain Zoo recently and the experience was average overall. The zoo is spacious with a good variety of animals, but the long walking distances and hot weather made it a bit tiring. I would definitely recommend opting for the golf cart subscription or shuttle service to make the visit more comfortable which we did. The place is clean and family friendly, but the overall experience could have been more satisfying. || Went on a public holiday - barely any queues.

Paid extra for buggy, but the service was messy and unorganised. Drivers picked up and dropped off people wherever they wanted and no one was really helpful about it. One driver was so rude, he asked us to exit the park when we got back to the entrance and kept demanding our bracelet back. No idea why. He even lied about the tiger enclosure being fully closed when we mentioned we wanted to still go see tigers.

Could not see any of the big cats (tigers, lions, etc.) because they were "all inside sleeping."

Water stations were not cold.

Safari was a unique experience, but quite underwhelming. Feeding a giraffe during the safari was definitely a beautiful memory.

Museum was ok.

Live dancing, music and henna were definitely the highlight!

Name: Al Jahili Fort
Description: A restored historic fort with exhibitions about Al Ain and Emirati history.
Reviews:
A great spot to get a glimpse of Al Ain’s history. The fort itself is well preserved, and the photo exhibition featuring old images of the region was a pleasant surprise. I ended up spending more time there than expected. Quiet, interesting, and worth a visit if you’re exploring the cultural side of the UAE. || I absolutely LOVED Al Ain, when I arrived at Al Jahili Fort I was the ONLY visitor, so refreshing after the crowds of foreigners in Abu Dhabi and Dubai.
The fort, built towards the end of the 19th century of sun-dried mud bricks, has undergone major restoration works in 2007-2008 and is today a cultural centre where extremely polite staff members offer you dates and coffee and invite you to visit a very interesting photographic exhibition dedicated to British explorer Sir W. Thesiger. Entry to both the fort and the exhibition is free.
Location is reachable by public bus, like all major attractions in Al Ain and since day tours can be quite expensive, the public bus system is a great alternative. Buses are fast, modern, reliable, frequent and cheap. Grab a temporary card at Abu Dhabi airport arrivals lounge and charge it with 20 AED, it'll be of use throughout the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. || Al Jahili Fort in Al Ain is one of the UAE’s most important cultural treasures. Its impressive architecture, peaceful surroundings, and well-curated exhibits highlight the nation’s rich history and resilience. The fort stands as a symbol of Emirati heritage, showcasing the strategic and cultural significance it once held in protecting the region and supporting local communities. Visiting Al Jahili Fort offers a deep appreciation of the UAE’s past and the legacy that continues to shape its identity today. A must visit for anyone exploring Al Ain. || Al Jahili Fort is one of the most impressive and well-preserved forts in Al Ain, and it’s definitely worth a visit if you’re interested in history and culture. The fort’s architecture is beautiful, with high walls, towers, and spacious courtyards that give you a real sense of traditional Emirati design. Inside, there are exhibitions about the region’s history and the famous explorer Wilfred Thesiger, which are informative and nicely presented. The grounds are clean and well maintained, and the atmosphere is calm and relaxing. It’s free to enter, and the staff are friendly and helpful. || Visiting Al Jahili Fort in Al Ain was truly a beautiful and memorable experience. The moment you step inside, you can feel the history, culture, and pride of the UAE. The fort is very well preserved, calm, and surrounded by peaceful greenery, making it a perfect place to relax and reflect. What made it even more special was that the entry is completely free, which shows how much value is given to sharing heritage with everyone. It’s easily one of the best tourist attractions in Al Ain, and a place I would happily visit again. Highly recommended for anyone who loves history, culture, and photography.

Name: Al Qattara Arts Centre
Description: A cultural centre offering exhibitions, art classes and community programmes.
Reviews:
I had one of the most wonderful experiences in this place.

It's rich with culture.

I would love to visit it again and again.

Staff are amazing and lovely and so welcoming.

I'm so sad I couldn't catch their names but every single lady I met there was awesome. I want to send thanks for everyone.

They have art classes with subscription.

They have classes for children.

They have seasonal galleries

Souk works only in Winter

The place is more of a camp, families would enjoy it the most. || I visited Al Qattara Arts Centre in Al Ain, and it was such a peaceful and inspiring experience. 🌿
The place beautifully combines traditional Emirati architecture with a touch of modern creativity. As you walk through the corridors, you can feel the connection between history and art in every corner.

The centre features various art galleries showcasing works by both local and international artists. They also offer workshops and cultural programs that are perfect for anyone interested in learning or exploring art.

The staff are welcoming and knowledgeable, and the whole space is calm, clean, and well-maintained. It’s truly a cultural gem in Al Ain — ideal for art lovers, photographers, and anyone who enjoys quiet, meaningful experiences. 🎨✨ || This is an awesome place to visit. It is completely free and no wait. Although it is a bit small than normal museums but it has everything needed and very beautiful. To travelers in Al Ain: you must visit here. It is open 24 hours, and plenty of parking. || Visited on June 20, 2025, is a remarkable destination that beautifully showcases the rich culture heritage of the UAE.
The centre blends historical significance with modern artistic expression, making it a must-visit for anyone eager to deepen their understanding of Emirati culture, arts and crafts.
The exceptional support from the reception staff since I arrived, a warm welcoming, providing detailed insights. || A great place to get inspired from art to culture. The uniqueness is the possibility to book different classes and experiences for painting, Arabic calligraphy, pottery, piano and much more. Kids can also do classes from 6 years and up.

The center is free entry but there is a charge in case you want to book a class.

Name: Al Qattara Souq
Description: A restored traditional market and cultural event space.
Reviews:
I visited Al Qattara Heritage Souq and it was a lively and vibrant experience! 🌙
The market is bustling with people, sounds, and the aroma of traditional perfumes and spices. It’s not a quiet place — instead, it’s full of culture, energy, and authentic Emirati spirit.

You’ll find traditional products, from perfumes and honey to handmade crafts and clothing, as well as live folk performances and cultural shows.
Even though it’s crowded, the place is clean, safe, and the vendors are warm and welcoming.

✨ Currently, the area is hosting the Manar Abu Dhabi Festival, running from November 1, 2025, to January 4, 2026, featuring stunning light installations and artistic displays — adding even more magic to the experience.

I highly recommend visiting in the evening to enjoy the vibrant atmosphere, the lights of the festival, and capture amazing photos! 📸✨ || This beautifully restored UNESCO site offers an authentic, peaceful glimpse into Emirati heritage. Browse traditional crafts, sample local food and coffee, and explore the connected Al Qattara Arts Centre. || Great historical place inside the farms area. During winter there are daily events and music events as well. Enjoying 7arbiyah and traditional coffee and food as well. This place is stunning. The only downside is limited parking area and you need to walk for long distances if you come late as it is busy and difficult to find parking. There are paid parking lots but also it is full || A rather nice spot to visit surrounded by some farmlands. I recommend visiting later on in the day because I assume markets become more alive then. The art center was a nice breather from the heat as well. || Souq Al Qattara in Al Ain is a peaceful and well-organized heritage market that beautifully reflects Emirati culture. With traditional architecture, local crafts, authentic products, and nearby cultural attractions like Qattara Arts Centre, it offers more than shopping—it’s a relaxing cultural experience ideal for families, residents, and visitors.

Name: Green Mubazzarah
Description: A landscaped park and hot-spring area at the base of Jebel Hafit.
Reviews:
Nice place to hang out.  Very vast area covered with green . Will get stunning views of Jabel hafeet Mountain.  Easily accessible through bus. Vast area for parking. Well maintained washrooms available at free of cost. Must visit place in United Arab Emirates.  Evenings are highly recommended. || Such a wonderful place to hangout with friends and Families
Ussually too busy area
* Toilet available
* Shops available
* Kids park available
* barbeque area
* Prayer room available
* Swimming Pool Available (25dhm)
There is a small lake flowing we can walk through it || A beautiful family friendly place to visit especially during the winter season. The hot water springs is definitely the highlight and flows through canals, throughout the green park. There is adequate space for parking, picnics, barbeque, washrooms and praying. || If you are looking for a place for relaxation with a mountain view and an entertainment then you must visit this place. Mini train is so fun it cost 25aed per head, there is also a hotspring in the area and cafe if u feeling thirsty and hungry. You can breath fresh air in this wonderful place. || Best green place in the desert.... I always visit there with my children and enjoy the quality time

Name: Hili Archaeological Park
Description: An archaeological park containing Bronze Age tombs and settlement remains.
Reviews: It’s more like free park than a archaeological site. || Beautiful park with surrounds archeological site. Plenty walkways, barbecue areas, exercise zones and play areas for the kids. || A good park to come with kids to play the playground, but in terms of archeology it is not really impressive, if you were looking for some historical places, this is not an interesting one. I have attached photos of signs with information , that's all you can see there. || Always find myself missing my childhood in this calm park || Best location and facilities for family and BBQ party. Out door exercise facility available. Free entry. Free parking. Drinking water cooler working condition available. Kids playing area is best.

Name: Hili Fun City
Description: A family amusement park with rides, play areas and seasonal entertainment.
Reviews:
We visited Hili Fun City on a Wednesday and it was less crowded. There was a 50% discount on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, which made it even better. After purchasing the entry ticket, more than 30 attractions were available for unlimited rides at no extra cost, making it truly worth the money we paid. Please note that only card payments are accepted, so carry a card while visiting. || This park represents such good value and of course it wouldn’t be so if it was filled with the latest rides.
You should visit with that in mind, the rides are old, the park looks a bit tired, but your kids will have the best time for very little money.  Tues and Wed is only AED30 to enter and play on all the rides.
We went at 4pm and didn’t queue at all, by 6.30pm there were queues at the popular rides such as the Roller Coaster. || Hilifun City Al Ain is a great place for kids to enjoy and relax in the beautiful oasis city of Al Ain. It offers a wide variety of activities and entertainment options suitable for all ages, from young children to adults. The environment is fun, safe, and family-friendly, making it an excellent destination for quality time with family. Highly recommended for a joyful and memorable experience. || Have been planning for a long, finally their renovation was over. Bravo, all rides open.
1 time payment all rides multiple access inside.
Rides for small kids to teenagers and adults available. Family boat ride is included & not to miss the 5D movie was fun.
Very clean, well maintained park.
Free parking, small cafes inside available, prayer room, toilets, etc.
Cycling on chargeable bases.
Outside food is allowed.
Location is good , ample parking available.
They accept payments by cards Only for tickets at entrance.
Timings 4.00 to 10.00.
Monday- closed
Tues & Wed - 30 aed
Must visit for fun . || We went there during weekend. Entrance is 60 dhs. Unlimited rides. It was indeed a fun city though facilities are old. My kids enjoyed. There is also a playground and barbecue area. Some of the rides are carousel, boat, train, bump cars and even 5D Cinema.

Name: Jebel Hafit
Description: Abu Dhabi emirate's highest mountain with scenic drives and viewpoints.
Reviews:
The views at Jebel Hafeet are absolutely breathtaking, especially during sunrise and sunset. It’s a peaceful place to enjoy nature and take in the beautiful scenery from the top. It’s also an excellent location for running training, with a challenging uphill route that helps build endurance and strength. A perfect destination for both outdoor enthusiasts and runners. Highly recommended. || Good place to visit but not for long stay. BBQ is not allowed at all. Nice view of al ain city. Must have your own ride. || This is my second visit to Jebel Hafeet. I visited once last year, and now the place has become more developed as a tourist destination with new additions at the top, while more developments are still in progress. The views and atmosphere are amazing, especially during the evening drive.

However, many tourists are not taking proper care of the place. Garbage and used bottles are thrown around in several areas, which reduces the natural beauty of this wonderful location. Hope visitors will help keep Jebel Hafeet clean and beautiful for everyone. || The Best Escape in Al Ain!
​Jebel Hafeet is hands-down the best spot for a peaceful outing in Al Ain. Whether you are looking for a scenic drive or a break from the heat, this is the perfect destination.
​The Drive: The winding roads offer one of the best driving experiences in the UAE.
​The Views: The sunrise and sunset views from the peak are absolutely awesome and worth the trip alone.
​The Weather: It offers a refreshing cold weather experience, especially during the winter months.
​A must-visit for nature lovers and anyone looking for a beautiful, calm atmosphere! || A must visit place in Al Ain,Abudhabi. Lovely mountaneous terrain.Great climb upto near top by car with several sidestep for enjoying the sunrise and sunset. Geological exposures are a learning experience for Geoscientists.

Name: Jebel Hafit Desert Park
Description: A desert park combining archaeology, camping, hiking and mountain landscapes.
Reviews:
This was our second stay here, and it was truly memorable. Our first visit was three years ago when we stayed in a traditional tent without air conditioning. They provided BBQ materials, but breakfast was not included at that time. Even then, it was already a unique and enjoyable experience.

Last month, we returned with our kids and stayed again in the Arabian tent and we were amazed by how much the place has developed. The tent is now fully equipped with air conditioning, a fridge, fresh fruits, water, a first aid kit, and complete BBQ materials, making our stay comfortable and family-friendly.

One of the highlights of our stay was the breakfast, now served in a beautiful location with a stunning view. The food exceeded our expectations ,the quality and presentation were comparable to a 5-star hotel, and the service was exceptional.

We would especially like to commend the Filipino F&B attendant who served us. He was incredibly warm, attentive, and professional, making sure our family was well taken care of throughout our dining experience. Not only him but the whole team ,their hospitality truly made our stay extra special.

Overall, it was a wonderful experience for our family, and we are so happy to see how much this place has grown while maintaining its charm and excellent service. We will definitely be coming back again. || We had a few wonderful stays over the past months at Pura Eco Retreat Jebel Hafit Desert Park. It’s the perfect place to unwind and feel completely disconnected from the city, with a beautiful and peaceful setting at the foot of Jebel Hafeet.
Our Deluxe accommodation was excellent, and the private fire pit in the evening made the experience even more special.
What really made the stay stand out was the people. Everyone is incredibly friendly and helpful. A special thank you to Dua, Narcer and Adil at reception, Erik and his lovely restaurant and kitchen crew, Richard and his cleaning team, Adip, Pradip and all the drivers and staff we may have missed — you truly made our stay.
Breakfast was very good with lots of choice, and the overall atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming.
We will definitely come back once the temperatures go down again. || The location and views are beautiful, especially being surrounded by Jabel Hafeet. The dome itself was nice and the private pool added to the experience. But for the price paid, I honestly expected much better service and setup.

The drive to the tents/suites is quite long through a desert road, which may not be ideal for sedan cars if you’re not prepared for it, although they do guide you with a car in front.

My main issue was the dining setup. Since it was very sandy and windy outside, sitting outdoors wasn’t comfortable at all, and there was no proper indoor dining space either. Even simple things like having breakfast became inconvenient because there wasn’t enough space to sit and eat properly. I really feel they should have a covered outdoor area so guests can actually enjoy the surroundings comfortably.

Overall, the place has potential and the views are great, but the experience didn’t fully match the price. || Great weekend escape, just 2 hours drive from Dubai. The room was spacious with a separate bathroom. We ordered for dinner the DIY BBQ, they have proved everything that is needed, we just had to put the meat on the grill. The meat was really well marinated and tasted amazing. The breakfast was really really good. Eric our server did a great job in meeting all our requirements.
We will be definitely coming back in the winter time to try the one or other hiking paths they have. || I recently had the pleasure of staying at this park, and I can honestly say it was an amazing experience from start to finish. The property itself is beautiful, well-maintained, and offers a relaxing atmosphere that made our stay truly enjoyable.

What really stood out, though, was the exceptional service. A special thank you to Adep, Arief, and Pradep for assisting us with the booking and making our check-in process incredibly smooth. They were welcoming, professional, and genuinely kind.

I’d also like to appreciate DUA, GURU, and Naseer for their support during the check-out process. They were very helpful, courteous, and ensured everything was handled quickly and efficiently.

Overall, the hospitality and attention to detail made a big difference, and I would highly recommend this resort to anyone looking for a memorable and stress-free stay. Looking forward to visiting again!

Name: Mubazzarah Dam
Description: A scenic dam and mountain recreation area near Green Mubazzarah.
Reviews:
I recently visited Mubazzarah Lake in Al Ain, and it was such a peaceful escape.
Surrounded by mountains and lush greenery, the place feels like a hidden gem calm, clean, and beautifully maintained. It’s the perfect spot for a quiet walk, a picnic, or simply to unwind by the water. The view of Jebel Hafeet in the background makes it even more magical. || ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Green Mubazzarah Lake is a beautiful and peaceful escape in Al Ain. Surrounded by greenery and mountains, it’s the perfect place for a relaxing walk, picnic, or just to unwind by the water. The views of Jebel Hafeet make it even more special. A great spot for families and nature lovers—highly recommended! || The lake is beautiful, but it lacks a lot of attention for people to come and enjoy it.

But there are places where you can sit with your family.

I urge those in charge of this lake to pay attention to it. || A stunning natural escape with a truly relaxing vibe! Green Mubazzarah Lake is one of the most beautiful spots in Al Ain, perfect for unwinding and enjoying nature at its best.

The scenery is absolutely breathtaking — surrounded by lush greenery, rolling hills, and peaceful hot spring areas nearby. The lake itself adds a calming atmosphere, making it ideal for picnics, evening walks, or simply sitting back and enjoying the view.

The area is well maintained, family-friendly, and offers plenty of space for relaxation and photography. As the sun sets, the whole place becomes even more magical with cooler air and soft lighting over the landscape.

A must-visit destination for anyone in Al Ain looking for peace, nature, and unforgettable views. 🌿💚 || Green Mubazzarah Lake is a hidden gem nestled at the foot of Jebel Hafeet. The clean, green, and refreshingly cold water makes it the perfect spot for kayaking and relaxing amidst nature. Surrounded by lush greenery and scenic views, it’s a peaceful escape ideal for families, couples, or solo travelers. Whether you’re there for a paddle or just to unwind, it’s truly one of the best places to enjoy the outdoors in every way.

Name: Sheikh Zayed Palace Museum
Description: A former royal residence displaying the life and heritage of Sheikh Zayed.
Reviews:
Zayed National Museum is an amazing place to visit. I love going to museums, and I really enjoyed this one. It tells the story of the UAE’s history, culture, and development in a very interesting way.

The building itself is impressive. The design is modern, unique, and beautiful, making it a landmark on its own.

The exhibits are well organized, and there is a lot to learn about the country and its heritage. I highly recommend visiting Zayed National Museum 🇦🇪✨ || What an incredible piece of architecture! Honestly a great experience. The building is incredible, the displays well curated and the story of the UAE beautifully told. Enjoyed every minute of the visit here. Don’t forget to go through the cafe to the ramp all the way to the roof. The photos you can take there and on the way are amazing. || My husband and I really enjoyed our visit. We’re from Dubai and traveled to Abu Dhabi to visit the museum, and it was such a wonderful experience. The architecture was stunning!! It was not only educational but also very modern and interactive, plus the impressive technology that brings the exhibits to life. What I liked most was the atmosphere. It was quiet, peaceful, and relaxing, which allowed us to appreciate each gallery at our own pace. Also, all of the staff (from entry, guides and security) were very helpful and always had smiles on their faces, even though it was Friday and we stayed until the museum closed. Indeed, a must-visit!! || Visited the beautiful Zayed National Museum in Abu Dhabi and had an amazing experience. The architecture of the museum is truly unique and modern, inspired by the heritage and culture of the UAE. We like this quick escape. || Delma Island is one of the UAE’s hidden treasures, offering a unique combination of natural beauty, cultural heritage, and warm hospitality. Tucked away in the Arabian Gulf, this island provides the perfect escape from the busy pace of city life, allowing visitors to slow down and immerse themselves in a serene atmosphere.

One of the most remarkable features of Delma Island is its rich history. Known as one of the oldest continuously inhabited places in the UAE, the island has deep roots in pearl diving and traditional Emirati culture. Exploring its museums, heritage sites, and old houses gives a fascinating glimpse into a way of life that has shaped the nation’s identity. Visitors often describe the island as a “living museum,” where history meets modern comforts.

The natural beauty of Delma is equally captivating. The island is home to pristine beaches, clear waters, and stunning views of the open sea. Whether you’re strolling along the shore, enjoying a quiet picnic, or simply watching the sunset, the island offers moments of pure tranquility. For those interested in nature, the island also hosts unique flora and fauna, making it a delightful spot for photographers and explorers.

Beyond history and scenery, Delma Island is known for its hospitality. The local community is warm and welcoming, eager to share stories and traditions with visitors. The island is also well connected by the Dalma Ferry, making travel convenient while still giving that “island getaway” feel.

Overall, Delma Island is a destination that combines culture, relaxation, and authenticity. It’s perfect for history lovers, families seeking a quiet retreat, or travelers looking for an off-the-beaten-path experience. A visit to Delma is not just a trip—it’s a journey into the heart of Emirati heritage and the timeless beauty of the sea. || 💥💥💥A MUST DO EXPERIENCE IN UAE 🇦🇪 💥💥💥

Delma/Dalma Island located nearly 26 miles from Abu Dhabi, is one of the United Arab Emirates' earliest settlements. It is a relic of the history of the United Arab Emirates and is well-known as a pearl trading center and archeological site.

With a history dating back 7,000 years, it was one of the world's oldest pearl trading centers. During various excavations, stone tools, beads, shells, and pieces of Ubaid pottery have all been discovered here, making it a particularly noteworthy historical attraction of the UAE. It's also a popular spot in Abu Dhabi for fishing, camping, and snorkeling.

Al Muhannadi Mosque, Al Dawsari Mosque, Al Muraykhi Mosque, and Al Muraykhi House are popular historical attractions that draw history and architecture enthusiasts to this beautiful island. The Delma Museum, housed in the fortified home of Muhammad Bin Jasim Al Muraykhi, houses a rare collection displaying the island's rich history and culture. The majority of the buildings on Dalma Island are century-old and reflect Emirati culture and architecture.

There is a small motel on the Island where visitors can stay. It is easily accessible by ferry and air travel. It is a two-hour scenic ferry ride from the Jebel Dhanna. Except for Friday, non-scheduled flights from Abu Dhabi International Airport to Dalma Island operate six days a week.

Boasting a rich history, Dalma Island is a beautiful paradise for those seeking peace and tranquility among nature's bounty.

Travel by land and Al-dobh:

Those wishing to visit the island of Dalma can go by road to Jebel Dhanna (Ruwais road from Abu Dhabi), and at Jebel Dhanna is the port of the Dobh (the ship that carries passengers and cars to the island of Dalma), and there are times for the ship from 7 am to 7 pm.

Overall, it’s a great place and I hope to see this aspect improved in the future || Delma Museum, situated on Delma Island approximately 42 kilometers off Abu Dhabi’s coast, offers a captivating glimpse into the region’s rich maritime heritage and the island’s historical significance.  ￼

Historical Significance

Housed in the former residence of renowned pearl merchant Mohammed bin Jasim Al Muraikhi, the museum showcases the island’s prominence in the pearl trade during the late 19th and early 20th centuries. The building itself, constructed between the late 1800s and early 1900s, exemplifies early coastal architecture, featuring traditional elements such as a majlis (reception room) and a badkesh (windcatcher) designed to cool interiors.  ￼

Exhibits

Visitors can explore a diverse collection of artifacts, including pearling equipment, stone anchors, and traditional date presses (midbasah) used for producing date syrup. These items were either unearthed during the building’s restoration or generously donated by local residents, providing insights into the daily lives and trades of the island’s past inhabitants.  ￼

Restoration Efforts

The Department of Culture and Tourism – Abu Dhabi (DCT Abu Dhabi) undertook significant restoration work from 2019 to 2021 to preserve the museum’s structural and historical integrity. Innovative conservation methods were employed to address issues like rising dampness, ensuring the longevity of this cultural landmark.  ￼

Visiting Information

To visit Delma Museum, you can take a water ferry from Al Dhana, with a journey time of approximately two hours. Ferries depart daily at 7 am and 1 pm, with return trips from Delma Island at 10 am and 4 pm. Tickets are priced at AED 20 for adults, and children under 12 can travel for free. An additional fee of AED 100 applies if you wish to bring your car. It’s advisable to check the latest schedules and book tickets through the Abu Dhabi Maritime website.  ￼ || We recently visited Dalma Island museum and had a truly wonderful experience

Zayed Cricket Stadium is a world-class sports landmark in Abu Dhabi that beautifully blends top-tier facilities with a vibrant atmosphere. Known globally for hosting thrilling international cricket matches, it has become a hub not only for cricket enthusiasts but also for families and the wider community who enjoy memorable sporting events.

The stadium’s design is impressive—its modern architecture, immaculate grounds, and comfortable seating provide an excellent viewing experience for all visitors. No matter where you sit, the visibility of the pitch is outstanding. The atmosphere during matches is electric, with fans from different nationalities uniting in their love for the game, reflecting Abu Dhabi’s multicultural spirit.

One of the standout features is the high standard of pitch and field maintenance. Players and professionals frequently highlight the quality of the playing surface, which has hosted some of the most exciting fixtures in world cricket. For fans, the facilities are equally well-managed, with clean amenities, efficient parking, and a well-organized security system ensuring smooth entry and exit.

Beyond cricket, Zayed Stadium also opens its doors to community events, concerts, and fitness activities, making it more than just a sporting venue. Families often visit for fun cricket academies, community tournaments, and other programs that encourage youth involvement in sports.

For visitors, the hospitality is another plus. The staff are courteous, ticketing systems are efficient, and food outlets provide a wide range of options. The experience is designed to ensure both casual visitors and die-hard cricket fans feel welcome.

Zayed Cricket Stadium is not just a venue—it’s a symbol of Abu Dhabi’s passion for sports, excellence, and community spirit. Whether attending a high-profile international match or enjoying a local tournament, you’re guaranteed a memorable experience. || Zayed Cricket City in Abu Dhabi is an outstanding destination for cricket lovers and sports fans alike. The facilities are top-class, with a well-maintained pitch, modern seating, and excellent lighting that makes both day and night matches enjoyable. The venue is clean, spacious, and well organized, creating a professional yet welcoming atmosphere. Parking is convenient, and access to the stadium is smooth even during major events. The match began with an electrifying atmosphere. The sound of bat meeting ball and the sight of players running across the field brought the game to life. The stadium, with its vibrant energy, made every moment memorable. The cheers from spectators, even if few, added to the competitive spirit and gave me a taste of what it might feel like to play in front of a packed audience.

By the end of the match, I was exhausted but thoroughly satisfied. Win or lose, the experience of playing cricket in a professional stadium was an unforgettable one. It was a reminder of the joy of sports, the value of teamwork, and the sheer fun of being part of a thrilling game.

Name: Sheikh Zayed Bridge Viewpoint

Reviews:
The Sheikh Zayed Bridge in Abu Dhabi, designed by the late Dame Zaha Hadid, stands as a striking example of how architecture and engineering can merge to create an iconic civic landmark. As one of the region’s most recognizable infrastructural works, the bridge demonstrates Hadid’s signature expressive design language—fluid, dynamic, and sculptural—while simultaneously fulfilling complex technical demands.
From an architectural perspective, the bridge is a masterpiece of form and movement. Its sweeping, wave-like arches evoke the rolling dunes of the UAE desert, creating a powerful visual connection between the built environment and the natural landscape. This rhythmic silhouette is especially captivating at night, when carefully choreographed lighting transforms the structure into a glowing, animated ribbon across the water. The bridge does more than facilitate transport; it enriches the urban experience by becoming a work of art visible from multiple vantage points throughout the city.
On the engineering side, the project showcases remarkable innovation and precision. The asymmetrical steel arches, with their complex geometries and large spans, required advanced structural solutions and meticulous coordination among engineers and fabricators. Despite its highly sculptural character, the bridge performs exceptionally well as a durable and functional piece of infrastructure, accommodating high vehicular loads while maintaining stability and resilience in a challenging coastal environment. The successful integration of complex design intent with robust engineering makes the bridge a significant achievement in contemporary civil engineering.
Overall, the Sheikh Zayed Bridge stands as a testament to Zaha Hadid’s visionary approach—bold, futuristic, and deeply rooted in contextual inspiration. It elevates a common infrastructural typology into a cultural landmark that celebrates innovation, artistry, and the UAE’s progressive architectural identity. || Sheikh Zayed Bridge designed by Pritzker Prize winner Zaha Hadid, the striking 842 metre-long, 64 metre-high Sheikh Zayed Bridge is said to be the most complex bridge ever built.

Its curved arches evoke undulating sand dunes and it features a dynamic lighting design, with subtle colours that flow across its spine. Its road decks are suspended from symmetrical steel arches, forming a waveform with a fluid silhouette. || Amazingly - designed landmark bridge connecting Abu Dhabi to mainland besides old Maqtaa bridge.

the striking 842 meters long, 64 meters high seikh Zayed Bridge is said to be the most complex bridge ever built.
Its Curved arches evoke undulating sand dunes and it features a dynamic lighting design, with subtle colour that flow across its spine. Its road decks are suspended from symmetrical steel arches, forming a waveform with fluid silhouette.
An amazing view you can have from any angle of it!

Name: The Galleria Al Maryah Island
Description: A luxury shopping and entertainment mall with dining and family activities.
Reviews:
The Galleria Mall is truly one of Abu Dhabi’s most impressive lifestyle destinations. It’s a huge, beautifully designed space that caters to every type of visitor — families, shoppers, food lovers, fitness enthusiasts, and those simply looking for a relaxing day out.

One of the standout features is the Sky Park — a stunning outdoor area with greenery, sunlight, and open-air seating that gives the mall a refreshing, elevated atmosphere. Inside, the mall is spotless with amazing restroom facilities, including dedicated mum rooms for feeding babies, family bathrooms, and clean, spacious areas that really make a difference for parents.

The shopping variety is exceptional. From high-end luxury brands to everyday favorites like Bath & Body Works, the mall strikes the perfect balance. The Apple Store with direct access to the promenade is a highlight — bright, modern, and always buzzing with energy.

Galleria is also very community-focused. This is reflected in their regular yoga and wellness events, seasonal activations, and endless kids’ activities that make the space feel lively and inclusive. For entertainment, the mall has Vox Cinema, world-class family zones, and fun play areas for children.

Food lovers are spoiled for choice — enjoy a meal at one of the many indoor and outdoor restaurants, grab something quick in the food court, or relax at one of the many coffee shops scattered around the mall.

Parking is convenient, and the newly added parking structure leading directly to the outside promenade is a great improvement, making access even easier.

Overall, The Galleria is a place where you can spend the entire day comfortably. Beautiful, family-friendly, full of lifestyle experiences — a definite must-visit in Abu Dhabi. || What an incredible place! The Galleria on Al Maryah Island is hands down one of the best malls I’ve visited in Abu Dhabi — truly luxurious yet welcoming for everyone.
It’s the perfect mix of high-end luxury brands alongside popular stores, there’s something for every budget and taste.
Over 70 restaurants and cafes, everything is super clean, and well-organized!
If you’re in Abu Dhabi, this is a must-visit! || Yesterday I went there with my friends. Everything was great except for the main items we ordered. The place itself is very posh and aesthetically beautiful, which made me even more excited since I’m an avid fan of coffee and stylish coffee shops.

However, when our order arrived, I was honestly surprised because the coffee was not hot at all, and it also lacked flavor. For a high-end coffee shop, I expected the coffee to be served at the proper temperature and with better quality.

Thankfully, the cake made up for it—it was really good.

I didn’t complain at the time because the staff member who served us was kind, and she is also my fellow Filipino. The service itself was good, so I didn’t want to cause any trouble.

I’m only sharing this feedback here so it can help improve things in the future—not necessarily for me, but for other customers who will visit your shop. Since your café presents itself as a high-end coffee place, I hope you can check the quality and temperature of the coffee before serving it.

Thank you, and I hope this feedback helps. || Call it a one stop shop, from luxury brands to restaurants. Its an enjoyable place to be.

You come to this place in mind and end up spending hours inside it, browsing books at Kinokumiya was my best one yet, every corner felt inviting.
Baths and body works was a grwat stop for my friends birthday gift purchases.
The ambience, spacious and well organized. Not forgeting thw abundance if variety here. Highly recommended. It's not just a shopping mall, its a whole experience. || I had a positive experience when I came here. Everywhere appears tidy and pleasant. A good shopping mall.

Name: Al Maryah Island Promenade
Description: A waterfront promenade with city views, dining and public art.

A very refreshing, calm and serene place to pass time at. Despite being surrounded by a lot of sky-scrapers, the waterfront area is maintained very well || Still under lots of maintenance,

fire alarms go off frequently between 2 am to 6 am.
Neighbours are assembling furnitures and mounting things using drill machines, swimming pool is not acceptable, gym has no mirrors and super small for such a huge building and elevators are constantly under maintenance. || Nice place for evening walks and for fireworks watching. Lots of entertainment, dining, shopping and hotel options.

We enjoy the fireworks each year and it never fails us to awe us.

A must visit place if you are visiting to Abu Dhabi.

It has grows a lot in past few years and very impressive development ..!

Name: ACTIVE Al Maryah Island
Description: An outdoor sports and fitness destination with football and recreation facilities.
Reviews:
We usually play 1–2 matches here every week, and honestly this has been one of the best grounds we’ve experienced in Abu Dhabi.

But when we tried to book this week, the convenient slot (10 PM to 11 PM) was not available. Usually, that time used to be available.

Also, the price has suddenly increased by around 150 AED (from 400 to 550), which feels quite high and difficult for us to manage.

Because of this, we are now in a situation where we may have to look for another ground. We really liked playing here, so we hope you can consider this and help us with a better solution. || I went to Abu Dhabi for an American Flag Football International tournament. We played at the indoor A/C stadium, and the experience was out of this world. It was well organized, with a great astroturf field, clean washrooms, and changing rooms. If I played football again, it would be in this indoor field. || Great & proper sport facilities for football, basketball, paddle, tennis, running track and many more. Completed with dome for indoor soccer field. There are many academies for each sports, you can come and ask directly to them during their classes.

Clean toilets, fresh drinking water,  changing rooms, lockers and free parking lot are available. They also provide benches for families to wait and see their children do activities.

Location is not in the same level as entrance of Galeria Mall, but it is connected to basement of Galleria Mall.

The only problem for me is about unavailability of praying room and taxi/bus stand. || Beautiful place mind blowing  panoramic view of football court || Great place to book and play games with friends..
Such a cool place just outside the city is really amazing.

Name: Rosewood Abu Dhabi Waterfront
Description: A waterfront hotel district with dining and views across the city.
Reviews:
I recently visited Rosewood Abu Dhabi and had an excellent experience. The hotel combines luxury, elegance, and exceptional service in a prime location on Al Maryah Island.

From the moment I arrived, the team made me feel genuinely welcome. I would like to extend my sincere thanks to the Front Office team for their professionalism, efficiency, and warm hospitality throughout my visit.

A special thank you to Oya from the Sales team for her support, kindness, and attention to detail. I would also like to recognize Amarachi and Lobna from the Front Office team for their warm welcome, professionalism, and outstanding hospitality. Their dedication and genuine care made the experience even more enjoyable.

Overall, Rosewood Abu Dhabi delivers a luxury experience with excellent service and a refined atmosphere. I highly recommend it and look forward to visiting again in the future. || A superb location with elegant, modern rooms. Our Deluxe King Room had an excellent waterfront view. The hotel’s accessibility for People of Determination was thoughtfully designed, and the staff were extremely helpful throughout our stay.
Breakfast at Aqua was exceptional, with a wide range of selections. I have never seen a breakfast buffet serving protein shakes before — such a thoughtful touch!
A truly memorable stay at Rosewood Abu Dhabi.. || Beautiful hotel, with a very luxurious feel. Had drinks at Glo, beautiful view. Honored to be served by the manager Felipe. Nyi and Barry were wonderful too. Great service, care and attention. Will definitely return. || My one night stay at Rosewood Abu Dhabi was truly memorable from start to finish. From the moment I arrived, the team’s gracious hospitality and genuine smiles set the tone for a relaxing experience.

The room was incredibly cozy with an amazing view, and what stood out most was the peaceful atmosphere that genuinely helped me sleep well. I especially loved the soft background music on the TV such a unique touch that added to the calm ambiance of the room. The lighting controls were very convenient and easy to access with a simple touch, the bathroom was spacious and beautifully set up, and the furniture was of excellent quality and very well organized, adding to the overall comfort of the stay.

At check in, Elnura at the front desk was wonderful, helpful and always smiling. She kindly arranged a late check-out for me, which I really appreciated and needed.

Lunch at Dai Pai Dong was a highlight of the stay. Jenny and Munashi were extremely welcoming and set a lovely first impression as soon as I arrived. Averina, who took care of my table, was attentive, helpful, and ensured everything was perfect throughout the meal. The warm service beautifully complemented the restaurant’s vibrant atmosphere.

Breakfast at Aqua was just as impressive. JJ greeted me first with a friendly welcome, Christian was very warm and welcoming throughout, Omar gave excellent recommendations and was very attentive, and Thinzar stood out with her genuine smile and kind approach. Overall, this short stay reminded me why Rosewood is known for its refined hospitality. Every team member I met added a personal touch that made the experience special. I’m already looking forward to returning || I got a pool membership at Rosewood about a month ago and it's been such a wonderful experience. The facilities are well maintained, clean and so relaxing. The staff is so welcoming, particularly Remi, Aang and the lifeguards.
10/10 experience.

Name: Reem Beach
Description: A city beach area with views of the surrounding towers and waterfront.
Reviews:
Community Beach Spot
Reem Beach is a peaceful area to enjoy the water, relax, or have a simple picnic. It’s a nice extension of the Reem Park community — people walk, run, stroll with their dogs, or just sit and enjoy the view. The open space and calm atmosphere make it a great spot for anyone wanting a break from the city.One gentle reminder: please bring a trash bag with you. Although there are trash cans, they fill up quickly and aren’t big enough to hold a lot of waste. Keeping the beach clean makes the experience so much better for everyone and helps protect the environment we all share.Overall, Reem Beach is a lovely community area with easy access to Reem Park, perfect for simple moments, fresh air, and quiet time by the water. || Lovely place to walk around at sunset. The mangroves and water are beautiful. The boardwalk and beach are clean. || Reem Beach is a stunning destination known for its pristine sands and clear turquoise waters. It's an ideal spot for relaxation, sunbathing, and water sports. With its serene atmosphere and beautiful views, Reem Beach offers a perfect escape for both locals and tourists.
You also can enjoy boat trips on this beach using orca boats.
Orca Boats offers an amazing boat adventure with its unique boat designs and scenic tours. The boats are well-maintained, ensuring a safe and comfortable ride. Whether you're looking for a relaxing cruise or an exciting water excursion, Orca Boats provides an unforgettable experience. || Great place to have a walk. There is a nice and long pavement along the beach with many cats on the way. Reem beach itself not very clean for sunbathing or swimming - a lot of garbage from food. || Beach is clean have boating facility at 70 aed per one boat. It has child play area, skating, basketball court, fountain. Free entry is the best part

Name: Reem Island Canal Walk
Description: A pedestrian waterfront path with bridges, landscaping and city views.
Reviews:
Top 👍
It’s really beautiful walk all around this well maintained island
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ SEVEN STARS! || A beautiful and convenient public space that runs along the northern peninsula of Reem Island; and across its main roads.

The public space that the canal is (with its outdoor gym equipments, benches, flowerbeds, trees, etc.) provides also the most convenient pedestrian connection to most of the other notable public spaces in the neighborhood, namely the Central Park (and Mosque), the periphery seawalk, and other smaller parks. The water is quite transparent to a point one questions how muhlch chemicals it has that makes it so devoid of life. It should sacrifice a bit of its cristal-clearness to nurture the local flora and fauna. (There isn't even a single patch of seaweed!)
