Description: A skate and recreation area inside Reem Central Park.
Reviews:
Al Reem Skate Park has a great layout and attracts many skating enthusiasts, but it is often very crowded. The high traffic can make it feel unsafe for young kids, especially beginners. Better crowd control or dedicated kids’ hours would improve the experience. || This place is great. Good facilities, ramps, and other skating delights. You can see plenty of skateboarders, skaters, and kids on scooters here. There are both learners and experienced people skating here on most days of the week. Not to mention the place has a lively atmosphere for people of all ages. Would definitely reccomend. || Hello, I am contacting the management of the skate park on Reem Island. I am a 14-year-old stunt scooter rider, and I would like to raise several serious concerns regarding the condition and supervision of the park.

1. Why is the park surface so slippery? Why is the park not treated with anti-slip solutions? This is extremely important for the safety of riders and for the protection and maintenance of the park itself.

2. There are many children aged 1 to 12 at the skate park, and many of them are unsupervised, despite this being against the skate park rules. Unfortunately, this issue is constantly ignored, especially by the park supervisors. When riders ask for help, the supervisors often pretend not to notice or hear them.

I sincerely ask that the skate park rules be enforced more seriously and that the behavior and responsibility of the park supervisors be improved. I hope this message will at least be seen and taken into consideration. || Very nice and calm skater park. We went there every evening, with kids 8 + 12 years old, and they really enjoyed.
The lanes are very slick, good for skating but be carefull walking there, I fell twice ;-) || Too much kids run around this skatepark with they're families not saying anything while people try to skate theyres kids playing football and dropping snacks and getting in the way reem park is huge and has many kids areas please implement rules on small children in the skatepark and food and cleanliness in there many families use it as a camping spot

Name: Saadiyat Cultural District
Description: A cultural district containing major museums, architecture and public spaces.

Name: Natural History Museum Abu Dhabi
Description: A museum presenting natural history, biodiversity and the story of the Earth.
Reviews:
Absolutely amazing. The sheer scale of the entrance with the dino exhibits is spectacular. The rest is also as impressive. For a young dino addicted toddler, this was heaven:) One of the most impressive aspects of the place is the actual architecture,  some of the more detailed nature exhibits was beautiful,  the level of attention to detail for the animals was the best I've seen also. The dino exhibit was obviously truly spectacular. The staff were amazing also. All in all an amazing day out with my son.

Just one thing worth noting - go early, opening time, its gets busy quick. Also, be prepared for an airport style security check-in...which is a bit of a pain yo be honest having to take off belts, watches etc. Lastly (and nothing major by any means for sure), some soft ambient music would of been nice...the dead silence around most of the main areas is a bit strange. || A truly state of the art museum and one of the best attractions in Abu Dhabi. The building itself is beautiful inside and outmodern, clean, creative, and exceptionally well designed. The museum offers fascinating journeys through natural history with spacious halls, immersive exhibits, impressive 3D animations, and incredible fossil and skeleton displays dating back millions of years.
The staff are friendly, knowledgeable, and always willing to share information, which adds to the overall experience.
The only reason I’m not giving it a full 5 stars is that I believe it would benefit from offering private guided tours for families and children. While the staff are informative, having a dedicated personal guide to walk visitors through the museum and explain the exhibits in greater detail would make the experience even more engaging and memorable.
Highly recommended for families, kids, and anyone interested in history, science, and nature. Definitely worth a visit. || An absolute masterpiece for natural history enthusiasts. The scale of the exhibitions is breathtaking.
The highlight is undoubtedly the massive pack of Triceratops, which creates an incredibly immersive, lifelike scene. Seeing the enormous Brachiosaurus towering over the space is equally unforgettable and awe-inspiring.
The curation is world-class, blending spectacular prehistoric specimens with interactive displays. A mandatory visit if you are exploring the Saadiyat Cultural District.

*Though not recommended to go on a public holiday as it will be overcrowded. But would definitely go again as the experience is absolutely fantastic. || This museum is very nicely designed. It starts from the Big Bang, to the Solar System and our Earth, where minerals formed(from star dust) and life evolved. An exceptional large collection of dinosaurs fossils is displayed in the huge show room. Overall it’s a great museum to visit! || Excellent place to bring your kids and family&friends having history and science interest. The whole building is beautifully constructed and gives you such a positive vibe. Staff is cooperative and super friendly as well. Museum has so much content and everything is displayed in interactive way.
One improvement suggestion if management is reading: It is understandable that management dont allow visitors to take water bottles inside the museum, however there should be water dispensers or water tab fountains (like the one in Louvre museum). Its very inconvinient for visitors to roam around thirsty (specially kids) when there is so much to explore. Only option to drink water is to buy it from cafe which is at entrance and super expensive.

Name: Zayed National Museum
Description: A national museum dedicated to the history, culture and development of the UAE.
Reviews:
Zayed National Museum is an amazing place to visit. I love going to museums, and I really enjoyed this one. It tells the story of the UAE’s history, culture, and development in a very interesting way.

The building itself is impressive. The design is modern, unique, and beautiful, making it a landmark on its own.

The exhibits are well organized, and there is a lot to learn about the country and its heritage. I highly recommend visiting Zayed National Museum 🇦🇪✨ || What an incredible piece of architecture! Honestly a great experience. The building is incredible, the displays well curated and the story of the UAE beautifully told. Enjoyed every minute of the visit here. Don’t forget to go through the cafe to the ramp all the way to the roof. The photos you can take there and on the way are amazing. || My husband and I really enjoyed our visit. We’re from Dubai and traveled to Abu Dhabi to visit the museum, and it was such a wonderful experience. The architecture was stunning!! It was not only educational but also very modern and interactive, plus the impressive technology that brings the exhibits to life. What I liked most was the atmosphere. It was quiet, peaceful, and relaxing, which allowed us to appreciate each gallery at our own pace. Also, all of the staff (from entry, guides and security) were very helpful and always had smiles on their faces, even though it was Friday and we stayed until the museum closed. Indeed, a must-visit!! || Visited the beautiful Zayed National Museum in Abu Dhabi and had an amazing experience. The architecture of the museum is truly unique and modern, inspired by the heritage and culture of the UAE. The exhibitions were very informative, well organized, and showcased the history, traditions, and vision of the country in an impressive way.

The atmosphere inside was calm, clean, and welcoming. I especially enjoyed exploring the galleries and taking photos around the museum because every corner looked artistic and elegant. The staff were also polite and helpful throughout the visit.

This place is perfect for tourists, history lovers, and anyone interested in learning more about the culture of the UAE. Highly recommended to visit when in Abu Dhabi! || Zayed National Museum was also very impressive. The museum beautifully reflects the vision, history, and legacy of Sheikh Zayed and the UAE’s culture. The design and overall experience were excellent. Since it was International Museum Day, there was a big crowd, but I really appreciate the Abu Dhabi government and museum management for their excellent crowd control and smooth operations. Everything was handled very professionally, making the visit comfortable and enjoyable despite the rush. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Name: Guggenheim Abu Dhabi
Description: A modern and contemporary art museum in the Saadiyat Cultural District.
Reviews:
Strucrure looks stunning.Still under construction. Hopefully this will become a unique landmark of abudhabi. || Can’t wait to see it open ! || Under construction || Under construction || .@DCTAbuDhabi has announced that Guggenheim Abu Dhabi, the region’s pre-eminent museum dedicated to global modern and contemporary art, is set for completion in 2025.

The landmark project is being developed on Saadiyat Island by DCT - Abu Dhabi in collaboration with the Solomon R. Guggenheim Foundation. Guggenheim Abu Dhabi is the largest and latest instalment in the Solomon R. Guggenheim Foundation’s international group of museums.

The museum will present a global collection, with a focus on works from West Asia, North Africa, and South Asia (WANASA). UAE national, regional and international experts will contribute to the development of museum’s collection and programmes.

Name: Saadiyat Beach Golf Club
Description: An oceanfront golf course designed around the island's natural landscape.
Reviews:
An unforgettable golf experience in Abu Dhabi. Dear golf lovers — I did the “golf blast” in Abu Dhabi and completely fell in love.

The golf course is located right next to the beachfront in one of the most prestigious areas of the city. From the very first moment, everything felt excellent: the golf club, the clubhouse, and the whole arrival and check-in process were perfectly organized.
The pro shop is dangerous for your wallet — in the best sense 😄 — with a great selection, and the changing rooms are excellent, exactly what you would expect if you’re familiar with high-end clubs in places like UAE.
For me, it was simply an awesome experience.
The carts were okay, although the screens felt a bit old-fashioned, not perfectly smooth, and with a bit too much advertising — that was probably the only thing I really didn’t like.

But honestly, that’s a small detail compared to everything else.
The course itself was fantastic: beautifully maintained, free-running wildlife around, great service, and water stations at every hole. Playing 18 holes at a price that is actually affordable compared to many other places in the region made it even better.
After the round, everything continued at the same high level: drinks, food, service, cleaning your equipment, organizing everything properly — all smooth, friendly, and very professional.
Overall: a perfect experience. Definitely a five out of five. I will absolutely come back. || Amazing views and the course is not only tiptop (i.e. great condition) but very challenging as well. Beautiful deer roam the course.

From the moment you arrive until you leave you will have any awesome experience. The staff are clearly pleased to welcome you and look after you.

The back 9 has recently been reconfigured and improved, which confused my Garmin watch, as Garmin have not updated their course course layout.

We can't wait to come back. || We Had a great time in Hawksbill from the moment we entered. Ranjitha greeted us with a beautiful smile and gave us a great experience. Keep up the great service 👍🏾👍🏾 || Enjoyed playing at Saadiyat golf club course but the course is a difficult one and you struggle if not experienced to play there and was a hot day but overall I enjoyed playing there ! We very much enjoyed meeting Paul and Cathy from Wimbledon playing golf at Saadiyat Abu Dhabi ! || I really enjoy spending time here. Riding the buggies and taking in the views of the beach is one of my favourite parts of the experience — it’s especially beautiful just before sunset. The driving range is excellent, and the club restaurant is a lovely place to eat and relax after a round. A peaceful and scenic spot overall.

Name: Mamsha Al Saadiyat
Description: A beachfront promenade with restaurants, cafes and coastal views.
Reviews:
is one of the most beautiful places I’ve visited in Abu Dhabi
The area is very clean and peaceful, and the sea view is absolutely stunning and relaxing. It’s perfect for walking and unwinding, especially around sunset. It’s also an extremely quiet place, ideal for those looking to relax and get away from the noise and crowds. A great experience, and I would definitely visit again. || Mamsha Saadiyat is one of the nicest places in Abu Dhabi. The atmosphere is peaceful, clean, and very classy. Beautiful beach views, great walking area, and amazing selection of restaurants and cafés. Perfect spot for relaxing, watching the sunset, or spending time with friends and family. The whole area feels very well designed and premium. || Absolutely loved our day at Marsha Saadiyat! The beach is stunning with crystal-clear water and a very relaxing vibe. We booked a cabana and Ghazi took amazing care of us the whole day, super attentive and friendly.
Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a chill and beautiful beach experience in Abu Dhabi! || Great vibe you can come and walk or sit in the restaurant
Clean, nice, and modern
There are many restaurants there || Dont go!!! It was contructio work just next to it and it was loud, not for relaxing. It is beautiful beach and the  color of the sea is stunning but it was destroyed by loud noice from contruction. Too much! 😭😭😭 we were there on a Sunday in may 2026

Name: Saadiyat Rotana Beach
Description: A managed beach area connected to the Saadiyat resort district.
Reviews:
We normally do not write reviews, but this time we truly felt that we had to share our experience.

The food in the Turtle Bay Restaurant was absolutely outstanding , one of the best dining experiences we have had in a very long time. Everything was incredibly fresh, beautifully prepared, and full of flavor. The chef clearly has exceptional talent and passion.

The design and atmosphere of the restaurant are equally impressive, with great attention to every detail.

A special thank you to Pratima, who took wonderful care of us with such kindness, professionalism, and genuine hospitality.

We also believe this excellence reflects the great leadership of the manager, Shae. It is clear that everything is very well organized and that she puts her heart and soul into her work.

Thank you for creating such a memorable experience. We will definitely remember this evening. || We absolutely loved everything about our stay at Saadiyat Rotana. The service was exceptional from start to finish. Everyone was incredibly kind, professional, and welcoming.

The restaurants are of a very high standard, and the food was consistently delicious. Every meal was a wonderful experience.

A special thanks to Sita for her kindness, warmth, and outstanding service. We absolutely love enjoying our time at Hamilton’s gastropub. We truly appreciate everything the entire team does and look forward to coming back! || We had a wonderful stay at Saadiyat Rotana Resort & Villas. The location is amazing, the service was excellent, and everything was exceptionally clean and well maintained. A special mention to Mugula from sim sim restaurant whose hospitality was truly extraordinary. He went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable and memorable. Team members like him are a great asset to the hotel. Thank you for making our family stay such a pleasant experience. We look forward to visiting again. || We had the pleasure of staying at Saadiyat Rotana Hotel - from February 3rd to 5th, and our experience was truly memorable. The three-night stay was for a wedding celebration, which was exceptionally well organized. Over the course of the event, five functions were hosted across the beautifully maintained lawns and the elegant ballroom. The food was excellent, the décor impressive, and the hospitality outstanding.

A special note of gratitude goes to the staff, particularly Director of Rooms Mohammed Baku, Night Manager Ahmad Ali, Security Manager Bertanl Dounia, and their dedicated teams. Their support during a medical emergency involving my daughter was remarkable—their concern, care, and follow-up left us deeply appreciative. It is rare to encounter such genuine attentiveness, and we are truly thankful.

The beach property itself, just about five years old, is stunning. But what makes it extraordinary is the people—the staff bring vibrancy and warmth that elevate the experience to another level. For us, Saadiyat Rotana deserves a rating of 7 stars and beyond, as it embodies hospitality at its very best. || We had a wonderful experience at Saadiyat Rotana Resort & Villas, and the hospitality of the staff made our stay truly memorable.

A special thank you to Hassan at the Italian restaurant. He was exceptionally kind, welcoming, and attentive, with a natural friendliness that made every visit a pleasure. The restaurant itself was outstanding, serving genuinely authentic Italian cuisine that exceeded our expectations. As someone familiar with Italian food, I was particularly impressed by the tiramisu—it was remarkably similar to the authentic versions served in Italy and was easily one of the highlights of our dining experience.

We would also like to recognize Anwar and Gilbert from the breakfast team. Both were calm, professional, and incredibly supportive. Their warm and attentive service created a peaceful and serene atmosphere each morning, making breakfast a truly relaxing and enjoyable experience.

Hassan, Anwar, and Gilbert were all exceptional. Their professionalism, kindness, and dedication to guest satisfaction reflect the very best of Saadiyat Rotana. Thank you for making our stay so special—we look forward to returning.

Name: Yas Gateway Park North
Description: A large landscaped park used for recreation and public events.
Reviews:
It’s… okay. Honestly, it’s a step up from Yas Park South, but West Yas Community Park still holds the crown.

The playgrounds are the definition of "mid"—nothing to write home about, but they exist. On the bright side, there’s plenty of grass if you just want to touch some nature, and they’ve set up a lot of designated zones perfectly built for BBQing.

Now, let's talk about the parking. There are so many parking spaces it borders on an existential crisis. Is there ever an occasion where this lot is full? Pretty sure they paved enough spaces to host a small aviation festival. If you love asphalt and zero competition for a spot, you’ll love it here. || Beautiful and well maintained family park in Abu Dhabi Yas, pre-set up Bbq areas are available.

Washroom facilities and ample parking available.

We had great time.

BRs, || A beautiful community memory

Yas Gateway Park is one of Abu Dhabi’s hidden gems — beautifully maintained, peaceful, and perfect for families. The toilets are clean and easily accessible, there’s a convenient water station, a safe playground for children, and plenty of shaded areas beneath the lovely trees to relax or enjoy a picnic. Ample parking makes visiting simple and stress-free.

I attended an outdoor yoga and sound healing event here organized by Aldar Experiences, and the atmosphere was absolutely wonderful — open skies, fresh air, and a community spirit that made the morning special. There’s even a barbecue area for those who want to gather with family and enjoy a healthy grill.

A truly welcoming space for wellness seekers, families, and nature lovers alike. 🌿
(Shared a few moments from the event on Instagram @AlwaysInYogaFlow) || Big empty spaces full of greenery, a rare find in Abu Dhabi. || Yas Gateway Park North is a true highlight on Yas Island. With its sprawling lawns, shaded picnic areas, and modern playgrounds, it's the ideal spot for family fun or a quiet escape. Enjoy peaceful tree-lined paths for walking or jogging, handy BBQ facilities, and immaculate grounds. Best of all, it's free, open 24/7, and has ample parking—Perfect for nature lovers in Abu Dhabi.

Name: Yas Gateway Park South
Description: A green recreation area with open lawns and family facilities.
Reviews:
awesome park and there’s even a grill there if you forget to bring your own, families always have a bbq there and if you go there alone you’ll be fine it’s amazing, good for long walks and jogging. || I might be lost… because what I found was not a park, but the biggest empty parking lot I’ve ever seen in my life.

From my window it looked like a miracle: something green in the desert! 🌴
So I walked all the way there, dreaming of palm trees, grass, maybe even birds singing…

But when I arrived? Just endless parking plots, a couple of benches with few workers taking a nap. 💤

Was it a park? Was it a mirage? I still don’t know.
All I know is: it was a very bad experience.

Maybe I should try Yas Gateway Park – North next time. || Yas Park is a great spot for families and kids. The area is clean, well-maintained, and has plenty of space for picnics, walking, and relaxing. The playgrounds are modern and safe, and there’s a good mix of shaded areas which really helps during hot days. It’s calm, organized, and perfect for spending a few hours outdoors. Definitely one of the nicer parks in the area. || Beautiful park. Clean and perfect for relaxation and sports || One of the most beautiful greens 🥗 places in Abu Dhabi. Very calming, green, clean and quiet place. Kids area, Tennis pitch and open areas. I used to come here at winter nights to study or to clear my mind. Very recommended. Toilets aren't very clean, they're have to try make it cleaner..

Name: Yas Marina Musical Water Fountain
Description: A small waterfront fountain and gathering area near Yas Marina.
Reviews:
🌊✨ Absolutely spellbinding! Caught the Yas Mall Fountain show in Abu Dhabi last weekend, and it was pure magic. Every evening at 7 PM & 9 PM, this stunning synchronized fountain dances to lights, music, and water jets shooting up to 50 meters—right outside the massive Yas Mall. The energy from the crowd, the colorful lasers, and those perfect mist clouds made it feel like a mini Vegas spectacle, but with that Arabian flair. Pro tip: Grab a spot early near the mall entrance for the best views, and pair it with some mall shopping or dinner afterward. If you're in Dubai/Abu Dhabi, this free show is a must-do! || 🇬🇧 Review for The Fountains – Yas Mall | Connecting Cultures and Investment Opportunities with Baku, Azerbaijan

The Fountains at Yas Mall offer a truly mesmerizing experience — a perfect combination of art, light, and music that creates an unforgettable atmosphere for families and visitors from around the world. It reflects the UAE’s commitment to excellence, beauty, and hospitality.

As a visitor from Baku, Azerbaijan, I was deeply inspired by this beautiful destination. It reminded me of Baku’s own seaside elegance and cultural vibrance. With its growing economy, stunning architecture, and welcoming spirit, Baku is becoming one of the most attractive cities for investment in tourism, retail, and entertainment.

I invite entrepreneurs, investors, and visitors from Abu Dhabi and around the world to discover Baku, Azerbaijan — a city of innovation, culture, and business opportunity. Just like Yas Mall’s dancing fountains bring people together, Baku connects tradition and modernity in a truly inspiring way. 🇦🇿🤝🇦🇪 || We were there 28th November 24. The mall were huge. It was too beautiful and plenty of shops and restaurants etc. You can shop till you drop.  Make sure you bring plenty of money or mastercard lol. Again lovely nice people very respectful. || The fountain at Yas Mall on Yas Island is a fantastic attraction, beautifully designed to complement the modern architecture of the mall. The fountain adds a touch of elegance, with its impressive water displays that create a relaxing atmosphere. The mall itself is clean, spacious, and well-organized, with a great selection of restaurants offering diverse dining options. Additionally, the prayer halls for both men and women are thoughtfully designed, offering a peaceful space for reflection. Overall, Yas Mall provides a wonderful shopping experience with excellent facilities and a welcoming ambiance for all visitors. || The Fountains Abu Dhabi – A Dining Oasis by the Waterfront

The Fountains at Yas Mall, Abu Dhabi, is a vibrant dining and entertainment hub located near Ferrari World. This scenic outdoor venue features a variety of restaurants and cafes, offering cuisines from around the world. Popular options include Cheesecake Factory, P.F. Chang’s, and Al Fanar, catering to both casual diners and food enthusiasts.

With its picturesque fountains, lush landscaping, and family-friendly atmosphere, it’s an ideal spot for a relaxing meal or an evening outing. The venue often hosts live performances and events, making it a lively destination for visitors of all ages. Perfect for dining with a view!

Name: Yas Kartzone
Description: An outdoor karting track at Yas Marina Circuit.
Reviews:
If you're a motorsport enthusiast or simply looking for an exciting day out, YAS Kartzone is a must-visit! The track is fantastic, the karts are well maintained, and the whole experience is professionally run.
What really stood out was the Simulator Driving Experience. It's incredibly realistic and a great way to sharpen your racing skills before hitting the actual track. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced racer, it's an absolute blast.
The best part is the pricing—it's surprisingly affordable for the quality of the experience, making it excellent value for money. If you're in Abu Dhabi and love speed, adrenaline, or just want to challenge your friends, YAS Kartzone is the perfect place. Highly recommended! 🏎️🔥 || What a great experience! You get to see all the race cars, the Yas marina circuit and there is some merch to buy. The gocarts are fast, but not extremely fast, enjoyable even for girls. The space on the track is wide enough for you to drive fast while others are also enjoying playing around. || Had a great experience in Yas Kartzone. One of the best tracks I've been to till now. Was bit crowded when I visited but got the slot within 20 minutes. Everyone can get 15 minutes of driving experience and it was so good. Results will be shared via email. After karting, you can also visit sunset Longue to view the F1 track, that view was breath taking. || It’s not the cheapest hobby, but for the quality of the track and the speed of the karts, it’s worth every dirham. Great spot to go with a group of mates if you’re looking for a bit of competition.
I’ll definitely be heading back to try and beat my personal best. || A great experience overall. From the helmets and the protective gear, everything was well maintained. The track was great. The carts were a bit slow. However, a great overall time.

Name: Yas Links Abu Dhabi
Description: A championship coastal golf course on Yas Island.
Reviews:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

This place absolutely deserves five stars. From the moment you walk in, you realize it’s more than just a bar — it’s an experience. The bar food is fantastic, elevated well beyond what you normally expect from a casual menu. Everything we ordered was fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with attention to detail. It’s the kind of place where you can sit down for a drink and end up staying for a full meal because the food is that good.

One of the most impressive parts of the space is the view overlooking the pool, which is nothing short of epic. Whether you’re stopping in for a quick drink or relaxing for a longer visit, the scenery adds an incredible atmosphere that makes the whole experience feel special. Watching the activity around the pool while enjoying great food and drinks creates a perfect, relaxed vibe.

Another unique feature is the small shop area, which offers a really fun and thoughtfully curated range of items to browse. From stylish accessories to unique finds you wouldn’t normally expect, it adds an extra layer of interest to the visit and makes it easy to pick up something memorable.

Between the great food, beautiful setting, and cool shopping options, this spot manages to combine several great experiences all in one place. It’s definitely somewhere you’ll want to come back to. || Played the par 3, used the viya app and got a great deal on 9 holes with a free drink.
Course is fantastic and friendly groups playing the course, most holes are short and mix of small irons only required and if you play like me the sand wedge will be your friend too.
Played through sunset into dark and flood lights are great to allow you to play later evenings.
Plenty of choice for food and a drink afterwards too, we ate a good wagyu burger at the crafty fox, staff were friendly and helpful, great evening out. || Clearly an absolutely outstanding golf course and deserving of a place in the world’s Top 100, however it feels as though the elements around it (apart from the restaurant, which is excellent) are now of a much lower quality.

The rental clubs aren’t fit for a local/public course - T350s (beginner clubs essentially) being the only option and the mid irons don’t even feel real, almost like Temu clubs. When we asked about the noise they were making on impact the range attendant who had NO idea about golf swung the club in the air and remarked it made no noise. Remarkable.

No one was really there to help much, the reception is a strange area and it doesn’t feel anyone is there to make your trip memorable.

Even aspects of the course were poor quality - the photo added shows how bad some of the bunkers were, almost a construction site. We saw some workers doing this to another bunker with a machine and the chap raking it just leaving it with boulders in it.

Beautiful surroundings ruined by a lack of investment in any decent (golf) staff. Compare this to somewhere like Emirates GC with fantastic new rentals, useful range staff, good marshals and perfect course conditioning. With such a brilliant golf course it all feels a bit of a waste. || The best, well-maintained grass I've ever seen! The staff, one guy there, was very accommodating. He tried to make sure we were provided with what we needed, despite how busy they were. || Top golf course, condition is exceptional, amazing views, no two holes are the same, amazing sunset on a twilight, guaranteed to be one the best courses anyone will play.

Name: Yas Acres Golf and Country Club
Description: A golf and leisure destination within the Yas Acres community.
Reviews:
Our Team hosted a breakfast gathering at Yas Acres Golf & Country Club, and the service exceeded expectations. The food was fresh, flavorful, and served promptly. The staff demonstrated excellent hospitality throughout our visit. Special recognition goes to Chef Satheesh, who was exceptionally attentive, ensuring our group was comfortable and satisfied. He proactively checked I with us and showed a sincere openness to feedback. A well-managed venue that delivers both quality and warmth. Kudos to the Team! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ || Been a member for 2 months now, beautiful course and friendly staff.

Sawmi is always professional and recommended me an excellent coach at Yas Acres. (After a few lessons I am already trending lower with my handicap)

Yas acres has one of the best chipping/ pitching practice area. A course to improve your short and long game. I always enjoy a round of golf at night. || The water park:
Very nice.
Small area for little ones in the water.
Food could be improved a little but for the 75 redeemable, it’s good enough.
Nice clean pool.
The toilets/ changing rooms are amazing!
Would definitely be going back. || So! Played here for the first! The golf course was exceptional, beautifully maintained,
The practice facility were top standard also. The pictures landscapes, rolling fairways and a mixture of desert and water features gave this course  a beautiful golf course. The staff were very attentive, helpful and friendly.

A great experience and will look forward to playing it again. However the actual club house restaurant and bar was not so good.. Again beautiful new and modern deco facility but lacked the 5 star service and finesse that the golf course offered. The menu was just like any other Irish bar, if burgers and chips is what you were looking for. The plating and presentation of the food was sub-standard and didn’t fit the deco of at least the surrounding sitting of such a place and the prices again was inconsistent with their overall menu.

Perhaps a little imagination and flair could set this place a light, but for me, the food experience was sub-standard and ordinary.

I give the course a 5 star rating and the restaurant a 3 star, therefore a overall rating of a 4 star, I think is pretty fair and generous…
Have a great day! || EDIT; Yas Acres reached out to us after this review and their response was commendable. We have since enjoyed a round of golf on the house.  They dealt with this issue professionally and we all enjoyed the excellent course and facilities.

Extremely disappointed with our experience at Yas Acres Golf & Country Club.

We made our booking over a week in advance, only to be told upon arrival that there were no rental clubs available, despite clarifying this when making the booking. A call or email from the club ahead of our tee time would have saved 4 people an hours drive.

Due to this poor service and lack of organisation, we won’t visit Yas Acres again, there are plenty better quality and similarly priced golf clubs in Abu Dhabi which we can’t fault after multiple visits.

Name: Marsana Beach
Description: A public beach and leisure area beside Marsana waterfront.
Reviews:
Marsana Beach is just a really nice, clean spot to hang out. The water is calm, the beach is spotless, and they have chaise lounges ready for you.
The best part is honestly the crowd. It feels like everyone in Abu Dhabi has a silent agreement to keep this place chill. You just see people everywhere reading books, sipping drinks, and just relaxing. No loud noise or chaos.
Parking is free and there’s always plenty of spaces. Just a heads up on the pricing: the beach is split into the East side (100 AED entry) and the West side (50 AED).
Pro Tip: Go to % Cento Gelato nearby and grab an Affogato (espresso over ice cream) to take to the beach. It makes the whole experience 1000% better. || Had a great experience at Hudayriyat Island. The services and facilities are very well organized, safe, and clean. The overall atmosphere is perfect for families—I visited with my family, and my son absolutely loved the place.
There are both paid family beaches and free beaches, and both are well maintained and properly serviced. The only downside is that the prices are a bit high and feel more like tourist pricing; it would be better if they were closer to Abu Dhabi city prices.
Overall, thank you for the excellent organization, cleanliness, and security. || Visited during sunset, which is the best time to be there. The beach is well-maintained, with towels and bottled water provided for visitors. It is also a great place for families to enjoy a safe and refreshing swim. The atmosphere was calm and relaxing, making the overall experience peaceful and enjoyable. || I had a wonderful experience at Marsana Beach in Al Hudayriat.

Name: Khalifa City Community Market
Description: A local market and family gathering destination.
Reviews:
Khalifa City Market is a popular local shopping and lifestyle hub in Khalifa City A, known primarily as a convenient one-stop spot for everyday needs. It combines grocery stores, restaurants, cafés, pharmacies, salons, and small service shops all in one place, making it useful for residents and visitors alike.  ￼

👍 Pros

✔ Wide variety of offerings
You can find everything from fresh produce and groceries to fruit juice stalls, fast food, bakeries, maintenance services, beauty salons, and tailor shops — many visitors like the diversity of shops under one roof.  ￼

✔ Great for quick errands & casual visits
Many locals enjoy coming here in the evenings to shop, grab a bite, or hang out with family and friends without going far.  ￼

✔ Friendly, community feel
Reviews often mention a welcoming, relaxed atmosphere and a place that serves as a community hub for residents of Khalifa City A.  ￼

👎 Cons

⚠ Parking & crowding
A common complaint is that parking can be crowded during peak hours, and finding a spot isn’t always easy. Some visitors also mention paid parking and occasional confusion about parking rules.  ￼

⚠ Not a major mall experience
This is more of a community market rather than a full-scale mall; if you’re expecting big brand retail or extensive entertainment options, you’ll find it limited compared to larger Abu Dhabi malls.  ￼

⭐ Overall Impression

Most people rate the market positively for its convenience, variety of everyday shops, and relaxed atmosphere, especially for residents nearby seeking day-to-day shopping and dining. However, visitors note that parking issues and limited scale can detract from the experience if you’re expecting a larger retail destination. || Khalifa City Market is a popular local market in Abu Dhabi’s Khalifa City A that offers a wide variety of shops, restaurants, cafes and everyday services all under one roof. Name: Jebel Hafit Beehive Tombs
Description: Ancient stone tombs located around the Jebel Hafit archaeological landscape.
Reviews:
Peaceful, serene, well mantained.You can park your car at the entry gate of the park if you wish to have nice easy level trek. Or you can drive up to adventure centre, park there have around 3km trek to the tomb and back, or drive streight to the tombs. By the adventure centre there is nice outdoor seating restaurant belonging to nearby eco resort, fresh juices, smoothies and great food options from this 5 star rated venue. To spend sunset time there is fully recommended. || We didn't know much about the tombs before we arrived - only that they were bronze-age, dating to around 3000BC and that they were worth a visit. When we got to the pull-off we found a large, free public car park with signs for the national park. We thought we needed to park there and walk up - we were wrong! After a short walk up a rough road we came to a manned booth where you had to pay to enter the park. The staff were super helpful. They explained that the tombs were a good distance away and that we could drive much further into the park to another parking area. They took payment and then actually gave our drivers a lift back to our cars to save us all having to walk back! It was 35AED per family (otherwise it would be 15AED for adults and around 7-10AED for children - I can't remember exactly). We then drove onto the carpark. The roads inside the park are more like tracks and are very bumpy in places. If you don't have a 4x4, or similar, you have to take it slowly. When we got to the carpark there was so much more than we imagined - there are very clean and well-presented toilets, a learning centre, play area, cafe and beautiful seating areas. There is a raised platform where you can look across the foothills and see the location of the tombs and the reconstructed area. We also realised that there is actually quite a complex throughout the park including campsites and opportunities to book stargazing, falconry and camping experiences which we weren't expecting. The walk to the tombs is about 20 minutes along rocky terrain - very accessible for walkers but you need good walking footwear or trainers and we had a few trips and stumbles from the children in our group. It would be hard for older people or those with a disability. Some of the tombs are easy to miss as they are in quite a ruined state but there are numbered markers to help you spot them. There is a group of reconstructed tombs which are great for helping you understand how they would have looked. There are also seating areas and modern sculptures around the site that were unexpected bonuses too. The scenery is spectacular - dramatic and rugged. We explored for a couple of hours before walking back to the carpark in the twilight. The seating areas were lit up like a grotto and looked really pretty. There was food being served and we wished we had planned to stay and have dinner there but we'll have to save that for next time... Overall we had a really lovely afternoon and are planning to return to experience the stargazing and camping. || Jebel Hafeet Beehive Tombs: 5/5 ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
A must-visit site for any history enthusiast in Al Ain! These amazing 'beehive'-shaped tombs, dating back over 5,000 years, offer a stunning glimpse into the UAE's Bronze Age history.

Located at the foot of the majestic Jebel Hafeet Mountain, this area is part of a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The ancient structures, set against the spectacular backdrop of the desert and mountain range, possess a unique and timeless beauty. It's a place cherished not just for its historical significance, but also by nature lovers and photographers.

Key Highlights:

Vibe: The atmosphere is incredibly serene and thought-provoking. The experience of connecting with a civilization from five millennia ago is truly special.

Visitor Tip: Try to visit early in the morning or late in the afternoon to avoid the heat and enjoy the best lighting.

The Experience: As part of the Jebel Hafit Desert Park, you can enjoy both the rich history and the surrounding natural beauty in one trip.

I highly recommend this location to everyone who wants to explore ancient history and enjoy magnificent natural landscapes! || Opportunity to discover things we didn’t know before, this place is definitely worth a visit if you’re in the area.
Something about Neolithic sites that, pre-date any of our ‘modern’ concerns, I find therapeutic.
Keen to escape the chaos of Dubai? || The tombs at Hili Archaeological Park are designed in a similar shape, but it's important to note that they were not originally discovered in this form. They have been reconstructed for exploration purposes. The tombs are related to the Umm al-Nar culture, dating back to the Bronze and Iron Ages.

The site itself is quite dry and, in my opinion, not particularly impressive when compared to other archaeological attractions. While the park does offer a few sculptures and, during sunrise and sunset, the valley provides a picturesque view, these features don't quite make up for the overall lack of depth in the experience.

For those who are deeply passionate about history, there may be a sense of connection to ancient civilizations that once thrived here thousands of years ago. However, for most visitors, the site feels somewhat underwhelming. Overall, I found Jebel Hafeet desert Park to be an overrated tourist destination, offering limited exploration and not enough to fully captivate the interest of those seeking a more immersive historical experience.

The oasis offers a perfect combination of nature, heritage, relaxation, and outdoor activities, making it an unforgettable experience for families, friends, tourists, residents, and visitors from different nationalities around the world.

The biking experience inside the oasis was truly amazing — relaxing, scenic, and refreshing while surrounded by thousands of palm trees, beautiful pathways, and natural greenery. The atmosphere feels calm, clean, and incredibly rejuvenating, especially for people who enjoy nature and peaceful surroundings.

The cafés and restaurants inside the oasis provide a cosy and authentic dining experience with delicious food, refreshments, coffee, and traditional date products. The date café experience was especially memorable, offering high-quality local flavors and a welcoming ambiance perfect for relaxing after exploring the oasis.

There are also wonderful souvenir shops where visitors can buy beautiful gifts, traditional products, handicrafts, dates, and memorable items representing the culture and heritage of the UAE. Everything is very organized, clean, secure, and well-maintained, making the entire visit smooth and enjoyable.

Highly recommended for sightseeing, biking, photography, cultural exploration, relaxation, family bonding, and discovering the natural beauty of Al Ain. Truly one of the most iconic and must-visit destinations in the UAE with exceptional experiences, hospitality, and unforgettable views 🌍💚🚲✨ || Nice spot!
Al Ain Oasis feels like you’re in the lap of nature. Birds chirping, trees swaying in the breeze — very peaceful. Convenient location with free parking. It’s wheelchair and pram friendly too. Single cycles and 4-seaters available for 60 AED per 30 min.
Washrooms, prayer area alloted inside .
Worth a visit! || One of the greenest and most serene places I have visited so far in UAE. During the night there is a fantastic light show and the breeze from the trees makes the night extremely pleasant! There are also clean bathrooms and nice coffee, food options! || I visited Al Ain Oasis around 3 PM, which in hindsight was not the ideal time due to the daytime heat. The oasis is primarily a peaceful agricultural area, featuring traditional falaj irrigation canals that are quite interesting and reflect the region’s heritage and ingenuity in water management.

While I would not recommend visiting during the middle of the day, I believe the experience could be far more enjoyable after sunset or during the cooler hours of the morning and evening. Overall, it is a calm and culturally significant place worth exploring at the right time of day. || Visited Al ain oasis after 3 years and I am surprised with it's improvement and upgrade. Name: AYA Universe
Description: An immersive light, sound and digital art experience in Wafi City.
Reviews:
AYA Universe is honestly one of the most unique experiences we’ve had in Dubai. Every room is super immersive and completely different from the previous one, with lights, visuals, sound effects and interactive elements that make the whole experience feel magical.

We visited with family during the Eid period and everyone genuinely enjoyed it - even our parents were excited taking pictures and videos 🥹🧿 It’s one of those places where you completely lose track of time because there’s so much to explore.

Perfect for families, friends, or honestly anyone looking for something different indoors in Dubai. The visuals are stunning and there are so many beautiful photo and video spots throughout the experience.

Definitely worth visiting! 🤩🫶 || We had such an amazing experience! Our tour guide and content creator, Monica, was absolutely the best. She took the most incredible pictures and her explanations were so engaging and informative—it really made the whole experience come alive.

From the moment we arrived at reception, the service was excellent. Everything had a real “wow” factor and was so well organized. The entire experience felt very therapeutic, almost like healing our inner child.

My friend and I had the best time and created such beautiful memories. Highly recommend! || AYA Universe is one of the most unique attractions I’ve visited in Dubai. The experience is spread across multiple themed rooms, each offering a different combination of lights, sound, visuals, and interactive elements. The creativity and attention to detail are impressive, and it feels more like stepping into a series of immersive art installations than a traditional attraction.

Some rooms were absolutely stunning and created a real sense of wonder, especially with the combination of digital effects and interactive features. It’s also very family-friendly and suitable for all ages, including older visitors who may prefer a slower-paced experience compared to other Dubai attractions.

The venue is well-maintained, organized, and easy to navigate, and there are plenty of opportunities for photos and videos. I would recommend allowing enough time to explore each room rather than rushing through, as some of the experiences reveal more the longer you interact with them.

The only reason I’m not giving it a perfect score is that a few areas felt shorter than expected, and the overall experience can be completed relatively quickly if you’re not taking photos. That said, it’s still a memorable and visually impressive attraction that offers something different from the usual theme parks and tourist activities.

Overall, AYA Universe is a great experience for couples, families, and anyone who enjoys immersive digital art and interactive environments. Definitely worth visiting at least once while in Dubai. || Visited AYA Universe and it truly felt like stepping into a different dimension. It is a futuristic art experience in Dubai that combines immersive digital experience, light and sound show, and interactive digital attraction in the most creative way.

The entire place feels like a next-gen entertainment Dubai destination, where every zone is designed as a sensory experience Dubai with beautiful visuals and AI-inspired art space concepts. It’s not just an attraction, it’s a visual storytelling experience that takes you through a walk-through digital world.

Each room offers a neon lights experience, creating a dreamlike universe vibe that feels completely unreal. It’s one of those Instagram-worthy spots in Dubai and definitely a viral Dubai experience because of its magical photo spots and cinematic experience Dubai feel.

From cosmic themed rooms to digital universe exploration, everything feels like a reality meets imagination journey. The attraction perfectly blends art meets technology, offering a sensory escape experience with interactive art installation and light projection experience throughout.

Overall, it’s a futuristic walkthrough zone and a multisensory journey that gives a virtual reality style attraction feel without needing VR gear. A must-visit for anyone looking for a viral Dubai hotspot and unforgettable experience. || AYA is a mind blowing immersive experience with vibrant, futuristic installations that make you feel like you’ve stepped into another world.

Every corner is full of surprises and interactive elements that keep you engaged and excited. Perfect for anyone looking for a unique and visually stunning outing in Dubai.

Truly unforgettable! 🌌🎨💫

Bluewaters is a really nice place to hang out, especially if you enjoy being by the water. With Ain Dubai in the background and lots of cafes and restaurants around, it’s great for a relaxed walk or a meal with a view. The area feels clean, modern, and well kept, and the views of the sea and skyline are great, especially in the evening. It’s not really about shopping, but more about enjoying the vibe, taking photos, and just chilling by the waterfront. || Bluewaters Dubai is one of the most vibrant and enjoyable spots in the city — perfect for a relaxed day out or an evening stroll with incredible views. The island offers a beautiful waterfront promenade, great restaurants, cafés, and a stylish modern vibe that makes it ideal for both families and couples.
With stunning views of Ain Dubai, easy access from JBR, and plenty of places to eat, walk, shop, or just unwind by the water, Bluewaters is a must-visit for anyone wanting to experience Dubai’s coastal charm in a more laid-back atmosphere.
Highly recommended for walking, dining, and soaking in the city’s unique energy. || Bluewaters Island is a really nice place to spend evenings. The atmosphere is calm yet lively, with great views of the waterfront and the city skyline. It’s perfect for a relaxed walk, dining, or just sitting and enjoying the breeze. The overall vibe feels modern and well designed, making it a great spot to unwind after a busy day. || The bluewaters island Amazing place with amazing construction.  The world largest Ferris wheel. This I'm seeing from the beginning. That really amazed me. But the riding wasn't much fun sometimes the scenery not much good. They have many events drone show stage show and many more. The environment is very good for photo. My biggest photo collection in Bluewaters island. This is my favorite place in dubai. || Go 30 minutes before sunset and stay at least an hour or two there. Experience the area around AIN Dubai, walk over the bridge to JBR beach. If you are taking your car, spend AED 100 or more in any participating outlet there to get free parking. Dont forget to give your car plate number to that outlet so they register the purchase for free parking up to 3 hours!  No entry ticket to experience Bluewaters! One of the scenic spots in Dubai!!

It’s a peaceful place to explore art galleries, museums, and cozy cafés while learning about the city’s history. The ambience is very good, and the narrow lanes, wind-tower houses, and courtyards give you a relaxing feeling away from the busy city.

Name: Al Mamzar Beach Park
Description: A coastal park with beaches, picnic areas, pools and family facilities.
Reviews:
If you are looking for a spot in Dubai that genuinely makes everyone in the family happy, Al Mamzar Beach Park is the ultimate crowd-pleaser. It is rare to find a place that effortlessly balances the high energy of a kids' playground with the laid-back, serene vibes that older adults crave, but this massive coastal park pulls it off perfectly.
For the sun-seekers and water babies, you are spoiled for choice with five distinct beaches. The sand is soft, the water is calm, and because the park is so massive, you can always find a quiet pocket to pitch your umbrella. If your family splits down the middle on the "beach vs. pool" debate, Al Mamzar solves it with three massive, temperature-controlled swimming pools. They are a lifesaver for parents with toddlers who want a sand-free splash, or for seniors who prefer a gentle, accessible swim.
Away from the shoreline, the park transitions into a lush, green oasis. Teens and fitness enthusiasts can rent bikes, hit the jogging tracks, or get competitive on the basketball and football courts. Meanwhile, younger kids have plenty of dedicated play areas to burn off energy.
What really sets Al Mamzar apart, though, is its setup for a proper family day out. You can rent private, air-conditioned chalets if you want a comfortable base camp with infants or elderly grandparents. As the afternoon cools down, the park transforms into a massive community hub, with families gathering around the built-in barbecue stations. With an entry fee that costs less than a cup of coffee, it is an absolute steal. It is inclusive, beautifully maintained, and offers the kind of wholesome, breezy day out that every age group will genuinely enjoy.

Entry fee of just AED 5 per person. || This is a nice and budget friendly place in Dubai. The ticket is only 5 dirhams. very calm and clean. good for relaxing the mind and spending time with loved one.beach and park are well maintained and peaceful.

This is a family park and males cannot enter alone without a female family member .Sunset is super nice || I visited Al Mamzar Beach Park for a walkathon and it was the perfect setting! 🏃‍♀️🌊 The park is huge and very well-maintained, with plenty of beautiful paths for walking and jogging. I loved the mix of lush green grass and the blue beach views—it made the walk so much more enjoyable and refreshing. It’s a fantastic spot for families and fitness enthusiasts. There are plenty of shaded areas, clean facilities, and spots for a BBQ or a picnic after a workout. Even when it’s busy, the park is so spacious that it never feels too crowded. Definitely one of my favorite outdoor spots in Dubai to stay active and enjoy nature! || Al Mamzar Beach Park is a very clean and spacious park.
I went on the weekend, but it was not too crowded, so it was comfortable.
My child had a great time at the kids play area and enjoyed many kinds of playground equipment.

There is also a BBQ area, and the smell of people cooking was very nice.
Next time, I want to bring food and have a BBQ with my family.

There are several beaches inside the park, and the sand felt very soft and pleasant.
It’s a perfect place for families to spend the whole day relaxing and playing together. || Al Mamzar Beach Park is one of the best places I have ever visited in Dubai. It’s a wonderful spot to relax and enjoy time with friends and family. The beach is very quiet, clean, and well organized, and the overall environment is perfect for a peaceful day out.🌊🏖️

However, the shower area needs some maintenance. One of the showers was not working during my visit. It would be great if the management could check and fix this so visitors can have a better experience.

Overall, it’s still a beautiful place and definitely worth visiting.♥️

Name: Alserkal Avenue
Description: A contemporary arts district with galleries, studios, events and cultural spaces.
Reviews:
Alserkal Avenue is such a cool place and one of my favorite spots in Dubai so far. I really love the concept. Everything is spacious and there is a great variety of art, design, fashion, and food cafés all in one area. The vibe is relaxed and welcoming, and it does not feel like it is only aimed at a younger crowd. People of all ages can feel comfortable here.

It is a lovely place to stroll around, sit at a coffee shop, or enjoy a meal at one of the restaurants. Every store I have been into has had really friendly and inviting staff, which makes the experience even better.

It is also dog friendly, which is a big plus if you want to bring your dog along, and very child friendly as well. The avenues are wide, easy to walk around, and the area is very easy to get to with plenty of surrounding parking.

Definitely a place to visit and one I keep coming back to. || Alserkal Avenue is truly one of a kind — a visionary space that reflects the incredible foresight of its founder, who transformed a cluster of warehouses into Dubai’s beating heart of art, culture, and creativity. What started as a bold idea has grown into a thriving community that continues to inspire artists, thinkers, and visitors alike.

From contemporary art galleries and immersive exhibitions to open-air festivals and creative workshops, there’s always something new and thought-provoking happening here. The Avenue’s support for local and international artists is remarkable — it’s a genuine platform for expression and collaboration.

Food lovers will also find plenty to enjoy — from trendy cafés and artisan bakeries to rotating food trucks serving everything from specialty coffee to gourmet bites. Families are welcome too; kids’ art activities, open spaces, and community events make it a great day out for everyone.

Parking can get a little tricky during busy events, but it’s a small price to pay for a space that so beautifully merges art, culture, and community spirit.

A visit to Alserkal Avenue isn’t just an outing — it’s an experience. || One of my favourite places in Dubai full of lovely cafes, beautiful art galleries and artisan shops. Worth spending time just wandering it and stopping in all the cute places. Also absolutely love their annual winter arts festival, one not to be missed! || Al Serkal avenue is the new hip place to be when in Dubai, the whole area is amazing you find a lot of art galleries, apparel shops, design stores, restaurants and cafes. Amazing vibes and cool people around you. Its a must visit place to be when in Dubai. Well done Al Serkal avenue on this nice spot. || Alserkal Avenue is an amazing artistic destination. It truly gives you a European vibe, surrounded by cozy shops and creative ateliers. It’s a place where you can walk, explore galleries, enjoy good food, and always discover something new. I really feel connected to this place, it’s one of Dubai’s must visit cultural spots.

Name: Arte Museum Dubai
Description: An immersive digital art attraction with large-scale multimedia installations.
Reviews:
This art museum offers an exceptional experience where digital art truly comes alive. The immersive rooms stood out to me the most — with light, sound, and space responding to your movements, making you feel integrated into the installation. I particularly enjoyed the interactive zone, where you can contribute your own digital piece to the artwork. It's a rare and inspiring experience. Don’t miss the café with interactive screens—it feels like an extension of the museum and adds its own magic. As a showcase of digital art's potential to surprise and captivate, this exhibit highlights its richness and innovative spirit. || This is a fantastic museum where you can have a completely unique and different kind of experience. It’s highly interactive—you can watch the sea come alive in 3D, explore beautiful digital forests, and even sketch a drawing and watch it magically brought to life right in front of you!
​There is so much more to see and do inside. I highly recommend this place to anyone who loves immersive, visual experiences and interactive art. It's an absolute must-visit! || ARTE Museum Dubai is honestly one of the most magical indoor experiences in Dubai ✨
The moment you walk in, you feel completely transported into another world filled with lights, sounds, colors, and moving digital art. Every room feels different — from glowing waterfalls and dreamy flower gardens to ocean waves and interactive spaces that make you feel part of the artwork itself.

What makes it special is how immersive and calming the experience feels. It’s not just a museum, it’s a full sensory journey with beautiful visuals, relaxing music, and even signature scents that make every installation unforgettable. Perfect for families, couples, or anyone who loves aesthetic places and photography.

One of my favorite parts was how every corner looked cinematic and unreal, especially the famous Starry Beach and waterfall rooms. The tea bar experience at the end also adds such a unique touch to the visit.

If you’re visiting Dubai and want something different from the usual attractions, ARTE Museum is definitely worth experiencing at least once 🤍✨ || Magical art experience! 🎨✨

ARTE Museum Dubai is a stunning blend of digital art, sound, light and creativity that really brings imagination to life.

Each room felt like stepping into a different world colourful, immersive and totally Instagram worthy.

It was so much fun wandering through with my family and friends, and even the kids were completely mesmerized!

The atmosphere is vibrant and joyful and the team there is super friendly.

A must visit if you love art, visuals and something truly unique in Dubai! 💖👍 || I visited the Art Museum Dubai with high expectations, but the experience turned out to be rather mixed.

✅ The highlights were the area where visitors can create their own art and see it projected onto screens a really fun and engaging interactive experience. I also really enjoyed the piano room, which offers an interesting and unique experience.

⚠️ However, I felt that the rest of the exhibition was rather weak for a museum of this kind. There are only two truly interactive experiences, and one of them is practically repeated in different locations. Most of the rooms are limited to projections and mirrors, with no visitor participation, which quickly becomes repetitive.

❌ Furthermore, the volume of the sound in some areas, particularly in the wave room and the waterfall room, is excessively loud and ultimately detracts from the comfort of the visit.

Overall, despite some interesting experiences, I feel the museum offers little interactivity for the price and the expectations it creates. It’s worth it for the two rooms I mentioned, but the rest of the exhibition didn’t impress me. ⭐️⭐️⭐️

Name: Atlantis Aquaventure Waterpark
Description: A large waterpark with slides, pools, marine experiences and family attractions.
Reviews:
One of the greatest water theme parks in the world with truly world-class rides and facilities. Located at Aquaventure World inside Palm Jumeirah, the entire experience feels unbelievable from the moment you arrive.

The park is easily accessible and has ample car parking. From the parking area, there are free Aquaventure shuttle buses to the entrance, which is very convenient. Near the entrance, you’ll find luxury shops and a massive Atlantis-inspired aquarium, both of which look stunning. The overall entrance architecture is absolutely wonderful.

The ticketing system is well managed, with around 6–8 counters functioning simultaneously, helping reduce waiting time. Once inside, it truly feels like entering another world. The park features several record-breaking and thrilling rides, delivering an unforgettable experience.

There are also food courts inside, and the washrooms are neat and clean throughout the park. The safety staff are well trained, attentive, and helpful, which makes the experience even more comfortable and secure. Overall, a must-visit attraction in Dubai. || Thank you for the wonderful day! 💕
We had an amazing time and created unforgettable memories
The trip was well organized, the staff were friendly, and the whole experience was so much fun. I highly recommend getting a waterproof phone cover so you can capture every special moment without worrying about your phone. Definitely a day to remember || I guess it is the best water Park in UAE, love everything of it.
Free parking available, shuttle from parking & around the park is an amazing experience & very convenient.
Appreciate your services and facilities like refilling cold water.
You don't feel you are in Dubai, greenery, beach like Maldives.
Alot of clean changing rooms & showers , no ques or Hassel.
Staff so cheerful & kind.
Prayer room available. || My Aquaventure Atlantis review (Visited on Monday, 15 June):

I visited on Monday, 15 June, which was a public holiday. Booking on a public holiday was partly my mistake, but the crowd was overwhelming.

The staff seemed unable to manage the number of visitors properly. We had to wait more than an hour for a single ride, and despite spending the whole day there, we couldn’t even try three rides because of the queues.

There were also too many people using the Fast Track option, and even those queues were very long.

I believe the park should only accommodate the number of guests it can properly manage. Everyone pays money and deserves a fair chance to enjoy the rides. It feels unfair when the focus is on attracting as many visitors as possible, but the experience doesn’t allow guests to actually enjoy or use the rides.

Promoting offers is fine, but there should be a limit on daily capacity so visitors can have a pleasant experience.

We had been looking forward to this for a long time, but it did not meet our expectations at all.

I genuinely feel like I wasted my money. Unfortunately, after this experience, I don’t think I’ll be visiting again. || Aquaventure Waterpark is an amazing experience and absolutely worth it. The rides are thrilling, well maintained, and there’s something for all age groups. The park is huge, so it never feels too crowded, and the views of Atlantis add to the overall experience. We especially enjoyed the mix of high-adrenaline slides and relaxing areas. A must-visit attraction in Dubai, and perfect for a full day of fun.

The majestic Ain 250 metres high Wheel sits majestically on the promenade adding to its Glitz and Glamor. The promenade is lined with restaurants from all over the world on one side and the beautiful waterfront marina on the other dotted with speeding yatchs boats and cruise 🛳. As the sun sets the horizon is lit up with twinkling lights from the surrounding High rise apartment and Hotel buildings reflecting on the waterfront and making it glistening paradise. A must visit place for families friends and couples. || One of the coolest things about Bluewaters is how you get there. You can drive, sure, but the pedestrian bridge from JBR (The Wharf Link) is the way to do it. It’s a scenic 10-15 minute walk over the water with the sea breeze hitting you and incredible views of the Marina skyline. Once you arrive, the island feels like a futuristic, upscale mini-city. It’s clean, impeccably designed, and surprisingly walkable.

At night, the island transforms. The lighting is sophisticated, the music from the beach clubs (like Brass Monkey) drifts through the air, and the whole place feels alive but not overwhelming.

Arrive around 5:00 PM. You get to see the sunset over the Arabian Gulf, and then watch the Marina lights flicker on. It’s magic.

There is plenty of underground parking, and many restaurants will validate your ticket if you spend a certain amount.

Name: Burj Al Arab
Description: An iconic sail-shaped luxury hotel and architectural landmark.
Reviews:
Staying in a suite at the Burj Al Arab was truly one of the most extraordinary hotel experiences I’ve ever had. From the moment we arrived, the level of luxury and attention to detail was simply unmatched.

The suite itself was breathtaking and spacious, beautifully designed, and incredibly opulent without feeling overwhelming. Floor-to-ceiling windows offered stunning views of the Arabian Gulf, and every detail, from the plush furnishings to the Hermès amenities, reflected pure elegance. The two-level layout made it feel more like a private residence than a hotel room.
The service was exceptional. The butler team was attentive, discreet, and always one step ahead, ensuring every request was handled effortlessly. Every staff member made us feel genuinely welcomed and valued.

The overall experience, from the private beach access to the world-class dining, exceeded all expectations. The Burj Al Arab is not just a hotel; it’s an icon, and staying in one of its suites is an unforgettable experience that defines true 7-star luxury.
Absolutely flawless in every way. Worth every moment. || The suite was unbelievable and mind blowing. Everything was to perfection, I wish I had more than one night there. - I could not find a night light for the bathroom
