He is a real gentleman and showed a big gesture of attention to my child and gifted her a teddy bear 🧸. He put her in an amazing mood! This huge , tall, 2 meters man has a big heart and doing his job perfectly!
Also, service in Sal is 100000/10 I was impressed by Diyorbek and his attention to us. He knows how to do a small talk with guests and was very attentive to the smallest details. Restaurant made a complementary dessert for us, it was very very cute.
Thanks to all team for an amazing experience || Our stay at the Burj Al Arab was honestly unforgettable. From the moment we arrived, everything felt smooth and welcoming. The staff greeted us warmly and made sure we felt comfortable right away. The suite itself was huge, beautifully decorated, and had an incredible view of the Arabian Gulf. Waking up to that view every morning was something I’ll never forget.

What I really liked was how attentive the service was without being over the top. Anytime we needed something, it was handled quickly and with a smile. The little details, like personalized touches in the room and thoughtful check‑ins, made the whole experience feel special.

Food was another highlight. We tried a couple of the restaurants inside the hotel, and every meal felt like a treat. Breakfast was especially impressive, with so many options that it was hard to choose.

The facilities are just as amazing as you’d expect. The infinity pool and private beach were perfect spots to relax, and the spa was a great way to unwind after exploring Dubai.

Yes, it’s pricey, but the Burj Al Arab really delivers on the promise of luxury. If you’re visiting Dubai and want a memorable experience, this hotel is worth it.

Name: Burj Khalifa
Description: The world-famous skyscraper with observation decks overlooking Downtown Dubai.
Reviews:
Visiting the Burj Khalifa Sky Lounge observation experience was absolutely incredible! The views of Dubai from the top are simply breathtaking and worth every minute. Being able to see the city, coastline, and desert from such an iconic landmark was unforgettable.
The Sky Lounge experience made it even more special. The refreshments were excellent, the atmosphere was elegant and relaxing, and the staff provided exceptional service throughout our visit. It was the perfect opportunity to sit back, enjoy a drink and light bites, and take in the spectacular panoramic views.
If you're visiting Dubai, this is a must-do experience and one of the best ways to appreciate just how impressive the city truly is. Highly recommended! 🌆✨🥂 || An Absolute Masterpiece of Modern Engineering and Art! Seeing the Burj Khalifa in person is one thing, but standing at the edge of the promenade just as dusk falls is a completely otherworldly experience. Honestly, looking up from the base is just as magnificent as looking down from the top. The architectural brilliance is mesmerizing. The Fountain Show: An incredible harmony of water, light, and music. Standing by the lake and feeling the energy of the crowd while the water dances perfectly to the rhythm is pure magic. The Atmosphere: The entire Downtown Dubai waterfront has an electric, upscale, yet welcoming energy. I love to visit there again ❤️❤️ || My visit to the Burj Khalifa was truly an unforgettable experience. I opted for the Platinum Lounge Access ticket, and it was worth every penny.

The breathtaking panoramic views of Dubai from the top were simply spectacular, especially during sunset when the city lights began to illuminate the skyline. The experience was very well organized, with premium access and minimal waiting time.

The lounge itself was elegant and comfortable, offering unlimited snacks and refreshments throughout the visit. The ticket also included an alcoholic beverage, which made the experience even more enjoyable while taking in the stunning views from one of the world’s most iconic landmarks.

The staff were courteous, attentive, and ensured that guests had a memorable experience. From the luxurious lounge atmosphere to the awe-inspiring vistas from the observation decks, everything exceeded my expectations.

If you’re visiting Dubai and want a truly premium Burj Khalifa experience, I highly recommend the Platinum Lounge Access package. It combines luxury, comfort, and some of the most incredible views you’ll ever see. || ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Incredible Experience at Burj Khalifa, Dubai (UAE)

My visit to the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, United Arab Emirates was truly one of the most breathtaking and unforgettable experiences of my life. It is not just a building, but a world-famous symbol of innovation, luxury, and human achievement. Standing in front of the tallest skyscraper in the world is an experience that leaves you amazed and inspired.

From the moment I arrived in Downtown Dubai, the view of the Burj Khalifa dominating the skyline was absolutely stunning. The architecture is beyond imagination, and its height makes it feel like it touches the sky. The surrounding area, including the Dubai Fountain and Dubai Mall, adds even more beauty and excitement to the visit, making the entire location a world-class tourist destination.

The elevator ride to the observation deck was smooth and incredibly fast, reaching the top within seconds. Once I reached the viewing area, the panoramic view of Dubai was simply magical. I could see the entire city, the desert on one side, and the sparkling coastline on the other. The view from the top of the Burj Khalifa is something that cannot be described in words—it must be experienced in person.

The observation decks are well-designed, clean, and safe, with informative displays about the construction and history of the tower. Learning about how this architectural wonder was built made the experience even more interesting. The staff were professional, helpful, and ensured that visitors had a smooth and enjoyable experience.

One of the most memorable moments was watching the sunset from the top. The sky changed colors beautifully, and the city lights slowly began to shine, creating a magical view of Dubai at night. It felt like the whole city was glowing beneath my feet. The experience was peaceful, emotional, and truly unforgettable.

Burj Khalifa is not just a tourist attraction; it is a symbol of modern engineering and the vision of the UAE. It represents ambition, progress, and excellence. Visiting this iconic landmark gives a sense of pride and admiration for what humanity can achieve.

I highly recommend Burj Khalifa to anyone visiting Dubai or the UAE. It is a must-visit destination that offers luxury, beauty, and an experience of a lifetime. Whether you are a tourist, photographer, or traveler, this place will leave you with memories that last forever.

Thank you to the team who maintains this world wonder so beautifully. I would love to visit again and relive this incredible experience. || The Burj Khalifa is one of those places that actually exceeds expectations. From the moment you arrive in Downtown Dubai, the tower dominates the skyline in a way that feels unreal, almost like something out of a futuristic city.

The journey to the top is smooth and well organized, with high speed elevators that add to the overall experience. Once you reach the observation deck, the views are simply breathtaking. You can see the entire city, the desert stretching beyond it, and even the coastline on a clear day. Sunset is the best time to visit, as the transition from daylight to the city lights creates a unique atmosphere.

The area around the tower makes the visit even more enjoyable. The Dubai Fountain offers a beautiful water show right at the base, and being next to Dubai Mall means you have plenty to explore before or after your visit.

However, it is not a perfect experience. It can get very crowded, especially during peak hours, and ticket prices are on the higher side. If you go without planning, you might feel rushed or spend more time waiting than enjoying the view.

Overall, the Burj Khalifa is more than just the tallest building in the world, it is a symbol of ambition and modern engineering. It is definitely worth visiting, but choosing the right time will make a big difference in how much you enjoy it.

Name: Children's City
Description: An educational indoor centre with interactive science and culture exhibits for children.
Reviews:
The park entry ticket is only 5 AED and Children’s City ticket is 15 AED, so total 20 AED which is definitely value for money.

There are so many fun and educational activities for children like face painting, kids playing areas, learning about body parts, planets, and many other things in an interactive and fun way. They also show a short movie, which was one of the best parts of the visit.

The best thing is that the whole Children’s City is indoor, so it’s very comfortable for families and kids to enjoy anytime. Highly recommended for parents looking for a fun and educational place for children. || A budget Friendly place for Kids and Parents. Entry ticket is charged 40Dhs for 2 adults and 2 kids. Separate tickets too available. Museum, Planetarium Show is available in both English and Arabic.Check the timings for the show.
Creek Park entry of 5Dhs must be bought separately. The staffs are very much friendly. Neat Washrooms. Perfect place to spend. || Educational place for kids. We headed here after the Dolphin show which is in the same park. There is a Space exhibit aswell as a Culture section where we learn about different countries cultures. Innovative lab also but unfortunately this was closed. There's a nice soft play area but children under 120cm aren't allowed in. So I'd say upto age 7 for this.. AED 40 for 2 adults and 2 kids
Also check out the 3D imax theatre show timings. Prayer rooms available for men and women || Very economical place to spend whole day with kids and family dolphine show , bird show museum many activities full of fun || It is a wonderful option for a toddler's day out, with plenty to explore, and my son had a great time. We need to settle the fees for the children's city. I don't recall the exact amount, but it's quite reasonable and worth it. The children's city is situated in the park, where an entrance fee is required as well.

Name: City Walk
Description: An outdoor urban district with restaurants, retail and entertainment.
Reviews:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5 Stars for City Walk (Thanks to Raising Cane's!)
City Walk is already a fantastic spot, but let’s be honest—Raising Cane’s absolutely steals the show and makes this place a guaranteed 5-star destination.
If you are a fan of perfect, golden, crispy chicken tenders, this is the ultimate spot to hit up. The crinkle-cut fries are always hot, the Texas toast is buttery perfection, and that legendary Cane’s Sauce is addictive enough to warrant its own 5-star review.
Having it right here in City Walk makes the whole area ten times better. Whether you're hanging out with friends or just looking for the ultimate comfort food meal, Cane's makes every trip to City Walk completely worth it. Highly recommended! || City Walk is often presented as a place to stroll around like in a European-style neighborhood, but in reality, it feels more like an open-air shopping mall.

There are plenty of shops and restaurants, but beyond that, there’s not much to see or do. It lacks cultural elements or any real sense of authenticity, so if you’re expecting something more than retail and dining, it might be disappointing. || City Walk Dubai is a must-visit spot ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
A perfect mix of modern design, luxury shopping, and relaxed outdoor vibes.

The area is beautifully designed with wide walkways, stylish cafés, and high-end brands, making it ideal for a casual stroll or a night out. The atmosphere is lively yet calm, with great dining options ranging from trendy restaurants to cozy coffee spots ☕🍽️

What makes City Walk special is its cleanliness, open-air feel, and family-friendly environment. Easy parking, great security, and a central location add to the convenience.

Whether you’re shopping, dining, or just hanging out with friends, City Walk offers a premium Dubai experience that’s classy, comfortable, and fun.
Highly recommended 👍✨ || City Walk is a vibrant and stylish destination in Dubai with a great mix of shopping, dining, and entertainment. The area is clean, well-designed, and very pedestrian-friendly, making it perfect for a relaxed walk. Restaurants and cafés offer plenty of choices, and the atmosphere is lively both day and night. Convenient parking and easy access add to the experience. A great spot to spend time with friends or family. || Dubai, City walk
~ City Walk offers a stylish open-air vibe with trendy shops, cafes, and street art, perfect for a relaxed yet upscale outing.
~It can be a bit pricey and quieter during daytime, but evenings bring a lively atmosphere worth experiencing.
.
For more Information ⬇️
Insta I’d : Petrol_hunter_350
YouTube : Petrol_hunter_350

Name: Coca-Cola Arena
Description: A large indoor arena hosting concerts, sports and live shows.
Reviews:
Had an amazing experience at Coca-Cola Arena in Dubai! The venue is absolutely world-class — super clean, well-organized, and easy to access. The seating arrangement is excellent, giving a great view from almost every spot.

The sound system and lighting are top-notch, making concerts and events feel truly unforgettable. Staff were friendly and helpful throughout, which made the whole experience smooth and enjoyable.

Parking and entry were well managed, and everything felt safe and comfortable. Definitely one of the best event venues in Dubai — highly recommended for concerts, shows, and live events! || Great place to watch basketball! I feel the same way  like watching live NBA game. Well organized, great atmosphere created by the host, mascot, cheer ladies, staff and all the people who entertain the public during the breaks. Food and drinks available. As clean and well organized as everywhere else in Dubai. || overall it was a memorable experience. The hall itself felt a bit outdated, with uncomfortable seating that made it hard to fully relax, and the sound system could definitely have been better. That said, the staff were helpful in guiding us through the event, which made things smoother.

Despite these minor issues, the band delivered an absolutely amazing performance—powerful, precise, and truly captivating. Their energy and musicianship completely made up for everything else. || Coca-Cola Arena is an amazing and beautiful venue. It's well organized and very easy to access, with plenty of parking available. I attended the Hope Makers event there, and it was wonderful and perfectly organized. The atmosphere was great. Thank you to the team for the excellent organization.
Highly recommended ❤️ || I attended the Dubai vs Milan (Dec 23, 2025) & Dubai vs Krka (Dec 26, 2025) basketball games at Coca Cola Arena and it was an excellent experience overall. The arena was buzzing well before tip off and the organization at the entrances was smooth. Inside, the seating was comfortable, visibility was great from most angles, and the arena lighting and sound gave the event a true big league feel.

The games themselves were exciting !!! fast pace, competitive plays, and great energy from the crowd. The atmosphere really lifted the home team, especially during key moments. Concessions were fairly quick, security was polite, and the staff helped guide people to their seats without confusion.

Parking and traffic around City Walk were busy (as expected for big events), so I’d recommend arriving early or using the metro. Apart from that, everything felt professional and well run.

Overall, it was a memorable sports experience and a great showcase of basketball in Dubai. I would definitely come back for future games.
Highly recommended!

Name: Creek Park
Description: A large public park beside Dubai Creek with picnic and family facilities.
Reviews:
Dubai Creek Park is one of Dubai’s oldest and most beautiful public parks, offering a perfect blend of nature, recreation, and family-friendly attractions. Located along the historic Dubai Creek, the park features lush green lawns, colorful gardens, children’s play areas, barbecue spots, and scenic walking and cycling paths. Visitors can also enjoy attractions such as the cable car, mini golf, and the famous Children’s City educational center. With its peaceful atmosphere and stunning waterfront views, Dubai Creek Park is an ideal destination for picnics, outdoor activities, and relaxing with family and friends away from the city’s busy lifestyle. || I really enjoyed my day at Creek Park Dubai! I spent the whole day here with my family, and the weather was cool and nice. The park is quiet and good for nature lovers. We had a picnic and used the grilling area. The park is clean and big, with plenty of benches and shops. The toilets were very clean. It’s a great place for jogging, relaxing, and family time. Please remember, alcohol and pork are not allowed. I highly recommend this park for a peaceful and fun day!

There is Entrance fee of 5AED per head. || Creek Park is absolutely stunning! The evening views of the city lights reflecting on the water were magical. I loved the serene atmosphere and beautiful landscaping. Perfect for a relaxing stroll! :) || I visited Creek Park in Dubai, and it was a very enjoyable experience. I first went there on a school trip, and more recently I also visited with my friends where we had a picnic together. We brought a lot of food and spent time talking, eating, and enjoying the fresh air. It was very fun and relaxing.

The park is very big and full of beautiful green spaces. There are many trees, walking paths, and places where families and students can sit and relax. One of the most interesting activities was the maze, which was very fun to explore. There are also small shops where you can buy snacks and different items. I especially liked buying instant noodles because they are my favorite snack.

Another exciting part of the visit was seeing the dolphins, which made the trip very memorable. The park also has very beautiful views, and it is a perfect place for taking pictures and enjoying nature. Everything was clean and well organized.

Overall, I think Creek Park is a wonderful place to visit with friends, family, or on school trips. It is fun, beautiful, and has many activities to enjoy. I would definitely like to visit again in the future. || Creek Park is a beautiful and peaceful place, perfect if you want to relax away from the busy city. The park is very clean, with lots of green spaces, walking paths, and areas where you can sit and enjoy the view of the creek.

It is a great spot for families because there are playgrounds for children and plenty of space for picnics. You can also rent bikes or simply take a long walk, especially in the late afternoon when the weather is nicer.

One of the best things about Creek Park is the calm atmosphere. It feels less crowded than other attractions, making it ideal if you prefer a quieter experience.

Name: Deep Dive Dubai
Description: A deep indoor diving pool with themed underwater environments.
Reviews:
Absolutely amazing experience at Deep Dive Dubai during my PADI Open Water course. The facility itself is super modern, unique and incredibly impressive.

Big shout out to my instructor, Imantha. Extremely patient, professional and always taking the time to explain every part of the training clearly and calmly. He made the whole experience enjoyable and stress-free.

All staff members were very friendly, welcoming and helpful throughout the course. Equipment quality was excellent as well.

I would 100% recommend Deep Dive Dubai for scuba diving experiences and certifications. || One of the best experiences in life . If you are in Dubai or you are planing a Dubai trip deep dive Dubai is the perfect choice for an adventure. We have the best world record holding diving experience in life . Felix our guide so amazing and caring . He treat us a child under water . So kind loving personality || Amazing experience I did the certified diver guided dive,  and it was the one of the most incredible things I’ve done as a diver. I got to play around with a lot of the props deep in the pool, including eating a meal, drinking, playing a guitar, playing foosball, playing pool, riding a motorcycle, and more. My guide was great. The equipment was absolutely top-notch. The pre-dive prep was great and facilities/showers were very modern and clean. The entire dive lasted like 45 minutes, we used nitrox, we went down to 30m, and I was able to bring my GoPro camera with me for free. If you scuba, or want to scuba, you absolutely need to do this when you’re in Dubai!! || I brought my daughter to Deep Dive Dubai to spend some time together. Our guide was Philippe and he was awesome. Great communicator, very focused on safety and was also a lot of fun. We had a great dive in a very near and different environment. Facilities are first class, equipment was excellent and staff were lovely. I highly recommend. || amazing diving destination with top notch facilities. what a very unique and remarkable diving experience in an underwater city. Thanks to the awesome and super friendly instructor Filipi. 👍

Name: Dolphin Bay
Description: A marine interaction attraction at Atlantis The Palm.
Reviews:
An absolutely unforgettable experience.

From the moment we arrived, our host Kaushik made us feel so welcome and at ease. His warmth and professionalism set the tone for what became one of the most incredible experiences of my life.

The 30-minute swim with dolphins was truly magical. I was genuinely emotional — being in the water with Centrol was something I will never forget. Centrol was so gentle, calm, and kind, and you could feel the deep trust and connection between the dolphin and the trainers.

A huge thank you to the amazing trainers Happy and Joshua. Their care, knowledge, and obvious love for Centrol shone through every moment. They made the experience feel safe, respectful, and incredibly special, while also sharing so much insight about these beautiful animals.

This was hands down one of the best things I have ever done in my life. If you are considering it — do it. I will treasure this experience forever. || It was a great experience with the family. The dolphins are such an intelligent mammal.  We met Dennita (a dolphin grandmother). I would like to thank the whole staff starting with Phiona and the trainers Van and Julia for having the patience to answer all our questions. My girls loved it... I recommend for the whole family. || Visiting the dolphins was an unforgettable experience. Seeing these beautiful and intelligent animals up close was truly special. The staff was friendly, professional, and clearly cared about the dolphins’ well-being. The facilities were clean and well-organized, and the educational information made the visit even more interesting.  The staff were Keish, Adrián and Werrick. One of them also speak Portuguese, so i was very happy, because my friend didnt speak english, and he could help speaking also Portuguese.  The dolplhin Maui was very well trained. || An Unforgettable Family Adventure at Aquaventure Dolphin Experience!

Our family of four had the most incredible day at the Dolphin Experience today. From the moment we arrived, the staff went above and beyond to make us feel welcome, turning a simple excursion into a truly "special" memory that we will cherish forever.

The A-Team of Trainers
We cannot say enough about the staff. Glen, Manu, Bimiso, and Perlina provided us with expert attention from start to finish. Their passion for what they do is evident, and they ensured every member of our family felt safe, engaged, and included throughout the entire session.

Meeting the Stars: Black, Lisa, and Michael
The highlight, of course, was getting to know the beautiful dolphin family. Spending time with Black, Lisa, and the adorable baby Michael was a dream come true. It wasn't just about the interaction; we actually learned so much about their biology, social structures, and conservation.

Magic Moments
Getting to perform tricks with these intelligent creatures was exhilarating! The trainers did a fantastic job of bridging the gap between humans and dolphins, allowing us to interact in a way that felt respectful and deeply personal.

The Verdict
If you are in Dubai, this is a must-do. Whether you're a local or a tourist, the team at Aquaventure provides a world-class experience that is educational, heartwarming, and pure fun! || Thank you so much to the amazing team (Steve, Kim and Joon) at Dolphin Bay for such an unforgettable dolphin ( Hilmal Lennox) encounter experience! 🐬✨

Everything was perfectly organized, and the staff were incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and caring—not just towards us, but especially towards the dolphins. It was truly heartwarming to see the love and respect you have for these beautiful animals.

This experience created memories I will cherish forever. Thank you for making it so special! 💙

Highly recommend this to anyone visiting—an absolute must-do!

Name: Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo
Description: A large aquarium and underwater wildlife attraction inside The Dubai Mall.
Reviews:
The Dubai Aquarium is absolutely outstanding and one of the most impressive attractions we have ever visited.

Even from the outside, viewing the enormous aquarium through Dubai Mall is already a spectacular sight. However, once you enter, it exceeds all expectations. The scale of the aquarium, the variety of species, and the overall experience are simply breathtaking.

The absolute highlights for us were the Penguin Encounter, where we had the unforgettable opportunity to interact with and gently touch the penguins, and the scuba diving experience in the main tank. Diving among sharks, rays, and thousands of fish was an experience we will never forget.

What impressed us most was the opportunity to observe so many different animals from incredibly close distances. Every area offers unique encounters and amazing views, making the experience exciting from start to finish.

The staff were absolutely amazing: friendly, professional, knowledgeable, and always happy to help. Everything was exceptionally well organized, clean, and maintained to a very high standard.

The animals appeared well cared for, and the habitats are spacious and thoughtfully designed. It is clear that a great deal of effort goes into creating an outstanding experience for both the animals and the visitors.

If you are visiting Dubai, this attraction is a must-see. It is beautiful from the outside, but once you step inside, it surpasses every expectation. || Dubai Aquarium is visually impressive and definitely worth seeing at least once. The tunnel walk is beautiful but it last about 1 minute which I didn’t know and expected more. Seeing sharks, rays, and so many different species up close is a memorable experience, especially for first-time visitors or families. As an attraction, it’s well designed and very appealing.

Unfortunately, the experience was negatively affected by the staff at the ticket counter. Two women were working there, and when I asked simple questions about whether our ticket included certain activities, they reacted in a very unprofessional manner. They laughed mockingly, spoke to each other in their own language, and sarcastically repeated my question back to me several times. This behavior felt disrespectful and made the situation uncomfortable.

Another downside is the price. While the aquarium is nice, it doesn’t fully justify how expensive it is. In addition, the photo service is extremely overpriced — you receive only one printed photo for €40, while the remaining photos are sent by email. This feels excessive and takes away from the overall experience.

In summary, Dubai Aquarium is a great outing visually, but the poor customer service and high costs significantly reduce its value. With better staff attitude and fairer pricing, it could easily be a much better experience. || best for every age visitors, no need to buy the toy which they offer at entry point for kids to interact with screens and speakers for telling the details of species. souvenir shop is nice, must visit if you are visiting Aquaventure water park. || A very nice aquarium located in the Dubai mall. Somewhat similar to the National Aquarium in Abu Dhabi, and perhaps a little bit larger collection of sea animals. A good place to spend an hour or two for the whole family. || Dubai Aquarium is an incredible experience for all ages inside Dubai Mall. Walking through the giant underwater tunnel surrounded by sharks and rays is breathtaking. The underwater zoo on the upper floor is also amazing with many unique marine creatures and penguins. The place is very clean, well-managed, and the staff are helpful and informative. It is highly recommended to book tickets in advance to save time. A fantastic place to visit with family and friends

Name: Dubai Autodrome
Description: A motorsport circuit offering races, driving experiences and karting.
Reviews:
Did the M2 driving experience as a birthday gift from the husband and it was an absolutely thrilling and fun experience!
The instructor was amazing and gave just the right kind of advice that removed any nervousness I had and gave me tips on how I can improve further.
Loved it and will definitely be back to try more cars! || I had an amazing time at the Dubai Autodrome! 🤩 The atmosphere was electric, and the tracks looked fantastic. It was a truly memorable experience. 🏎️💨 The giant screen made viewing easy, and I can't wait to go back. 🌟👏 || Went to Dubai Autodrome and temporarily believed I had racing talent. The setup is super professional, the instructors are patient (thankfully), and the track gives you just enough confidence to push it without feeling reckless. Whether you’re a petrolhead or just chasing an adrenaline hit, this place delivers. 10/10 would pretend to be a race car driver again. || It was an unforgettable experience. From the moment I arrived, everything was well organized and professionally managed. The facilities are clean, modern, and designed perfectly for motorsport enthusiasts.. There are also great viewing areas for friends and family, which adds to the overall atmosphere.. It’s a fantastic place for car lovers and anyone looking for a fun, unique experience in Dubai. Highly recommended! || Absolutely blast of an experience, did the formula dxb and was a bit worried that since they have a pace car in front of your smaller groups, that I wouldn't be able to push so much. But the team had very good observation and adjusted the order for faster cars to go closest to pace car and hence increase the speed and fun! Just a bit sad that the course was so short and the tempo of some very low which meant a lot of slowing down for overtaking. But that overall, very very fun and got a good taste of maximum pace for myself for at least a couple of sections at a time! Thanks to the great team who made sure everything went smooth! Hope to come back again!

Name: Dubai Butterfly Garden
Description: An indoor butterfly attraction with climate-controlled domes.
Reviews:
We visited this place in late March. It has three domes, two of them are air conditioned and one is not, though we still found it quite comfortable. There are seating areas to rest in between walks. There were many beautiful butterflies of all sizes, though we were hoping to see a few more. The kids enjoyed it a lot, and overall it was a pleasant experience spending time together as a family. We used an Entertainer 1+1 offer for two entries and purchased one additional ticket at the counter for AED 50. || This place never stops wowing you. The butterflies are literally everywhere, fluttering around so freely that it feels like you’ve stepped into their home. They sit around you, twirl past you, and follow you almost everywhere you go. I’ve visited multiple times with family, friends, and kids, and every single visit still feels magical. Entrance, has a  quick introduction about butterflies, their habitat, and their journey of life. It makes the whole experience even more special and enjoyable.
Amazing place to visit for both kids and adults. || Dubai Butterfly Garden is a really beautiful and unique experience, especially if you enjoy nature and photography. There were so many blue butterflies during the visit, and the whole place felt extremely photogenic.

The garden is made up of climate-controlled domes filled with lush plants, flowers, and small water features, creating a peaceful and colourful environment. Butterflies are everywhere, resting on flowers and sometimes even landing close by, which makes it perfect for photos. Just avoid using flash and don’t touch their wings so they stay safe.

It’s a calm and relaxing place to walk through at your own pace, and you can also learn a bit about the butterfly life cycle along the way. Overall, a lovely experience and definitely worth visiting, especially along with Dubai Miracle Garden which is right next door. || Tip: Do buy your tickets online in advance — we got them for 40 dirhams, whereas at the counter they were 70 dirhams!
A truly magical experience at Dubai Butterfly Garden! Being surrounded by thousands of colorful butterflies was simply mesmerizing. The environment is beautifully maintained, very clean, and perfectly temperature-controlled. The staff is friendly and informative, and the best part was getting the chance to hold butterflies and click some unforgettable pictures. They guide you to first hold the butterflies properly on your finger before letting them sit on any other body part, which makes the experience safe and comfortable for both visitors and butterflies.
It’s a must-visit place for nature lovers, families, and anyone who wants to experience something unique and peaceful in Dubai. 💕🦋 || We had a wonderful family visit to Dubai Butterfly Garden. The garden is beautifully designed, clean, and very well organized. Seeing hundreds of colorful butterflies flying freely was magical for both adults and children.

The staff were friendly and informative, always happy to help and explain interesting facts. It’s a calm, educational, and memorable experience—perfect for families with kids.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for a unique and enjoyable attraction in Dubai! 🦋🌸

Name: Dubai Creek
Description: A historic waterway known for abra rides, souks and traditional trading areas.
Reviews:
Had a wonderful time at Dubai Creek. The atmosphere is truly special, blending the charm of old Dubai with beautiful waterfront views. Sitting by the creek with a coffee, watching the traditional boats pass by, and enjoying the peaceful surroundings made for a perfect experience.

The area is full of character, history, and authentic local charm. It’s a great place to slow down, relax, and appreciate a different side of Dubai away from the busy city life.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for beautiful views, a peaceful atmosphere, and a glimpse of Dubai’s heritage. || It's one of the best experience you can have in Dubai, you must visit Dubai Creek when you are in Dubai without a miss.
The Dubai Creek is a natural saltwater forming historic commercial port and the central landmark that divides the Old Dubai into Deira and Bur-Dubai. The Dubai Creek can be explored in a traditional abra boat visiting some historic places and shopping at souks in Deira and Bur-Dubai souk markets. You can shop for spices and other goods in the souks. The modern Dubai Creek harbour offers water front community with dining, shopping and entertainment and the mesmerizing view the city skyline.
During Our visit to Dubai Creek we went for a cruise ride which includes dining and some entertainment on the cruise, it's probably 2-3 hours journey in the modern Dubai Creek sailing through the city for this duration.
There are many cruises available for such activity check and book a good one with good food. The food in our cruise was good and for entertainment a traditional dance was performed which was very nice. The main highlight of this ride is the view of the city while we sail through the Creek.
The view of the skyline of Dubai and the beautiful towers with amazing lightings is just fantastic to watch, words cannot describe the beauty of the experience we had one should come and experience it.
If you are visiting in peak season dont forget to wear some warm clothes because it was very cold as the time progressed at night.
This was one of the best experience we had in Dubai.
Love for Dubai is Eternal. || Dubai Creek is a really nice place to visit. The architecture feels much more in line with what you would expect from a traditional Arab city, which makes the area feel more authentic compared to other parts of Dubai. The waterfront promenade is clean and pleasant to walk along. While there is a bit of litter in the water, it’s not too noticeable. You can also take boat rides across the creek, which adds to the overall experience. || Dubai Creek is a beautiful blend of old and new. Taking an abra ride across the water gives you a glimpse into the city’s rich heritage, with traditional souks on one side and modern skyscrapers in the distance. It’s a peaceful spot to relax, explore, and experience the authentic charm of old Dubai. A must-visit for anyone who wants to see the city beyond its luxury malls and high-rises. || Dubai Creek never fails to charm.. a perfect blend of old Dubai vibes and stunning waterfront views. 🌅 Whether you’re strolling along Al Seef or taking an abra ride, it’s always relaxing and picture-perfect. A must-visit spot to feel the city’s soul! 💛

Name: Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve
Description: A protected desert area offering wildlife viewing and guided desert experiences.
Reviews:
Great place which is the starting point of the desert safari trip (uae only Arabian adventures, they are the best) if you are lucky you will get to see wild life. And the dune bashing is so much fun! || Great experience dune driving, food was ok, we did up grade to the drink package which was a waste of money. Hard to contact the company before the event to confirm pick up, but not a real problem as they turned up in time. || Absolutely wonderful! Everything is so well thought out with Platinum Heritage. We went with an 11 year old she absolutely enjoyed it. Our camel guide Shakeel was amazing and the whole evening was phenomenal. || A bucket list experience.
We were collected in a private G wagon from our hotel.
Our driver was very knowledgeable and friendly.
The private desert tour was outstanding.
We had dinner in the desert at a table for 2.
The food was first class.
There were dancers, henna tattooists sisha and camels. || This was our first visit to the conservation reserve, and it was an unforgettable experience. The center features a beautifully curated mini-museum with fascinating insights into the region’s wildlife and native species. The highlight, of course, was the dune drive — an incredible journey through the desert landscape. The entire tour was well-organized and truly worth a visit for anyone wanting to connect with the natural heritage of the UAE.

Name: Dubai Dolphinarium
Description: An indoor marine entertainment venue with dolphin and seal shows.
Reviews:
This facility offers dolphin and sea lion shows, with each performance lasting about 45 minutes.

The program is generally designed with children in mind, but the movements and performances of the dolphins and sea lions are engaging enough for adults to enjoy as well.

If you place a request in advance at the reception, it is possible to touch a dolphin and take photos together after the show, which was a particularly memorable experience.

There also seems to be a separate program available where you can swim with dolphins via a different route.

Overall, it is especially suitable for families and a nice place to create lasting memories. || We had a fantastic time at the Dubai Dolphinarium! 🐬✨

The show was absolutely amazing—very entertaining, well-organized, and full of impressive performances. The dolphins were incredible to watch, so smart and playful, and it was clear how much effort goes into the experience.

The whole atmosphere was lively and fun, making it enjoyable for both kids and adults. It’s definitely a unique experience and something you shouldn’t miss when in Dubai.

Highly recommended for a fun and memorable day out! || The kids and even the young at heart will definitely enjoy this place! It was our first time seeing seals and dolphins up close, and it was truly amazing. The trainers did an incredible job teaching and interacting with the animals, and the performances were both entertaining and impressive. Honestly, the dolphins and seals deserve a salary because they are the real stars of the show! 😅

We were also lucky to use an Entertainer buy 1 take 1 voucher, which made the visit even more worth it. Overall, it’s a fun and memorable place to visit with family and friends. || Had a wonderful experience at Dubai Dolphinarium. The show was truly entertaining and enjoyable—definitely worth watching. The performances were impressive and kept us engaged throughout.
However, the experience at the ticket counter was disappointing. Even after booking tickets online, there was a significant delay due to poor crowd management. The process was quite unorganized, and because of this, we ended up entering after the show had already started, despite arriving before the scheduled time.
Overall, the show itself was fantastic, but the management at the entry point needs serious improvement to match the quality of the experience inside. || Lovely spot for the whole family! The dolphin and sea lion show was truly amazing - fun, lively, and full of energy. The bird show was also surprisingly engaging and added a nice touch to the experience. There’s even a small café for snacks and coffee, making it easy to enjoy a relaxing break. A wonderful, fun-filled visit overall!

Name: Dubai Frame
Description: A landmark observation structure presenting views of old and new Dubai.
Reviews:
My visit to Dubai Frame was absolutely wonderful. The monument itself is architecturally stunning, but the real magic happens at the top. Standing there and watching old Dubai on one side and the modern skyline on the other was a thrilling and unforgettable moment.

The glass floor walkway adds a fun element of excitement, while the panoramic views give you a perfect perspective of how beautifully the city has evolved. Everything was well organized, and the overall experience felt smooth and enjoyable.

Highly recommended for anyone visiting Dubai — it’s more than just a viewpoint, it’s a journey through the city’s past and present. || I had a great experience visiting the Dubai Frame at Zabeel Park. It’s one of those attractions that truly lives up to the hype. The structure itself is impressive to look at, and it’s fascinating how it frames both old and new parts of Dubai from the top. The panoramic views from the observation deck are stunning, especially at sunset when the city skyline comes to life.  ￼

Inside you get more than just views. The galleries take you through Dubai’s past, present and future in a way that’s engaging and informative, and the glass skywalk adds a fun thrill factor. Staff were friendly and helpful, and even on a busy day the flow was smooth.  ￼

Being inside beautiful Zabeel Park makes the visit even nicer. It’s easy to spend extra time afterward walking around the gardens, having a picnic or grabbing a coffee. || It was great view from the top. They had nice little history museum before the the elevator took you up. My children enjoyed the garden area once we came back down. Overall it was great experience experience. || Dubai Frame is definitely worth visiting at least once while in Dubai. The architecture is impressive, and seeing the massive golden frame up close is an experience on its own. The views from the top are spectacular, offering a unique perspective of both old and new Dubai.

The attraction is clean, well-maintained, and organized. The glass-floor walkway adds a bit of excitement, and the exhibits provide interesting insights into Dubai’s past, present, and future.

One thing to be aware of is the photo service. There are two separate photography teams—one at the entrance and another at the top. The photos are good, but they are quite expensive, and each team sells their photos separately. It would be much better if both sets of photos were offered together as a single package.

Overall, it’s a great attraction for sightseeing, photography, and learning more about Dubai’s transformation. Despite the expensive photo packages, the experience itself is excellent and highly recommended for tourists and first-time visitors. 🌟📸🏙️ || Dubai Frame – Absolutely Stunning!

Visited in the morning and it was an amazing solo experience! 😍🏙️ I took my time exploring everything, and it was totally worth it.

The structure itself is breathtaking modern, clean, and very well maintained ✨🟦 The sky bridge was super exciting and a bit scary at the same time 😄😱 (Pro tip: don’t look down or look at your camera screen while recording, it makes it much easier!).

Inside, the galleries showcasing Past & Future Dubai are very informative and immersive 🎥🕌🌆.

Everything is organized well, air-conditioned, and easy to explore at your own pace.

🚶‍♂️ How I got there: Took the metro and then walked a short distance simple and convenient!

💡 Tip: Weekends can be a bit crowded, so mornings are ideal. Night lights are supposed to be amazing, though I haven’t tried that yet 🌃✨.

Overall vibe: Scenic, chill, touristy, exciting, and very informative — 100/10! 🌟

Highly recommend for everyone families, tourists, photographers, solo travelers basically anyone visiting Dubai! 📸🙌

Name: Dubai Garden Glow
Description: A seasonal illuminated attraction with themed installations and family displays.
Reviews:
Had an amazing time at Glow Garden Dubai! The glowing displays and colorful light installations were absolutely beautiful and made the whole place feel magical. 🌈 The Dinosaur Park was a favorite with the kids—they were so excited to see the life-sized moving dinosaurs. 🦖 There were plenty of fun attractions and photo spots throughout the park. A perfect family-friendly destination for a fun evening in Dubai! 💖 || A fantastic place for families, especially with kids! The dinosaur displays are very realistic and exciting, and the whole park is well maintained. My kids were completely fascinated and enjoyed every corner. It’s educational, fun, and a great way to spend a few hours outdoors. Staff were friendly and the atmosphere was very welcoming. Definitely worth visiting if you’re looking for a fun family outing. || We had such a fun experience at Dubai Garden Glow. The Dinosaur Park was honestly impressive, the dinosaurs are life-size, they move, make sounds, and it feels surprisingly realistic. You can tell a lot of effort went into the details.

Fantasy Park at night was my personal highlight. The glowing installations create such a magical atmosphere and it’s perfect for photos while still being very family-friendly.

It’s a great evening plan, especially if you go around sunset so you can see everything in daylight and then enjoy the lights after dark. Open from 9AM to 10PM, so there’s plenty of flexibility.

Definitely worth visiting if you’re in Dubai, whether with kids or just curious like me. || Two magical worlds, one location! 🦖✨ Did you know you can travel from the Jurassic era to an animals  wonderland in a esingle evening?

We spent the night at Dubai Garden Glow in Zabeel Park, and it’s a must-visit! 🌙 We started at the Dinosaur Park, where the animatronic giants feel so real (the kids were obsessed!), and then  we walked into the Fantasy Park. It’s like stepping into a dream with  fairytale sculptures of animals and magical flowers . 🦋🌸

Perfect for a family outing. || I visited Dubai Garden Glow recently and really enjoyed it. The place has two sections  Dinosaur Park and Fantasy Park  and both were impressive. The lights in Fantasy Park make the whole area look stunning once it gets dark.There’s also a Dinosaur Show at 5 PM, which was a nice bonus. Tickets are 73.5 AED and valid for the whole day, so you can explore at your own pace.Overall, it’s a lovely spot to visit with family and friends.

Name: Dubai Marina Walk
Description: A waterfront promenade with restaurants, views and leisure activities.
Reviews:
Visiting Dubai Marina Walk was an absolutely spectacular experience and one of the most impressive places in Dubai.
The atmosphere is vibrant, modern, and full of energy. Walking along the waterfront surrounded by luxury yachts, futuristic skyscrapers, restaurants, and cafés creates an unforgettable experience. The promenade stretches for several kilometers along the marina, offering breathtaking views everywhere you look.
What impressed me most was the incredible skyline. The combination of exotic architecture, illuminated towers, and reflections on the water creates a truly magical setting, especially at night.
The area is perfect for walking, relaxing, enjoying dinner, or simply admiring the luxurious lifestyle and modern engineering that Dubai is famous for. The entire promenade feels elegant, lively, and visually spectacular.
Overall, a must visit destination in Dubai modern, scenic, and absolutely unforgettable. Wowww… what an incredible skyline and atmosphere! || Hello happy people. Today we are in the largest city in the United Arab Emirates, namely Dubai. The city has many attractions that are worth visiting. One of these places is “Dubai Marina Walk”. This is one of the most popular coastal promenades in Dubai. It is about 7 km long pedestrian promenade that goes around the artificial canal of the Dubai Marina district. In the evening when it is not so warm it is very suitable for walks. Visit this place. Greetings and smiles. || Definitely one of the best spots in Dubai! The landscape is absolutely breathtaking, especially with the skyline views over the water. There’s a huge variety of restaurants and shops to explore along the path. Pro tip: Rent an e-scooter to see the whole Marina—it’s a long stretch, and your feet will definitely burn if you try to walk the entire thing! || Dubai Marina is one of my favorite areas in the city. It’s modern, vibrant, and very pleasant to walk around, especially along the marina promenade. The views of the water, yachts, and skyscrapers all together are beautiful—both during the day and at night.

There are tons of restaurants, cafés, and bars with options for every taste and budget, many of them with great views. It’s a perfect place for a relaxed walk, a nice dinner, or just sitting down for a coffee and people-watching. The area feels lively but still comfortable and safe.

It’s also very well located and easy to move around, with good access to transport, beaches nearby, and boat or yacht cruise options if you want to see the marina from the water.

Overall, Dubai Marina feels polished, fun, and very “Dubai.” Great atmosphere, great views, and definitely a place worth spending time in. || Beautiful place. Lots of restaurants and bars all within walking distance very impressive to see how many restaurants they have.
Great views all around nice to see so many people walking around at 11pm on a regular weekday.

Name: Dubai Miracle Garden
Description: A seasonal garden displaying large floral sculptures and themed landscapes.
Reviews:
Absolutely magical! The garden is a burst of colors with creative floral displays everywhere you look. Perfect spot for photos, family visits, or just a peaceful stroll. The paths are well-maintained, and there’s so much to explore , every corner is a new surprise! Be ready for some crowds during peak hours, but it’s totally worth it. Highly recommend visiting in the cooler months to enjoy the flowers at their best! || Experiencing the Dubai Miracle Garden in 2026 remains one of the most surreal and breathtaking journeys one can take in the UAE. Nestled in the heart of Dubailand, this 72,000-square-meter floral oasis defies its desert surroundings with over 150 million blooming flowers and plants.
A Living Masterpiece in the Desert
Upon entering, you are immediately enveloped in a symphony of scents and colors. The garden is not merely a collection of plants but a meticulously crafted landscape of 3D floral art. For many visitors, the sheer scale is the first "miracle"—seeing millions of blossoms thrive where once there was only sand.

Essential Travel Tips for 2026
Operational Season: The garden is a seasonal attraction, typically open from late October to April or May. It closes during the summer months (June to September) as the heat is too intense for the flowers to survive.
Best Time to Visit: Arriving at opening (9:00 AM) or in the late afternoon (4:00 PM onwards) is recommended. The sunset hours provide a magical glow, and the newly enhanced night experience features twinkling lights on sculptures, creating a totally different, romantic mood.
Tickets & Entry: Standard adult tickets for the 2026 season are approximately AED 85 to AED 100. It is highly recommended to book tickets online to skip long entry queues.
Nearby Attractions: You can easily pair your visit with the Dubai Butterfly Garden (located right next door) or the Global Village, which is just a short drive away.

Food and Dining: There are over 30 food and beverage vendors within the premises, including cafes, kiosks, and specialized shops like a bubble tea stall. While options are mostly basic snacks and juices, they provide necessary refreshments during the walk.
Accessibility: The entire park is wheelchair and stroller accessible, with wide, paved pathways and strategically placed seating areas for those needing a rest. || Dubai Miracle Garden￼ is a beautiful attraction with an amazing variety of flowers and creative floral displays. The garden is very well maintained and perfect for photos and family visits. However, be careful about the visiting time, especially during hotter months, as it can get extremely hot during the daytime. It’s best to plan your visit either early in the morning or later in the evening for a much more comfortable experience. || What a beautiful place — so many great photo spots, simply a dream, an absolute Instagram dream. You can find everything you could want there, even a Smurfs village where our children were able to drive around in bumper cars. There are also many small restaurants and drink stands everywhere.

I can truly recommend this place for families with children. It’s absolutely fantastic. You can easily spend two to three hours there, and the money is more than well spent. || An absolute floral wonderland! It is hard to believe such a lush, colorful paradise exists in the middle of the desert. My wife absolutely loved the beautifulness of the arrangements—every corner is more stunning than the last. The heart-shaped arches and the giant Emirates A380 covered in flowers were the highlights for us. It’s the perfect place for a romantic stroll and some incredible photos. A must-visit in Dubai!

Name: Dubai Opera
Description: A performing arts venue hosting opera, theatre, concerts and cultural events.
Reviews:
Amazing place to watch any kind of LIVE shows but very limited food options. They also have free parking in such a. Prime area that’s awesome || Dubai Opera will forever hold a special place in my heart.
I’ve made so many beautiful memories there from the magic of the orchestra filling the hall to breathtaking performances like Swan Lake and Pirates of the Caribbean.
Every visit leaves me with goosebumps and a sense of wonder that stays long after the curtains close.
It’s a place that reminds me why I love the arts so deeply, and I can’t wait to return again and again. || Had an amazing experience at Dubai Opera! The venue is incredibly clean and well organized, the staff were exceptionally friendly and welcoming, and the sound system quality was absolutely outstanding. Every detail contributed to a world-class experience. Definitely one of the best entertainment venues in Dubai! || What an excellent experience at the Opera for  Beethoven concert
The venue is outstanding – amazingly organized and a pleasure to visit.
I especially want to thank the Security team for their outstanding support; they went above and beyond to help me find a lost item immediately. Truly professional and kind!
Thank you! || Visited Dubai Opera and had an exceptional experience. The architecture is stunning, the acoustics are outstanding, and the atmosphere feels truly special. The staff is very welcoming and helpful, and the seating offers great visibility from almost any spot. A perfect place for cultural events and a beautiful evening out. Highly recommended.

Name: Dubai Safari Park
Description: A wildlife park with animal habitats, safari experiences and educational zones.
Reviews:
Dubai Safari Park was one of the highlights of our trip and far exceeded our expectations.
The park is beautifully designed, well maintained, and home to an incredible variety of animals. It was amazing to see so many beautiful animals in spacious, well-designed habitats that clearly prioritize their welfare and comfort.
The safari tour was fantastic and gave us the opportunity to observe many animals up close while learning interesting facts about them. Throughout the park, there is a strong educational focus, and we left with much more knowledge about wildlife and conservation than we had before.
What made the experience even more special was the staff. Everyone we met was friendly, professional, and passionate about the animals. The keepers and guides shared a wealth of information and were always happy to answer questions, making the visit both enjoyable and educational.
We were particularly impressed by the care given to the animals and the quality of the enclosures. The park provides plenty of space and natural-looking environments, creating a wonderful experience for both the animals and the visitors.
An outstanding attraction for families, animal lovers, and anyone visiting Dubai. We would highly recommend Dubai Safari Park and will definitely visit again. || Great Family Day Out at Dubai Safari Park.

We had a wonderful experience at Dubai Safari Park with family and friends. The park is very well maintained, neat, and clean, with excellent facilities throughout.

My son enjoyed the visit the most, especially interacting with the cows, donkeys, and small goats. It was an amazing experience for him and one of the highlights of our trip.

I highly recommend taking the eco rides, as they make it much easier to explore the different zones of the park. We visited the Africa section first and then continued to the other areas, which was both convenient and enjoyable.

Overall, it was a fun, educational, and memorable day for both children and adults. Highly recommended for families! || Dubai Safari Park was a great experience and totally worth visiting. The place is huge, clean, and very well organized. There are many different animals to see, and you can tell they take good care of them.

What I liked most is that it’s not just a normal zoo — the safari part is really fun and feels more like a real wildlife experience. The park is easy to move around with the buses/shuttles, and everything is clear and smooth.

It’s a perfect place for families and kids, and also nice for anyone who enjoys animals and walking around outdoors. I recommend going early because it takes time to see everything. Overall, really enjoyable day. || Fantastic trip! The park is extremely clean, well-organized, and very spacious. The safari journey was truly the highlight—seeing animals up close in such a natural environment was an unforgettable experience. The staff were very friendly , who made the visit even more pleasant. The facilities are excellent, making it a perfect place for families and kids.
We were lucky to visit during Christmas, and it made the experience even more special. The kids had an amazing time meeting Santa, enjoying the magic show, fun games, tattoos, and even a movie. It was a wonderful blend of fun, education, and conservation.
Highly recommended and definitely worth visiting again! 🎄🦒✨ || We had an amazing experience at Dubai Safari Park! From the moment we entered, everything was well-organized, clean, and easy to navigate. The park is beautifully maintained, and it was exciting to see such a wide variety of animals in spacious and well-designed habitats.

The safari experience was definitely one of the highlights of our visit, allowing us to see animals up close in a way that felt both immersive and educational. The staff were friendly, helpful, and clearly passionate about the animals and conservation efforts.

We were fortunate enough to visit thanks to tickets we won through one of Dubai Safari Park's IG giveaways, and we're incredibly grateful for the opportunity. It turned into a memorable day filled with laughter, great photos, and wonderful moments with family.

Thank you, Dubai Safari Park, for a fantastic experience. We highly recommend it to anyone looking for a fun and enjoyable day out in Dubai! ❤️

Name: Etihad Museum
Description: A museum documenting the formation and political history of the UAE.
Reviews:
The architecture is absolutely stunning. The roof resembles a constitutional manuscript.
Inside, the exhibits are highly interactive. They focus beautifully on the nation's birth.

It is fully air-conditioned. This offers a great weather escape. It is rarely crowded. You can explore at your own pace.

Good to Know:
•	Adult tickets cost 25 AED.
•	Student entry is 10 AED.
•	Focuses strictly on modern history.
•	Plan for 1 to 2 hours. || Al Etihad Museum is truly a wonderful and peaceful place to visit, especially for anyone who appreciates history and culture. From the moment you arrive, you can feel a calm and quiet atmosphere that makes the experience even more enjoyable. It is not a crowded or noisy location, which allows visitors to take their time and fully absorb everything the museum has to offer.
This museum is a golden destination for history lovers. It beautifully tells the story of how the United Arab Emirates was formed, bringing together the journey of the founding fathers and the events that led to the union. The exhibits are well-organized, modern, and very informative. Through interactive displays, photographs, and original documents, visitors can clearly understand how the UAE came together as one nation.
One of the best parts of Al Etihad Museum is its environment. The design of the building itself is unique and meaningful, symbolizing the unity of the Emirates. Inside, the space is clean, well-lit, and thoughtfully arranged, making it easy to explore. The peaceful surroundings allow you to reflect on the history and appreciate the efforts that built the country.
I personally love this place because of its calm and inspiring atmosphere. It is not just a museum, but a place where you can connect with the roots of the UAE. Whether you are a tourist or a resident, visiting Al Etihad Museum is a meaningful and memorable experience that leaves you with a deeper respect for the nation’s history. || I visited the Etihad Museum in Dubai and I am now 80 percent smarter about the formation of the Emirates. Here is the shocking truth.

I walked in expecting a regular museum and walked out feeling like I had just binge watched the UAE’s origin story on turbo mode.
The building looks like a spaceship that politely landed in Jumeirah to teach humans about history. And yes, you absolutely need to take the tour. Do not wander around pretending you will figure it out. The guide turns the founding of the UAE into a full drama series with plot twists, suspense, and the kind of storytelling that makes you whisper about the dedication under your breath.

Highlights include standing in the exact spot where the UAE was born and realizing I almost missed it because I wanted to go to the museum of the future.

If you skip the Etihad Museum, you are missing out on architecture, and a history lesson that goes down easier than dessert. Take the tour. Your brain and your Instagram will thank you. || Etihad Museum is a beautiful and meaningful place to visit, offering a rich look into the story of the UAE’s founding. The building itself is striking, and the museum is very well organized, clean, and informative, with interactive exhibits that make the experience engaging.
It’s a great place for anyone who wants to understand the history and heritage of the country in a calm and respectful setting. You can easily spend a good amount of time here, and it’s definitely worth visiting if you enjoy cultural and educational experiences. || A heartfelt thank you to the amazing team at Etihad Museum for creating such a welcoming and inspiring environment for families and visitors from across the Emirates specially Maryam Ahmed Salem.
The workshop venue was beautifully prepared and gave everyone the opportunity to practice and enjoy the art activities in a comfortable and creative atmosphere.

Special appreciation goes to Ayesha Bukattara and Lei song  for their  kindness, warm hospitality, and wonderful support in opening and organizing the venue for us and the other families. Her efforts truly made the experience memorable and enjoyable for everyone.

It was a meaningful experience filled with creativity, culture, and positive energy. Looking forward to visiting again and participating in more inspiring workshops in the future.

Name: Global Village
Description: A seasonal multicultural entertainment park with pavilions, food and performances.
Reviews:
Global Village is honestly one of the best places in Dubai if you want shopping, food, entertainment, and a fun evening all in one place. The vibe is amazing, especially at night with all the lights, music, and different country pavilions. You literally get to experience cultures from around the world in one location.

The shopping is really good — there’s a huge variety of clothes, perfumes, accessories, home décor, snacks, souvenirs, and unique products from different countries at reasonable prices. It’s one of those places where you go “just to look around” and end up shopping a lot.

The food is definitely one of the best parts. So many options from different cuisines, street food spots, desserts, and drinks. Every corner has something tempting to try, and the atmosphere makes the whole experience even better.

There are also rides, games, live performances, and entertainment for both kids and adults, so it never feels boring. It’s perfect for families, friends, couples, or even solo visits if you just want to walk around and enjoy the vibe.

Overall, one of the most fun and lively places to visit in Dubai during the season. Definitely worth visiting more than once. ✨ || Great place to experience different cultures.  Enjoy rides, shows, food, shows this place has it all.  Great lighting Thru out the park really beautiful place.  We got there at 6pm and left about midnight which is also the best time to enjoy the rides as we had no wait time.  Dressing is normal here no need to worry to much about this.  But don't leave Dubai without this experience. || Amazing experience.   Child friendly and it's truly an international market experience.   Lots of food,  carnival games and amusement park rides.   Be sure to purchase the passport to enhance you engagement experience.   The shopping is amazing with products representing many countries.  Those   vendors can be aggressive in marketing their products.  Live performances on various platforms.   A must do activity when visiting Dubai. || One of those places that just puts you in a good mood the moment you walk in.

The whole world in one spot — India, Egypt, Europe, China, all with their own food, shops and little cultural moments. The India pavilion facade with the giant elephant is genuinely cool. The Egypt guy walking around in full costume with a brass coffee dispenser on his shoulder is a character.

Go at night. Everything lights up and the vibe is just different.

Food is great, options are everywhere, you won't go hungry. The rides are fun if you have kids. The main stage energy is infectious.

Just wear comfortable shoes and enjoy it. One of Dubai's best nights out. || Visited Global Village a few week back and had a wonderful experience. The atmosphere was vibrant with beautiful lights, cultural pavilions from different countries, and plenty of shopping options. There were lots of food stalls offering a variety of cuisines, and the entertainment shows were enjoyable for all ages. It’s a great place to spend an evening with family or friends. The only downside is that it can get quite crowded on weekends, but overall, it’s definitely worth visiting and one of the best attractions in Dubai.

Name: Gold Souk
Description: A traditional market in Deira known for gold and jewellery shops.
Reviews:
Visited the famous Dubai Gold Souk during my 2023 visit and it was truly an overwhelming experience to see so many gold shops and stunning jewellery designs all in one place. The entire area shines with gold and gives a completely different vibe that you rarely get to see anywhere else.

While visiting, make sure to be careful and purchase only from authentic and trusted shops. It’s always better to compare prices and check purity before buying.

Even if you are not planning to shop, this place is definitely a must-visit when you are in Dubai. The atmosphere, traditional market feel, and endless display of gold make it a memorable experience. || Dubai Gold Souk is one of the oldest traditional markets in the Emirates. It is home to more than 380 merchants. There are many excellent goldsmiths, spice sellers and other beautiful delicacies. We were transported to the market from the other side of the sea channel. We rode in fast traditional boats. It was a very interesting visit. || Visited Dubai Gold Souk and it was an incredible experience. The place is full of stunning gold jewelry with a wide variety of designs, from traditional to modern styles.

The atmosphere is lively and gives a true traditional market feel. Prices are reasonable, and many shops are open to negotiation, which makes shopping even more interesting.

It can get a bit crowded, but that’s part of the charm. Overall, a must-visit spot in Dubai, whether you’re shopping or just exploring. || The Gold Souq is a fascinating and vibrant market, full of shiny jewelry and interesting shops. The atmosphere is lively, but be careful with some vendors who may try to take you to hidden shops. Still, a great place to explore and experience local culture. || It offers a stunning variety of gold jewelry, from traditional to modern designs, all at competitive prices. The atmosphere is vibrant and authentic, giving a glimpse into Dubai’s rich trading culture. Even if you’re not shopping, it’s a great place to walk around and experience the charm of old Dubai.

Name: Hatta Wadi Hub
Description: An outdoor adventure destination offering biking, hiking, kayaking and activities.
Reviews:
Last year, we celebrated a birthday at Wadi Hub Hatta and booked three camping slots and honestly it was such a great experience. The place is perfect for winter camping. Each slot comes with a stone fire pit, running tap water, a long table, and a BBQ area, which made everything super convenient. Our stay was really enjoyable 👍🏻 Youre allowed to bring your car inside too (one car per slot you rent), which helps a lot when unloading camping gears and stuff. We went on a weekend, so there was even a fireworks display which made the night extra special.

The staff at the entrance and during check-in were all friendly and approachable. The area was peaceful with no loud music, which we appreciated. Plus there are outdoor activities for all ages, so its a great spot for families too. The only small downside is that the toilets are a bit far from the camping area, so you need to walk for a while. Name: Jameel Arts Centre
Description: A contemporary art institution with exhibitions, a sculpture park and learning spaces.
Reviews:
Jameel Arts Centre is one of Dubai’s strongest contemporary art spaces — not because it tries to overwhelm visitors, but because it gives them room to think, pause, and occasionally disagree with what they are seeing. Located along Dubai Creek in Al Jaddaf, the museum combines minimalist architecture, water, gardens, and rotating exhibitions by artists from the Middle East and beyond. Admission is free, photography is allowed, and opening hours are usually 10:00–20:00 (Saturday–Thursday) and 12:00–20:00 on Fridays. Visitors register via QR code at the entrance, though Wi-Fi is available if needed. The centre spans three floors with around ten gallery spaces, plus a bookshop, café area, and outdoor garden spaces that are honestly as memorable as some of the exhibitions themselves.

The exhibitions vary dramatically in tone and accessibility, which is part of what makes the experience interesting. During my visit, the Palestinian installation by Jumana Emil Abboud explored folklore, water, and ritual through sound, language, and sculptural installations; Thai artist Araya Rasdjarmrearnsook presented darker works on mortality and grief that felt emotionally heavy and intentionally confrontational; while Syrian artist Bady Dalloul offered playful, intelligent works using maps, books, and invented histories that brought humour and imagination back into the space. Even if contemporary art is not always your thing, Jameel Arts Centre is worth visiting for the atmosphere alone: calm, reflective, beautifully designed, and noticeably less performative than many contemporary art institutions.

If you’re planning a visit or just curious to learn more, I’ve shared a detailed account of my experience here: https://splaces.home.blog/2026/05/17/jameel-arts-centre-dubai-the-uae-12-feb-2026/ || Jameel Arts Centre - One of the best place I have personally visited here in Al Jaddaf area of Dubai. Centre is an exceptional institution to serve all the visitors especially who are inclined towards Arts & Culture. There is a library which i have visited for almost a week and I could do my work peacefully without any disturbance within a cosy cubicle. There is High Speed Wifi facility free to use. The staff is extremely co-operative. One may spend some quality time in the evening to stroll around the water front with some cool breeze and some jazzy lights from the boats and Yachts cruising with some exciting music. One can easily walk here from Al Jaddaf Metro station. Its a 15-20 mins walk. An excellent place planned at the Al Jaddaf Water front. || I had a great experience at Jameel Art Centre. The security staff were very friendly and welcoming, even though I unfortunately didn’t catch his name.

Truly memorable. || The area around this art centre is really nice with a beautiful view. However, the actual exhibitions inside were a bit underwhelming. Name: Jumeirah Mosque
Description: A prominent mosque offering cultural visits and guided learning experiences.
Reviews:
A visit to the Jumeirah Grand Mosque in Dubai is an experience that seamlessly blends spiritual devotion with architectural magnificence. I recently had the opportunity to attend the Friday prayers (Jumu'ah) here, and the atmosphere was truly profound.

Stepping onto the grounds on a brilliantly sunny Dubai day, the first thing that strikes you is the mosque's "Open Doors. Open Minds." philosophy. As one of the few mosques in the UAE open to non-Muslim visitors (outside of prayer times), it serves as a vital bridge for cultural understanding. However, during the Friday prayer, the site transforms into a bustling hub of faith. The area was very crowded, with hundreds of worshippers spilling out from the ornate prayer hall onto the surrounding courtyards, yet there was a palpable sense of orderly peace and communal respect.

From a historical perspective, the Jumeirah Grand Mosque is a landmark of the Fatimid architectural style, which originated in medieval Egypt and Syria. Construction of this iconic structure began in 1976 and was completed in 1979. It was a gift from the late Sheikh Rashid bin Saeed Al Maktoum, the former Ruler of Dubai and father of the current Ruler. The mosque is crafted entirely from white stone, featuring twin minarets that frame a large central dome, intricate carvings, and beautiful landscape gardens.

Watching the sunlight hit the white stone facade against the deep blue sky was a highlight of my visit. Whether you are there for religious reasons or to appreciate the history and stonework, the Jumeirah Grand Mosque remains an essential pillar of Dubai’s cultural landscape. || A beautiful and peaceful place to visit in Dubai! Jumeirah Mosque is absolutely stunning and offers a wonderful opportunity to learn about the local culture and Islamic traditions. While we weren't able to participate in a tour (they were closed), the architecture is breathtaking. Whether you're interested in history, architecture, or cultural experiences, this is a must-visit while in Dubai. Highly recommended! 🕌✨ || Purely a tourist place. The animals — camels and the falcon — look unfortunate, and everything there feels staged. The people working with tourists aren’t locals; they’re just dressed like locals. It’s strange, because to truly introduce culture, you need real, traditional native people. I’m a little disappointed that this costs 45 AED, especially since I can experience much more authentic things in Saudi Arabia, Al Ain, and Abu Dhabi.
It’s a good initiative, but the quality of the experience and the program itself isn’t great.

It’s nice that they offer free appetizers, coffee, and tea, but to be honest, Arabic food is usually much tastier than what they served. They also provide free henna.

Conclusion: if you first time in Arabic World - yes, try. If you live here for many years - such a boring place. || Beautiful building, peaceful despite the numbers of other tourists present. Such incredible architecture, and beauty.
Seemed a bit odd to have a selfie area with someone selling a 360 degree video selfie of tourists. || Jumeirah Mosque is one of the most beautiful and welcoming landmarks in Dubai.

Open to non-Muslim visitors, it offers guided tours that are both informative and respectful, giving great insight into Islamic culture and traditions. The architecture is stunning, especially at sunset when the light gives the mosque a golden glow.
