The place is extremely well-organized and interactive. There are mini activities inside that make the visit even more fun — such as dancing on a music platform that lights up with your moves, and a small football area where you can show off your skills. These extra attractions keep both kids and adults engaged throughout the visit.

The lighting, displays, and background setups are also great, making every photo look amazing. It’s a perfect spot for families, friends, or anyone who enjoys entertainment, celebrities, and memorable experiences.

We had such a good time exploring and capturing moments that will stay with us forever. || Located on the vibrant Bluewaters Island, Madame Tussauds Dubai offers a surprisingly engaging experience that goes beyond just looking at wax statues. As a travel guide, I often recommend this spot for a break from the heat, and it rarely disappoints. The location itself is fantastic, situated right next to Ain Dubai, making it easy to combine with a stroll along the waterfront.
The museum is divided into seven themed zones, featuring over 60 figures. What makes this branch stand out is the excellent mix of global icons and regional Middle Eastern celebrities. You will see everyone from Queen Elizabeth II and Donald Trump to Nancy Ajram and Shah Rukh Khan. The Bollywood and Sports zones are particularly popular, with figures like Virat Kohli and Cristiano Ronaldo drawing huge crowds. The craftsmanship is impeccable; the skin textures and eyes are incredibly lifelike, which makes for some slightly eerie but amazing photos.
Unlike some older wax museums, the interactivity here is a major plus. There are no ropes holding you back, so you can put your arm around the Rock or sit down for tea with the Queen. The lighting is professionally designed to ensure your photos come out perfectly, which is a thoughtful touch for an attraction driven by social media. There are also fun interactive stations, like a penalty shoot-out game and a fashion runway where you can strut your stuff.
Plan to spend about an hour to 90 minutes here. I suggest visiting on a weekday morning to avoid the rush, as it can get quite packed with families and groups fighting for the best selfie angles. While the ticket price is on the higher side, the level of detail and the sheer fun of the interactive zones make it a worthwhile stop for families and pop-culture enthusiasts.

Name: Madinat Jumeirah
Description: A resort-style destination with waterways, dining, shops and views of Burj Al Arab.
Reviews:
While I haven’t stayed in the rooms yet, I have visited and dined here several times—most recently while volunteering for Art Dubai. Honestly, the experience is always lovely. The atmosphere is wonderful, the food is consistently great, and the overall hospitality makes it a standout venue. Highly recommend! || Madinat Jumeirah in Dubai is one of the most beautiful and relaxing places to visit. The whole area feels like a traditional Arabian city, with stunning architecture, peaceful canals, and a very clean environment. Walking through the Souk is a lovely experience, with many shops, restaurants, and great views.

The atmosphere is calm, especially in the evening when the lights reflect on the water. One of the best parts is the amazing view of the Burj Al Arab, which makes the place perfect for photos.

There are many restaurants with delicious food, and the service everywhere is excellent. It is a perfect place for families, couples, or anyone who wants to enjoy luxury and culture together.

Overall, Madinat Jumeirah is a must-visit destination in Dubai and definitely worth the time. || Amazing evening to celebrate my sons birthday the whole team were amazing and such a nice place for special occasions. Special mention to Yulia she was really lovely and attentive to our table . Perfect 10/10 service and the food was lovely || Madinat Jumeirah Conference & Events Centre offers a luxurious and versatile space for gatherings of all sizes. From intimate meetings to grand events, its stunning architecture and state-of-the-art facilities ensure a memorable experience. || a nice local styled market next to Burj Alarab. Warm environment of several locals while walking along the canal. Many restaurants and bars around with nice view terraces.  Good spot also for families to spend some quality time. Only dislike the parking area as extremely tight and small parking spaces! Always busy and expensive but some of the restaurants provide 3 hours of free parking.

Name: Mall of the Emirates
Description: A major shopping mall with dining, cinema and indoor attractions.
Reviews:
A truly world-class shopping destination with a beautiful and elegant atmosphere. From luxury brands to great dining options, everything is well organized and maintained. The architecture and interior design are impressive, creating a premium shopping experience. The mall is spacious, clean, and comfortable for visitors. Whether for shopping, dining, or simply spending time, Mall of the Emirates is definitely one of the best places to visit in Dubai. Highly recommended || Lovely Mall. You can get almost everything you would ever need here. Spotlessly clean and the Mall staff are so polite and helpful. It is fully air conditioned with a massive car park and wheelchair accessible facilities. || Mall of the Emirates is one of the best shopping destinations in Dubai. The mall is clean, well-organized, and has a great variety of international brands. I especially enjoyed the spacious layout and the overall atmosphere. There are plenty of dining options, from quick bites to fine dining. Ski Dubai is a unique attraction and definitely worth visiting. Parking is convenient, and everything is easy to find. Highly recommended for shopping, entertainment, and a great day out! || Mall of the Emirates is one of the best places for shopping in Dubai. You’ll find a great variety of brands and products all under one roof, with plenty of good offers available throughout the year. The mall is spacious, well-organized, and has something for everyone, from fashion to dining and entertainment. A great place to shop, spend time, and enjoy the overall experience. || Nice mall

Mall of the Emirates is one of those places in Dubai that never gets old. It’s not just a shopping mall—it feels like a city within a city. From high-end brands to everyday stores, cafés, cinemas, and family spaces, everything you need is under one roof.

What makes it truly special is Ski Dubai. Walking from warm desert air straight into a snow park still feels unreal every time. Whether you’re there to shop, meet friends, watch a movie, or just escape the heat, the mall always offers something to do. It’s lively without feeling chaotic, well-organized, and easy to navigate. Mall of the Emirates isn’t just a place to shop—it’s a place to spend time, unwind, and enjoy Dubai’s unique blend of comfort and spectacle.

Name: Museum of Illusions Dubai
Description: An interactive museum with optical illusions and perception-based exhibits.
Reviews:
I visited Museum Of Illusions Dubai and it was a very fun and unique experience.

The staff were helpful and explained how to take the best pictures in each spot, which made the visit even better.
The museum is not very big, but there are many interesting activities.

It’s a perfect place to visit with family or friends while exploring Al Seef.
I highly recommend it if you like fun photos and something different from usual museums. || We went there with our 7-year-old and he had an amazing time! Watching all the illusions was truly mind-blowing, fun, interactive, and full of surprises at every corner. It’s a must-visit place with kids, but even adults will enjoy the experience just as much. On top of that, there are plenty of Insta-worthy photo spots that make the visit even more memorable. The museum is not very big, but gives you a nice experience.
People with kids can visit for a fun outing. || It's a small place in the long alleys of the Al seef souk. However, contrary to it's size, it is enough to keep your kid busy for a good 1hr and more. A lot of learning for the young minds and some interesting articles on display. || I recently visited Museum of Illusions Dubai and it turned out to be a really fun and surprisingly engaging experience. It’s one of those attractions that mixes entertainment with mind tricks, optical illusions, and interactive rooms that constantly make you question what you’re seeing.

The museum is well designed, with each section offering something different—from perspective rooms and infinity illusions to holograms and gravity-defying setups. It’s very interactive, which makes it great for photos and videos. Honestly, half the fun is trying to figure out how each illusion works while also getting creative shots for social media.

What I liked most is that it’s suitable for all ages. Whether you go with friends, family, or even kids, everyone ends up getting involved and having fun. The staff are also helpful and usually happy to explain how some of the illusions work or help take pictures, which improves the overall experience.

The place is not very big, so you can comfortably go through everything without feeling rushed or exhausted. That said, because of its size, the visit is relatively short compared to other attractions in Dubai. It’s more of a one-time experience rather than a full-day activity.

Ticket prices are a bit on the higher side for the duration of the visit, but the uniqueness of the experience and the amount of fun you get out of it make it worthwhile, especially if you enjoy interactive attractions or photography.

Overall, Museum of Illusions Dubai is a light, fun, and creative experience that’s perfect for a casual outing. It’s not about thrill or scale—it’s about clever design and entertainment, and it definitely delivers on that. || If you have some free time and want to spend it in a fun and different way, the Museum of Illusions is a perfect place to visit. It’s a great spot to challenge your brain and enjoy fun activities. If you have kids with you, this place should definitely be on your itinerary — they will love it!

I had an amazing experience here and really enjoyed my time. The location is also very convenient.

📍 Nearest Metro Station: Sharaf DG (Exit No. 4)
🎟️ Tip: Try to visit during weekdays to avoid crowds and take more pictures peacefully!

Name: Museum of the Future
Description: An immersive museum exploring technology, science and possible futures.
Reviews:
Visited the Museum of the Future, and it truly lives up to its name. The architecture alone is breathtaking—easily one of Dubai’s most iconic landmarks. The futuristic design, immersive exhibits, and interactive experiences make it much more than a museum; it feels like stepping into the future.

The exhibits are beautifully curated, combining technology, innovation, and imagination in a way that appeals to all ages. The staff were professional and helpful, making the visit smooth and enjoyable.

The location on Sheikh Zayed Road is very convenient, with easy access by car and Metro, plus well-managed parking nearby. Overall, a must-visit attraction in Dubai for anyone interested in innovation, design, and the future. Highly recommended. || The museum is outstanding and has a great way to present all the information and artistry that is all around. We went during the week and pre-purchased tickets which save alot of time. Once we got our wristbands the wait in line started. It took about 45 mins to be able to "Start" the actual museum. If you take your time and experience the whole museum you can complete it in about 3 hours. Our whole family thoroughly enjoyed the experience and the cultural presentation as well. || I loved the space and overall atmosphere.
It felt very comfortable and enjoyable to walk through. Seeing ideas about the world 70 years into the future was fascinating. The flying taxi was especially exciting. There is also a kids’ play area, so children can enjoy it too, which was great. The gift shop was fun, with unique features like a robot that prints custom magnet letters. I really liked the souvenirs and would love to visit again. || A very interesting experience overall, especially as a family visit, because each of us connected with different parts of the museum in our own way. That was actually one of the strongest aspects of the visit: it offers a variety of themes and environments, so people with different interests can still each find something meaningful and engaging. Even though our reactions were not identical, everyone found sections they liked and remembered.

The entry line took quite a while, so that is something worth being prepared for. Parking, however, was relatively easy, which helped make the overall visit smoother. The parking fee was around AED 30, if I remember correctly. We visited all the levels, including the outdoor deck where you can see Sheikh Zayed Road, and that added a nice dimension to the experience.

What stayed with me most was the overall vision of the place. Beyond the architecture and presentation, it tries to imagine a future that is hopeful, creative, and human-centered. That optimistic perspective gave the visit a more emotional side as well. Overall, it was a worthwhile experience, with some waiting time at the entrance, but enough variety and imagination to make it memorable. I genuinely hope the future can move in the beautiful direction that this museum tries to portray. || This is breathtaking place you will feel like stepped into next 50
Years, journey through possible futures and bring hope and knowledge back to the present.

Inside there are kids activities as well.

Entry tickets needs to be booked in the advance, if you forget other travel agent provides it with higher costs.

Without ticket as also there are many photo stops.

Name: Palm Jumeirah
Description: A man-made island featuring hotels, beaches, restaurants and attractions.
Reviews:
Palm Jumeirah is located alongside the Persian Gulf (also referred to as the Arabian Gulf).
It stands as one of the most renowned artificial islands globally and is also recognized as one of the most ambitious engineering feats ever accomplished.
Palm Atlantis hotel is expensive but you can always have a look frm outside a beach view is awesome and the view is just amazing.
If you go there by car, you could not really see the shape of the palm. You can take a monotrain instead which goes a bit above the sea level.Anyone can enjoy the view through monorail...But I believe for the best view is necessary to be on the top of some of the skyscrapers.
We visited before the war
Must visit when You are in Dubai... || don’t miss the observation deck of the Palm tower when visiting Palm Jumeirah.
it offers best view of Palm Jumeirah as a whole and other buildings such as Burj Al Arab. || Palm Jumeirah is truly massive and fascinating. Even just driving through is impressive. It’s ideal for spending time as a family. The view is a 10/10, especially the Marina lights at night are wonderful. Traffic can be very heavy in the evening hours. it’s a must-see when you come to Dubai. || I recently visited Palm Jumeirah, and it was quite an experience. The man-made island is impressive, with its unique tree-like shape visible from above. Walking along the beach, I enjoyed the stunning views of the skyline, and the atmosphere was really relaxing.

The resorts there are luxurious, and it’s clear that a lot of thought went into the design and landscaping. Overall, it felt like a perfect getaway, blending relaxation and indulgence in a beautiful setting. I’d recommend it to anyone looking for a unique experience in Dubai. || Palm Jumeirah is second master plan after Dubai marina and most expensive and luxury community in neighborhood.It is first man made island in the world and it attracts tourists and investors every year.
Worth to visit to experience different cultures in one island!

Name: Quranic Park
Description: A landscaped park inspired by plants and stories mentioned in the Quran.
Reviews:
Such a peaceful place, while walking through the park they have the Quran playing and it’s so peaceful. The glasshouse was really nice and informative regarding some of the foods mentioned in the Holy Quran. The Cave of miracles was also very nice with stories playing on the projector, I wish they improved the animation of the videos. The park is so big you have to spend the whole day there. I think this was a unique experience and would 100% recommend it. It’s AED 5 each for both the Cave and the Glasshouse, otherwise the entry to the park is free. || We visited Quranic Park on Friday, and it was an amazing experience for the whole family. The park is very well maintained, neat, and clean, making it a pleasant place to spend a few hours relaxing and exploring.

The entrance fee for the Cave of Miracles is AED 5 per adult, and the Glass House also costs AED 5 per adult. Children under 2 years old can enter free of charge, which is great for families with young kids.

The Cave of Miracles was one of the highlights of our visit. It features projector presentations, images, audio narrations, and visual displays explaining various miracles mentioned in the Quran and the stories of the prophets. The cave is fully air-conditioned, making it comfortable even during hot weather, and the presentations are both educational and interesting.

The Glass House was equally impressive. It is very clean and houses a wide variety of beautiful plants from different environments. Walking through the greenhouse was enjoyable, and it provided a great opportunity to learn about different plant species.

One of the best things about Quranic Park is the number of scenic locations available for photography. There are countless spots with beautiful landscapes, unique architectural features, and well-designed gardens that make for excellent pictures and memorable family photos.

Overall, Quranic Park is a wonderful destination for families, nature lovers, and anyone interested in learning more about Quranic stories in a peaceful environment. It is affordable, educational, clean, and offers plenty of beautiful views. I would highly recommend visiting it if you are in Dubai. || Quranic Park is located in Al Khawaneej opposite to last exit. Very nice place to visit. very much quiet and calm place. Huge garden landscape, flowers, and greenery.
Quranic Park also has a jogging track and separate cycling track as well. Which is very good for the nearby people in community.
Inside Quranic Park, there is a cave which has having video streaming.
Also inside the chronic park, there is a glass house. This glass house contained multiple plants and trees. This glass house is fully air condition. There are few plans more than 700 years old.
Must visit please.
Only one problem inside Glass house cafeteria staff. The staff is rude and not friendly at all. || I visited Quranic Park yesterday evening. It is a very big park with plenty of free parking around the area. Cycling and jogging tracks are available. You can also create an account and join events at the park.

There is no entry fee to the park. Inside, there are eateries available. There are two major attractions:

1. Glass House – It has many medicinal and herbal plants, with information about the plants and their health benefits. Entry is AED 5 per person, and children below 2 years enter free.
2. Cave – It has shows in both English and Arabic about the prophets. The entry fee is also AED 5 per person.

The park is huge, with beautiful lawns and plenty of seating areas. There is also a water attraction. Overall, it is a good place for families to spend a peaceful evening. || Quranic Park is one of the most peaceful and unique parks in Dubai, offering a beautiful blend of nature and Islamic heritage. The park is spacious, clean, and thoughtfully designed, making it perfect for families, walks, and quiet reflection.
What makes it special is the educational aspect, with areas that highlight stories and elements mentioned in the Holy Quran. The greenery, walking paths, and well-maintained facilities create a calm and refreshing environment away from the city’s busy life.
It’s also very family-friendly, with plenty of open spaces for kids to play and relax. The atmosphere is serene, especially during the evening, making it a great place to unwind.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for a meaningful and relaxing outdoor experience in Dubai

Name: Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary
Description: A protected wetland known for flamingos and migratory birds.

Name: Real Madrid World
Description: A football-themed park with rides, attractions and club experiences.
Reviews:
Real Madrid World at Dubai Parks was such a fun experience! We had an amazing time, and the staff were very accommodating and friendly. My son truly enjoyed spending his Christmas Day here—it made the day extra special for our family. The facilities are posh and well-maintained, making it a perfect family getaway.
It’s more suited for kids, but there are also rides that adults can enjoy. There wasn’t much waiting time, and we were able to finish everything in about 3 and a half hours. Highly recommended for a family outing. We will definitely be back! || It would be a truly remarkable experience for any Real Madrid fan, allowing one to delve into the club's rich history, admire the impressive trophies, and capture some unforgettable photographs.
Hala Madrid y Nada Mas ❤️ || It was amazing experience and suitable for kids till 10 years old, it’s not that big you can finish it within 3 hours if there is no traffic there, for adults there are round 3 games they will like it.

It’s give an image about the history of real madrid team but its not contained all players that were in the team seems there are some copyright not sure.

You can use Faza it will be 170 aed normal tickets 220 aed on the site. || The official store was amazing. Two of the employees jerome and Ismail, were very nice, kind, and helpful, and made our visit memorable. The park was fun, and entertaining and rides were thrilling. The various experiences were very interesting to see. Overall 10/ 10 || We had an amazing experience today at Real Madrid World Park! A perfect family outing, especially with kids — they absolutely loved it! Walking through the changing room and feeling like you’re inside the stadium was a surreal and unforgettable moment for any football fan.

The rides were super fun and engaging for all ages, and there’s a great mix of excitement and interactivity. After the thrills, we wrapped up the day with some delicious dinner options — a wonderful variety and excellent quality to satisfy everyone in the family.

Highly recommended for football lovers and families looking for a fun, immersive day out!

Name: Riverland Dubai
Description: A themed dining and entertainment promenade at Dubai Parks and Resorts.
Reviews:
I had a wonderful experience at Riverland Dubai. The entire destination is thoughtfully designed, with multiple themed districts that make you feel like you’re traveling through different cultures and time periods. Every corner has its own charm, which makes simply walking around an enjoyable experience on its own.

The atmosphere strikes a perfect balance between lively and relaxing. During the evening, the place becomes even more beautiful, with lights reflecting off the canal and creating a calm, scenic environment. It’s an ideal spot for a peaceful stroll, catching up with friends, or spending quality time with family.

There is also a good variety of restaurants and cafés, offering options for different tastes and preferences. Whether you’re in the mood for a quick bite or a sit-down meal, you’ll find something that suits you. The presence of live entertainment and occasional performances adds a vibrant touch without overwhelming the space.

Overall, Riverland Dubai is more than just an entry point to nearby attractions—it stands as a destination in its own right. It combines great ambiance, thoughtful design, and a relaxed vibe, making it a place you’ll want to visit more than once || Beautiful and relaxing place to spend an evening!Better to reach 1 to 2hrs before sunset and leave by night.
Riverland Dubai is a great spot for a family walk or dinner by the water. The themed zones — especially the French Village — are perfect for photos and have a nice atmosphere. Entry cost AED 30, and there are plenty of restaurants and cafés to choose from. We reached by metro and bus.Reached ibn battuta metro and got 5.30 pm bus.DPTR1 is the bus code and its take 10 ro 15 min to reach.Overall it’s a lovely destination for a calm outing, especially in the cooler months.
Also parks are available || Nice location to escape from buy schedule. I paid 25 AED for entrance and purchased it via online. You can have a relaxing walks and can’t think you’re in UAE. There are other activities inside you need to pay separately. Something like Legoland, Real Madrid, Kart zone, etc… Tried out the pirate cafe and it was great. Enjoyed the live shows there. If you purchase the 30AED ticket for entrance, you will be able to redeem it for food. Try out this beautiful place❤️ || The Riverland Music and Food Festival started on 17 January and runs until 8 February 2026. The standard ticket costs AED 50 per person, which is fully redeemable on food. It’s a great place to spend time enjoying live music, food and the venue looks especially beautiful in the evening with its lights. The laser show begins at 7:30 pm but good for kids. || We went to Riverland.
We purchased the basic ticket there.
It was one day after the holidays.

The place was empty, there was no one around and everything was closed.
All the activities required additional payment, and we had to pay 300 dirhams separately for each one.
None of these were included in the basic ticket.

The basic ticket could not be used at the well-known restaurants, and it only covered regular food options.

Overall, it felt a bit eerie, and because there were no people, it was quiet and lacked any excitement.

There was also a music and food festival happening, which in my opinion was not successful in its own right.

Name: Ski Dubai
Description: An indoor snow park and ski slope inside Mall of the Emirates.
Reviews:
Really cool indoor ski and snow park for both kids and adults. I just passed by to explore the facility so I didn’t get to try skiing — you need to book an instructor and it depends on availability. The chairlift goes around the whole slope and park, which is a nice experience, and the temperature inside is perfectly chilly ❄️⛷️

Snowfall isn’t continuous and is only turned on at times to refill the area. Rental suits are warm enough and include gloves and boots, but I recommend bringing your own warm hat since it’s not provided. Staff were accommodating, and my package also came with hot chocolate — nice touch. ☕️❄️ || Wow, what a perfect experience! I came with a friend for a day of snowboarding. The entire staff was nice and welcoming. They welcomed us right away and helped us get our pre-ordered tickets and collect the equipment that was good enough for surfing. We only went in to surf, but there are many other attractions that are worth it for the family and children. I will definitely be back with the rest of the family. || Ski Dubai is a wonderful place to escape the hot weather. It's inside the Mall of the Emirates, and it’s amazing to see real snow in the middle of Dubai!

As soon as we entered, everything was neat and well-organized. Whether you're trying skiing for the first time or already know how to ski, there’s something fun for everyone. You can go skiing, snowboarding, ride the chair lift, try tobogganing, or play in the snow area made for kids. The Snow Park has lots of fun activities, and the penguin show was the best part; very cute and special!

They give you all the clothes and equipment you need, and everything was clean and ready to use. The staff was kind, friendly, and very helpful, especially with beginners. They explained safety rules clearly, so we felt safe the whole time.

Inside, it feels like a real ski resort with cold weather, snowy hills, and even a café where you can enjoy hot chocolate and watch people skiing.

Ski Dubai is a great place for families, tourists, and even people living in Dubai. It’s full of fun, excitement, and great memories. I highly recommend visiting! || Amazing winter vibes – just skip the extras if you’re not into rides

Went to Ski Dubai in Mall of the Emirates this Eid holidays and it was honestly such a cool break from Dubai heat. The moment you walk in, you’re in a proper winter wonderland – real snow, freezing air, and slopes you can actually ski down.

If you love snow play, building snowmen, and just hanging out in the snow park, you’ll have a blast. The staff are super helpful, gear is included, and the place is clean and well organized.

My tip: If you’re not into rides, just get the regular Snow Classic pass.
I made the mistake of looking at Snow Plus/Premium thinking “more is better.” But if you don’t care for tubing, zorb balls, bumper cars, or the Mountain Thriller, you’re paying extra for stuff you won’t use. Snow Classic gives you full access to the snow park, the play areas, and the vibe for way less. You can still take photos, and enjoy the snow.

The rides are fun if you’re with kids or adrenaline junkies, but for adults who just want a chill snowy escape, Classic is perfect. Saves you money and you won’t feel like you’re rushing between attractions.

Overall 9/10 experience. Go early on weekdays if you want it less crowded. And bring a few layers under the suit – it’s proper cold in there!

Would I go again? Absolutely. But next time it’s Snow Classic all the way. || BRING GLOVES!!
So cool to be able to go skiing in Dubai when it’s summer outside.
Pre book your visit to save time when you get there.
I don’t think I saw any information that they don’t provide gloves…!! It says they provide needed equipment but for some “strange” reason they don’t provide gloves. Extra socks are included but not gloves..
But.. they are happy to sell you a pair of gloves in their shop (guess if prices are high or low)
Perhaps a small thing but things like this makes me disappointed, better to rise the price a bit then having this kind of business idea, more honest in my opinion.
The snow was actually good, of course not very long but it was fun anyway.
The temperature between minus 2-5 degrees so the gloves are needed.
The sit-lift was quite slow and there were a lot of starts and stops.
They queue-system, or lack of a system was obvious. You sometimes need to be a bit “aggressive” because not all the guests know how a queue works.
Fun thing to do and not very expensive.

Name: Sky Views Observatory
Description: An observation attraction with glass walkways and an outdoor slide.
Reviews:
This is a wonderful experience to observe and appreciate the city on high view perspective. During our visit there was no rush and crowd that is why we really enjoyed all corners of the observatory. The staff are very assistive, alert and kind. They made sure that we are enjoying the experience and make out of it. It is very well recommended to get tickets in advance for easy and fast entry. || Sky Views Observatory in Dubai feels like one of those ideas that could only be imagined in a city that constantly challenges the limits of architecture and ambition. Standing high above Downtown Dubai, the entire experience feels less like a tourist attraction and more like a celebration of how far Dubai has come in such a short span of history. Looking out from the observatory during dusk, with the golden sunlight slowly fading into the city lights, is something that genuinely stays in memory for a long time. On one side stands the mighty Burj Khalifa dominating the skyline, while on the other side the endless Sheikh Zayed Road stretches through the city like a river of lights. Even the distant ocean view adds a calm contrast to the fast-moving energy of Dubai.

What makes this place special is not just the height, but the thought behind creating an observatory right in the heart of Downtown. It gives visitors a chance to pause and admire the scale of development around them. It almost tells the story of Dubai without words — a place that transformed from desert tracks and camel caravans into one of the world’s most futuristic cities. The vision and leadership behind this transformation deserve admiration because very few places on earth have evolved with such speed and confidence. From humble beginnings to luxury skylines and global landmarks, it truly feels like the “camel to Cadillac” story becoming reality in front of your eyes.

The attractions themselves add excitement beyond the views. The glass walk creates a thrilling feeling of floating above the city, while the slide brings a fun adrenaline rush that surprisingly becomes one of the highlights of the visit. The edge walk rope experience especially stands out for adventure lovers, giving a completely different perspective of Downtown Dubai from the outside of the tower itself. Together, these activities make Sky Views more than just another observatory. It becomes a mix of inspiration, engineering, adventure, and admiration for Dubai’s incredible journey. || Amazing experience! The Sky View observation deck was absolutely breathtaking. We had a perfect view of the city skyline and a spectacular view of the Burj Khalifa. The views were stunning both during the day and at night. The staff was friendly, the facilities were clean, and everything was well organized. This is definitely a must-visit attraction when in Dubai. Highly recommended! || Visiting Sky Views Observatory was an unforgettable experience filled with thrill and luxury. The observatory offers stunning panoramic views of Dubai’s skyline, especially of the iconic Burj Khalifa. One of the highlights was the glass slide—such a fun and unique experience! Sliding down through a transparent tube with views of the city below gives you an exciting adrenaline rush. Walking on the glass floor at the observatory also adds to the thrill, making it a must-visit for adventure lovers. To make the experience even more special, I opted for the Gold Menu add-on. The gold sparkling wine had a unique touch with fine 24-karat edible gold sparkles, giving it a luxurious feel. The gold cheesecake, topped with 24-karat edible gold, was not only beautifully presented but also delicious—definitely a treat worth trying for a premium experience. || We visited Sky Views Observatory in the evening, and it was an incredible experience! Walking on the glass floor and trying the glass slide gave an adrenaline rush, while the night views of Dubai’s skyline were simply breathtaking. The city lights stretching out in every direction made it feel surreal. The staff were helpful and made the experience smooth. A must-visit for anyone looking for thrilling views and unique perspectives of Dubai!

Name: Skydive Dubai
Description: A skydiving centre offering tandem jumps over Palm Jumeirah and the desert.
Reviews:
I had an amazing experience with Skydive Dubai, absolutely one of the best things I've ever done! I was nervous at first, but my tandem instructor Max was incredibly friendly and funny. He kept making jokes inside the plane that I almost forgot I was about to jump out of it. He was very reassuring the whole time, made me feel completely safe, and we landed perfectly.

Huge shoutout to Cody, the cameraman, who captured every moment so well, the angles were perfect for that picture-perfect memory!

Honestly, I didn't even want to go down and end the experience, that's how incredible it was.

Overall, the experience was unforgettable. The view from above was breathtaking and the whole team made it even more special. I highly recommend this to anyone visiting Dubai or looking for an adventure of a lifetime! || Had such an amazing skydiving experience and I already want to do it again! 🪂 Huge thank you to my awesome TI Sasha and my videographer Rodney for making everything so fun and comfortable the whole time. They were both so nice and really helped me feel at ease. I forgot to say thank you properly because I was so overwhelmed with pure adrenaline after the jump 😭 but truly, it was such an unforgettable experience. So good!!! ❤️ || Skydive Dubai is the perfect place to turn a lifelong dream into reality. If you’ve ever wondered what it truly feels like to fly, this is where you’ll experience it in the most breathtaking way. Jumping over the iconic Palm Jumeirah is nothing short of surreal — a mix of adrenaline, freedom, and pure awe that stays with you forever.
The team is incredibly professional, supportive, and makes you feel safe from the very first moment. Whether it’s your first jump or a long-awaited dream, they guide you through every step with confidence and positive energy.
If you want to feel alive, conquer your limits, and create a memory that will stay in your heart forever, Skydive Dubai is absolutely the place to do it. Highly recommended! Enjoy! || Today I did a tandem skydive with Ivan, and he was a true professional. I never felt unsafe or nervous for even a second. The jump, freefall, and landing were all amazing.
Before doing it, I thought it was expensive, but it was absolutely worth every penny. The staff, equipment, and facilities were all of the highest standard.
A once-in-a-lifetime experience that I highly recommend. Thank you to the entire team for making it unforgettable! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ || One of the best experiences you can have in your life.. definitely worth it in Dubai!! The facilities are really good! Big parking and nice cafe with a view of the divers! My partner didint join but had plenty of space to have a coffee while waiting for me! Last but not least, Sha was the man who I did the dive with! Really nice guy that made me feel comfortable before the drop while I was a bit anxious! They are really professionals and I can guarantee you will have a great time! Go for it!

Name: Spice Souk
Description: A traditional market selling spices, herbs, fragrances and local products.
Reviews:
Visited Dubai Spice Souk and it was a great experience. The place is full of vibrant colors, rich aromas, and a wide variety of spices, herbs, and traditional products. Walking through the narrow lanes feels very authentic and lively. Shopkeepers are friendly and open to bargaining, which makes it more interesting. Prices can vary, so it’s good to compare before buying. Overall, a must-visit spot for anyone who enjoys culture and unique shopping. || ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
The Dubai Gold Souk is a must-visit for anyone exploring Dubai. The variety of gold and jewelry on display is incredible, with designs ranging from traditional to modern.

The atmosphere is lively and authentic, and even if you’re not buying, it’s a great place to walk around and experience the culture. Prices can be negotiated, which makes the experience even more interesting.

Highly recommended for a unique shopping experience! || A not-so-hidden gem that offers a sensory dive into Middle Eastern market culture. The area is immediately striking for its aroma—spices are often displayed openly, filling the streets with a rich, fragrant atmosphere that makes simply walking around an experience in itself.

While it’s not a traditional “attraction,” it’s definitely a place worth visiting for its character and cultural texture. The appeal lies in observation rather than activity—taking in the colors, scents, and interactions that define the space.

Last visit: December 30, 2025

I visited with my mom, and we spent most of our time casually exploring rather than shopping. Stepping into a few shops, we were met with the usual lively sales talk—at one point even being offered saffron tea, which added a nice personal touch to the experience.

Overall, it’s a relaxed and engaging place—ideal for those who enjoy slower-paced, immersive wandering rather than structured sightseeing. || A lively and bustling market selling colourful array of herbs and spices!! We tried some samples and bought some goods! The Dubai chocolate was amazing! As was the hibiscus tea! || Went here with my family, the Dubai spice souk is really full of stalls selling so many herbs spices!! From cinnamon, to star anise, nutmeg, and ofcourse their most popular is saffron. There is also many tea leaves created from the herbs and spices, i managed to try their saffron tea, it had a spicy smell but the taste was not bad, almost like spiced milk tea.
There is also alot of small items that u can buy as souvenirs, the teacups and their lamps reminds me of the movie Aladdin, the genie in a bottle. I even rubbed the lamp to see if really got genie come out 😂
Anyways, it was really fun and interesting, almost like a night market but in daytime. They also sell their traditional clothes, and offer photo taking services, something similar to the Thailand traditional costume photo taking, they wil help u to dress up and do your make up, i think u can choose which location to take ur photo, most popular is to take Infront of Burj Khalifa, or take in the middle of their desert, or on a camel? Haha i don't know cus i didn't get the chance to take their traditional costume photo.
Would love to come back again to try tho!

Name: The Dubai Fountain
Description: A choreographed fountain show beside Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall.
Reviews:
Burj Khalifa is absolutely breathtaking. The view from At The Top observation deck is unreal city, desert, and sea stretching forever. Standing at 828m, you truly feel on top of the world. Staff are professional and the experience is seamless.

Right outside, the Dubai Fountain show is pure magic. Water, lights, and music sync perfectly with iconic songs. It’s free and mesmerizing every single time, day or night.

Clean, safe, and world-class throughout. If you visit Dubai, this combo is non-negotiable. 5 stars for an unforgettable experience! || The Dubai Fountain is one of those rare places that actually lives up to the hype. Set against the backdrop of the Burj Khalifa and right next to Dubai Mall, it delivers a performance that feels more like a carefully choreographed show than a simple water display.

The combination of powerful water jets, synchronized music, and precise lighting creates a spectacle that grabs your attention immediately. Each show feels different, with music ranging from classical to modern Arabic and international hits, which keeps it from becoming repetitive even if you watch it more than once.

What really stands out is the scale and timing. The water shoots impressively high, moving in perfect rhythm with the music, which shows a level of engineering and design that goes beyond aesthetics into pure experience. It is short, yes, but that works in its favor, it keeps the energy high and leaves you wanting more rather than bored.

If there is a downside, it is the crowd. Finding a good viewing spot can be frustrating, especially in peak hours. But even then, the atmosphere of people gathering, waiting, and reacting together adds something you do not get from quieter attractions.

Overall, the Dubai Fountain is not just a tourist stop, it is a well-executed public experience that blends art, technology, and location. It is absolutely worth seeing, especially at night when the full effect comes alive. || ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Dubai Fountain show is absolutely beautiful and one of the best attractions in Dubai. The water dance with music and lights looks amazing, especially at night with Burj Khalifa view in the background. Very nice atmosphere for families, tourists, and friends. The area is clean, well organized, and full of energy. A must-watch experience when visiting Dubai Mall and Downtown Dubai. Highly recommended || Don't skip the Dubai Fountain during the day! We caught the afternoon show outside the Dubai Mall and it honestly looks too good. The preparation is good and seeing the massive water jets dance perfectly to the music in broad daylight is a totally different, amazing vibe. Plus, it’s much easier to beat the crowds and get a great photo with the Burj Khalifa in the background. A must-see daytime spot!" || The Dubai Fountain is one of the most stunning attractions in Dubai, offering a breathtaking show that combines water, light, and music in perfect harmony. Located at the base of Burj Khalifa, it creates a magical atmosphere especially at night when the lights reflect beautifully on the lake. Watching the fountain show feels luxurious and unforgettable, as each performance delivers a unique experience that captures the beauty and spirit of Dubai. It is truly a must-visit landmark in Downtown Dubai.

Name: The Dubai Mall
Description: A major shopping and entertainment destination with attractions, dining and indoor experiences.

Name: The Green Planet
Description: An indoor tropical rainforest biodome with animals and educational exhibits.
Reviews:
Visited The Green Planet with my husband and daughters recently. Overall, it was a good experience, especially for children. The interactive bird encounters and the opportunity to see different species up close kept my kids engaged, and we spent nearly two hours exploring the attraction.

Before our visit, I faced significant issues booking tickets due to a website glitch. Unfortunately, I was unable to get assistance through customer care. I eventually managed to book the tickets myself. I had also sent an email regarding the issue, and a representative did call me later, which I appreciated, although it was after the booking had already been completed.

At the ticket counter, I encountered another issue. My daughters were initially denied the visitors' books, with staff saying they were out of stock, despite there appearing to be copies available behind the counter. After some insistence, another staff member stepped in and kindly provided two books for my children.

The attraction itself is well-maintained and enjoyable for families with young children. However, as an adult visitor, I felt it is more of a one-time experience. Adding more bird species and wildlife exhibits would make repeat visits more appealing and enhance the overall experience.

Overall, a pleasant family outing with some memorable interactions for the kids, but there is room for improvement in customer service, ticketing support, and the variety of species on display. || Green Planet Dubai is a hidden gem in the city. From the moment we walked in, it felt like stepping into a real rainforest right in the middle of Dubai. The greenery, the animals, and the overall setup were all so impressive and well cared for. It’s educational, relaxing, and such a lovely experience for both adults and children. The atmosphere was peaceful, the staff were friendly, and every corner felt worth exploring. It’s one of those places where you can slow down, enjoy the surroundings, and leave with a smile. A wonderful outing and definitely worth visiting if you’re in Dubai. || Visiting The Green Planet Dubai was an absolutely unforgettable experience. Words can hardly describe how unique and immersive this place is.

From the moment we entered, it felt like stepping into a completely different world. The indoor rainforest concept is beautifully designed, with a stunning vertical structure where you move through different levels surrounding a massive artificial tree. Walking up and then down through the layers of the ecosystem was both fascinating and fun.

The atmosphere is incredible—humid rainforest air, the sound of water and nature, and the feeling of being surrounded by real wildlife. We saw a wide variety of exotic birds and animals up close, many of which we had never seen before. Everything feels very well maintained and thoughtfully arranged.

The rain and forest ambience add to the magic, making it feel like a real tropical jungle inside the city. It was honestly a speechless experience at times.

This is a must-visit attraction in Dubai. I truly enjoyed every moment and would definitely go back again. || I visited The Green Planet and I really loved it. It is an amazing tourist attraction. The place is very beautiful and full of nature. The view inside is so nice and relaxing, it feels like you are in a real rainforest.

I learned many new things about animals and different kinds of birds. It gives you more knowledge and you can see the animals very close. The place is clean and nature-friendly.

I really enjoyed my time there because I love nature. I highly recommend this place, not only for kids but for adults also. It is a great experience for everyone. || Our school trip to The Green Planet was a truly wonderful experience for both the children and the adults. From the moment we entered, it felt like stepping into a lush rainforest right in the middle of the city. The environment was engaging, educational, and perfectly suited for young learners.
A special mention goes to our guide, Mr. Ashar, who was excellent with the children. He was patient, friendly, knowledgeable, and very helpful throughout the visit. The children felt comfortable asking questions, and he made the experience both fun and informative.
The food and drinks provided for the children were of good quality, and they really enjoyed their meals. We also appreciated the thoughtful gesture of offering fresh fruits for the kids, which was a nice and healthy addition.
I would highly recommend The Green Planet for school trips with children as well as adults. With proper advance planning, the visit can be managed smoothly even when multiple schools are present.
One area for improvement would be to bring back some of the interactive experiences from previous visits. Earlier, there was a wooden bridge walk and a rain simulation, which added excitement and realism to the rainforest experience. Introducing the rain effect more frequently, perhaps hourly, would greatly enhance the overall experience for visitors.
Overall, it was a memorable, educational, and enjoyable trip, and our students returned with big smiles and lots of learning. 🌿💚

Name: The Lost Chambers Aquarium
Description: A themed aquarium with marine habitats at Atlantis The Palm.
Reviews:
The Lost Chambers Aquarium was absolutely amazing! The aquarium is beautifully designed, with so many unique chambers to explore, each offering something different and fascinating. The entire place feels very spacious, making it comfortable to walk around and enjoy at your own pace.
I especially loved the variety of marine life and the immersive Atlantis-themed atmosphere. It's very family-friendly and perfect for visitors of all ages. Every section was well maintained, and there was always something new to discover around the corner.
Overall, it was a memorable experience and definitely worth spending time at. I would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Dubai! || Had a great time at Lost World Aquarium. The aquarium is has a good variety of fish and marine life to see. It was fun walking around and watching the different species up close. A nice place to visit with family or friends, and the atmosphere is very relaxing. Definitely worth a visit. I’d happily come back again. || I recently visited the newly reimagined Lost World Aquarium, and I was genuinely impressed by the transformation. It perfectly embodies the "small place, big experience" vibe. It isn’t a sprawling oceanarium that takes all day to walk through, but every meter of the 14 themed zones is packed with detail.
​The 2026 upgrades have added incredible projection mapping and over 1,900 LED panels that make the "ruins" feel alive. For photography enthusiasts, the lighting is a dream—especially in the new Medusa’s Cave. If you have a decent camera, the silhouettes you can capture against the massive Ambassador Lagoon are world-class.
​Overall, it’s a dense, high-quality attraction that prioritizes mood and storytelling over sheer size. Highly recommended for a tranquil but visually stunning escape on The Palm! || My recent visit to The Lost World Aquarium was mainly because I had free tickets. Overall, I would say it’s more of a one-time experience, especially if you’ve already visited some of the larger and more established aquariums in the UAE or abroad.

That said, the place does have its positives. The setup is neat and well-maintained, and it’s definitely a good spot for families with kids 👶🧒. Children will enjoy the colorful marine life, smaller exhibits, and the easy-to-navigate layout. It’s not too crowded compared to bigger attractions, which makes the visit more relaxed.

While it didn’t personally excite me much due to my previous experiences with bigger aquariums and theme parks, it can still be a pleasant and short outing if you’re nearby or visiting with family.

Overall, worth visiting once—especially for kids—but don’t expect a large-scale or highly immersive experience. || An immersive underwater adventure – absolutely magical!

I recently visited the newly reimagined Lost World Aquarium at Atlantis The Palm, and it was nothing short of spectacular! This is far more than just an aquarium—it's a full sensory journey into the legend of Atlantis.

The moment you step in, you're surrounded by the incredible theming of a sunken ancient city with dim blue lighting, tunnels, and ruins that make you feel like a true explorer . The star of the show is the massive Ambassador Lagoon, which is breathtaking. I highly recommend timing your visit to catch the "Return of the Trident" mermaid show—it's mesmerizing watching the performers glide through the water in the 11-million-liter tank .

The variety of marine life is impressive, with over 65,000 animals across 21 exhibits . I loved the interactive elements, including the touch tanks where you can gently interact with starfish. The new technology with projection mapping and synchronized sound really elevates the experience, making it feel like you've entered another world .

A few tips: arrive early (around 10 AM) to avoid the crowds and get clear photos . Also, flash photography is not allowed to protect the animals, so adjust your camera settings beforehand. It's also completely wheelchair accessible, which was great to see .

Whether you're a marine life enthusiast or just looking for a magical family activity, this place is a must-visit in Dubai!

Name: The View at The Palm
Description: An observation deck offering panoramic views of Palm Jumeirah and Dubai.
Reviews:
​⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely breathtaking – A worldwide famous experience!
​The View at The Palm is simply spectacular! You get a gigantic, dreamlike view over the entire Palm Jumeirah and the Dubai skyline.
The King of Love was highly delighted with this incredible experience. It is highly recommended to everyone visiting Dubai—truly a worldwide famous landmark. I will definitely be back! A must-visit! || Wow, pretty good value, for such a fun experience, and incredible views. Wasn't sure what to expect but was blown away by the views and surrealism of it all, loved the glow after sunset. Didn't really stay and read all the info on the way up as was too excited to see the views, but no doubt interesting. || We visited The View at The Palm and had an amazing experience. The panoramic view over Palm Jumeirah is truly impressive — you can clearly see the shape of the island, the coastline, and the Dubai skyline in the distance. It’s one of those places that really makes you appreciate how unique this part of Dubai is.

Everything was well organized from start to finish, and the whole visit felt smooth and enjoyable. The observation area is spacious, the views are breathtaking from every angle, and it’s perfect for photos. If you’re visiting Dubai, this is definitely worth adding to your list — we really enjoyed it and absolutely recommend it. || This observation deck is a must see, even though one has been to the observatory on top of the Khalifa — as the sea side view is different and more details can be seen here. The beautiful Palm Island can be seen in its entirety, and the Burj al Arab is particularly nice in the late afternoon. || We had fast track tickets that we couldn't honor at the scheduled time, and the staff was very nice and helped us twice with rescheduling. Upstairs, we discovered a wonderful view of this exceptional achievement of some visionary people.

A minus is represented by the observation devices that, no matter how hard I tried, I couldn't get them to focus on both eyes, otherwise I used them looking with only one eye. Also, these devices can only be moved up and down, not left and right.

PS. I highly recommend the ice cream from the restaurant.

Name: Topgolf Dubai
Description: A technology-enabled golf entertainment venue with games and dining.
Reviews:
I had an amazing time at Topgolf Dubai! The venue is fantastic — modern, lively, and perfectly organized. Whether you’re there for the golf, the food, or just the atmosphere, everything is top-notch. The bays are comfortable, the technology works flawlessly, and the whole place has a fun, energetic vibe that makes you want to stay for hours.

What really made the visit special was the outstanding service. A huge thank you to Shagun, who was incredibly friendly, professional, and attentive throughout our time there. She went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable, helped us with anything we needed, and did it all with a warm smile and great knowledge of the venue. Her positive attitude truly elevated the whole experience.

I would absolutely recommend this place to anyone visiting Dubai — whether with friends, family, or colleagues. We’ll definitely be coming back! || Amazing experience at Topgolf Dubai! The atmosphere was lively, staff were accommodating, and the setup was perfect for both beginners and experienced players. Food and drinks were great, and the night view made the experience even better. Special kudos to Danilo for assisting us throughout the visit and making the experience even more enjoyable with excellent customer service. Definitely a fun place to unwind with friends and family. Highly recommended! || Had a wonderful experience at Topgolf Dubai! The atmosphere was fantastic, the games were fun, and the food was great. A special thank you to Nataly, our attendant, and Manager Leny for her excellent service. She was friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout our visit. Her professionalism and positive attitude made our experience even more enjoyable. Highly recommended! || Topgolf Dubai is easily one of the coolest spots in the city. Whether you’re a pro golfer or have never picked up a club in your life, you’re going to have a blast. The climate controlled bays are super comfortable, and the view of the Dubai Marina skyline at night is absolutely breathtaking.

​The service was top-notch. Our bay host named Ravi was attentive and quick with the orders. Speaking of orders, the food is way better than your typical 'bar food' (highly recommend the injectable donut holes!). It’s the perfect place for a birthday, a work outing, or just a fun night out with friends. 10/10 experience. || It was my very first visit to Topgolf Dubai and also my first golf experience, and I truly enjoyed every moment. A special thanks to Supervisor Gladwin, who kindly showed me how to hold the golf club and hit the ball. He was incredibly encouraging and kept cheering me up even when I missed many times, which made the experience so much more fun.

We were also pleasantly surprised with an extra 30 minutes of free time, which was a lovely bonus. The food was delicious—especially the margarita pizza and nachos, which I highly recommend trying.

A big thank you as well to Julia, who took care of us. She was very friendly, always smiling, and provided amazing service throughout our visit.

Overall, the place was clean, lively, and full of activities. Gladwin, Julia, and the entire team made us feel genuinely welcome with their professionalism and positive energy. Kudos to everyone for making Topgolf such a top-notch place that you’ll always want to come back to.

I will definitely be visiting again soon! 🤩❤️

Name: XLine Dubai Marina
Description: An urban zipline crossing Dubai Marina.
Reviews:
Such a great experience! For those who live extreme experiences, it is not the most scary but definitely worth it. Super well organized, from the order process to the actual activity. The great plus is the go pro video each participant gets. Still waiting for it so hopefully it is in good quality. The office is in the parking lot of the marina mall which is a grès place to go to, before and after the zip line. || It was truly an extraordinary experience—very well designed and executed. While there are a few areas for improvement, it was nevertheless an unforgettable moment for adrenaline lovers.

The views are absolutely stunning, and the price-to-value ratio of the experience is very fair, especially considering all the logistics involved.

I truly believe it’s worth doing at least once in a lifetime. You’ll enjoy it immensely. || Not worth the price.

It was fun and views were great but it's too expensive.

The quality of the video footage that you get is top notch.
The normal video that you get with the package is good enough, I wouldn't recommend you to pay extra for the 360 degree view footage.

The staff were great and the safety measures were very good.

Worth a try if you are rich.

You have to go to the basement/parking lot at the mall, from there they will take you to another sky scrapper in a van. After the zipline experience, you will land at the first mall.

I have done the ziplines with beautiful nature views more faster, taller and longer than this one but they were not with the city / sky scrapper views and it had costed at less than  quarter of the amount that I paid here.. || An incredible experience from start to finish. The team was extremely professional, attentive to every detail, and made us feel completely safe throughout. The staff were helpful, friendly, and well-organized. Overall experience: 10/10. Highly recommended. || Had an amazing experience at XLine Dubai Marina! The staff were incredibly supportive and made me feel safe and confident. I did this to overcome my fear & it truly worked. Highly recommend everyone to try it at least once!

Name: Zabeel Park
Description: A large urban park containing Dubai Frame, gardens and recreation areas.
Reviews:
Zabeel Park is a beautiful and well-maintained green space in the heart of Dubai. Great for walking, family time, picnics, and relaxing away from the city rush. The park is clean, spacious, and well organized, with nice views of the Dubai Frame nearby. Perfect spot for a calm break or an evening stroll. Highly recommended. || Zabeel Park is truly one of the most beautiful and well-maintained parks in the world. Located in the heart of Dubai, this park offers an amazing combination of nature, technology, and modern attractions. It is a perfect place for families, tourists, and anyone who wants to relax and enjoy a peaceful environment away from the busy city life.

The park is very large and clean, with wide green lawns, beautiful trees, and colorful flowers everywhere. Walking through the park feels refreshing because the environment is calm and full of fresh air. There are many walking tracks, jogging paths, and cycling areas, which makes it a great place for people who enjoy outdoor activities and fitness.

One of the most famous attractions inside the park is the Dubai Frame, which gives visitors a stunning view of both old and new Dubai from the top. This unique landmark makes the park even more special and attracts visitors from all around the world. There are also boating areas, barbecue spots, children's play areas, and many picnic spaces where families can spend quality time together.

Zabeel Park is also known for its modern design and innovative features. It has themed areas, technology displays, and beautifully designed bridges and lakes. Everything is well organized and maintained, which shows the high standard of public places in Dubai.

The park is especially beautiful in the evening when the lights turn on and the weather becomes cooler. Many people come here to walk, relax on the grass, take photos, and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere.

Overall, Zabeel Park is not just a park, it is a wonderful experience. It perfectly represents the beauty, cleanliness, and modern lifestyle of Dubai. In my opinion, it is one of the best parks in the world and definitely a must-visit place for anyone traveling to Dubai. || Zabeel Park is a beautiful and well-maintained park, perfect for families, walks, and relaxing outdoors. The park is spacious, clean, and has plenty of green areas, playgrounds, and picnic spots. It's a great place to escape the city's hustle and enjoy some fresh air. The views of the Dubai skyline are also a nice bonus. Highly recommended for a peaceful day out. || One of the best spots in Dubai for a relaxing day out! The park is huge, well-maintained, and very clean. We went for a picnic and found plenty of green spaces and barbecue spots. It’s also great that it connects to the Dubai Frame if you want to do some sightseeing. The entry fee (AED 5 via Nol card) is a bargain for the quality of the park. Definitely recommend arriving early on weekends to get a good spot! || Zabeel Park is a wonderful place to relax and spend quality time with family and friends. The park is very clean, spacious, and beautifully maintained. There are plenty of green areas, walking paths, and spots to sit and enjoy the view. It’s perfect for picnics, exercise, or simply unwinding after a busy day. One of the best parks in Dubai for a peaceful outdoor experience. Highly recommended! 🌳☀️

Name: Hatta Dam
Description: A mountain reservoir popular for kayaking and scenic views.
Reviews:
Nice place. Peaceful.  Full of activities can be done there, most of them related to water.  You can also find some restaurant there if you are hungry. The place you have to pass through to take the free shuttle is really nice take time make a little tour. Also there you can find prayer room and washrooms. || I visited Hatta Dam with my family on New Year’s Day. No need of ticket to visit Dam. Only for Kayak we need ticket. Small food spots are there at the top of the Dam. Due to vehicle restrictions near the dam, visitors need to park their cars in Parking Slots 1, 2, 3, or 4 and then take the free shuttle bus service to reach the dam area. The system is well organized, though it was very crowded because of the holiday. Due to large volume of visitors, it took more than 30mins to reach Dam from parking.
Despite the crowd, the atmosphere was lively and enjoyable, and it felt like everyone was having a great time. My child especially loved the place. The area is very well maintained, particularly the kids’ play area, which was clean and safe.
The best time to visit is in the evening between 4:00 pm and 7:00 pm, when the weather is pleasant and the views are beautiful. Toilet facilities were available and generally good, but due to the large number of visitors, cleanliness could have been better.
Overall, Hatta Dam is a wonderful family-friendly destination with great views and good facilities. It’s worth visiting, especially if you plan your trip during the evening hours. || Hatta Dam is a beautiful place to escape the busy life of Dubai. You can visit with family, friends, your partner, or even alone like I did. It’s peaceful and welcoming for everyone.

I visited using public transport and a paper map, which made the journey even more adventurous.

The dam area is clean and calming. Although the temperature was above 43°C, the water felt pleasantly cool and refreshing. Several water activities are available at reasonable prices.

Swimming is strictly prohibited because the water is used for producing drinking water after treatment and processing.

I would highly recommend kayaking.

Connectivity is good. From Dubai, you can take Bus E16 from Union Bus Station or Bus H02 from Dubai Mall Bus Station to Hatta Bus Station. From there, Bus H04 frequently runs towards Hatta Dam. There is also a free shuttle service available if you want to avoid the 500-meter walk.

A food court is available with plenty of options to eat.

The staff are friendly, polite, and hardworking. Salute to them for serving visitors in such immense heat. || Hatta Dam is a truly beautiful destination and perfect for a day trip. The scenery is simply breathtaking. The contrast between the turquoise water of the dam and the rugged Hajar Mountains creates an impressive and almost dramatic landscape. It’s the kind of place where you naturally slow down and just take in the view.

The hiking trails in the area are very well designed and maintained. They are clearly marked, accessible, and offer routes for different fitness levels. Whether you prefer a relaxed walk or a more challenging hike, the infrastructure makes it easy to explore the surroundings safely and comfortably.

Another highlight is a visit to the nearby strawberry farm. It’s a charming stop that adds something special to the overall experience. Fresh products and the relaxed atmosphere make it well worth including in your trip.

Overall, Hatta Dam and its surroundings offer a well-rounded excursion: spectacular views, great outdoor activities, and small local attractions that complete the experience. Highly recommended for anyone looking to escape the city and enjoy nature. || Hatta Dam is a stunning place with breathtaking views of the mountains and clear blue water. It’s a perfect spot to relax, take photos, and enjoy nature. The area is well-organized, and the bus facilities make it easy and convenient to reach the dam. The peaceful atmosphere and scenic beauty make it a must-visit destination. Overall, a wonderful place for a refreshing day out.

Name: Hatta Heritage Village
Description: A restored mountain village presenting traditional Emirati life and architecture.
Reviews:
Visiting Hatta Heritage Village was a fascinating experience. Set against the beautiful backdrop of the Hajar Mountains, the village offers a wonderful glimpse into traditional Emirati life. The restored mud-brick houses, watchtowers, and mosque create an authentic historical atmosphere. Walking through the exhibits of old agricultural tools, furniture, and handicrafts makes it easy to imagine life before the 1960s. The fact that entry is often free adds to its appeal, making it a great cultural stop for anyone exploring the area. || Its a historical place. They are  maintained well
Plenty of parking available
One of the main place in hatta.
My suggestion is jun, july time very much heat. Outdoor activities is very difficult after 10am - 3pm. Because we can't handle the heat 🔥🔥. mostly thos who plan with child.After 4pm plan is better then you can visit all area and night view also u can cover
There is no entry fee.
A water canal is there, the entry is chargeable aed 49/adult.child AED 19/-. Fish 🐟 food available AED 3/-
No restaurant, But a small shops is there
Water, and mojito something available. But price is high
Dont miss anything. Because at the end a small farm. Actually nobody notice that easly. || We had a new experience staying in a hotel with a thatched roof; it was surprisingly cold inside. The air conditioning was comfortable, and the furniture had a classic style. However, a few small issues came up — we often bumped our heads on the low doorways since we weren’t used to their height. Despite these tiny challenges, it was a memorable stay that we enjoyed overall. || We booked (via Get Your Guide) for an hours kayaking in Hatta Heritage.  Early on a Sunday morning.
This setting is just beautiful!!!!!
From the car park you have either brave the steps to the top, or wait for a shuttle bus which runs every few minutes.
Options for kayaking are single/double ones, peddle bikes or donuts ring.  There are lockers for your belongings if you don't want to take them....if you don't take a camera/phone you'll miss some stunning photos opportunities.
Gentle relaxing water.  Stunning views!
RECOMMEND!!!! || Hatta Heritage Village is a well-restored cultural site located in the scenic Hajar Mountains, offering visitors a glimpse into the traditional lifestyle of the UAE before modern development. The village features traditional stone houses, watchtowers, a historic mosque, and displays of old tools, weapons, and household items that show how people lived many years ago. Walking through the village is peaceful and educational, making it a good place to learn about Emirati history and heritage.

The location is clean and well maintained, and visitors can explore the area easily using the walking paths inside the village. One of the convenient aspects of visiting this place is the availability of a free parking area close to the entrance, which makes it easy for tourists and families traveling by car. There are also public toilet facilities available near the entrance, which are generally clean and useful for visitors during their trip.

The surrounding mountain views make the atmosphere calm and beautiful, which is great for photos and short relaxing walks. Entry to the village is free, making it a budget-friendly attraction. However, there are limited activities and food options inside, and most visitors can explore the entire place within one to two hours. Overall, it is a nice short stop when visiting Hatta for culture, history, and scenic views.

Name: Hatta Hill Park
Description: A hilltop public park with viewpoints, walking areas and family facilities.
Reviews:
Hatta Hill Park is a nice and peaceful place for families and friends. Many visitors like the beautiful mountain views and fresh air. It is a great spot for taking photos, relaxing, and enjoying nature. The park has clean walking paths, a children’s play area, and BBQ spots for picnics. Entry is free, so it is a budget-friendly place for a weekend trip from Dubai. The view from the top of the hill is especially beautiful during sunset. Many people say it is clean and well maintained. || Hatta Hill Park is truly an excellent and beautifully designed park, easily one of the best in the region. The entire place is extremely neat and clean, but what makes it stand out is its unbeatable scenic location. Surrounded by majestic hills and mountains, the park offers a calm, serene atmosphere that refreshes the mind instantly.
One of the most unique things about Hatta Hill Park is that it is built on a mountain in a very creative way. As you walk upward to find your perfect picnic spot, you naturally get a light hiking experience, which adds a fun and adventurous touch. Carrying your picnic things up the hill makes the outing feel even more enjoyable and memorable.
The park is also very spacious, offering many quiet corners where families can sit comfortably with seclusion and privacy — something truly valuable. Whether you want to enjoy the views, relax in nature, or simply spend peaceful time with your loved ones, Hatta Hill Park is perfect.

Overall, it’s a 10/10 experience for its scenery, cleanliness, design, and atmosphere. A must-visit spot in Hatta! || I recently visited Hatta Hill Park in Dubai and had an absolutely wonderful experience! The park offers a great BBQ area that is well-maintained and spacious, perfect for a relaxing day out with family and friends. There is ample parking, making it very convenient to access the park without any hassle.
The washrooms are clean, and the overall hygiene of the park is impressive. I was pleasantly surprised by the level of care in the BBQ designated area, where the cleaning staff ensures everything is tidy and ready for visitors. Initially, I thought I would have to discard all the used charcoal myself, but the staff informed me that the cleaning team takes care of it—what a relief!
A special thanks to the security guard, who was incredibly helpful and made the visit even more enjoyable with his friendly and attentive service.
The best part is that it is completely free of charge, with no entry ticket required, making it even more accessible for families and friends to enjoy.
Overall, the service provided by Dubai Municipality at Hatta Hill Park is excellent, making it a perfect spot for a stress-free and enjoyable outing. Highly recommended! || Hatta Hill Park is a nice place to relax and enjoy nature. There’s a barbecue area, although it was closed when I visited. There’s also a swimming area, but it was under construction at the time. My driver mentioned that swimming is usually possible there.
The park has clean restrooms, and there’s a water station where you can refill bottles for free. The area is very well-maintained.
To enjoy the best view, you need to climb stairs for about 20 minutes. It’s definitely worth it, but I wouldn’t recommend going in the middle of summer—it gets too hot. The best time to visit is after 3–4 PM. || Apeaceful hillside park set in the Mountains. It’s a great place to chill, enjoy fresh air, and escape the city. The park has open green spaces, shaded picnic and BBQ areas, walking and jogging paths, kids’ play areas, and sports courts. At the top, there’s a viewpoint tower with beautiful panoramic mountain views. Ideal for families, friends, or anyone looking for a calm outdoor spot to relax and unwind, especially during cooler months.

Name: Hatta Mountain Bike Trail Centre
Description: A network of marked mountain biking trails for different skill levels.

Great place for doing mountain biking and for kids activities outdoors.  It is a must if you go to Hatta.  It has good coffee and snacks.  There other food options.  Kids loved the pool and water slides. || It's quite lovely:  a barren, crumbling rock setting of mountains with some lakes, nice views and a wadi bed.
