Please go and enjoy || This is an excellent place for an outing. Lots of outdoor activities such as mountain biking (lots of trails to choose from), water sports, archery,  axes,  much more. Beautiful camping site with BBQ grills, washrooms, etc.
What I liked was the cycle washing bay. After the mountain cycling,  wash the cycle and load to the car, how cool is it?
If you don't have a cycle,  no need to worry as they are renting the  mountain bikes, a range to choose from.
Good eating options like hotdogs,  shawarma,  sandwiches,  etc.
The cycle store sells cool stuffs,  safety gears, spare parts, emergency kits, etc.
Not only that, they have cool cabanas build from containers for a comfortable stay. || An excellent getaway to the wilderness from the concrete jungle!
This place is only open until April end and then closes for summer to reopen again in October.
Plenty of outdoor activities for kids and adults.
Food trucks available for snacking (they could add a few more as right now only three options)!!

A huge campfire area along with a kids play area.
And the stay options are amazing, you can choose from - lodges, caravans or trailers!
Each one is self contained with premium options for those who want the 5 star feel!

A must visit for all....

Name: Dubai Mall Waterfall
Description: A large indoor waterfall installation featuring diving sculptures.
Reviews:
The waterfall is a really nice and unexpected feature in the middle of such a busy shopping center. It’s tall, impressive, and beautifully designed, with the diving sculptures adding a unique artistic touch. It’s a great spot to stop, take a break, and snap a few photos while shopping. The sound of the water also gives a calm feeling, which is a nice contrast to the crowded mall around it. Even if you’re not shopping, it’s worth stopping by to check it out. || It is honestly quite a sight to see a massive waterfall right in the middle of a mall. The overall design and the silver diver decorations are always impressive and give it a premium feel. There is also a dedicated heart-shaped spot for couples to take photos, which is a nice touch.
​Pro-tip: Use a wide-angle lens if you want to capture the full scale of the falls.
​However, it’s not as great as it looks on social media because there isn’t a proper, dedicated area to stand and click a clean picture. Because of the layout and the crowds, it’s hard to get a shot without others in it, so you might struggle to find that "perfect" photo here. || Such a cool landmark inside the mall. The water sounds are so peaceful and the diving statues are very impressive. Great place for a family photo. We loved it || It looked good i mean it okay to take photos the only impressing thing is how they managed to make a waterfall inside the mall || Really cool sculpture in the mall

Name: Burj Park
Description: A landscaped park beside Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain.
Reviews:
Excellent place to wind down. During sundown this place becomes amazing with all the lights. Such a beautiful wall during day light.  Good places to eat in the area. The views of the area are great. || ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

An absolutely unforgettable experience. The fountain at Burj Khalifa is, without a doubt, one of the most impressive and elegant shows you can enjoy in Dubai. The combination of water, lights, and music creates a magical and very special atmosphere, and seeing it with Burj Khalifa in the background makes the moment even more breathtaking. The entire setting is beautiful, vibrant, and perfectly designed to make the visit feel unique. It is an attraction that conveys emotion, beauty, and grandeur in every performance. Without a doubt, it is a must-see for any visitor and one of the most memorable experiences in the city. || Seeing Burj Khalifa at night in the rain felt especially beautiful and unique. The combination of the tower, the fountains, and the rainy atmosphere made the whole area look more dramatic and memorable. It is already an iconic place, but in that weather and lighting, the experience felt even more special. A very beautiful spot for an evening walk and for enjoying one of the most striking city views in Dubai. || Burj Park is a beautiful, well-maintained space right near the Burj Khalifa. Perfect for a relaxing walk, picnics, or taking amazing photos of the skyline. The landscaping is lovely, and there’s plenty of space to enjoy outdoor activities. Name: Dubai Fountain Boardwalk

Name: Dubai Fountain Lake Ride
Description: A traditional boat ride on Burj Lake during fountain performances.
Reviews:
Last weekend, I finally witnessed the breathtaking Dubai Fountain, and it truly felt like experiencing one of the world’s greatest water shows in person. Located right beside the iconic Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, the entire atmosphere during the evening was absolutely magical and unforgettable.

As the lights around the lake started glowing and the crowd gathered with excitement, the fountain show began with powerful music echoing across the area. The way the water danced perfectly in sync with the music and lights was simply mesmerizing. Massive jets of water shooting high into the sky, graceful movements, and the stunning reflections from the Burj Khalifa created a view that looked straight out of a movie scene. Every performance felt unique and emotionally captivating.

What impressed me the most was the incredible coordination between music, water, and lighting effects. From soft romantic melodies to energetic Arabic music, every beat was matched perfectly by the movement of the fountains. The entire crowd was completely silent at moments, just enjoying the beauty of the performance. It is one of those rare experiences where videos and photos can never fully capture the real feeling of being there in person.

The surrounding ambiance was equally amazing. The cool evening breeze, the vibrant atmosphere around Downtown Dubai, luxury surroundings, and the glittering skyline made the entire experience feel premium and unforgettable. Walking around the lake after the show while watching the Burj Khalifa shining in the background was a beautiful moment itself.

The place was well maintained, organized, and tourist friendly despite the huge crowd during the weekend. There are plenty of perfect viewing spots around the lake, and every angle offers a spectacular view. Families, couples, tourists, and friends all seemed completely amazed by the performance.

Dubai Fountain is truly a masterpiece and one of the best attractions in Dubai that everyone must witness at least once in their lifetime. It perfectly showcases the luxury, creativity, and grandeur that Dubai is famous for. My weekend visit turned into a memorable experience that I will never forget, and I would highly recommend anyone visiting Dubai to watch this extraordinary fountain show during the evening hours. || Me and my partner were amazed how quickly we could purchase a ticket (for 15EUR per person) on the spot without any advance booking and only have to wait 10-15minutes until the next boat ride. You get a very nice long boat ride and have great views of the Burj Khalifa and fountain show. Highly recommended. || Absolutely magical!
The Dubai Fountain Lake Ride is an unforgettable experience. Gliding across the water right in front of the Burj Khalifa feels surreal — and the best part is that the boats always wait for the fountain show to begin, so you don’t miss a single second of the spectacle. The music, the lights, the reflections on the lake — everything is pure magic. Mega cool and totally worth it! || The musical fountain is pretty good! It reminds me of Las Vegas. This is actually even bigger than the one in Vegas! The scale is massive and the water jets definitely reach higher || A beautiful and clean Yatch by Exclusive yatch club of dubai. Spectacular view of Dubai night life as well as skylines. Just 2 hour Yatch ride which start from Dubai Marina having Dj songs, soft drinks as well as good barbecue food with fruits and sweets like small cup cakes. Lovely atmosphere and cool breeze

Tickets are a bit pricey, and the rink can get quite busy with public skaters and lessons, especially on weekends. They also offer souvenir photos, but these are charged separately and not included in the ticket. Overall, a well-maintained rink and convenient location, especially for visiting skaters.

Name: KidZania Dubai

Reviews:
A wonderful spot for kids to explore and learn with so many activities to enjoy! I highly recommend the premium ticket—it unlocks even more fun for the little ones compared to the economy option. Bring the kids along for a day they’ll truly enjoy 😍😘 || Kids just loves it. It would be recommended to get the premium tickets. We just got the economy so we can't do any food work. It will cost you 21aed for pizza. So it would seem the same with the premium ticket. If your kids like snacks. But anyway, we just did without. No water fountains here. We had to buy water bottles for 3 to 6 aed. || Great experience at Kidzania with my 4y old.

Depends on ticket type some activities as extra charge.
Overall great experience and different type of learning for children trough games while having fun. || Amazing experience! Took my nearly 5 year old when we were in Dubai, he loved every minute of it. There own world where they get to be the grown ups, work/play/spend.
Worth every penny, we also got a discount because we flew with emirates which was a bonus. If kids want to do every part it can take up to 3-4hours. Each job is about 15-20mins || We visited KidZania Dubai with our 3-year-old and had a really positive experience.

Our little one was actually able to do a fair number of activities. Staff were helpful in guiding her towards suitable jobs, and many of the experiences were adapted well enough for her to take part and enjoy them. She loved the independence of choosing what to do and collecting her KidZos.

We went during the daytime, and as there were surrounding regional tensions, the mall was noticeably quieter than usual. That meant we didn’t have long waiting times at all, which made a big difference to our experience. I can imagine on a busier day — especially weekends or holidays — the queues could be quite long.

What we liked:
-Very immersive setup — it genuinely feels like a mini city
-Clean, well organised and secure
-Friendly, patient staff
-Plenty of variety

Things to consider:
-Many activities do have minimum age/height requirements
-On busy days, waiting times could be significant
-Younger children may need a bit more parental guidance to understand the concept of earning and spending

Overall, we had a great day and would definitely return. While I still think 4–7 years old might be the sweet spot to get the absolute most out of it, a confident and engaged 3-year-old can still have plenty of fun — especially if you visit at a quieter time.

Staff who went the extra mile: William, Margaret, Lanze?(shopping) and staff in music room.

Conveniently located inside Dubai Mall, it’s easy to combine with other activities, which makes it a good half-day plan.

Name: Play DXB

Reviews:
Kids had a lot of fun with the rides and games. It was surprisingly quiet on a Friday morning! All the staff was super friendly and patient with us (we are not easy making decisions) .. especially Charles helped us and explained the rides and most the games to us! We were especially impressed by Lina—she was incredibly attentive and kind, ensuring the kids felt safe and supported while they played. The concept is very convenient since you only need to recharge the card to access the different games and experiences, which makes everything quick and easy.

It is perfect either for a short break between shopping and other activities in Dubai Mall, or even to spend an entire afternoon there. The variety of VR games, attractions, and immersive experiences makes it enjoyable for both kids and adults.

A great entertainment spot in Dubai for anyone looking for fun indoor activities, especially during hot weather. || We had a fantastic experience at PlayDXB thanks to Catherine,Omaima,Manilyn,Noushida! They were incredibly helpful, friendly, and attentive throughout our visit. Their support made everything smooth and enjoyable, especially while getting us set up to play. It’s always great to be assisted by such welcoming and professional staff. Highly recommend PlayDXB, and a big thank you to Catherine,Omaima,Manilyn,Noushida  for making our day even more fun!

Name: Dubai Dino
Description: A large dinosaur fossil display inside The Dubai Mall.
Reviews:
An incredible sight right in the middle of The Dubai Mall! The dinosaur skeleton is massive and beautifully displayed — hard to believe it’s millions of years old. A great spot for photos and to learn a bit of history while shopping. Definitely worth stopping by! || Impressive original skeleton of 155M of a dinasour from 155 milillon years ago || The Dubai Dino at Dubai Mall is a truly fascinating attraction 😍📍. It features a complete Diplodocus dinosaur fossil 🦴, most of which dates back around 155 million years to the Jurassic period 🌍⏳. Information boards provide details about the Jurassic era, dinosaur life, their diet, and behavior 📚💡. It’s a fantastic spot for photography 📸🌟 and combines history, education, and fun for all ages 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦💛.

It’s incredible to see a real fossil of a dinosaur displayed right in the middle of the mall — a unique experience for both kids and adults. The display is well-presented with interesting information about the dinosaur’s history and discovery. It’s a great photo spot and a fun educational stop while shopping. Definitely worth checking out when you visit Dubai Mall! || Dubai Dino, located in the heart of The Dubai Mall, is an impressive 155-million-year-old dinosaur skeleton standing tall amidst the bustling shopping scene. Its sheer size and detailed preservation make it a fascinating sight, blending history with modern retail in a unique way.

Name: Souk Al Bahar
Description: A traditional-style shopping and dining destination overlooking Burj Lake.
Reviews:
Souk Al Bahar is a beautiful spot located right next to Dubai Mall, making it very easy to visit while exploring Downtown Dubai.

There are many restaurants and cafés to choose from, offering a wide range of cuisines. It’s a great place whether you’re looking for a relaxed meal, coffee, or a nice dinner with a view. Speaking of views, the area offers really nice scenery, especially around the waterfront, which makes walking around very enjoyable.

The design is attractive and well thought out, blending a modern feel with traditional Arabian-style architecture. It feels elegant but not too formal, and the layout makes it easy to stroll, take photos, and enjoy the surroundings without feeling rushed.

This place is very good for tourists, as it’s close to major attractions and offers great views, dining, and atmosphere all in one area. At the same time, it’s also a nice spot for expats, whether meeting friends, bringing visitors, or just enjoying a calm walk away from the busy mall.

Overall, Souk Al Bahar is a great balance of location, design, food, and atmosphere. Highly recommended if you’re visiting Downtown Dubai. || Souk Al Bahar is a beautiful and elegant place.
The traditional Arabian style building has a very nice atmosphere.

There are many restaurants and cafes with a great view of the fountain and Burj Khalifa.
It’s a perfect place for dinner and a relaxing evening.

The inside is clean and well designed, and it’s not as crowded as Dubai Mall.
You can enjoy shopping and walking comfortably.

I’ll visit again. || Emaar Souq is a stunning spot right near Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain. The architecture mixes Arabic heritage with modern elegance think cozy stone lanes, courtyards, and fountains. Shopping here is a treat: unique boutiques, designer stores, and artisanal crafts you won’t find in regular malls.

Ambiance is calm yet vibrant, making it great for both shopping and evening strolls.

Clean, well-maintained, and beautifully lit at night. If you want authentic Dubai vibes with luxury, Emaar Souq deserves all 5 stars. A hidden gem! || Set right beside the iconic Burj Khalifa, Souk Al Bahar offers a truly mesmerizing experience that beautifully blends traditional Arabian charm with modern elegance. From the moment you step in, the architecture transports you into a world of intricate design, warm lighting, and cultural richness.

What makes this place truly special is its stunning location. With direct views of the Dubai Fountain and the towering Burj Khalifa, every corner feels like a postcard. Whether you visit during the day or at night, the atmosphere remains vibrant yet soothing. The evenings, however, are particularly magical when the fountain show lights up the surroundings, creating a breathtaking visual spectacle.

The souk is home to a variety of restaurants and cafés offering cuisines from around the world. Dining here is more than just a meal—it’s an experience. Sitting outdoors, enjoying delicious food while watching the fountain dance, is something that stays with you long after you leave.

Souk Al Bahar is not just a shopping or dining destination; it’s a place where culture, views, and ambiance come together perfectly. A must-visit spot in Dubai for anyone looking to unwind and soak in the beauty of the city. || Souk Al Bahar felt like a welcome pause after the constant movement of Dubai Mall.

Even though it’s directly connected, the atmosphere shifts immediately to something calmer and more refined, helped by the Arabian-inspired architecture and softer lighting, which really stands out in the evening.

Crossing the bridge is quick and scenic, opening up views over the lake with the fountain and Burj Khalifa right in front of you. During the fountain shows, the area fills with tourists, but it still feels less chaotic than the mall itself.

The restaurant scene is one of the main reasons to stop here. There’s a good mix of international and Middle Eastern options, many with outdoor terraces facing the water. Sitting down for dinner or even just a drink while watching the fountain performances adds a lot to the experience.

The menus are varied, the settings are comfortable, and while prices lean toward the higher end, the views and atmosphere help justify it. It’s more about enjoying the moment than rushing through a meal.

The shops mainly offer souvenirs, perfumes and carpets, well curated but clearly aimed at visitors, with prices to match.

kindly confirm so that i can look for some other brand. || The branch of Christie’s in Dubai, just dealing with Watches and Paintings

Name: Jumeirah Archaeological Site
Description: An archaeological area containing remains from the early Islamic period.
Reviews:
Interesting contrast between this site whose remains date from the Abassid Caliphate over 1000 years ago and the ultra modern city that surrounds it. Entry is free and I would recommend visiting the Visitors Centre first to get a handle on some of the archeological discoveries made on the site. The site visit doesn't take a huge amount of time and is a relatively easy walk
At the end of your visit a refreshment stop may be in order on the pleasantly appointed restaurant/Cafe beside the entrance || Good museum which tells history of Abbasid era, between the 9th and 11th. Excavation begin in 1969 here. You can walk around the site outside the museum. Good Arabian tea house cafe is there. || I visited this place on 23rd March 2024 during the Ramadan time. The office and the Museum inside was closed. But I could freely visit the large compound and the actual architectural ruined.

This place had flourishing Arab Islamic civilization during 10th-11th century AD and remained in use during 17th-18th century AD. The site has eight ruins, five domestic houses, a caravansary, a mosque and a marketplace. All ruined were nicely labeled, you don’t need a guide.

Best part is you will be amazed by this huge empty land reserved the background of tall Dubai building landscape including Burj Khalifa which you can see clearly. || Beautiful, historical part of this futuristic City. The beauty its where the history meet the future. Something to enjoy, relax and...there is one of my favourite place to dine - is the traditional Emirati dine "Arabian Tea House". Close to Jummiera beach, can walk, cycle too. || This museum, not long opened, is really well done. Not at all ostentatious, the building is moderate and the curation considerate, focusing on a small number of artefacts unearthed from the digs, some of which are very beautiful and intricate, but all of which tell a little bit of the story about the people who lived here up to a thousand years ago. Not busy on weekdays in the middle of August, I was fortunate to be given a personal tour by Fahid, a warm and generous host whose passion for this project, and for Dubai's history and ancestry more generally, was so uplifting.

Name: Mercato Shopping Mall
Description: An Italian-themed shopping and family entertainment mall.
Reviews:
Had a great visit to Mercato Shopping Mall. The place has a beautiful Italian-style design that makes shopping feel unique and relaxing. It’s not too crowded, which makes it easy to walk around and enjoy the stores and cafes. Overall, a nice and calm shopping spot with a pleasant atmosphere. || This place is stunning. The whole “outdoor Italian street” concept with the sky roof. Great for photos too.  Great for families and couples. I Stumbled into Mercato Mall Dubai and I’m obsessed 😍 Feels like you’re shopping in Italy, not Jumeirah. Smaller than the big malls but way more chill. Good shops, tasty food, and that painted sky ceiling is unreal. Plus free parking = win. || I’d describe this place with one label: classic quiet mall. It has a more authentic and less crowded feel than many larger malls, and the overall product mix is good, especially if you are looking for mid-range to upper-mid-range brands. The main central area feels bright and pleasant, and the café in the middle is actually a good spot to sit, work, or take a break. The restrooms were also clean, which always makes the visit more comfortable.

The biggest issue by far is the parking entrance, and this is something first-time visitors should be aware of. It can be genuinely frustrating to find, especially because the surrounding roads are one-way and the access logic is not intuitive. I spent around half an hour just trying to locate the entrance, and I can easily imagine many first-time visitors getting confused for the same reason. In some cases, you may need to continue along Al Wasl Road, reach a U-turn, and then come back again just to enter properly.

Another mixed point is the interior mood. The main space feels open and welcoming, but some of the side corridors are darker and a bit dull. Overall, it is a good mall with a calmer character, but the parking access needs major improvement. || Mercato Shopping Mall offers a truly unique and pleasant shopping experience. The beautiful European-style architecture, spacious walkways, and elegant indoor design make it stand out from other malls. The mall is clean, well maintained, and very comfortable to walk around. There is a good mix of international brands, cafes, and restaurants, making it ideal for shopping, dining, and relaxing. The overall atmosphere is calm and premium, perfect for families and visitors looking for a refined mall experience. Highly recommended for anyone who enjoys a stylish and peaceful shopping environment || I absolutely love the unique Italian Renaissance theme here. It’s a refreshing change from the typical mega-malls. Very relaxing atmosphere, great for a casual stroll, and has a fantastic selection of cafes and shops. Highly recommend for a more charming shopping experience!

Name: Jumeirah Fishing Harbour
Description: A waterfront harbour with restaurants, boats and coastal views.
Reviews:
We went on a Jetski ride with Rashid. Great tour with pictures and videos. He sent us them for no extra charges. || Very nice and friendly place to spend time with your love one || Had an incredible jet ski tour in Dubai, and it was made even better thanks to our amazing guide, Sampath. From the moment we arrived, he was professional, friendly, and clearly passionate about what he does. He made sure everyone felt safe and confident on the jet skis, regardless of experience level, and guided us through some breathtaking spots along the Dubai coastline.

Sampath’s energy and enthusiasm were contagious—he even helped us take some great photos and videos to capture the experience. It felt less like a tour and more like an adventure with a friend who genuinely wanted us to have the best time possible.

If you’re booking a jet ski tour in Dubai, ask for Sampath—you won’t regret it! || Excellent site for swimming,  fishing or rentimg moto marine of all kinds || Nice place, good food, fun water activities

Name: Jumeirah Public Beach
Description: A public beach with views of Burj Al Arab and the coastline.
Reviews:
I recently visited Jumeirah Public Beach 02 - Walking Board, also known as the “Night Beach,” and it turned out to be a truly peaceful and relaxing spot.

What I loved most about this beach is how calm and quiet it is, especially compared to other busy beaches in Dubai. It’s perfect if you’re looking to unwind, enjoy the sound of the waves, or just have some personal time by the sea.

One of the standout features is the wheelchair access all the way to the beach, which is something you don’t commonly see. It makes the place inclusive and convenient for everyone.

Another big plus is the presence of lifeguards 24/7, which makes it feel very safe. Whether you’re going for a swim during the day or even at night, you can enjoy a sea bath without any worries.

Overall, this is a clean, safe, and well-maintained beach that’s ideal for a quiet and stress-free experience. Highly recommended if you prefer a less crowded and more peaceful beach in Dubai. || A Moonlight Paradise: Jumeirah Public Beach
If you’re looking for the ultimate Dubai beach experience, Jumeirah Public Beach (especially the Night Swimming area) is a total game-changer. I recently visited after sunset, and it’s easily one of the coolest things to do in the city.
Why I Love It:
24/7 Night Swimming: It’s rare to find a beach where you can safely swim at night. The Dubai Municipality has installed these massive, futuristic light towers that illuminate the water perfectly. It feels safe, magical, and is the perfect way to beat the heat.
Stunning Views: You get a front-row seat to the iconic Dubai skyline. Seeing the Burj Khalifa lit up while you're standing on the sand is a vibe you won't get anywhere else.
Top-Notch Facilities: The area is incredibly clean and well-maintained. There are wooden walkways, plenty of sun loungers, and clear signage.
Safety First: I was impressed to see dedicated lifeguard stations and clearly marked swimming zones with lit-up buoys. It makes a nighttime dip feel very secure.
Pro-Tip:
Bring your camera! The reflection of the city lights on the water makes for some of the best photos you’ll take in Dubai. Whether you’re here for a workout, a family hang-out, or just a quiet stroll along the shore, this beach is a 10/10. || Great location, clean area, can swim 24/7. Good infrastructure. I just wish not to hear the noise and smell the gas from the water scooters || Be it early morning,or lazy afternoon or relaxing evening.. this place is for joggers, walkers, kids ( a small play area available) or just for chit- chatting, this place can fulfill all those moods. KAYAKs also available. With restroom, a grocery packed with quick snacks, and a grab shop is available. For photography too, its a cool location. You can walk n the opposite side Bridge. Just live every moment ❤️❤️ || Jumeirah Beach is absolutely a must-visit for anyone coming to Dubai. The soft, clean white sand and the stunning backdrop of the Burj Al Arab make this beach utterly iconic and perfect for photos.
​We spent a wonderfully relaxing day here. The water was crystal clear and warm, and the overall atmosphere was incredibly peaceful yet chic. There are great facilities, and it never felt overly crowded. If you’re looking for a spot to simply unwind, swim, and soak up that luxurious Dubai sun with a world-class view, look no further.

Name: Sunset Beach
Description: A public beach known for sunset views and photography of Burj Al Arab.
Reviews: Sunset Beach is a beautiful and relaxing spot with stunning views of the sea and the skyline. Perfect for watching the sunset, taking photos, or enjoying a peaceful walk along the shore. Highly recommended for a calm escape. || Umm Suqeim Beach is an amazing spot and one of my favorite places in Dubai. The beach is clean, calm, and perfect for relaxing or taking a swim. The water is clear, the sand is soft, and the view of the Burj Al Arab makes every visit feel special. Sunset here is absolutely beautiful, with peaceful vibes and a great atmosphere. It’s well maintained, easy to access, and perfect for families, couples, or solo visitors. Truly one of the best beaches in the city! || It's one beach is so beautiful in this jumerah ,you can see the nice view of sea,and you can swimming .and you can see the nice view of sunset || A great beach near the Burj Al Arab. Fantastic views of waters of the Arabian Gulf and aesthetic sunsets. || Beautiful beach and not even crowded! Loved watching the sunset

Name: Nessnass Beach
Description: A public beach popular for kitesurfing, paddling and water sports.
Reviews:
Loved the e&beach canteen! So many great food options with live entertainment and beach vibes! Greatest combo while the weather is still amazing! || My favorite beach when am with my family, they kids always enjoy  their time. There's the beach library a nice place to sit read and relax. || I organised a lesson for me and my son with Kite n Surf. It was at the Last minute, but they were able to accommodate us. Thank you.
We had 1 on 1 instruction which was perfect.
My instructor, Ajlan was a great guy, he has lots of patience. His feedback and clear communication (very good English) improved my technique to a much better level than before. || I started my kite surfing course at Kite N Surf and I couldn’t ask for a better Instructor than ‘Amjath’. He is so cool, patient and thorough with his knowledge which helped me progress fast in each session. My experience has been great so far and I plan to continue until I’m ready to go with the wind on my own :-) || It’s an amazing public beach surrounded by lots of Food & Beverage Cars.
Bring a towel, Sand Mattress your sunblock and enjoy the amazing atmosphere from 17:00 to 19:00

Name: Umm Suqeim Park
Description: A landscaped park beside Sunset Beach with family facilities.
Reviews:
Umm Suqeim Park is an absolute gem in Dubai! 🌳 Located just steps from Kite Beach, it offers the perfect mix of lush green spaces and stunning, unobstructed views of the Burj Al Arab. It’s incredibly clean, well-maintained, and peaceful—ideal for a morning jog, a family picnic, or just unwinding with a book.
The dedicated kids' play areas are fantastic, and there’s a lovely little café to grab a coffee. Safe, serene, and scenic, it’s a must-visit coastal oasis for residents and tourists alike! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ || Very nice not crowded clean park
Located just next to the beach
Nice playing area || This park offers a truly exceptional experience with its stunning beachside location. You can enjoy breathtaking ocean views as the sun begins to set. The atmosphere here in the evening is wonderfully relaxed and inviting. It's the perfect place to unwind and soak in the natural beauty. Visitors often find the ambiance here to be incredibly pleasant. || Very good sea facing park with cool breeze during October till march from the beach with lots of swing and slides for kids to play. Good place to plan for a gathering as there are many quiet corners away from all the noise. There is a very good seafood restaurant and their fresh fish grill and fish fries are excellent. After spending quality time at the beach many visitors visit this restaurant and park. Its neat and clean with washrooms available. CAR PARK is not easily available as the beach crowd and park visitors have limited parking facility and during holidays it’s quite congested especially during public and national holidays . Yesterday as we were returning from the park had the opportunity to watch the national day airshow around 4 to 5pm . It was amazing and a beautiful experience which was quite unexpected. || Perfect free-entry family spot in Dubai, especially for kids under 6. You can enjoy the beach and sunset first, then walk into the park for kids to play while adults enjoy a walk, jogging, or just relaxing in the nice weather. Clean, peaceful, family-friendly, and great views of Burj Al Arab. A lovely evening outing for families.

Name: Wild Wadi Waterpark
Description: A waterpark near Burj Al Arab featuring slides, pools and family rides.
Reviews:
We visited Wild Wadi with our family.
We enjoyed the whole day there.
Our child is 120cm tall, and we could ride most attractions together.
There were many fun rides for both kids and adults.
The sunset was very beautiful and made the day even more special.
It was an amazing and fun family experience!
We will come back soon.Thank you! || This was an amazing experience. It has very thrilling water fun games for all, children and adults. The location of the water park is very strategic... it is next to Burj Al Arab, a seven Star hotel in Jumeirah.

You will never get sliding water tunnels like those in Wild Wadi. We had an exciting day full of fun. The views from the top of the Wild Wadi are amazing. || We thoroughly enjoyed every moment there. The staff were incredibly kind and caring and it’s a place where the whole family can relax and enjoy themselves.  We arrived early at 10am and were the first guests so we got to try everything more than once. I’ve been there several times and each visit has been a pleasure. || Wild Wadi Water Park is a fun and exciting place to visit in Dubai. I went to this place with my two kids, and they had a really nice time. There are many rides suitable for kids as well as adults, and we enjoyed some adventure rides too. The park is clean and well maintained, and the staff are friendly and helpful. The view of the Burj Al Arab from the park is beautiful. It is a great place to spend a full day with family and create happy memories. Highly recommended. || Visited Wild Wadi Waterpark oduring UAE National Holidays and had an exceptional experience that truly reflects the high standards of Jumeirah hospitality.

The entire environment is extremely well-maintained — clear water, spotless common areas, well-balanced crowd flow, and excellent safety supervision at every ride. The lifeguards and operations team deserve special appreciation for their professionalism, attentiveness, and calm, consistent communication. Their approach made the experience safe and comfortable for families throughout the day.

We were particularly impressed by the operational discipline and guest service culture, which is very much in line with Jumeirah’s reputation. Even with seasonal visitors, the park remained organised, clean, and efficiently managed.

The views of the Burj Al Arab from within the waterpark, along with the unique design and flowing waterways, give Wild Wadi a charm that is difficult to match. A wonderful family destination, and a strong reflection of Dubai’s excellence in hospitality.

Compliments to the entire Jumeirah team for maintaining such international standards. We look forward to visiting again.

Name: Safa Park
Description: A large established city park with lawns, lakes and family recreation.
Reviews:
Good and pretty big park.
Entrance fee is 3 aed for 1 adult person.
Some areas allowed to do bbq grilling.
Has washrooms.
Has a restaurant.

Only I would suggest to make more entrances, to make it more comfortable for people who are walking. || Went for the Grand picnic. Very easy entry if you buy online. Lovely park, gorgeous skyline, just a little much constuuction on the sides but overall, a very big park. Usually empty unless events as such. || I took some photos to show you what kind of event was recently held in this park. The park is very beautiful, there is a very large parking lot right at the entrance. An ideal place for walking and just to run in the fresh air. || Unfortunately, this park was a very disappointing experience. It was extremely crowded, with large groups cooking and grilling food everywhere, which made the atmosphere noisy and uncomfortable. The park lacks greenery and shade — there are very few trees, and while there is some lawn, the overall environment feels quite barren and uninviting.

Another serious concern is the presence of wasps or bees. In certain areas, there are noticeable clusters of them, and they actively swarm around people, making it unsafe and stressful to spend time there. Overall, the park does not feel relaxing or suitable for a peaceful visit.

P.S. Entry is paid — 3 dirhams per person. || Beautiful but confusing. Paid entry of 3 Dirhams, lots of construction sites surrounding which go into the night. Barely any people there? Basketball courts and lakes are shown on the map but not there in reality? No snack or beverage stands? Not sure why it was so empty at night, but at least it was quiet and no creepy men anywhere. Lots of Careem Bikes around as well.

Name: Dubai Water Canal Boardwalk
Description: A pedestrian waterfront route with bridges and city views.
Reviews:
My visit to the Dubai Water Canal Board was absolutely fantastic! The entire experience exceeded my expectations. I truly enjoyed the beautiful scenery and the peaceful atmosphere. ✨ A definite must-visit spot! 💖 Highly recommend checking it out. 🤩 || Beautiful spot in Business Bay! 🌊✨ The waterfall is stunning at night with the lights, and the boardwalk is perfect for a walk or photos. Definitely worth a visit if you’re nearby! || Perfect place to stroll down and enjoy the sites. There is plenty of space for walking (cycling unfortunately is not permitted) and there are a host of shops along with boardwalk if you feel hungry.

There are bridges where you can switch sides to cross the river but these are more regular closer to Jumeirah side. In the business bay area there is just 1 single cross point (at the waterfall)

The waterfall itself is colourful and opens regularly for passing ships.

Overall a great place to relax and take a quick stroll || Perfect location for a walk watching the city scape || An excellent destination for leisure and relaxation. Dubai Canal offers scenic views, well-maintained pathways, and a calm atmosphere, especially during sunset.

Name: Tolerance Bridge
Description: A pedestrian bridge across Dubai Water Canal with distinctive architecture.
Reviews:
The Tolerance Bridge looks cute and visually pleasing, especially when seen from the water. Like much of Dubai, it comes alive at night during the day the city can feel very concrete-heavy and flat, whereas in the evening, with the lights on, it almost feels like a mini New York or Canary Wharf on overdrive.

We took a ferry from the bridge area, and while the surroundings are fine (including nearby private residential developments), it was surprising that there were no public or portable toilets at the ferry point. For a major, well-used spot in a global city, this felt like a basic oversight.

More broadly, Dubai still struggles with walkability and pedestrian-friendly infrastructure. For a young, world-class city, it’s baffling how difficult it is to walk or cycle between places sidewalks are often missing, and exploring on foot simply isn’t encouraged. Yes, it’s a desert city, but that doesn’t fully explain the lack of pedestrian planning.

Overall, the bridge itself is nice, but the surrounding public amenities and customer service experience need improvement. Dubai may aim for luxury, but attention to everyday details toilets, walkability, and consistent service would make a big difference. || The Tolerance Bridge is one of Dubai's most beautiful pedestrian bridges, offering breathtaking views of the Dubai Water Canal, skyline, and Burj Khalifa in the distance. The elegant arch design makes it not just functional but also an architectural landmark. Whether you're walking, jogging, or cycling, the experience here is calming and scenic — especially during sunset or in the cooler evening hours when the bridge lights up.

It’s a perfect spot for both tourists and residents to relax, take photos, or simply enjoy the breeze over the canal. The path is clean, wide, and well-maintained, with ramps and railings that make it accessible for all. It’s also a great location to catch views of passing boats and soak in the peaceful vibe right in the middle of the city.

The bridge symbolizes unity and harmony, which adds even more meaning to your visit. That said, it’s one of those hidden gems that adds to Dubai’s charm.

Highly recommended for anyone who appreciates architecture, photography, or just wants to enjoy a quiet moment amidst the city lights. || BETWEEN CITY LIGHTS AND GOLDEN SKIES, THE TOLERANCE BRIDGE OFFERS A VIEW THAT SPEAKS IN CONTRAST AND HARMONY.
This spot truly feels like a hidden gem—calm, relaxing, and perfect for a peaceful escape in the heart of Dubai. You can reach it easily via a direct RTA boat from Al Ghubaiba, and the nearest metro station is Business Bay. The long walkway offers an uninterrupted skyline view on one side, and if you simply turn around, you're greeted by a stunning sunset over the water. Cycling is also an option here, with a Careem bike stand conveniently located nearby. The area is part of the dhow cruise route, so you get to enjoy those elegant boats gliding past as well. And what to say about the Dubai Water Canal? The waterfall there stops automatically when a cruise passes and then starts flowing again—an unforgettable moment that’s impossible not to capture on camera. Without a doubt, this is one of the best spots in the city for photography lovers. || I stopped by Tolerance Bridge during an evening walk and really like  the vibe. The design is simple but meaningful, and the views over the water are beautiful, especially around sunset. It's a nice spot to pause, take a few photos, or just enjoy the breeze. The area around it is clen and peaceful, making it perfect for a relaxed walk. || Really nice views at night and perfect distance to go for a evening walk or jogging. Or just sit there yo chill and enjoy the view, when the weather is cooler ~ also a very nice spot for photography. Love those magnificent bridge designs, so amazing how the designers came up with such ideas 💡 bravo 👏

Name: Marasi Promenade
Description: A waterfront path along Dubai Canal with dining and skyline views.
Reviews:
A beautiful clean and lovely promenade by the Canal. It's still being developed with nice buildings and floating villas right on the waterfront. A perfect place to walk run or a leisurely stroll. Perfect in the early hours of the morning or an evening in winters. The waters are clean and pleasurable sight. Around 15 km promenade length one way.
Worth to visit and enjoying the scenes in the morning along the canal and amazing architectural tower structures.
Paid Parking available all over the canal areas . || Peaceful walk by the canal with nice views of the high rise buildings including the Burj Khalifa

Name: Dubai Water Canal Waterfall
Description: A illuminated waterfall feature beneath Sheikh Zayed Road bridge.
Reviews: The Dubai Water Canal is a true marvel, a shimmering ribbon weaving through the city's heart. 🌃 Its tranquil waters reflect the urban gleam, a dance of light and shadow. ✨ Strolling along its banks is a soothing escape, a beautiful experience for the soul. 🚶‍♀️ A gem of engineering and artistry. 💎 || Wonderful place to enjoy a walk... silent and peaceful location || Good for walking, jogging and biking. Spectacular views of Dubai at night if you choose to walk in the evening, or the pleasure of seeing iconic buildings up close if you stroll during the day. || "Recently explored Dubai Water Canal and it was spectacular! The park features two play areas designed for kids, offering them a fun and safe environment to enjoy || Wandoful place,my kids was happy inside as qe found a small waterpark

Name: The Square at City Walk
Description: An urban public space used for events, dining and entertainment.
Reviews:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5 Stars for City Walk (Thanks to Raising Cane's!)
City Walk is already a fantastic spot, but let’s be honest—Raising Cane’s absolutely steals the show and makes this place a guaranteed 5-star destination.
If you are a fan of perfect, golden, crispy chicken tenders, this is the ultimate spot to hit up. The crinkle-cut fries are always hot, the Texas toast is buttery perfection, and that legendary Cane’s Sauce is addictive enough to warrant its own 5-star review.
Having it right here in City Walk makes the whole area ten times better. Whether you're hanging out with friends or just looking for the ultimate comfort food meal, Cane's makes every trip to City Walk completely worth it. Highly recommended! || City Walk is often presented as a place to stroll around like in a European-style neighborhood, but in reality, it feels more like an open-air shopping mall.

There are plenty of shops and restaurants, but beyond that, there’s not much to see or do. It lacks cultural elements or any real sense of authenticity, so if you’re expecting something more than retail and dining, it might be disappointing. || City Walk Dubai is a must-visit spot ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
A perfect mix of modern design, luxury shopping, and relaxed outdoor vibes.

The area is beautifully designed with wide walkways, stylish cafés, and high-end brands, making it ideal for a casual stroll or a night out. The atmosphere is lively yet calm, with great dining options ranging from trendy restaurants to cozy coffee spots ☕🍽️

What makes City Walk special is its cleanliness, open-air feel, and family-friendly environment. Easy parking, great security, and a central location add to the convenience.

Whether you’re shopping, dining, or just hanging out with friends, City Walk offers a premium Dubai experience that’s classy, comfortable, and fun.
Highly recommended 👍✨ || City Walk is a vibrant and stylish destination in Dubai with a great mix of shopping, dining, and entertainment. Name: Boxpark
Description: A container-style retail and dining district along Al Wasl Road.
Reviews:
Boxpark in Dubai is a unique commercial area lined with container-style buildings, making it a nice place to stop by for a walk.

The area brings together a variety of shops, including cafés, a cinema, furniture stores, and Asian grocery shops, so it covers a wide range of needs—from shopping and dining to simply killing some time.

Overall, the space feels open, and just walking around is enjoyable.

There are also several photo-friendly spots, such as stylish architecture and wall art, making it a suitable place for visitors to drop by while sightseeing.

However, rather than offering a specific, must-do experience, it feels more like a mixed-use complex where different types of stores are gathered in one place.

It’s convenient if you have a particular shop to visit or if you’re already in the area, but it may not be a place where you would spend a long time as a main destination.

As a casual spot to enjoy the atmosphere, though, it’s not a bad area at all. || An absolute hangout place for family and friends.. Highly recommended. || Nice for a stroll in the evening when it's less hot. Here you can find shops, restaurants, cafes and cinema. Perfect place if you don't want to dine or chill in a crowded spot. Free parking along roadside too. If you don't drive, there are a few buses coming here so it's quite convenient. Downside, it will be boring if you're here for window shopping. || This place gives a unique ambience and vibe all around. Surrounded by precisely crafted boxy structures using containers makes this place a treat for your eyes and mind. There are good restaurants and Fast food chains like McDonalds, Pizza Hut etc. This place is a family friendly spot to spend your good times with your loved ones. If you are a person who loves solitude vibe, this place suits you too. || This place is my all time favourite and i can go their at any time of the year whether it be in winter or summers and can stroll for quite some time and enjoy the all glowing lights, uniquely designed outlets and the serene atmosphere which always gives out those positive vibes and makes you feel relaxed.
However they should improve the pricing for all the food outlets or atleast have some special discounts for students who can find it tough to afford.

Name: Dubai Design District Waterfront
Description: A creative district promenade with architecture, art and dining.
Reviews:
Dubai Design District is a great place to enjoy a peaceful walk or run, and it’s also perfect for families. The open spaces, fresh air, and beautiful views create a relaxing environment where you can sit, unwind, and spend quality time with loved ones. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a calm and scenic outdoor spot in Dubai. || Its my first time at dubai design district and i was in a hurry i just came for brunch , definitely coming back inshallah i need to explore more of it 👌

Nice big variety of coffee shops and restaurants the shades of the buildings on the corridors made the weather perfect || The new employee parking setup is really disappointing. The parking area is dusty, overcrowded, and not well organized, which makes parking there frustrating every day.

What I don’t understand is why employees are being pushed to these parking areas while the paid parking is always empty (attached picture). It feels like the needs of the people working in D3 every day haven’t been taken into account.

I hope D3 reconsiders this decision and comes up with a more practical solution for employees. || It was an absolute nightmare to park now in D3.

The limited number of parking permits allocated to each company has created daily difficulties for employees who rely on private vehicles to commute. Many of us are now forced to park in the furthest unpaved areas, while large portions of Areas A, B, C, and D often remain noticeably underutilized. This has made what was once a manageable process increasingly frustrating and time-consuming.

D3 is predominantly made up of employees who commute daily by car, while visitors represent a much smaller percentage of parking demand. Parking allocation should reflect this reality to better serve the people who use the district every day.

Many companies are willing to pay the annual parking fees required for their employees. We simply ask that a fair and reasonable number of parking spaces be made available to accommodate this demand. || The place is amazing specially at night time. The place full of restaurants and coffee shops. Ideal for walking and chilling with friends. Free car parkings are available. Prayer place available too. Seatings seats available all over place. Here you can have an amazing photos to Dubai downtown

Name: The Block
Description: An urban recreation park with sports courts, skating and waterfront paths.
Reviews:
I found this place is not suitable for kids under 10 at least. There is a small playground available. Personally I find this place looking a bit sad. Basketball court and wall climbing area is good. View is also nice. There some better places available around the same area, e.g. Harbour creek. || Visited this park few days ago for a morning walk. It is a nice place, but seems like there is not enough shade provided, so it would be nicer to go there in the winter months. Pity that whoever designed the landscape didn’t provide more trees, it seems very bare and exposed to the sun, but skate park is nice and colorful concrete blocks are great background for the photos. || Nice and silent place.

Note: Traffic Signals has sensors here.
So if you stop at red signal then kindly stop your vehicle close to the stopping line for the sensors to detect your vehicle and the singal to turn green. Or else you will be waiting at red signal for ages🤣

Not many people are aware of this place,

It was quite lonely as we can’t find anyone visiting this place expect the employees who work at the food outlet. || The Block is located in the Dubai Design District. It is a well maintained park beside Dubai Creek with a fantastic view of the water and Dubai skyline. My son attended a birthday of his classmate here and they had lots of fun. || The Block is located at Dubai Design District.
Timings: 7am to 10pm
It's a friendly space where you and your family / friends can play, relax and unwind. It features a Skate park, basketball and volleyball courts, climbing walls, table tennis etc. And it's a waterfront spot as well.

Name: The Courtyard Al Quoz
Description: A creative complex with galleries, theatre spaces and cafes.
Reviews:
A beautiful and peaceful place to visit. The art galleries were very interesting and enjoyable to explore. I especially liked the greenery throughout the area, which created a relaxing atmosphere. The fountain was also beautiful and added to the charm of the place. A great spot to spend some time away from the crowds and enjoy art and nature together. || A hidden gem in Al Quoz! The Courtyard is a beautiful creative space that feels worlds away from the city's hustle. The charming European-style walkway, lush greenery, blooming bougainvillea, shaded seating areas, and elegant fountain create a peaceful and photogenic atmosphere.
It's a great place to slow down, explore art galleries, enjoy a coffee, or simply take a stroll through the beautifully landscaped courtyard. The architecture and thoughtful design make every corner feel unique and inviting.
Whether you're looking for a quiet escape, a spot for photography, or a creative afternoon, The Courtyard is definitely worth a visit. A refreshing oasis in the heart of Dubai.
📍Highly recommended for art lovers, photographers, and anyone seeking a tranquil urban retreat. || Tucked away in Al Quoz, Courtyard feels like a dreamy escape you wouldn’t expect in Dubai at all. The moment you step in, it transports you somewhere far from the city’s usual fast pace.

I visited after dark, and the experience was absolutely magical. The moon installation, gentle lighting, and the soothing sound of wind chimes created a calm, peaceful, almost therapeutic atmosphere. It’s the kind of place where you naturally slow down, breathe deeper, and just take it all in.

The earthy architecture, artistic corners, and quiet pathways make it perfect for a mindful walk, photography, or simply sitting in silence for a while. It truly feels like a hidden gem — dreamy, serene, and beautifully different from typical Dubai spots.

If you’re looking for a peaceful escape within the city, this place is absolutely mind-blowing and definitely worth visiting, especially in the evening. || Really enjoyed this place. It’s quiet, peaceful, and ideal for working, painting, or just disconnecting for a while. The coffee shop is charming, and the atmosphere feels calm and inspiring. Service is available until 7 PM. || Aabsolutely loved the peaceful vibe. It’s a beautiful space that connects you with nature and greenery, perfect for artists and creative minds. The atmosphere felt calm, inspiring, and full of positive energy. Definitely planning to visit again soon!

Name: Cinema Akil
Description: An independent cinema presenting international and regional films.
Reviews:
The one & only cinema in Dubai with art house movies. Atmosphere,  vibes... impossible to describe.. you have to experience it. Not your regular cinema. Trust me . || What a lovely experience, it was so nice to have experienced a film here it was such the ideal spot for movie lovers. They had popcorn nachos and so much other options. The theatre itself was sooooo nice, but the couches were a bit uncomfortable, the screen and sound system were great tho. Overall great experience. || Amazing place with a chance of watching old movies on the big screen.  One small detail; the sofa's frame was hard, it wasn't a comfortable seat. But I can change seat!
Another small thing; parking is a nightmare. || We stopped by Cinema Akil just for a coffee. Mine came out cold at first, but the lady was really sweet and made me a fresh one. Name: The Junction Theatre
Description: A small performing arts theatre in Alserkal Avenue.
Reviews:
I went to watch "Peter Pan Syndrome" at The Junction in Al Serkal Avenue, and it was such a joy to watch the actors perform live. The theatre itself is small but still fits a good crowd, maybe around 100+ people, so it feels like a nice, cozy place to enjoy a show. The staff were super friendly and helpful, which made the whole experience wonderful.

The performance made me chuckle here and there, and the jokes were good. I even made some new friends, so I'd definitely recommend it. It's a great reminder to go see live theatre; you can really appreciate that they're crafted pieces that take so many hours of practice and rehearsal.

My only comment is about the seats. They were fine for the first hour and a half, but started to feel a little uncomfortable after that. But overall, it's a must visit! || The best podcast ever I loved the vibes and the show was amazing full of joy and laughing 😃 ♥️🥰 || Such a lovely place where theatre comes live. If you love drama action and comedy shows please keep a watch at this place . They come up with the best short plays I’ve experienced in Dubai. I’ve been to junction couple of times and what I loved the most was Bollywood theme show called film film ki Kahaani
Kinda fun place to do something different
Keep checking what’s coming 😍 || Really good place to organize the events or theater shows. The Junction is located in Al Serkal avenue which is an amazing area all together. The seating inside is of 100 people. Would highly recommend to book this place if you are looking for theatre shows or standup comedy shows as well. Moreover, they have the marketing poster wall where they keep promoting upcoming events in The Junction. || It was my 3rd experience attending independent theater play and certainly it wont be the last! Lovely actors and great script! Great venue for small / medium performances. A theatre with comfortable seating and high standard lights and sounds. . The sound system, stage set up, everything is perfect for a theatre event! Highly recommended!

Name: OliOli
Description: An interactive children's museum focused on play, science and creativity.
Reviews:
Had a great family day out at OliOli and really enjoyed the overall experience. The interactive exhibits and hands-on activities kept the kids engaged for hours, making it both fun and educational. There was plenty to explore, and it was wonderful seeing the children learn, play, and use their imagination throughout the visit.

The facilities were clean, well-maintained, and the staff were friendly and helpful. While a few areas felt quite busy and some activities could have had shorter waiting times, the experience was still very enjoyable overall.

After all the fun, we headed for BBQ pizza, which was the perfect way to end the day. The pizza was delicious, fresh, and packed with flavor, making for a great family meal after an active afternoon.

Overall, a memorable outing with lots of smiles, learning, and good food. Definitely worth a visit for families with young children. || OliOli® Kids Dubai is a wonderful place for children to learn and play at the same time. The space is creative, interactive, and thoughtfully designed to spark curiosity and imagination. There are plenty of hands-on activities that keep kids engaged and entertained, making it a great outing for families. While it can get a bit busy at times, the overall experience is fun, educational, and well worth a visit. A great spot for kids to explore and enjoy! 🎨✨ || Highly Recommended – A Truly Inclusive & Sensory-Friendly Place!
We would like to share our heartfelt appreciation for OliOli Dubai, a place that has become a favorite and repeatedly requested destination for our Ausome students.Our children absolutely love coming back because of the rich sensory play opportunities, fun games, and engaging hands-on activities that support learning, regulation, and joyful exploration. As a therapy and learning center, we truly value spaces like OliOli that naturally promote development while keeping everything fun and meaningful.
A special shout-out to Mr. John, who kindly assisted us until all our kids and staff received their snacks — your support made a big difference. We would also like to thank the Filipina staff member who patiently and compassionately supported us when some of our children started showing behavioral challenges inside the venue. Your calm, understanding, and inclusive approach means so much to us.From the environment to the people, everything about OliOli reflects warmth, acceptance, and child-centered care.Our students love it. Our staff enjoy it. And as a center, we are always grateful for your amazing team.
Thank you for being part of our Ausome journey. We look forward to many more visits! 💙🌈 || My daughters 9th birthday party was done in Oli Oli and it was wonderful.. there are different packages and options to choose from.. almost a month back they allowed a tour of the place and the explained the packages.  On the party day they took care of everything and we were so relaxed .. they engage with kids and there are so many activities and they were very organised. Sahar was very friendly and nice and very engaging with the kids.. they loved her. My daughter personally loved how nice and cooperative she was.
A big thank you to the entire team of Oli Oli. || This place never fails us every time we visit! The staff are always so kind, welcoming, and amazing with the kids (shout out to Kris, Don, Arian, Daniel and Sahar).They go out of their way to play with them, keep them entertained, and make them feel so comfortable and happy at all time. You can really see the genuine care and patience they have for children. (Our boy was always looking for Kris as his kuya). The whole place has such a warm and family-friendly atmosphere, which makes every visit enjoyable and stress-free. Always a great experience for both kids and parents, highly recommended! It’s a ten out of ten!

Name: Woo-Hoo Children's Museum
Description: An interactive indoor play and learning centre for young children.
Reviews:
Worst money spent in Dubai. Even though the staff is kind, the place is a joke. For a very expensive ticket that doesn't allow you access to all galleries (some ate at extra cost) everything is broken, restricted, out of order, or damaged. No parking, no lockers, not a place to go! I remembered it much nicer from 3 years ago but now I do not recommend. Wish I could get my money back. || I had my daughter’s birthday here last February and have forgotten how amazing the experience was, I just got reminded when we were at dubai festival city mall last weekend and I saw that they had a second branch out there, woo-hoo is an amazing place and definitely the people there are all accommodating! Especially the person who organized our birthday last time Mr.Michael! This guy provided an experience way beyond we were expecting! From the time we walked-in and until the very end everything was well organized and well executed, even my daughter knew him up to this day as she loved her woo-hoo! birthday so much! Highly recommend to look for Michael if you are all trying to book a birthday here in woo-hoo! || Great place for learning and exploring.  Kids can be kept entertained for hours, while parents can enjoy the café.  The staff are well trained and helpful. || Brought my daughters here last Sunday and they absolutely loved it! There are so many activities to choose from and enjoy. Each gallery has a unique theme that will boost your child’s curiosity and creativity. There is also a decent cafe for parents to chill and relax while the kids play. Staffs are accommodating and patient in handling kids. Special thanks to Genelene for helping us around especially when we were in the splash lab. My kids went hyped with all the activities and didn’t want to leave that room. Rochelle was very kind and explained the mechanics in the mining room. She also taught my kids how to differentiate rocks which was very educational. They also had fun at the cave exploration and at the tree house. There are rooms where kids can spend time doing crafts and take home to enjoy. Overall, the place is clean, safe and kid-friendly. Superb experience and will definitely come back again! Highly recommended! || Our group had an amazing time exploring this play area over the weekend. The staff were super friendly and helpful, making sure everyone had a great experience.

The main activity which was the soap workshop was very experimental  .The kids couldn’t wait to take home their very own handmade soap. We can't wait to come back and have more fun at Woohoo 👍 5 stars from me!

Thanks to our dearest Doris who recommended Woohoo and made sure everything run smoothly ❤️

Name: Dubai Media City Amphitheatre
Description: An outdoor amphitheatre hosting concerts and public events.
Reviews:
I attended the Krazy Super Concert on February 17 at Dubai Media City Amphitheatre, and it was such a fun experience overall. The venue is spacious and works really well for big concerts — you can actually enjoy the crowd energy without feeling too cramped. The open-air setup made the vibe even better, especially at night.

Entry and security were organized, and the staff were helpful when it came to guiding people to the right areas. Sound quality was decent and you could clearly enjoy the performances from most spots. Food and drink stalls were easy to find, and restrooms were well maintained considering how many people were there.

For events like Krazy Super Concert, this place really shines. Great atmosphere, good layout, and perfect for live shows. Would definitely come back for another concert here! 🎶✨ || I’ve been to a few concerts at Media City, and every single time it’s been such a great experience. The vibe there is just different  you can really feel the energy from the crowd the moment you walk in. No matter what kind of concert it is, the setup always feels impressive and well put together.

The sound quality is clear and powerful, and the lighting really adds to the whole atmosphere. I also appreciate how organized everything is, from entry to security it makes the night stress-free so you can just enjoy the music.

If you love live concerts, Media City is definitely one of those places that never disappoints. Can’t wait to go back for the next show! || it was a nice concert experience! just walking distance to metro. however i wish they planned the crowd entrance differently because the crowed was pilled up outside right next to the road. || Huge place for the event
I attended the 2nd Thai Select Festival 2025,
Such nice place with good ambiance || Great concert!
Well organized, good sound and lighting, and a very warm atmosphere. The performance felt genuine and enjoyable from start to finish. Definitely worth it.

Name: Marina Beach
Description: A public beachfront beside JBR and Dubai Marina.
Reviews:
Good place for chill out. It's very busy in weekend so if you want less crowded then avoid to come on Saturday Sunday. Overall the beaches very clean and location is amazing everywhere you can click  pictures and take your videos. If you want to see rich then you should definitely visit once || It is a beautiful beach in Dubai. It is a very popular beach ⛱️🏖️,a tourist attraction. The beach itself was clean and well-kept, and there were lots of beach shacks where you can sit, relax, and take a break. Overall, it’s a vibrant and enjoyable spot, especially if you don’t mind the crowds. || Stayed at a nearby apartment and Marina Beach became my favorite spot! The location is perfect just a short walk to the beach with stunning views, especially at night with the skyline and Ain Dubai. The area is clean, lively, and full of great restaurants and activities. Highly recommended for anyone staying around Dubai Marina || An unmissable spot in Dubai! The Marina's impressive skyline, buzzing atmosphere, and endless dining options make it perfect for a sunset walk or boat ride. Just steps away, the public beach offers soft sand, clear water, and a fantastic view of Ain Dubai. Whether you want to relax, swim, or dine by the sea, this area has it all—safe, lively, and unforgettable.

Name: Dubai Marina Yacht Club

I really recommend it to anyone who wants a great yacht adventure. || 5/5 Stars
