Name: Pier 7
Description: A dining tower overlooking Dubai Marina.
Reviews:
Cargo offers a great combination of good food, drinks, and stunning views of Dubai Marina. The atmosphere is lively and energetic, especially in the evening, making it a perfect place to meet friends or enjoy a night out. The outdoor terrace provides beautiful waterfront views, and the interior has a stylish industrial design.
The staff are friendly, attentive, and professional, ensuring guests feel welcome from arrival to departure. Food quality is consistently good, with a varied menu and generous portions. Service is efficient even during busy hours. The location inside Pier 7 adds to the overall experience, with easy access and a vibrant surrounding area. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a memorable dining experience in Dubai Marina. || Pier 7 in Dubai is an absolute masterpiece of dining and atmosphere. Each of its seven restaurants offers a unique culinary experience — from fine dining to relaxed lounges — all sharing one breathtaking view of the marina. The rooftop bar is the crown jewel, offering a vibe that effortlessly blends luxury, music, and magic.

Every moment here feels unforgettable — the lights, the skyline, and the energy that flows through the place make it one of a kind. Whether you’re celebrating life, love, or success, Pier 7 gives you the perfect backdrop for memories that last forever.

Signed with love,
King of Love 💫 || Our team thoroughly enjoyed a delightful lunch, characterized by exceptional and appetizing cuisine. The service provided was exemplary, with Mr. JL outstanding attention to our needs. || Did not try the food that’s why rating is only for service and atmosphere. Prices are better compared to other restaurant by the bay. Go directly to 7th floor and head to rooftop. Good vibes and serves alcohol. || We visited the new restaurant, Elaia on Saturday. Absolutely fabulous setting...we were given a beautiful table outdoors on their terrace overlooking the Marina. The food was beautifully presented and sooo good! The service, by the wonderful Jomar, was attentive and spot on. A lovely bubbly vibe, possibly one slight issue... the (slightly too loud!) in-house DJ...although, to be fair, the music was great!!! Thank you... we will, most definitely, be back again soon!!

Name: Dubai Harbour
Description: A large marina district with cruise terminals, yachts and waterfront views.
Reviews:
One of the most modern and luxurious places to visit. It becomes even more amazing during sunset, creating a truly beautiful atmosphere.  Had a wonderful experience there. The area is surrounded by stunning yachts and the entire place is very clean and well maintained. There are boat ride facilities available to explore modern Dubai and you can also enjoy dining experiences based on the package you choose. I highly recommend visiting during the evening hours so you can witness the breathtaking sunset views... || Absolutely stunning spot, especially at sunset! The 'Viewing Point' walkway is a highlight it’s free to enter and offers one of the best unobstructed views of the Dubai Marina skyline, Ain Dubai, and the Palm all in one frame. It’s a great place for a peaceful walk or to take photos without the crowds of the malls. The whole area feels very modern and luxurious. Highly recommend visiting just before golden hour || It was a great experience taking a boat from there easy access to jbr sky Dubai and Dubai eye and stuff are friendly a Gulf car will pick you from the parking if you have goods that you want to take them with you on the boat cost 10 AED per person so all the luxury facility are available || Dubai Harbour is one of the places in Dubai which make luxury accessible for many.
So many options available for yachts.
Yacht operators are also flexible and take care of their client’s requirements.

Things to improve:
Traffic is major concern as there’s only one common entrance. However, as usual RTA is busy making new roads and soon it will be improved.
Suggestions: they can have floating restaurants for a different dining experience. || Book your plans before it's full. Enjoy iconic views and peaceful cruise with your friends.

Name: Dubai Harbour Cruise Terminal
Description: A modern cruise terminal and waterfront arrival point.
Reviews:
Every thing is well orgnized. Parking free available for the cruise guests. Very lovely location. || Must visit in the evening with lights up.
Amazing skyline.
Daily firework and drone shows are there. || Very amazing night view! Can't imagine all these manmade infrastructures ads done only within the last 30 years! I'm really impressed by the power of humans! || So, the big question I always has is: Can you book an independent Dhow trip up the Creek?. Well we just happened to get this ticket included in a Big Red Bus day ticket, but YES you can. They sell Dhow tickets adjacent to the Spice & Gold markets for $20 (US) or local currency. The trip is 1hr, goes up the Creek and the down. Its not thrilling but present, particularly if sit on top level of Dhow in open air and drive along. They play local music from a couple of big speakers up top. They have the reconstructed Old Streets (some spice shops with over enthusiastic shop owners & frankly i dont this at all cheap) on other side of the Creek from the gold Souk- that's pretty, good for photographs, clean loos & boarding point if you've the big Red Bust Dhow ticket. When busy, that bus stop is thought to board bus at. || Beautiful place. From imaginary turns into reality. The city has a lot to offer, see for your self.

Name: The Wharf Bluewaters
Description: A waterfront shopping and dining promenade.
Reviews:
Small shopping mall located at bluewaters island serve the residential area and the tourists. They have wide varieties of stores that provide excited experiences to the visitors || In Bluewaters, The Wharf often is the place to run to for some air-conditioned comfort during the scorching weather.
Sat next to Ain Dubai and hosting the infamous Madame Taussauds, it offers more than meets the eye with option for shopping and lounging.
You will find everything you need and more!
Noting that the Toilet design is very beautiful hahaha! || Gorgeous mall with lots of dining and shopping options. They also have Starbucks and McDonald's close to the wharf if you're looking for something familiar.

✅ Clean restrooms inside the mall
✅ Free water outside the mall (just bring a bottle)
✅ Spacious walking areas
✅ Great views outside
✅ Madame Tussaud's Wax Museum inside the mall (your receipt can be validated for free parking) || The Wharf Bluewaters Dubai is a vibrant waterfront destination that offers a unique blend of entertainment,  dining  and shopping experiences. Located on the iconic Bluewaters Island,  this development boasts stunning views of the Arabian Gulf and the Dubai skyline  making it a must-see destination for tourists and locals. || A very nice place to unwind after the ferris wheel ride. Madame Tussaud is there with a few nice restaurants to go to.

Name: Palm West Beach
Description: A beachfront promenade with restaurants, swimming and skyline views.
Reviews:
I really enjoyed visiting Palm West Beach. The area is beautiful, clean, and perfect for walking, especially in the evening. There are many nice restaurants, cafés, and beach views along the promenade. The atmosphere feels relaxing and lively at the same time. Definitely one of the best places in Dubai for a peaceful walk and good vibes. || My new favourite space for morning walks. Wide, straight boulevards and beautiful beaches. Parking is availed at AED 20 per hour || Without a doubt my absolute favorite sunset and beachside walking spot in Dubai right now. The entire boardwalk is lined with trendy beach clubs, high-end pet-friendly cafes, and incredible restaurants that offer front-row views of the iconic Dubai Marina skyline. It is the perfect place to grab an outdoor table, enjoy a refreshing drink, and watch the sunset. The vibe here is relaxed yet upscale. Underground parking is available right underneath the promenade, though it can get a bit expensive if you don't get your ticket validated by one of the dining venues || A good place for walking, it is very pleasant to walk in this place, there are many restaurants, clubs, hotels, there are several paddle courts and a tennis court, a gym outside. || Dreamy Beach with a Perfect View of the Skyline!

For us, West Beach was one of the most beautiful places to end the day. The beach is extremely clean, the water is clear, and the atmosphere is relaxed and chic. There are many excellent cocktail lounges and restaurants from which you have a perfect view of the Dubai Marina skyline. Ideal for a relaxing afternoon or a sundowner. Absolutely beautiful!

Name: Palm Jumeirah Boardwalk
Description: An 11-kilometre walking route along the outer crescent of Palm Jumeirah.
Reviews:
It is a nice long path along the sea, great for a walk with views of the water and skyline. Peaceful vibe, clean, and not too crowded, making it a good spot to relax. || The sunset view is really beautiful from here.
Usually there are lots of people jogging, running and exercising. It is also full of tourists taking their most iconic and memorable pictures…
Parking ⚠️‼️Parking is closed in front of the old Atlantis hotel. It is easily available in front of new Atlantis the Royal. You can park your and go to the board walk for the view.
There is traffic jam more often … be prepared.🫢
This place is best to visit in winters because the humidity was not letting us spend more than 5/10 minutes out of the air conditioning… 🥵🥵🥵 || So scenic and beautiful!  Must visit when in Dubai! You can even drive through the entire bolouvard for the best experience!! || This place made me feel very lonely

Usually when I'm bored and alone, I go to Marina and I enjoy it.

I tried going here for a walk
There's no kiosk
Nothing to grab quickly
No where to sit
I know it might be the theme of the place , but it's not suitable for evening walk

Maybe someone wants to run or anything,  but for a casual walk,  you will feel abandoned || The outer crescent has a great sea view. During your walk here, you can watch the sea on one hand while the luxurious hotels and adventure parks on the other.
You may watch the sun dip into the sea while sipping a cocktail from a hotel's restaurant on Palm Jumeirah but it may cost more than your first car.

Name: Nakheel Mall
Description: A shopping and entertainment mall in the centre of Palm Jumeirah.
Reviews:
One of the best malls in Dubai. A hidden gem of great high end items to plenty of bargains.  Restaurants and cafes. Good choice of food. Spacious and cool. Friendly staff. When in Palm Jumairah a must visit mall. Trendy cafes. Parking is available.  Great to visit during weekdays. || 🥺absolutely stunning mall! All you will want from bargain to high end luxury! It’s massive. Stunning! Plenty shops and things to do for kids. Trampo extreme and Fabyland. Soft play for smaller kids too! Has restaurants, cafes, food court. Just amazing! Outside lovely too with the golden mile which is walkable had parks and running track etc! Can’t wait to go back! || Located on Palm Jumeirah, this mall offers a wide range of restaurants and retail outlets. Although there is no official Apple Store, shoppers will find alternatives such as iStyle and Virgin Megastore. The best VOX Cinema here and I enjoyed  movie experience. || A lesser known community mall based in Palm Jumeirah. Sine it is not a huge mall, you could spend 2-3 hours, but not more than that. The positive side is, they are always not busy, so you won't feel stressed. However,  their washroom is not clean and the cleaner is busy with his mobile. There are too many pillars inside the mall and a bit difficult to see what are there on the other side of the isle. || Very clean mall.
Nice seating areas.
Lots to drink and eat.
Mixed offer of shops.
Definitely worth checking the rooftop.

Name: Aura Skypool
Description: A high-rise 360-degree infinity pool overlooking Palm Jumeirah.
Reviews:
Aura Sky Pool Dubai is a must-try place if you are in Dubai — it’s not just a pool, it’s a complete experience. If you are planning to visit around New Year or peak season, make sure to reserve well in advance because it gets sold out very fast.

The 360-degree view is absolutely unreal. You get a full panoramic view of Palm Jumeirah, Atlantis, the Palm, and even planes flying by, which makes the experience even more exciting. Whether it’s day or sunset, the view is breathtaking and perfect for photos and videos.

The ambience is luxurious, vibrant, and very well maintained. Every corner looks aesthetic and Instagram-worthy. The music, crowd, and energy of the place make it feel lively but still classy.

The food is great — well presented, flavorful, and worth trying. Drinks are also nicely crafted. The staff is extremely courteous, professional, and classy. They make sure you are comfortable, guide you properly, and take care of every small detail.

Overall, Aura Sky Pool offers stunning views, luxury vibes, amazing service, and great food. It’s one of those places in Dubai that you simply should not miss. || AURA SKYPOOL is a truly unique experience and definitely worth trying at least once. The place is luxurious and well maintained, and the panoramic view of Dubai is incredible—it really feels like something special. The service was excellent, the staff were polite and helpful, and everything from cleanliness to organization was top level.

However, to be honest, it’s not a quiet place and it can be very crowded, with a lot of noise and movement. So it’s not ideal if you’re looking for peace and total relaxation. Great for the experience and the vibe, but not for quiet. || one of the most breathtaking breakfast experiences in Dubai. Starting the day with stunning views from their iconic 360° infinity pool was absolutely unforgettable. From the pool, you can enjoy panoramic views of Palm Jumeirah, Burj Al Arab, Dubai Marina, and the city skyline all at once.

I visited for breakfast and was pleasantly surprised by their special AED 100 cover deal, which offers great value considering the location and experience.

The food and beverages were excellent. We tried the avocado toast, fish salad, and açai bowl, all of which were fresh, healthy, and beautifully presented. Their coffee, mocha, and hot chocolate were equally impressive and perfect for a relaxing morning by the pool.

Whether you’re a tourist or a Dubai resident, Aura Skypool is a must-visit for the views, atmosphere, and quality dining experience. The combination of great food, amazing drinks, and one of the best views in the city makes it a truly memorable destination. || Visited AURA SKYPOOL in the morning and had a wonderful experience. The views of Palm Jumeirah and the Dubai skyline were stunning, especially during sunrise hours. The pool area was clean, well organized, and very relaxing. Staff members were polite, welcoming, and helpful throughout the visit.

It’s a great place for travelers who want to enjoy a peaceful luxury experience, take beautiful photos, and spend quality time with friends or family. Morning timing is perfect because the weather is comfortable and the atmosphere feels calm. I would definitely recommend booking in advance and arriving early for the best experience. A memorable spot to visit in Dubai. ✨ || Stunning views, we were 2 and it costed us 400aed which included the food as we went during the discounted month.

Food: best sushi ive had, really good asian food i loved.
Ambience: good vibe overall, good security , but its a loud place cux of the music.
They have a big changing room with showers and lockers and a shop.

One down side, we werent informed when the kitchen would close, so after the swim we were left hungry despite having paid for it. Otherwise lovely experience and helpful staff. Would recommend

Name: Atlantis The Royal
Description: A landmark resort known for distinctive architecture, dining and fountains.
Reviews:
Having previously stayed at Atlantis The Palm, I didn’t think it could be surpassed — but Atlantis The Royal absolutely exceeded all expectations.
From the moment we arrived, the experience felt elevated. The reception was seamless, and the upgrade was a wonderful surprise that set the tone for the entire stay. What really stood out was the sense of space and exclusivity throughout — whether on the beach, by the pool, or in the Royal Club, everything felt calm, spacious, and impeccably managed. Even getting a same-day reservation at Carbone was effortless and the experience itself was outstanding.
Although a few outlets were not open due to renovations, this actually worked in our favour. The atmosphere felt more personalised, with attentive service and plenty of availability in all areas — something quite rare at this level of hotel.
The Kids Club is truly exceptional and deserves special mention — one of the best we’ve experienced.
Service throughout was flawless, with not a single negative moment during our stay. I did share one observation regarding the check-in experience for club guests, as I had expected a dedicated area similar to (or exceeding) the Imperial Club at The Palm. That said, the team responded with great professionalism and genuine openness to feedback, which was very much appreciated.
Overall, Atlantis The Royal offers a refined, luxurious, and memorable experience. I would return without hesitation and highly recommend it. || Our recent stay at Atlantis The Royal in Dubai was exceptional and sets a remarkable standard for luxury hospitality.

The architecture is striking, with impeccable décor and finishes throughout the resort, reflecting a clear attention to quality and detail.

The dining experiences are outstanding, offering an impressive selection of restaurants, each delivering exceptional food and beverage quality.

The service was equally impressive. The staff were professional, respectful, and genuinely attentive, creating a seamless and welcoming experience from start to finish.

The rooms are spacious and beautifully appointed, with thoughtful details designed to enhance guest comfort. The personal care amenities provided were of an exceptional standard and reflected the hotel’s commitment to excellence in even the smallest details.

Atlantis The Royal offers a level of refinement and hospitality that leaves a lasting impression. We would gladly return and highly recommend it to anyone looking for an exceptional and memorable stay in Dubai. || We stayed for my wife's 40th birthday weekend, with very high expectations, and Atlantis The Royal did not disappoint!
The hotel is stunning, you get wow factor from the second you enter to every new place you find. The service was exceptional, truly flawless, from every single staff member we encountered. Breakfast at Gastronomy is, without doubt, the best breakfast I've ever had in any hotel anywhere in the world! Bedroom was spotless, view was incredible, and beds were comfy.
The only criticism, if I had to make one, is that an adults only pool that is not Nobu would have taken this stay from a 99/100 to a full 100! Nobu Pool is not good for relaxing, and the Royal Pool is full of kids - great for families, but couples not so much.
Can't wait to return to my new favourite hotel! || Our day at the pool at Atlantis The Royal was truly unforgettable. From the moment we arrived, we were warmly welcomed and taken care of in the most attentive and professional way.

A special thank you to Mr.Upulitha, who looked after us throughout the entire day. His service was outstanding—always present without being intrusive, always smiling, and incredibly fast and professional in everything he did. He anticipated our needs before we even had to ask and made sure that every detail was perfect.

Thanks to his kindness and dedication, our pool day became one of the highlights of our trip to Dubai. Experiences like this truly make a stay special.

We can highly recommend this amazing experience to anyone visiting the hotel, and we are very grateful to Mr. Upulitha for making our day so memorable. || It was a great pleasure to have been in this beautiful and wonderful place, it was only by chance that my humble and beautiful sponsor/arbab, who was so kind to have brought me there. I am so blessed that she was generous. But the place was beautiful and the food was great, there was really few back logs when it comes to the housekeeping or some amenities but that didnt matter. We enjoyed though we didn't have much time to roam around. But it was so so beautiful,  lavish. I hope people would come to visit Atlantis the Royal. I love the food in Gastronomy and the lounge anyway

I love the food in Gastronomy and the lounge anyway

Name: Black Palace Beach
Description: A quiet public beach between Palm Jumeirah and Burj Al Arab.
Reviews:
I went there to relax and it  turned out to the perfect spot. It's quiet, peaceful, and not crowded at all, which makes a huge difference. The water is clear, the sand feels natural, and the views especially around sunset are really beautiful. I enjoyed just sitting there, listening to the waves and switching off from everything else. A great place to slow down and enjoy some clam time by the sea. || This beach was so beautiful. If you get a chance, do go! Please pick up your trash after you are done or this beach will get messy fast. We did see a jellyfish and a couple tiny fish. The planes and helicopters are flying overhead so that was neat as well. Find more of my photos and videos at #whenartandtravelcollide
Thanks, Crystal Fisher. || Very nice view of Burj al arab and Marina || If you don't want to take a taxi or don't have a car, it's not easy to get here especially in summer. Walking in 44 degrees in hot sand, with no shadow - horrible. The beach itself is nice but think ahead. First consider how to get there and when. We had the feeling that it was not worth. But for sure there were hardly any people.... || Is a Beach with .net for volleyball,security with bus stop very close and also accessible with the tram, have a uncovered parking area, few stay for camping and install sport equipment for kayak also outdoor boot camp the families are also welcome the only contra is there is not sweet water or changing room and not toilets, not service so make you sure that you bring with you all that yiu will need not commercial or retails sales

Name: Dubai College of Tourism Viewpoint
Description: A coastal viewpoint area facing Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina.
Reviews:
Dubai College of Tourism (DCT) is a vocational education institution established by Dubai’s Department of Economy and Tourism. It offers certificate and advanced diploma programmes in tourism, hospitality, culinary arts, and events, aligned with the UAE National Qualifications Framework and approved by the Ministry of Education. The college focuses on industry-oriented training, including practical experience and internships, to support students entering or advancing within Dubai’s tourism and hospitality sectors. || One of the best colleges I've attended, my culinary journey here was an amazing experience and had created a core memory that I will remember forever. Chef's are wonderful, everyone's a second family, I highly recommend if you're planning on going here.

Thank you DCT  || I recently completed my Level 4 Certificate in Events from Dubai College of Tourism. This is a vocational college that offers excellent practical exposure for students of all ages who want to enter the industry. Most of the staff come from the industry, bringing real-world experience, and they are incredibly friendly and approachable. The campus is cozy creating a warm and supportive learning environment.
We had numerous opportunities to network with professionals from the industry during site visits. The academic director and team was very hands-on, They always took our feedback seriously, acted on it quickly, and supported us throughout our time at the college. The teachers were compassionate, and the overall structure of the course, along with the syllabus we followed, prepared us really well for working in Dubai’s fast paced industry.
At the end of the year, the college made sure we were all ready for the real world and connected us with exciting opportunities in some of the top, fast-paced brands across Dubai. || I started my journey at Dubai College of Tourism in 2022, studying the Advanced Diploma in Events Management. My experience has been nothing short of amazing. One of the biggest advantages of vocational education is learning directly from industry professionals and at DCT, all of our instructors are industry professionals. That made a huge difference.

Every class was hands-on and practical, which gave us the skills and confidence to step straight into real-world roles. The support we received from our teachers helped us grow not just academically, but professionally. I truly feel prepared for the industry thanks to the well-rounded and immersive education we received.

Highly recommend this college to anyone serious about a career in events or tourism! || Honestly, studying at Dubai College of Tourism has been one of the most life changing experiences for me. I came in unsure of myself not knowing if I was truly ready for this industry but from the very beginning, DCT made me feel like I belonged.

The teachers and staff are beyond supportive. They don’t just teach they truly care. They pushed me believed in me and helped me grow not just as a student, but as a person. There were days I doubted myself, and somehow, someone at DCT would always say the right thing to keep me going.

What I loved most is how real and practical everything is. We didn’t just sit in classrooms we got to experience the industry, meet professionals, work on real projects, and build the kind of confidence you can’t learn from books. ( we did a lot of volunteering jobs and internships)

DCT became my second home. I’ll forever be grateful for all the support, and strength this place gave me.

Name: Dubai Internet City Lake
Description: A landscaped lake and walking area surrounded by technology offices.
Reviews: Beautiful place for cycling and walking or running around || One lf the best compared to other public dubai parks || A great view to have during short work breaks || Wow what a lovely place to spend dinner with family 👪 || Beautiful lake and view

Name: Dubai Media City Park
Description: A public green area with a lake and skyline views.
Reviews:
a fantastic little green escape right in the middle of media city. It has a lovely lake that usually has ducks and swans swimming around. It is a perfect spot to sit on the grass for a lunch break, go for a quick walk, or even do some outdoor work since there is plenty of shade under the trees. || One of my favourite places in Dubai! Park is surrounded with skyscrapers, office buildings and hotels. Ideal for walking, jogging, picknicks and also table tennis(there are some tables).Also there is an aesthetic pond with a fountain:)
True big city vibe👍🏙️

Name: Montgomerie Golf Club Dubai
Description: A championship golf course surrounded by lakes and residential landscapes.
Reviews:
Montgomerie Golf Club is one of the best golf courses in the UAE. The team at the bag drop, cart well, and the marshals are amazing. Special thanks to Mahee, Alan, Rodle, Jonathan, Francis, and a few others who always do a great job.
The food and service at the restaurant are really good. Tharun and his team are doing a fantastic job.

If the front desk team could offer a warmer welcome, it would make the overall experience even better.

Thank you, and keep up the good work. || The golf is good, but the staff are great! Especially Cesar, Radan, Sudaka and James!

The guys always greet you with a smile and actually want to make a difference. If it was not for this team, the guests experience would be stuck at just golf and the sole of the place will be lost! Good on the boys! Golf course is also always in good condition! Well done to the staff that keep the grass green! || Haven’t played here in a while but reminded when I did what a fantastic course this is, great condition, challenging, amazing views, service in reception and pros shop was superb. Been coming to this course for 18 years and still a firm favourite || Started here with zero golfing experience and, thanks to the amazing coaching team, especially David Laing, I’m now down to a 3.9 handicap. Their guidance and support have been unbelievable.

The practice facilities are the best in Dubai with an excellent indoor TrackMan studio, great short-game areas, and both individual and group lessons that make improvement consistent and enjoyable. The golf course is very enjoyable to play, overall conditions are good, and while the greens could be slightly nicer and faster at times, the layout and experience more than make up for it. Prices are a bit on the high side, but the quality shows.

Marshals are very friendly, and most of the reception team are welcoming and helpful, with just a few exceptions here and there.

Overall, a top-class place to learn, practice, and enjoy golf. Five stars from me! || We thoroughly enjoyed our round at Address Montgomery golf course. Beautiful layout, great scenery and fantastic condition. The staff are very helpful and friendly. The food was delicious. We would play this course again, in the future.

Name: Earth Course
Description: A championship golf course known for hosting major tournaments.
Reviews:
A superb golf club with the flair of the DP World Tour. We played both the Earth and Fire courses. Both were in excellent condition, and if you can calmly accept that your scorecard won't look like Rory's on display in the locker room, then it's a good day of golf. :-)
Perfect and friendly staff with incredible service. These are the best moments for a golfer.
Even after the round, all the staff were there for us, including helping us search for my lost Scotty putter cover. Thank you for everything, we will definitely be back. || Played both Earth and Fire courses with a clear winner being the Earth course.
crazy good and the condition was next level however the courses are way overpriced , even for Dubai standards as they are ripping you off for the privilage to play. || Had a wonderful experience at the Earth course today . First class service start to finish, course was immaculate . Pace of play incredible best I’ve experienced in yrs . Credit to Kieran and his staff for a truly memorable day . || Good maintainance and nice staff. The course not quite challenge, bunkers are more than others. Fairway and green are flat || Fantastic golf course. One of the must play courses.

Name: Fire Course
Description: A desert-style championship golf course.
Reviews:
An outstanding golf destination in Dubai, offering immaculate fairways, pristine greens, and a challenging yet enjoyable layout. The scenery is stunning, the course conditions are world-class, and the overall experience perfectly blends luxury with top-level golf. A must-play for any golf enthusiast visiting Dubai. || The Jumeirah Golf Estates is one of Dubai's most prestigious residential and leisure destinations, renowned for its world-class golf courses, beautifully landscaped surroundings, and exceptional lifestyle offerings.

The community combines luxury living with stunning green spaces, scenic lakes, and championship golf facilities, creating a peaceful environment that feels far removed from the city's fast pace. Whether visiting for golf, dining, fitness, or simply exploring the area, the atmosphere is elegant, welcoming, and well maintained.

A remarkable destination in Dubai that showcases luxury, recreation, and nature in perfect harmony. Jumeirah Golf Estates is a must-visit for golf enthusiasts and anyone looking to experience one of the city's most impressive communities. || "An exceptional golf haven in Dubai, boasting impeccable fairways, lush greens, and a layout that's both challenging and fun. The breathtaking views, top-notch course conditions, and luxurious atmosphere make it a golfer's paradise. Whether you're a seasoned pro or just looking for a relaxing round, this course is a must-visit. And if you're looking for more, Emirates Hills offers an equally impressive golf experience, nestled amidst stunning villas and scenic landscapes. 😊" || A course you absolutely have to play every time you go to Dubai.

I’ve seen it on TV dozens and dozens of times, and luckily I’ve played it three times—but every time it’s a unique experience. Every hole is beautiful and challenging. The level of care and maintenance is incredible, and the staff at the club are fantastic.

I can’t wait to come back. || Jumeirah Golf Estates is such a chill and classy place! The golf courses are amazing, and the whole area has a peaceful, nice vibe. Definitely worth checking out if you’re into golf or just love beautiful spots!

Name: Dubai Hills Park
Description: A large community park with play areas, sports facilities and open lawns.
Reviews:
Great family-friendly park with plenty of activities, especially for kids. It’s also perfect for a walk or a run if you just want to relax or stay active. Dogs are allowed, which is a big plus. Parking is easy, and there are restaurants on-site, making it convenient to spend a few hours here. || All in all well organized park. Huge with multiple facilities and play areas. Also suitable for picnics.

Parking available RTA paid. Busy especially during weekends.

Parks is busy during weekends, so avoid if you want  to relax with quietness and reflection.

Restrooms available across the park, Mini groceries shop and a cafe. Great to utilize the restaurants park view in Dubai Hills Mall which is walking distance away.

Hope to visit again. || Really good place, quiet and peaceful vibes || Authentic and old part of Dubai, really a true gem to see. A lot of shops and restaurants || If you wanna take a quiet peaceful walk, this is the place for you. Waterfront location. Its an amazing  amalgamation of new and old Dubai. Created beautifully. I would say the old Dubai walk was mesmerizing. Check out all the pics posted. All the cafes and stores designs are heritage-inspired. Good for souvenirs, old and some traditional outfits shopping. Enjoyed well here || This place was my absolutely favourite in the entire Dubai journey.
This place has a calming vibe with extremely beautiful art all around the place.
They sell beautiful artefacts and they also have some amazing cafés around.

Name: Bur Dubai Abra Station
Description: A traditional boat station connecting Bur Dubai and Deira.
Reviews:
The area has a lovely atmosphere, and the evening vibes are particularly attractive.

One of the most enjoyable ways to travel between Bur Dubai and Deira is by using the traditional boat service. It is a very affordable experience, costing only 1 AED for a 5-to-10-minute trip across the canal to the Gold Souk. For those interested in photography, I highly recommend going during sunrise or sunset to capture the best views.

During my visit, we were able to board a boat immediately for a private one-hour trip. It provides a unique perspective of the city that you simply cannot get from the shore. Please note that payment for the boat service is required in cash. || Inexpensive tickets. You can pay cash or card in the ticket office. Boats leave every 5 minutes. Fun. || This boat station provides abra ride from here to Deira for just 1 dirham. It is very convenient and affordable. || One of the must visit site for Tourists;
Abra the bot that connects Deira dubai to Burdubai ,
just AED 1 for one ride .
You can also book a ferry to take personel ride for your family and friends where you can get best views of creek side , || Awesome visit

Name: Deira Old Souk Abra Station
Description: A historic abra station near Deira's traditional markets.
Reviews:
The Deira Old Souk Marine Transport Station – Information & Ticket Office is a convenient and well-located spot for abra services in Deira. It is easy to access and close to the Old Souk area, making it useful for both tourists and daily commuters.
Staff are helpful and guide you clearly about routes, timings, and ticket prices. The ticket process is usually quick and simple.
It can get crowded during peak hours, but service remains efficient and well organized.
Overall, a reliable and smooth transport point. || The best 1 Dirham you will ever spend. The Marine Transport station is well organized, and the boats run every few minutes, so there is hardly any wait time. It’s the perfect way to get between the Gold Souk and the Bur Dubai side. A cool breeze and a great view you can’t beat it! || ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I visited Deira Old Souk Marine Transport Station and had a very pleasant experience. The station was clean, well-organized, and easy to use. It is very convenient for crossing Dubai Creek, especially if you want to experience old Dubai.

The abra ride was smooth and enjoyable, offering beautiful views of the creek and nearby old souks. Staff members were helpful, and the ticket price was very affordable. Overall, my visit was comfortable and memorable. I would definitely recommend this place to tourists as well as daily travelers. || If you're visiting from Bur Dubai/Meena Bazaar and want to explore the Spice, Gold, or Naif Souks (including gems like Yousuf Bhai Perfume), start your adventure at Deira Old Souk Marine Station. This isn't just a station—it's the gateway to an authentic Dubai experience.

Why start here? You get to take the traditional abra (wooden boat) across Dubai Creek. It’s a fun, super cheap (just 1 AED!), and short ride that lets you travel like a local while soaking in fantastic waterfront views of the old city. Highly recommended for the experience alone.

For your return: You have two easy choices:

1. To Al Fahidi Station: More crossings available (use NOL card/buy a ticket). Ideal if you plan to explore more of Bur Dubai or connect to the metro.
2. Direct to Meena Bazaar: The simplest option. Again, only 1 AED, no waiting—just hop on and enjoy the breezy ride back. || A great spot to experience the hustle and bustle of Dubai Creek. It’s always busy, with lots of abras and boats crossing the water, giving you a real feel of the city’s traditional trade and transport. The area is lively, and watching the boats come and go is surprisingly relaxing. It’s also a convenient starting point if you want to explore the souks and old parts of Deira.

Name: Al Hefaiyah Mountain Conservation Centre
Description: A wildlife conservation centre presenting species from the Hajar Mountains.
Reviews:
Al Hefaiyah Mountain Conservation Centre is an amazing place to explore nature and wildlife! The trails are well-maintained, and the enclosures allow you to see native animals up close. Staff are knowledgeable and helpful. Perfect for families and anyone who loves nature. Highly recommended! || The experience is largely indoors, which is great during the hotter months of the year. Very informative & you can see several endangered species native to the gulf region. || We recently visited here. The place is nicely designed and well maintained, with good overall ambience. However, we felt the variety of animals is limited compared to the other small zoo. It may be more enjoyable for families with young children. Overall, a decent visit, and I would rate it around 3 stars. || Visiting the Al Hefaiyah Mountain Conservation Center was a pleasant and eye-opening experience. Located among the mountains, the place is calm and well organized, making it easy to enjoy nature. The center provides clear information about local wildlife, and seeing the animals up close helped me understand how they live and why they need protection. Walking around the area was relaxing, with beautiful mountain views and fresh air all around. Overall, the visit was enjoyable and informative, and it made me appreciate the natural beauty of the UAE and the efforts taken to preserve it for coming generations.

**Suggestion:** It would be helpful to further improve the visitor experience by providing better staff guidance or a clear, sequential route map near the entrance gate. This would help visitors follow the correct path easily and avoid any confusion during the visit. || Really nice place to enjoy and see animals from uae . You have 2 kinds of visits. First is the one you learn a lot about every animal you can see there, some are not easy to find. Second a short ride in an electric gulf cart. 15 aed per adult is a really fare price. We recommend and come with kids they will love.

Name: Kalba Bird of Prey Centre
Description: A conservation and education centre focused on regional birds of prey.
Reviews:
If you are making a visit to Kalba, the Kalba Bird of Prey Center is a nice place to visit with your kids. You will have a very informative bird show, which ends with the birds flying over your head from one end to the other.

The show lasts for about an hour, during which you will get a full introduction to birds of prey.

Afterwards, you can see them up very closely. Ample parking space is available, and it is a nice place with spectacular surroundings. Very easy to locate.

I visited During winter season, better to check before visiting during summer. || Very beautiful place and you learn alot about different types of eagles, falcons owels
Very informative and fun for kids. There are also 2 birds show at 10 and 4pm but we missed it. There's also small place for watching goats, camels and cows. We all enjoyed the experience. Its obvious they put alot of care to keep the birds safe in the preservative. Everyone there was welcoming and willing to help. Must visit || Amazing place. Superb 4 pm show! Price/value very good. Nice place to visit with kids. Good walking area to the fort. Not only birds but some animals to look at. || We had an amazing time at the Bird of Prey center. Seeing the birds up close was incredible and very informative.
The farm animals were a lovely bonus and the baby goats are absolutely adorable.
A visit is highly recommended. || Falcons, eagles, vultures fly just above my head, close enough that I felt the wind of their wings. The show isn't meant to impress, but to understand what a predator really is: precision, silence, and speed.
I've seen a lot of beauty here, but also truth. Birds are free in flight, and still tethered when they rest. That tension is visible, honest, and part of what this place is about: culture, tradition, and the fragile balance between humans and wildness.
I left with my heart wide open and my senses sharpened.

Name: Kalba Mangrove Reserve
Description: A protected east-coast mangrove ecosystem with birds and marine wildlife.
Reviews:
A very beautiful and peaceful place. I visited on Friday around 5:00 PM. The area was a bit crowded at that time, but still enjoyable. I recommend going earlier in the day, as it is less crowded and you have a better chance to see the animals. In the evening, most of the animals are not visible because they are resting or sleeping. The entry fee is 16 AED per adult. Overall, it is a great place to relax and enjoy nature, especially if you plan your visit early. || It’s was a great experience indeed. Quite relaxing with wild nature. There are more areas do improvement specially in facilities. Otherwise, it’s good place to visit specially during the winter season in the UAE. || Must visit!
We didn’t buy tickets before, just turned up.
Please take a bottle of water with you.
This is really a lovely all family day activity , such beautiful scenery and hidden gem 💎 || If you're looking to escape city life and just need to relax and unwind, then look no further than the Kalba Mangrove Reserve! This place has such an amazing peaceful and serene atmosphere where you can feel totally at peace, from the moment you enter and begin walking along the beautifully designed paths through the lush green mangroves with their stunning views that will immediately start bringing you to a state of relaxation.

It is the area of rich and diverse wildlife that makes this place unique. The ability to see so many types of birds in their natural habitats as well as varieties of fish swimming in the crystal-clear waters is incredible. If you are fortunate enough, you may even catch sight of a turtle, which adds to the amazing experience of being at the Kalba Mangrove Centre. This spot is perfect for families, nature lovers, and photography enthusiasts.

The Kalba Mangrove Reserve is well-kept and thoughtfully constructed, providing visitors with both an educational and enjoyable experience. The Kalba Mangrove Centre has an amazing educational component that will allow you to learn about the mangrove ecosystem while experiencing firsthand what nature has to offer.

Timing is flexible, allowing you to easily plan a relaxed visit because it is usually open during

Tuesday - Thursday
9:00 am - 6:30 pm

which is perfect! But please make sure to reach the ticketing counter before 5:00pm in winters and 5:30pm in summer to buy the tickets otherwise it will close.

Overall, the Kalba Mangrove Reserve is a somewhat hidden gem in the UAE, and is well worth visiting if you enjoy experiencing nature, wildlife, and tranquillity. || Can see rare mangrove fishes 🐠 in aquariums. A big Turtle is also present. A park for children and drawing and colouring room for children to enjoy. A beautiful bridge walk of mangrove with view of birds , gazells and sea water. Overall good experience. Parking is small difficult to get on holiday and weekend so be careful.

Name: Kalba Waterfront
Description: A waterfront park and leisure destination with walking and family facilities.
Reviews:
A very convenient and well-located mall in Kalba. It caters well to daily needs with a good mix of retail stores and essential services. The biggest draw is definitely the waterfront location with the relaxing view of the lagoon.

There is ample parking and the facilities, including the public areas, are kept very clean. It’s a great spot for both quick shopping and a relaxed meal outdoors. While it may not have all the high-end brands of larger city malls, it offers everything a community needs in a beautiful setting. || Kalba waterfront is a mall located on Kalba lake where you can find variety of different stores, hypermarket, restaurants and kids playing area.
There is outside places just on the lake in the fresh air it is simply magnificent at winter time.
Also there is a floating restaurant which you can book for unforgettable moments with your beloved ones.
The mall overall is pretty good, not crowded and really calm but it is still lacking more different stores which is planned to open as soon as possible. || It's peaceful shopping destination with waterfront || Small but good mall || Best in Kalba Town!

Water front View is beautiful 😻

Name: Al Rabi Hiking Trail
Description: A marked mountain trail overlooking Khor Fakkan and the coast.
Reviews:
Had so much fun tackling the Al Rabi hiking trail! It's a fantastic, well-marked path that is totally doable for beginners. The panoramic views overlooking the ocean and the historical town of Khorfakkan are completely breathtaking. Make sure to get there early to beat the sun and bring plenty of water. 5 stars! 🌟 || The view at the top is absolutely worth it—this hike gives you a real sense of achievement from start to finish. It’s a perfect adventurous weekend plan with friends or family, something different from the usual outings.

The trail takes around 2 to 2.5 hours, and the reward is a stunning panorama of Khorfakkan Beach on one side, the town on the other, and Shark Island sitting in the middle of the sea.

Try to start early to catch the best sunrise views. Wear comfortable clothes, carry light essentials like water, an energy drink, or a protein bar, and check the weather and visibility a day before. It’s especially enjoyable during the cooler winter months. || If looking for a family-friendly hike and this was perfect. The path is well-maintained with clear steps in the trickier sections. It took us about an hour and a half round-trip, moving at a decent pace. The view at the top overlooking the bay with the boats was truly breathtaking and worth every step || Al Rabi Hiking Trail is one of the best trails in Khorfakan. It's equally interesting for seasoned hikers and someone who is just starting to explore hiking. It's a suitable hike for kids as well.
Every climb gives a different scenic view from the top giving you the opportunity to capture the moments in your mind as well as your camera.
Highly recommended hiking trail. || It's perfect for those who love hiking. The view from the top is beautiful, but the sun is very  hot . Burn my skin , It's recommended to wear a sun hat and sunglasses. Bring enough water. This was my first time hiking. I felt like my heart was beating very fast and I was extremely tired. For me, walking around and shopping in a mall would be more suitable lol . but hiking was a great experience, a good memory, and good for my health.

Name: Al Rafisah Dam
Description: A mountain dam offering kayaking, walking trails and scenic views.
Reviews:
Visited Al Rafisah Dam and had a wonderful experience. We tried the single kayak, which costs AED 40 with unlimited time, and it was definitely worth it.

The calm water, beautiful mountain views, and peaceful atmosphere made the kayaking experience very enjoyable and relaxing. A great place to spend some quality time with nature and enjoy outdoor activities.

Highly recommended for anyone visiting the area! 🚣‍♂️🌄✨ || A perfect escape from the city, this destination is surrounded by nature and mountains, offering a truly refreshing retreat. With activities like kayaking and paddle boating, it’s ideal for spending quality time with family. The kids’ play area keeps the little ones engaged, while spotting gazelles and ducks adds a unique charm to the experience. Quiet, serene, and peaceful an ideal setting to relax and unwind. || Beware of parking fees, seems like free parking area but not. A dedicated parking area is there after coming from that place only noticed.
Free to visit, for the riding and all you need to buy tickets.
Very nice place to view and relax. Single and double Kayaking option are available. You can feed fish and goose, kids can enjoy nicely.
Visit the place early morning or in the evening in order to avoid Sun hot. A nice masjidh is there you can pray and start freshly. || It turned out to be an unexpectedly amazing experience. It’s perfect to visit at night, with a beautiful view that really stands out. Just make sure to pay for parking—unlike us, we ended up getting fined 😅. But honestly, it was still worth it. The place offers a great escape from the city noise and is perfect for a relaxing getaway with family and friends. || Our evening visit to Al Rafisah Dam was truly magical — a perfect escape from the busy city life and a place where nature, serenity, and beauty come together. As the sun began to set behind the mountains of Khor Fakkan, the entire landscape transformed into a breathtaking scene with golden reflections over the calm water.

The weather in the evening was cool and refreshing, making it ideal for a relaxing walk along the waterfront. The well-designed promenade, clean surroundings, and peaceful ambiance made the experience even more enjoyable. The sight of ducks swimming, the gentle breeze, and the tranquil sound of water created a soothing atmosphere that instantly puts your mind at ease.

We also enjoyed the boat ride, which offered stunning views of the mountains and the dam from the middle of the water. It’s a short and simple activity, but the experience feels incredibly calming, especially during sunset.

The café and seating area overlooking the dam is another highlight — perfect for enjoying tea or coffee while watching the sky change colors. The children’s play area and small shops also make it a nice family-friendly destination.

What makes Al Rafisah Dam special is its quiet charm. Unlike crowded tourist spots, it offers a peaceful and refreshing environment where you can sit, relax, and enjoy nature at its best.

Overall, our evening trip was beautiful, relaxing, and memorable. Highly recommended for families, couples, and anyone looking for a peaceful evening surrounded by mountains, water, and stunning views.

Name: Al Suhub Rest House
Description: A mountain viewpoint and rest destination overlooking Khor Fakkan.
Reviews:
A beautiful spot to enjoy a peaceful sunrise with stunning mountain views. The scenery is absolutely worth the visit and makes for a memorable experience. 🌅

It’s best to arrive about 30 minutes before sunrise and be mindful of the parking timings and fees. The café opens at 7:00 AM, and purchases there can help with free parking for a limited time.

Overall, a lovely one-time sightseeing destination… calm, scenic, and perfect for relaxing and soaking in nature. ❤️ || We drove 1.5 hours from Dubai to watch sunrise over Khorfakkan at Al suhub area on a weekday and our experience was just what we expected and actually even better. You get 360 degree views of khorfakkan, its really very scenic , you can come at sunset as well!

We almost had the entire place to ourselves as there were only 2 more couples there. Since we were there at sunrise the cafe/restaurant on top was closed, no washroom facilities were there but we still had to pay the parking fee- aed 20 per hour.

We went there again during Eid holidays and it was jam packed , totally opposite vibe and too much chaos, so not suggested to go there on public holiday! || If you are planning to visit this place, please read this before going.😑

Try to reach 30 minutes before sunrise. Don’t go too early, because the parking charge is very high, especially on holidays and special occasions. Many people are not aware of the parking fees. I have attached photos with the parking fee details.

The café opens at 7:00 AM. If you spend AED 50 at the café, you will get free parking for the first 2 hours. Make sure you reach the exit gate before the free parking time expires. Otherwise, you will be charged.😐

Washroom facilities are available inside the café only, so remember that they are accessible after 7:00 AM.

When I was exiting, I saw a group who didn’t know about the parking fees. In the end, they had to pay AED 225 to exit. Without paying, you cannot pass the exit gate.😓

Experience:
This is a one-time sightseeing spot. The sunrise view is beautiful and totally worth it. Overall, it’s a nice place and I loved the experience ❤️❤️❤️ || I recently visited Al Suhub Rest Area in December during the evening, and it was truly an unforgettable experience.

Perched high above the scenic coastal town of Khorfakkan, this destination offers breathtaking panoramic views of the mountains blending beautifully with the Arabian Sea. The cool evening breeze and serene atmosphere make it a perfect spot to relax and unwind.

One of the most striking highlights during my visit was the floral decoration around the steps beautifully arranged flowers added a vibrant and elegant touch to the entire setting. The attention to detail in maintaining the landscape enhances the overall charm and makes it very photogenic.

Beyond its beauty, Al Suhub Rest Area also holds cultural and historical significance. Khorfakkan itself has a rich past as an important port town along historic maritime trade routes, connecting the region with civilizations across the Indian Ocean. Visiting this place gives a sense of that legacy, where modern development blends seamlessly with heritage and natural beauty.

The facilities are well-maintained, and the café at the top provides a great place to sit back and enjoy the stunning views, especially during sunset and into the night.

Overall, Al Suhub Rest Area is a must-visit destination for anyone traveling to Khorfakkan. Whether you’re looking for scenic views, peaceful ambiance, or a glimpse into the region’s history, this place offers it all. Highly recommended for families, photographers, and nature lovers alike. || It’s most recommended place to visit.  The Best spot for sunrise view.
Very beautiful site at the top. Parking fees is very high and please be cautious regatthe time of stay. I had visited on 3rd May 2026 and stayed for 2 hours and 10 minutes- paid 140 dh including all charges. Literally its very high and feel very bad .

The view is very awesome and you could experience high winds over you. Its a wonderful feeling to have the full moon view at good windy atmosphere. Really enjoyed the moments with friends.

Name: Khor Fakkan Amphitheatre
Description: A Roman-inspired outdoor amphitheatre used for performances and events.
Reviews:
Beautiful spot for photos! The architecture is stunning and the waterfall makes the whole area feel much cooler. It can get pretty crowded on Saturday evenings, so try to reach by 4:00 PM to catch the 'golden hour' for pictures. There’s a café at the top of the waterfall cave which is a bit pricey but the view of the corniche is unbeatable. Great addition to Khorfakkan || An architectural masterpiece! The Khorfakkan Amphitheatre is absolutely stunning. A blend of classical Roman-style design and modern elegance. Set against the mountain backdrop with the sea nearby, it creates a truly majestic atmosphere. The place is beautifully maintained, especially at night when the lights bring the whole structure to life. It’s right next to the famous waterfall, making it a perfect spot for photos and evening walks. A must-visit landmark that captures the charm and culture of Khorfakkan perfectly. 🎭🏛️🌅 || Khorfakkan Amphitheatre is truly one of the highlights of the city and a must-visit if you’re in the area. The design and architecture are breathtaking, inspired by Roman-style amphitheatres, yet blended beautifully with modern touches. It feels grand and majestic, especially when lit up in the evening, giving it a magical atmosphere.

The location is perfect, set right by the mountains with a view overlooking the sea. It’s not just about the amphitheatre itself, but the whole surrounding area is beautifully developed, with wide walking paths, plenty of seating, and a clean, well-maintained environment. The fountain shows nearby add even more charm and make it a complete family destination.

What I liked most is that it’s not only a performance venue but also a tourist attraction in itself. Even if there isn’t a show, you can enjoy walking around, taking photos, and soaking in the views. There are cafés and restaurants around, so you can sit and enjoy the scenery with a nice meal or coffee. Parking is available and well-managed, which makes visiting hassle-free.

In the cooler months, it’s especially nice to spend time outdoors here, as the sea breeze makes the entire place feel fresh and lively. During summer, though, the heat and humidity can make it a bit less comfortable to stay for long.

Overall, Khorfakkan Amphitheatre is a beautiful landmark, perfectly combining culture, architecture, and natural surroundings. Whether you’re coming for an event or just sightseeing, it’s definitely worth a visit and makes for some stunning memories and photos. || Khorfakkan Amphitheatre is a beautiful spot with impressive architecture inspired by classical Roman amphitheatres, set against the mountains and close to the coastline. The area around it is well maintained and clean, and the views are especially nice in the late afternoon when the light is softer.

It’s a pleasant place to stop by if you are already in the area, for example if you are having lunch at one of the nearby restaurants or visiting the Khorfakkan Waterfalls. The amphitheatre itself is nice to walk around, take a few photos, and enjoy the scenery, but it’s not something I would drive specifically for on its own.

Overall, a good short stop on the way, especially combined with food nearby and a quick photo session by the waterfalls. || We visited Khorfakkan Amphitheatre for the OCR Tiger event and were really amazed.

The place is very beautiful, and since it was our first time in the area, it truly did not disappoint.

We went inside the amphitheatre to use the restrooms and couldn’t help but imagine how amazing it would be to watch a show there.

We will definitely come back again and explore more of the area.

Name: Khor Fakkan Beach
Description: A long east-coast beach with watersports, playgrounds and mountain views.
Reviews:
Khorfakkan Beach is clean and peaceful.
It has soft sand and clear blue water.
You can swim, relax, or enjoy the fresh air.
Many people come here for a morning or evening walk.
There are jet ski rides and boat trips for fun.
Kids can play safely near the shore.
Palm trees and mountains make the view beautiful.
Shaded seating areas are also available.
Food stalls, cafés, and small shops are nearby.
Public restrooms and changing rooms are provided.
The beach is well-maintained and family-friendly.
Swimming is not allowed after sunset for safety.
It’s a perfect place to spend a calm day by the sea. || Perfect National Day getaway! Great weather, relaxing boat ride, and beautiful views. Highly recommended for families. || My go to place for jetski and boating
Fyi, the shark island is closed already-meaning they cant let people  go in that little island anymore- you can still swim but from the back only, so if the guys working in the boat suggested they can take you to shark island- better say,no and just negotiate a price going to secret beach where you can swim and have a picnic. || Neat and clean beach with lot of rides and paragliding || Khorfakkan Beach is truly an amazing place for swimming. The water is beautiful and clean, and the views are really attractive - perfect for a relaxing day by the sea. We enjoyed swimming so much that we left our bags right on the beach while we swam, and everything was safe. It felt comfortable and secure here, and the atmosphere is friendly and peaceful. Highly recommended for families, friends, or anyone looking to enjoy a lovely beach day!.

Name: Najd Al Meqsar Heritage Village
Description: A restored mountain village and fort reflecting traditional regional life.
Reviews:
A peace and private place for those couple who wants to stay a night or travel. A quite far from the city life. Best for weekend to have refreshments over monotonous daily life. A good place to spend a best time! || Najd Al Meqsar
Is not your traditional hotel staycation, its an experience not always ypu get to stay in place with ancient history to try the old houses which is renovated to suit the 21st century accommodation from ac and hospitality
The hotel and hotel staff were very welcoming and very helpful in everything while we stay and accommodate our requests with positive and happy
The food for breakfast from tchi restaurant was amazing me and my wife had an amazing experience, recommend to visit the hotel if you want some between the mountain experience with absolute private atmosphere and at night great view at the great city of khorfakan || Our stay at Najd Al Meqsar by Sharjah Collection was nothing short of amazing. The property itself is absolutely stunning, peaceful, beautifully preserved, and surrounded by breathtaking mountain views. It truly feels like stepping back in time while still enjoying modern comfort.

What made our experience even more memorable was the exceptional morning service by Mrig. He was extremely humble, polite, and genuinely attentive. His efficiency, warm attitude, and willingness to go the extra mile made our breakfast experience truly pleasant and relaxing. Service like his reflects the high standards of hospitality this property stands for.

Overall, this is a perfect destination for anyone looking for tranquility, heritage charm, and top-class service. Highly recommended, and we would absolutely love to visit again. || We stayed at Najd Al Meqsar for one night and had an excellent experience. The property is truly unique and full of character, offering a peaceful escape with stunning views of the Wadi and Hajar mountains. It’s one of the most memorable staycations we've had in the UAE.

The standout of our stay was the hospitality of Mr. Austin, the property manager. He was extremely kind and helpful—from arranging a surprise birthday cake for my husband to checking in with us during our stay to make sure everything was smooth. His attention to detail really enhanced our experience.

The on-site restaurant, Wishi, had stunning views of the valley and ofcourse served delicious food, and the breakfast was impressive.

Things to Know Before You Go:
1. No lifts – Rooms are accessible by stairs. A ramp is available up to Level 1, but higher rooms require climbing (luggage assistance provided)

2. No room service – Meals are served only at the restaurant on Level 0, so plan your movements around meal times.

3. Parking is available, but not shaded, so your car may heat up during the day.

4. Rooms have antique-style fans – a charming but unusual feature for UAE hotels. Air conditioning is available and works well.

5. Breakfast is not a buffet – It’s made fresh to order, which we appreciated for its quality, attention to detail and fresh ingredients.

6. The property is built into a heritage site, so expect an authentic, rustic feel with luxury standards.

7. Not stroller or wheelchair friendly beyond Level 1 due to stairs and layout—best suited for able-bodied visitors.

Overall, We'd highly recommend it for a short, meaningful escape from the city. || It is amazing place with quite atmosphere
With lovely views
I like the food in Wshee restaurant and I would thank the chef and the staff in the restaurant and the reception for great services

Name: Shees Park
Description: A mountain park with a waterfall, walking paths and family picnic areas.
Reviews:
Shees Park is a beautiful and well-maintained family park, surrounded by mountains and natural greenery. The atmosphere is very peaceful, and the walking paths, seating areas, and play zones are thoughtfully designed for visitors of all ages. It is a perfect place to relax, enjoy fresh air, and spend quality time with family and friends.

The park is clean, safe, and ideal for evening walks, children’s activities, and small family picnics. The scenic mountain backdrop and calm environment make the visit very refreshing and memorable. A highly recommended destination for anyone looking for a quiet and enjoyable outdoor experience in the Khor Fakkan area. || I had been planning to visit Shees Park for a long time, and finally this Saturday I got the opportunity. I started my journey with a lot of excitement. Since I am based in Ajman, it was just about a one hour drive from my home. I made a short stop on the way to refuel and refresh, and then continued towards this beautiful destination.

The place is truly marvelous. My children enjoyed themselves so much that we spent more than three hours there without realizing how time passed. We climbed the stairs all the way to the top, and the view from there was absolutely stunning. I took several pictures and even recorded a video to share with people who are planning to visit.

I would recommend reaching the park around 3 PM or 4 PM these days, as the weather is quite pleasant during that time. However, it is important to carry warm clothes because the temperature drops in the evening and becomes quite cold yet very enjoyable.

If you are planning a barbecue, there is sufficient space available, and you can also bring fruits, snacks, or light food for the children while they play and enjoy the surroundings. Parking is well managed and not an issue, as it operates on a priority basis.

Overall, Shees Park is a perfect place to spend quality time with family, relax in nature, and create beautiful memories. Highly recommended and definitely worth a visit. || Great spot, really peaceful, nestled in the mountains. Perfect for an evening with friends and family. There are some nice viewpoints and places to sit, plus play areas for kids. Lots of food options right before you go in, and a cafe inside too. Just a heads up, there's an entrance fee! || Amazing place with places for children to play on many families come here great view from the top of the mountain || Shees Park is a beautiful destination that combines nature, comfort, and family-friendly activities, making it one of the most enjoyable places to visit in the region. I recently went there with my kids, and the overall experience was memorable from start to finish.

The first thing to note is that there is paid parking and a paid entrance fee for adults. However, children under 12 years old can enter free of charge, which makes it an affordable outing for families. The ticket cost is reasonable, especially considering the facilities, cleanliness, and the effort that has gone into maintaining such a large and green space.

The park is extremely spacious and well designed. From the moment you step inside, you are greeted by wide walkways, beautifully landscaped areas, and plenty of greenery. It feels refreshing to walk around and enjoy the open space, especially for kids who love running and playing in wide, safe areas. The management has done a great job keeping everything neat and organized, which makes the experience even more enjoyable.

One of the highlights is the abundance of greenery all around. The grass, trees, and well-maintained plants create a relaxing atmosphere. It almost feels like stepping into an oasis surrounded by mountains. This balance of natural beauty and modern facilities makes Shees Park unique compared to many other parks in the UAE.

For families with children, this place is a blessing. There are safe walking paths and large areas where kids can move around freely. Since the park is big, it never feels overcrowded, even when many visitors are present. Parents can relax while children explore, which adds to the overall enjoyment. The environment feels calm, safe, and family-oriented.

Another advantage is the variety of seating areas spread across the park. There are plenty of benches and shaded spots where you can sit, rest, or even enjoy a picnic. The facilities are clean and well-kept, including the washrooms, which is a very important point for families with young kids.

The park also offers a chance to enjoy nature in a structured way. The mountain backdrop adds beauty to the views, and the air feels fresher compared to the city. Many visitors bring cameras because the scenery is picture-perfect. For those who enjoy walking, there are pathways that allow you to explore comfortably. It’s the kind of place where you can spend several hours without realizing how quickly the time passes.

Overall, Shees Park is a wonderful spot for families, groups, and even solo visitors looking for peace and natural beauty. The small entrance and parking fees are worth it because of the excellent maintenance and the relaxing environment you get in return. It’s an ideal place to spend a weekend morning or evening, especially if you want your kids to enjoy outdoor time away from the usual malls or indoor play areas.

In short, Shees Park offers a peaceful, spacious, and green escape where both adults and kids can enjoy themselves. With its well-maintained facilities, family-friendly policies like free entry for children under 12, and its natural beauty, it’s a destination I would highly recommend to anyone visiting or living nearby.

​Just a short walk from the Sharjah Art Museum is the striking Al Hisn Fort (Sharjah Fort), the former residence of the ruling Al Qasimi family and the headquarters of the Sharjah government.
​History and Architecture: Originally constructed in 1823, the fort, though largely reconstructed, uses traditional materials like coral stone and local wood, giving visitors an authentic sense of the past. Its square design, spacious inner courtyard, and defensive towers vividly illustrate the architecture and defensive strategies of the emirate's history.
​The Exhibits: The fort now functions as an engaging historical museum. Its rooms are filled with exhibits detailing Sharjah's modern history, the lives of the ruling family, and the region's early judiciary system (including a glimpse of the historic Al Muhalwasa jail). The armory section, displaying traditional weaponry, and the rooms demonstrating old practices like dibs (date syrup) making, are particularly fascinating. The displays, available in both Arabic and English, offer a well-rounded and informative journey back in time.
​Visiting the Sharjah  Al Hisn Fort  provides a seamless transition from the cultural heart of the emirate to its historical roots. The site is high-quality, inexpensive, and located in the beautifully restored heritage area, surrounded by traditional souqs and architectural landmarks like the Bait Al Naboodah.

Name: Al Mahatta Museum
Description: An aviation museum located at the site of the region's first airport.
Reviews:
📜 The Beginning

Al Mahatta Airport opened on October 5, 1932.
It is recognized as the first airport in the Gulf region.

At that time, Imperial Airways (the predecessor of British Airways) used Sharjah as a stopover on its route between the UK and India.

⸻

🌍 Why Sharjah?

In the 1930s, aircraft could not fly very long distances without refueling.
Sharjah’s ruler signed an agreement with the British government to allow aircraft to land, refuel, and rest. This strategic decision placed Sharjah on the global aviation map.

⸻

🏢 Facilities in the 1930s
•	A simple desert runway
•	A small control tower
•	Passenger accommodation building
•	Fuel storage facilities

Aircraft at that time were small and carried only a limited number of passengers.

⸻

📈 Later Development

As aviation technology improved, larger and more modern airports were built.
Eventually, operations moved to Sharjah International Airport, and Al Mahatta stopped functioning as the main airport.

⸻

🏛️ Today

The site is now preserved as the Al Mahatta Museum.
Visitors can see historic aircraft, documents, photographs, and exhibits that showcase the early days of aviation in the UAE.

⸻

⭐ Key Facts
•	Opened in 1932
•	First airport in the Gulf
•	Major stopover for Imperial Airways
•	Now a historic aviation museum

Ticket can be easily purchased on the spot and a guide also available to provide information || ​Al Hisn Fort: A Glimpse into the Emirate's Past
​Just a short walk from the Sharjah Art Museum is the striking Al Hisn Fort (Sharjah Fort), the former residence of the ruling Al Qasimi family and the headquarters of the Sharjah government.
​History and Architecture: Originally constructed in 1823, the fort, though largely reconstructed, uses traditional materials like coral stone and local wood, giving visitors an authentic sense of the past. Its square design, spacious inner courtyard, and defensive towers vividly illustrate the architecture and defensive strategies of the emirate's history.
​The Exhibits: The fort now functions as an engaging historical museum. Its rooms are filled with exhibits detailing Sharjah's modern history, the lives of the ruling family, and the region's early judiciary system (including a glimpse of the historic Al Muhalwasa jail). The armory section, displaying traditional weaponry, and the rooms demonstrating old practices like dibs (date syrup) making, are particularly fascinating. The displays, available in both Arabic and English, offer a well-rounded and informative journey back in time.
​Visiting the Sharjah  Al Hisn Fort  provides a seamless transition from the cultural heart of the emirate to its historical roots. The site is high-quality, inexpensive, and located in the beautifully restored heritage area, surrounded by traditional souqs and architectural landmarks like the Bait Al Naboodah.
