Name: Sharjah National Park
Description: A large public park with gardens, play areas and family recreation.
Reviews:
A Perfect 5-Star Family Destination in Sharjah

I recently visited Sharjah National Park, and it truly stands out as one of the best value-for-money attractions in the UAE. Spanning an impressive 630,000 square meters, it is the largest park in Sharjah and offers a calm, refreshing escape from the city’s hustle and noise. What makes it even more appealing is the incredibly affordable entry fee of just 2 AED per person, making it an excellent choice for families and large groups.

The park is beautifully maintained and features a charming mix of traditional Arabian and modern European architectural styles. My children especially loved the Giant Slide, which kept them entertained for hours. Another highlight was the mini-zoo, where visitors can see deer, goats, ostriches, and a variety of exotic birds. The Miniature City, displaying detailed clay models of Sharjah’s famous landmarks, is both educational and visually impressive.

For fitness lovers, there are well-designed cycling and jogging tracks surrounded by lush greenery. The peaceful duck pond adds to the park’s charm and is perfect for relaxation or photography. We also appreciated the well-organized BBQ areas, complete with solid grills, shaded seating, and picnic tables.

Located in Al Qarayen, just 4 km from Sharjah International Airport, the park features a grassy hill that offers a fantastic spot for plane spotting—a unique and enjoyable experience. Facilities are excellent, including a clean mosque, women’s prayer rooms, and ample free parking. I highly recommend visiting between 4:00 PM and 8:00 PM for the best weather and lighting. Overall, Sharjah National Park delivers a true 5-star family experience. || Visited Sharjah National Park recently and it was a wonderful experience. The park is very spacious, clean, and well-maintained, making it perfect for families and kids. There are plenty of green areas, shaded seating spots, and dedicated play zones for children.
The walking and cycling tracks are great for a relaxing evening stroll or some light exercise. I also appreciated the barbecue areas and picnic spots, which make it an ideal weekend getaway within the city. The overall atmosphere is peaceful and refreshing.
Parking is convenient, and the facilities are well organized. Highly recommended for anyone looking to spend quality time outdoors in Sharjah! || I visited Sharjah National Park last week with my family. The park is spacious and has a pleasant environment, making it suitable for a short family outing. There is an entry fee of 2 AED per person, which is quite affordable. Entry is free for senior citizens and children under 3 years. The park is open from 8:00 am to 10:00 pm and has plenty of free parking available, which is very convenient. There are also a few tea shops located in front of the park.
The park has two children’s play areas located on either side — one for small kids and another for older children. While the play areas are large, they look very old and poorly maintained. Most of the rides are made of metal, and due to heavy use over time, they have lost their grip. This makes them unsafe, as children can easily slip and fall, and accidents can happen.
There is also a small train ride inside the park, which children may enjoy, but it is a paid service.
Overall, Sharjah National Park has good space and facilities, but the children’s play areas urgently need maintenance and safety improvements. With better upkeep, it could be a much more enjoyable and safe place for families. || Sharjah National Park is one of the best family-friendly parks in the city. It’s very big, clean, and well-maintained, offering a peaceful environment for relaxation and outdoor fun. A unique feature is its proximity to Sharjah Airport, allowing visitors to watch planes fly overhead, which is especially exciting for kids. The entry fee is just AED 2, making it very affordable, and free parking is available. The park has designated BBQ areas, shaded spots, and open spaces for games or picnics. It’s perfect for weekend outings, birthdays, or casual get-togethers. A highly recommended place for a calm and enjoyable day out. || Very nice park — large, clean, and well-maintained. Name: Sharjah National Park Miniature Landmarks

Reviews:

Spanning an impressive 630,000 square meters, it is the largest park in Sharjah and offers a calm, refreshing escape from the city’s hustle and noise. What makes it even more appealing is the incredibly affordable entry fee of just 2 AED per person, making it an excellent choice for families and large groups.

The park is beautifully maintained and features a charming mix of traditional Arabian and modern European architectural styles. My children especially loved the Giant Slide, which kept them entertained for hours. Another highlight was the mini-zoo, where visitors can see deer, goats, ostriches, and a variety of exotic birds. The Miniature City, displaying detailed clay models of Sharjah’s famous landmarks, is both educational and visually impressive.

For fitness lovers, there are well-designed cycling and jogging tracks surrounded by lush greenery. The peaceful duck pond adds to the park’s charm and is perfect for relaxation or photography. We also appreciated the well-organized BBQ areas, complete with solid grills, shaded seating, and picnic tables.

Located in Al Qarayen, just 4 km from Sharjah International Airport, the park features a grassy hill that offers a fantastic spot for plane spotting—a unique and enjoyable experience. Facilities are excellent, including a clean mosque, women’s prayer rooms, and ample free parking. I highly recommend visiting between 4:00 PM and 8:00 PM for the best weather and lighting. Overall, Sharjah National Park delivers a true 5-star family experience. || Visited Sharjah National Park recently and it was a wonderful experience. There is also a small train ride inside the park, which children may enjoy, but it is a paid service.
Overall, Sharjah National Park has good space and facilities, but the children’s play areas urgently need maintenance and safety improvements. The site showcases over 93 million years of geological history through fossils, rock formations, and interactive exhibits. It blends science, architecture, and desert scenery into a uniquely immersive experience.

🏛️ Architecture & Design
- The visitor centre features a futuristic, pod‑like structure designed by Hopkins Architects.
- Its design blends seamlessly with the desert terrain, offering panoramic views of the surrounding mountains.
- The layout includes indoor galleries and outdoor trails that highlight the region’s geological evolution.

🧭 Exhibits & Experience
Indoor Exhibits
- Interactive displays explaining the Arabian Plate, ancient marine environments, and fossil formation.
- Fossils and rock samples dating back millions of years.
- Archaeological insights into human settlement in the region, some dating back 125,000 years.

Outdoor Trails
- A well‑marked fossil trail with rock layers, marine fossils, and burial sites.
- Stunning views of Jebel Buhais and the surrounding plains.
- Ideal for geology enthusiasts, families, and photographers.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 It is an excellent learning centre with well‑curated information and a peaceful desert setting.
- The remote location adds to the charm — quiet, scenic, and perfect for slow exploration.
- Great for families, school trips, and nature lovers.

🕒 Timings & Practical Info
- Located in Al Madam, Sharjah.
- Entry fees 10 dus + VAT. Below 12 years age is free.
- Best visited during cooler months for outdoor trail comfort.

Pros
- Exceptional educational value
- Unique architecture
- Beautiful desert and mountain views
- Well‑designed indoor and outdoor experiences
- Rare fossils and archaeological sites

Cons
- Remote location (requires a drive)
- Limited shade outdoors
- Not ideal during peak summer heat.

Reviews:
Ras Al Khaimah (RAK), one of the seven emirates of the United Arab Emirates (UAE), is a hidden gem for travelers seeking a blend of nature, history, and luxury. While Dubai and Abu Dhabi often steal the spotlight, RAK offers a quieter, more authentic Arabian experience, making it a perfect destination for those looking to escape the bustling city life.

One of Ras Al Khaimah's biggest draws is its natural beauty. The emirate is blessed with stunning landscapes, from pristine beaches along the Persian Gulf to the rugged Hajar Mountains. Jebel Jais, the highest peak in the UAE, is a must-visit for adventure seekers. The Jebel Jais Flight, the world’s longest zipline, offers an exhilarating experience for thrill enthusiasts. The mountain is also ideal for hiking, and the views from the summit are nothing short of breathtaking. The desert of Ras Al Khaimah also provides opportunities for dune bashing, camel rides, and Bedouin-style camping.

History lovers will appreciate the rich cultural heritage of RAK. The National Museum of Ras Al Khaimah is housed in a 19th-century fort and offers a fascinating insight into the region’s past, including its involvement in the maritime trade. The ancient Dhayah Fort, which played a crucial role in defending the emirate against British attacks in the 19th century, provides panoramic views of the surrounding area and is a testament to the emirate’s historical significance.

For those looking for relaxation, RAK boasts some of the finest luxury resorts in the UAE. The Al Wadi Desert, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, offers a unique desert escape with private villas, spa treatments, and wildlife experiences. Similarly, the Waldorf Astoria Ras Al Khaimah provides beachfront luxury with a touch of Arabian elegance.

Food lovers will find a mix of traditional Emirati cuisine and international options, with restaurants offering everything from local seafood to Middle Eastern delicacies. Don’t miss out on trying local dishes such as "machboos," a fragrant rice dish with meat or fish, and "luqaimat," a sweet treat served during festivities.

In conclusion, Ras Al Khaimah is a destination that offers something for everyone, whether you’re an adventure seeker, history enthusiast, or someone simply looking to unwind in luxurious surroundings. Its combination of natural beauty, rich heritage, and modern comforts makes it a unique travel destination in the UAE. || Our experience with BNB, LLC was exceptional. Description: The UAE's highest mountain, known for viewpoints, hiking and adventure attractions.
Reviews:
I had the opportunity to visit Jebel Jais this December with my friends, and it turned out to be an absolutely memorable experience.

Located in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah, Jebel Jais is the highest mountain in the United Arab Emirates, standing tall at around 1,934 meters above sea level. The drive up the mountain itself is breathtaking, with well-maintained winding roads offering spectacular panoramic views of the rugged Hajar Mountains. The landscape is a stunning mix of rocky cliffs, deep valleys, and vast open skies, making it a paradise for nature lovers and photography enthusiasts.

The view from the top is simply amazing serene, expansive, and truly refreshing. There are plenty of activities available for visitors, including viewing decks, picnic spots, and adventure attractions. One of the major highlights here is the Jais Flight, which attracts thrill seekers from around the world.

We also went for a short trek, and I must say the trekking trails are quite easy and beginner friendly, making it accessible even for those who are not experienced hikers. The cool mountain breeze and peaceful surroundings add to the overall charm of the experience.

I would strongly recommend visiting early in the morning to fully enjoy the beauty of the Jabel Jais and to avoid the harsh sunlight later in the day. The sunrise views from Jebel Jais are particularly mesmerizing and worth the early start.

Overall, Jebel Jais offers a perfect blend of natural beauty, adventure, and relaxation. It’s a must-visit destination if you are in the UAE and looking to escape the city and immerse yourself in nature. || ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Jebel Jais is one of the most breathtaking places in the UAE! The mountain views are absolutely stunning, and the weather is much cooler and refreshing compared to the city. The roads are smooth and perfect for a scenic drive with family and friends.

It’s an amazing place for photography, relaxing, BBQ, and enjoying nature. The viewpoints are beautiful, especially during sunrise and sunset. The peaceful atmosphere and fresh mountain air make the trip truly unforgettable. A must-visit destination in Ras Al Khaimah for adventure and relaxation lovers! || It is a wonderful location for camping with both family and friends. However, it is important to note that the mountain area can get quite cold, so make sure to pack warm coats and other appropriate gear. Additionally, be sure to bring enough food and water to sustain yourself during your stay. Rest assured, the location is very safe and also has washroom facilities available for your convenience. || Visited Jebel Jais with friends for an overnight camping experience, and it was truly remarkable. It’s not just ideal for friends, but equally perfect for a family getaway, offering both adventure and serenity in one destination.

Surrounded by majestic mountain ranges, the atmosphere is incredibly refreshing, with noticeably cooler weather even in April. The natural landscape creates a calm yet dramatic setting, making it a perfect escape from the city.

Well-defined trekking paths add to the experience, allowing you to explore the terrain and enjoy the scenic beauty up close. One of the most unforgettable highlights is the sunrise absolutely breathtaking and worth waking up early for.

Facilities are well-developed, with restaurants available that cater to all meals. During my previous winter visit, we experienced their offerings, and it complemented the overall trip beautifully.

Overall, Jebel Jais delivers a perfect balance of nature, comfort, and adventure a destination that leaves a lasting impression and invites you to return || An amazing destination for adventure and nature lovers! Jebel Jais offers stunning mountain views, fresh air, and thrilling activities like the world’s longest zipline. The drive itself is beautiful and very well maintained. Highly recommended for anyone visiting the UAE.

What stood out most was the way the history of the city is presented. The narration and arrangement of the exhibits make the visit both informative and enjoyable, allowing visitors to better appreciate the rich legacy of Ras Al Khaimah.

I would recommend visiting this museum to anyone interested in local history, heritage, and cultural learning. || We had an amazing night at the Ras Al Khaimah National Museum, Watching the wonderful Candle Opera, It was great to witnesses that incredible performance while enjoying that historical place, It felt like the voice was coming from the ancient history and the walls were repeating the magical world, Such a wonderful experience the place and the music mixed with the great opera singer’s voice it was like a magical dream that you don’t want to wake up.

Even the karts were limited — they didn’t have enough 9 hp ones for everyone, which was surprising considering how far the place is. Overall, it just didn’t feel worth the time, effort, or money. I wouldn’t recommend it. || Not Worth the Drive or the Hidden Costs

​By the time you actually get in a kart, you’re paying at least 30 AED more than advertised due to "hidden fees" like mandatory memberships, gloves, and other extras they don't lead with.

​The Service: They made us go out and buy shoes from elsewhere, only to wait until we got back to mention the rest of the hidden fees. They should be upfront about requirements and total costs before making customers jump through hoops.
​The Equipment: For a track this out of the way, you’d expect a full fleet, but they didn't even have enough 9 hp karts available for us.
​Save your petrol and your money. Go to a track that actually respects your time and is transparent about their pricing. This place is a disorganized money pit.

Name: Suwaidi Pearls Farm
Description: A working pearl farm offering boat tours and demonstrations of Emirati pearling.
Reviews:
The pearl museum tour in Ras Al Khaimah was truly beyond my imagination. During the 2-hour tour, I felt completely transported to another world filled with history, culture, and incredible stories. Our tour guide, Taghi, was absolutely incredible — very knowledgeable, passionate, and able to explain everything in such a clear and engaging way.

Learning about the stages of pearl farming and how people in the past used to dive deep into the sea to collect oysters containing pearls was absolutely fascinating. Every detail of the experience was amazing, from the storytelling to the atmosphere itself.

This was honestly one of the greatest activities that can be done in Ras Al Khaimah. I left the tour feeling happy, inspired, and deeply impressed by the rich pearl heritage of the UAE. Highly recommended for anyone visiting RAK.

Also, I would like to update something for future visitors: online it mentions that there is a dress code for the tour, but in reality no specific dress code is required. Feel free to wear whatever you are comfortable in and simply enjoy the experience. || This trip was well worth doing. A James Bond feel from being transported by motorboat to a freestanding structure in the middle of the lagoon. Othman was excellent. Engaging and knowledgeable. If you think you’re going to doze off, forget it, Othman will be asking questions 😁 Fascinating information and the opening of the oyster to reveal a pearl was memorable. A special mention to the support crew who brought us there and regularly offered us drinks. At one stage when we were outside the structure I noticed one of the crew quietly following us with a fan. That’s attention to detail and professionalism. Well done to all involved 👏 || I visited Suwaidi Pearls with my family, and it was truly an exceptional and one-of-a-kind experience. From start to finish, the visit was both educational and memorable, offering a rare insight into one of the region’s most fascinating cultural traditions.

Mr. Taki took us by boat to the pearl farming station located on the water near the mangroves, which in itself was a wonderful experience. Once there, he gave a clear and engaging explanation of how pearl farming works, using illustrations and demonstrations. He also showcased traditional pearl diving and hunting tools, which added great historical depth to the visit. One of the highlights was watching a shell being opened and discovering a real pearl inside — a moment that was especially exciting for the whole family.

In my view, this is one of the most extraordinary experiences you can have in Ras Al Khaimah. I was also delighted to meet Mr. Al Suwaidi, whose passion and dedication to preserving this important cultural heritage are truly admirable. He showed some of his personal pearl collections, which made the visit even more special and meaningful.

I highly recommend Suwaidi Pearls to anyone visiting Ras Al Khaimah, especially families and those interested in authentic cultural experiences. || Very impressive tour with a very knowledgeable guide Mr Othman Abdulla who made this tour a lifetime memory.
The office toilets are very clean with water saving mode.

We were 17 tourists for the session and in that 4 school kids made it very lively with their enthusiastic questions and Mr Othman explained very clearly.
Overall its a very very nice experience . || It was truly amazing experience. Our guide -Otaman was very knowledgeable, his engagement with kids was truly amazing. Kids were engaged all the time and for sure didnt want to leave the place🙂 We couldn’t be more than happy to discover this place.

Reviews:
Al Rabi Hiking Trail is one of the most beautiful trails in the UAE, offering breathtaking views from an altitude of around 350 meters and a trail length of approximately 1,800 meters. The hike is moderate and enjoyable, making it suitable for nature lovers looking for great scenery without extreme difficulty. One note worth mentioning is that some visitors unfortunately leave water bottles behind. The area is already equipped with trash cans, so I truly hope everyone takes better care of nature to preserve the beauty of this place. || I recently had the pleasure of visiting the Mountain Top View of Khor Fakkan, and I must say, the experience exceeded all my expectations. As someone who has always had a deep love for mountains, this location provided an unmatched sense of awe and tranquility.

From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with stunning panoramic views of the surrounding landscape. The mountain’s elevation allows for a sweeping view of Khor Fakkan and its coastline, offering a perspective that is simply mesmerizing. The vistas are so beautiful that they almost seem surreal, especially as the sun sets and the evening light casts a warm glow over the entire area.

The journey to the summit is an adventure in itself. The mountain stairs, though long and challenging, are meticulously designed and provide a perfect blend of natural beauty and human craftsmanship. The climb is both invigorating and rewarding, as each step brings you closer to an even more breathtaking view. The surrounding greenery and the fresh mountain air add to the allure, making the entire experience unforgettable.

While the view is spectacular at any time of day, I highly recommend visiting in the evening. The twilight hours provide a serene atmosphere, with the fading light creating a peaceful ambiance perfect for reflection and relaxation.

Overall, my visit to the Mountain Top View of Khor Fakkan was a truly memorable one. It combines adventure, natural beauty, and a sense of peace that makes it a must-visit destination for nature lovers and anyone looking to escape the hustle and bustle of daily life. I highly recommend this spot for anyone seeking a unique experience in the UAE's mountains. || If your a beginner in hiking ,try this place,the pathway is visible and easy to follow. Carry some snacks and water so that you can enjoy the views while having some snacks.
If you want to catch the sunrise be there by 6:30 am.
Carry a sunscreen just in case you feel you will take time to get down,and the sun becomes hot. || Jabal Al Khatim is a still unknown natural wonder that deserves all the attention! This site offers spectacular desert landscapes, perfect for lovers of hiking, adventure or tranquility. Beautiful and natural . Sea vibes , sound of sea shores  the fresh air . Name: Pearl Museum Ras Al Khaimah
Description: A small museum and cultural display connected to the emirate's pearling history.
Reviews:
The National Museum of Ras Al Khaimah is only AED 5 per person — but the experience is truly worth it. You even get the chance to climb up the fort and enjoy the beautiful sunset scenery.
What I liked most was the archaeological section. You are guided from one room to another, experiencing the history through different perspectives.
A simple place, but very meaningful. ✨ || I visited the National Museum of Ras Al Khaimah and found it to be a very enriching experience. The museum offers visitors a valuable opportunity to explore the heritage and cultural history of the region through thoughtfully curated displays and exhibits.

What stood out most was the way the history of the city is presented. The narration and arrangement of the exhibits make the visit both informative and enjoyable, allowing visitors to better appreciate the rich legacy of Ras Al Khaimah.

I would recommend visiting this museum to anyone interested in local history, heritage, and cultural learning. || We had an amazing night at the Ras Al Khaimah National Museum, Watching the wonderful Candle Opera, It was great to witnesses that incredible performance while enjoying that historical place, It felt like the voice was coming from the ancient history and the walls were repeating the magical world, Such a wonderful experience the place and the music mixed with the great opera singer’s voice it was like a magical dream that you don’t want to wake up.

Name: Manar Mall
Description: A major shopping and entertainment mall beside the creek.
Reviews:
Manar Mall￼ has a great open-air park for kids. The place is spacious, clean, and perfect for families. Children can enjoy playing safely while parents relax and enjoy the atmosphere. It’s a very nice spot for kids and a great place to spend quality family time. || Visited Manar Mall on 31st December night with friends just to explore. No celebration, only to enjoy the beauty of the place. Lovely night view and peaceful environment. A good tourist spot in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE. || A perfect place to visit in RAK with your family to enjoy your weekend. You can do  many kids fun activities, enjoy nova movies, can eat healthy foods in food court  and many options for shopping like , clothing, home accessories etc ….. || I visited Manar Mall on a Saturday evening and was pleasantly surprised by how spacious, clean and beautifully designed it is. The atmosphere feels very open and relaxed, with plenty of room to walk around without feeling crowded.

There are many perfume stands throughout the mall and you can clearly notice how popular fragrances are in this region.The whole place smells amazing.

On the opposite side of the mall, there is a lovely outdoor garden area with a great view and a peaceful vibe, perfect for taking a break from shopping or enjoying a walk outside.

Overall, a really nice mall with a welcoming atmosphere. I truly enjoyed my visit and would definitely come back. || Manar Mall is a great place for families and kids. Name: RAK Mall

Reviews: RAK Mall offers a solid mix of shopping, dining, and entertainment. It’s clean, family-friendly, and features a great Lulu Hypermarket. Coffee Shops , LuLu Hypermarket…. || Imran & Estella at Katrina coffee RAK mall are doing a fantastic job. We always visit there during the evening and as expected; the best service is provided  Price is affordable and best quality

Name: Al Hamra Marina and Yacht Club
Description: A marina destination with boats, dining and waterfront leisure.
Reviews:
Great time at Al Hamra Marina! The views are absolutely phenomenal and the location is beautiful boasting with views of the sea, golf courses and luxurious hotels. A must visit if you are in Ras Al Khaimah! || I can't praise the team at Royal Yacht Club of Ras Al Khaimah highly enough. I have sailed from Dubai to Al Hamra several times and the assistance they provide for temporary berthing is above and beyond. The Al Hamra Marina area is undergoing renovation and improvement which is obviously disruptive to visitors, but by providing a shuttle service over to the golf club, the experience is even more VIP than it was before! || Nice place to relax for couples and for families not busy on weekdays can get a little busy on weekends, jet ski hire is a good price and few food places to choose from. || Wonderful place , neat & clean area, peaceful & worth visiting.
Loved every moment spent here. || Peaceful.
A boat or even could be rented if you do not have your own. After a few hours at sea, pop into one of the restaurants to enjoy a meal or drink while taking in the calmness that surrounds this place.
Ask for specials of the day.

Name: Al Hamra Waterfront
Description: A pedestrian waterfront area with restaurants and marina views.
Reviews:
It's a beautiful place at night. There are good food options available as well. Reviews:

Name: Al Marjan Island Corniche
Description: A long waterfront walking and cycling route around the islands.
Reviews:
I visited Al Marjan Island Corniche just before sunset, and it turned out to be a wonderful experience. The place is beautifully designed, with wide walking areas, clean surroundings, and a very calm atmosphere. It is the perfect spot if you want to relax after a long day or simply enjoy a peaceful evening with family or friends. The vibe is very laid-back, and the sea breeze at that time of day makes it even more enjoyable.

Parking is never a problem here. There are plenty of spaces available, and I was impressed to see many EV charging stations in the parking lots, which shows how well the area is planned for both regular and electric vehicles. Families with kids will find it especially convenient since there is a nice play area for children, where they can run around and enjoy themselves while parents take in the views.

Another nice touch is the availability of food trucks. They add to the lively feel of the Corniche, especially in the evenings when people gather. I didn’t try the food trucks this time, but it’s great to know they’re there if you want to grab a quick bite or snack while enjoying the outdoors.

Overall, Al Marjan Island Corniche is clean, safe, and very well-maintained. It has everything you need for a relaxed outing—great views, peaceful walking spaces, play areas for kids, parking facilities, and even food options. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Ras Al Khaimah who wants to spend some quality time by the sea. || Al Marjan Island is a truly superb destination if you are looking for an elegant and relaxing seaside escape in the Emirates! This artificial island that juts out into the Arabian Gulf combines magnificent beaches, waterfront walks and breathtaking panoramic views, which creates an ideal atmosphere || Marjan Island is a beautiful and peaceful place 🌊✨
Amazing scenery, lovely lighting at night, and a cool sea breeze make it perfect for a relaxing walk. Highly recommended! || I would recommend everyone to visit this beautiful place. The sunsets look amazing. Fresh air, full view of the sea, good food and marvelous view. If you can, try to visit at sunrise and you would probably have the best view in the whole of UAE. || Al Marjan Island was perfect for the 2026 celebrations — stunning fireworks and an amazing drone show!

Al Aqqa Beach, Khorfakkan

The beach is clean, spacious, and great for families and friends who love nature and outdoor activities. There is also a nearby petrol station, which is very convenient for fuel, snacks, and basic needs.

Highly recommended for camping, BBQ, and a calm night close to nature 🌙🔥🌊 || Great place for family/friendly gatherings, and bbq nights. Even for simple camping, this place is awesome! || Worth to watch the sunrise..
One of the best camping spot in UAE. Difficult to get the access to restrooms nearest spot is the adnoc gas station have min 30min waiting time.

Name: Al Aqah Diving Sites
Description: East-coast dive sites featuring reefs, marine life and wrecks.
Reviews:
This was my first ever dive, and it turned out to be an absolutely amazing experience. From the very beginning the entire process was handled in a highly professional and reassuring manner.

Trainer Mr Noushad deserves special appreciation..
he is extremely skilled, knowledgeable and talented. The predive training sessions were very well structured and detailed, which made me feel confident, safe, and well prepared before entering the water. Every instruction was clear, and all safety aspects were explained patiently.

Both dives were exceptional. The underwater visibility was fantastic and the views were simply breathtaking. Exploring the marine life and the calm underwater environment made the experience truly memorable.

Overall this is one of the best diving experiences in the UAE. Excellent training, well planned dives, stunning underwater views and outstanding guidance throughout.

Highly recommended for beginners as well as experienced divers. I would definitely love to dive again! || Diving with Aquanauts was one of the best personal experiences my wife Margrit and I have had in more than 600 dives around the world. From the very first message, Lionel and the whole team showed exceptional professionalism, kindness, and genuine care.
Because I am handicapped and need some assistance with gearing up, stability underwater, and longer walking distances, I initially contacted Aquanauts with some real-life questions as we had a nasty experience before in another near-by dive-center. Lionel immediately reassured me that they would fully support us — and they absolutely delivered on every promise.
The team organized everything perfectly:
• they picked up our equipment directly from another dive center, the local leader,
• prepared our wetsuits,
• handled all gear setup, tank changes, rinsing and packing,
• and always made sure I felt comfortable, safe, and respected.
Underwater, Lionel was not only an excellent guide but also incredibly attentive, helping me maintain balance without ever making me feel limited. The dives at Inchcape – a wreck at 32 meters depth, Martini, Sharm Rock and the other sites were beautiful, but what made the experience truly outstanding was the warm hearted spirit of the whole Aquanauts team.
We were treated not just as customers, but as friends. On our last day, the entire staff came to say goodbye — something we will never forget.
Thank you, Lionel and the Aquanauts team, for your patience, support, humor, and compassion. You challenged yourselves to make our dives memorable, and you succeeded far beyond our expectations. We left with wonderful memories and hope to return soon.
Highly recommended for every diver — and especially for anyone who needs a bit of extra assistance. You will be in the best hands. || I recently completed my diving course here,  and I cannot recommend them enough! A huge part of what made this experience so special was my instructor, Paloma.
She was incredibly professional, patient, and made sure I felt safe and confident every step of the way.
Beyond her skills as an instructor, I was truly inspired by her personal story. Learning about her journey—how she followed her passion for the ocean and turned it into a life of adventure—was so uplifting. It’s not every day you meet someone whose courage and determination motivate you to chase your own dreams. Her story is a beautiful reminder that it’s never too late to dive into what you love !
The entire team at the shop was friendly and welcoming, and the equipment was top-notch. If you're looking for a place to learn to dive, this is it.
Thank you for everything—I’ll definitely be back for more dives || I had a wonderful experience diving with Aquanauts.
Very responsable priced, extremely patient and kind instructor. I want to thank Lionel for his guide and support with my buoyancy whilst taking pics of sea life, making these pictures possible.
If you come to UAE, be sure to dive here, it has many great dive sites. || It was my first time trying diving, and I absolutely loved it! 🌊 The underwater world was even more beautiful than I imagined. Name: Snoopy Island
Description: A small rocky island popular for snorkelling, diving and marine wildlife.
Reviews:
Snoopy Island in Khorfakkan is an absolutely beautiful and peaceful destination, perfect for a relaxing getaway. The crystal-clear water, scenic mountain views, and clean beach make it a great spot for nature lovers.
It’s an excellent place for snorkeling, where you can see colorful fish and marine life close to the shore. The area is well-maintained and ideal for families, couples, and friends who want to enjoy a calm beach day. The sunrise views are especially stunning.
Overall, Snoopy Island is a must-visit if you’re in Khorfakkan and looking to unwind, enjoy nature, and experience one of the UAE’s most beautiful coastal spots. || the beach is beautiful, high tides, good place for camping, glamping, bbq, sun bath, beach fun, not much public even on weekends || Awesome places Best Camping areas ❤️😍⛺🔥 || Good place for snorkeling.... coral you can see... and verity of fishes || I just love snorkling here. My favorites are the turtles and silver schools of fish that circle you. Amaaaaaaazing

Name: Al Bidya Fort Watchtowers
Description: Historic hilltop watchtowers overlooking Al Bidya Mosque and the coast.
Reviews:
My visit to Fujairah Fort was truly mesmerizing and unforgettable. The moment I stepped inside, I felt like I had travelled back in time. The fort stands proudly against the backdrop of the mountains, showcasing the rich history and culture of the UAE. Its traditional architecture, with mud-brick walls and watchtowers, reflects the strength and simplicity of the past.
What I loved most was the beautiful old homes surrounding the fort. They give an authentic glimpse into how people once lived, preserving the heritage and lifestyle of earlier generations. Walking through the narrow pathways and exploring the restored houses made me appreciate the craftsmanship and attention to detail in every corner. The calm and peaceful atmosphere adds to the charm of the place.
The site is well-maintained, clean, and organized, making it easy to explore and enjoy. It’s a perfect destination for history lovers, families, and anyone who wants to experience the cultural roots of the Emirates. Visiting Fujairah Fort was not just sightseeing — it was a journey into the past, filled with heritage, beauty, and pride. I would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Fujairah. || Fujairah Fort 🏰 – A Glimpse into UAE’s Heritage

Visited Fujairah Fort and it’s one of the oldest and most historic forts in the UAE, beautifully preserved with a strong cultural essence. Built using traditional materials like mud, stone, and palm logs, the structure itself tells a story of the past.

What makes it unique is its hilltop location, offering great views of the surrounding town and mountains — you can really feel the contrast between old heritage and modern development. The watchtowers and thick walls give a clear idea of how it was once used for defense.

The area around the fort is well maintained, peaceful, and perfect for a short cultural visit and photography. It’s not overly crowded, which makes the experience even better.

A great place to explore UAE history, architecture, and heritage — simple yet meaningful. 🇦🇪✨ || This historic fort is truly impressive and beautifully preserved. Standing proudly against the backdrop of the mountains and the clear blue sky, it offers a remarkable view and a strong sense of the region’s heritage. The architecture is stunning, and walking around the site allows you to appreciate its history and importance in protecting the land in earlier times.

The area is peaceful and spacious, making it a great place to explore, take photos, and enjoy the atmosphere. Visiting here feels like stepping back in time. If you are traveling in Fujairah, this is definitely a must-see destination || A beautiful and well-preserved historical site! The fort offers lovely views of the surrounding area and mountains, and it’s a great place to learn a bit about Fujairah’s history. Quite calm, compact, and definitely worth a visit while in the city! || Fujairah Fort, a traditional military building for defense. You can go to any room and floor in this fort. When you at the top of the fort, horizontal view is nice as you can see the Fujairah city.

📍Dibba Beach, Fujairah || A picturesque location, with the mountains and the sea opposing either sides of a road.

If you're looking for an unforgettable experience in Fujairah, I highly recommend visiting Dibba Rock. || A very beautiful sight that’s not usual to see in any water body across the country, very nice diving spot around it so try to do scup diving or snorkeling, you have to go there ofcourse by boat so book one from nearby diving and water sports centers to arrive there, most amazing by sensory timing || If u want a relaxing time, do visit this hidden gem during no rush hours and also drive around this area to find out some really good hidden spots near the coast like Farm houses and some really good shaded beaches with not much people. || One of the best experiences ever! Name: Fujairah Fort
Description: One of the UAE's oldest forts, overlooking the historic area of Fujairah.
Reviews:
My visit to Fujairah Fort was truly mesmerizing and unforgettable. The moment I stepped inside, I felt like I had travelled back in time. The fort stands proudly against the backdrop of the mountains, showcasing the rich history and culture of the UAE. Its traditional architecture, with mud-brick walls and watchtowers, reflects the strength and simplicity of the past.
What I loved most was the beautiful old homes surrounding the fort. They give an authentic glimpse into how people once lived, preserving the heritage and lifestyle of earlier generations. Walking through the narrow pathways and exploring the restored houses made me appreciate the craftsmanship and attention to detail in every corner. The calm and peaceful atmosphere adds to the charm of the place.
The site is well-maintained, clean, and organized, making it easy to explore and enjoy. It’s a perfect destination for history lovers, families, and anyone who wants to experience the cultural roots of the Emirates. Visiting Fujairah Fort was not just sightseeing — it was a journey into the past, filled with heritage, beauty, and pride. I would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Fujairah. || Fujairah Fort 🏰 – A Glimpse into UAE’s Heritage

Visited Fujairah Fort and it’s one of the oldest and most historic forts in the UAE, beautifully preserved with a strong cultural essence. Built using traditional materials like mud, stone, and palm logs, the structure itself tells a story of the past.

What makes it unique is its hilltop location, offering great views of the surrounding town and mountains — you can really feel the contrast between old heritage and modern development. The watchtowers and thick walls give a clear idea of how it was once used for defense.

The area around the fort is well maintained, peaceful, and perfect for a short cultural visit and photography. It’s not overly crowded, which makes the experience even better.

A great place to explore UAE history, architecture, and heritage — simple yet meaningful. 🇦🇪✨ || This historic fort is truly impressive and beautifully preserved. Standing proudly against the backdrop of the mountains and the clear blue sky, it offers a remarkable view and a strong sense of the region’s heritage. The architecture is stunning, and walking around the site allows you to appreciate its history and importance in protecting the land in earlier times.

The area is peaceful and spacious, making it a great place to explore, take photos, and enjoy the atmosphere. Visiting here feels like stepping back in time. If you are traveling in Fujairah, this is definitely a must-see destination || A beautiful and well-preserved historical site! Reviews:
Fujairah Museum is a hidden gem for anyone interested in UAE heritage and archaeology. It’s small, peaceful, and beautifully curated — the kind of place where you can really slow down and learn.

The exhibits are well organized, covering traditional Emirati life, old weapons, jewellery, pottery, and fascinating archaeological findings from the region. The displays are clear and easy to understand, and the staff are friendly and informative.

One of the highlights is the section on ancient tombs and local excavation sites — it gives a deeper appreciation for Fujairah’s long history. The museum also includes traditional huts and outdoor structures that show how people lived before modern development.

Entry fees are very affordable, and the entire space is clean and well maintained. It doesn’t take too long to explore, but you leave feeling enriched.

A wonderful stop for families, students, tourists, or anyone wanting to understand the cultural roots of Fujairah. Definitely worth adding to your heritage tour of the emirate. || Amazingly laid out and beautifully decorated, with so much history to tell. The mosque follows a beautiful Ottoman architectural style, with elegant white domes and impressive design details. The main prayer hall is very large and decorated with beautiful carpets and stunning chandelier lights, which makes the interior feel grand yet peaceful.
I visited the mosque during Iftar in Ramadan, and the arrangements were truly remarkable. There were separate seating areas for families and bachelors, and everything was very well organized. It looked like the arrangement was made for more than 5,000 people.

Name: Fujairah Mall
Description: A shopping and family entertainment destination.
Reviews:
​Fujairah Mall stands out as a sophisticated yet tranquil shopping destination in the heart of the emirate. Unlike the overwhelming bustle often found in Dubai’s mega-malls, this two-story complex offers a more relaxed, family-centric atmosphere that mirrors the calm spirit of Fujairah itself. Its modern architecture, set against the backdrop of the Hajar Mountains, provides a clean and aesthetically pleasing environment for both residents and tourists.
​Shopping and Convenience
​The retail mix is a thoughtful blend of international favorites and essential local services. Highlights include:
​Retail Giants: Large anchors like Nesto Hypermarket and Brands For Less make it a go-to for high-quality goods at competitive prices.
​Variety: From fashion outlets like H&M and Centrepoint to specialized perfume and cosmetic shops, it covers all the bases for "retail therapy."
​Amenities: The mall is well-equipped with free Wi-Fi, prayer rooms, and ample parking, ensuring a hassle-free visit.
​Entertainment and Dining
​For families, the mall is more than just a shopping center. The Galaxy Cinema offers a premium movie-going experience, while the dedicated kids' play areas and unique indoor attractions—like kart racing and laser tag—provide high-energy fun for younger visitors. The food court is notably well-organized, offering a diverse range of international cuisines that cater to the UAE’s cosmopolitan population.
​Overall, Fujairah Mall is a premier choice for those seeking a "one-stop" destination that balances modern convenience with a stress-free environment. || Fujairah Mall is a vibrant destination for shopping, dining, and entertainment. From daily essentials at Nesto Hypermarket, Life Spring Pharmacy, and the Korean & Asian Supermarket to unique finds at Pier Imports (vintage, antique & custom-made furniture), the mall offers something for everyone.
You’ll also find a wide variety of perfumes, beauty products, accessories, and gift shops, perfect for every occasion.

Food lovers can enjoy favorites like McDonald’s, O’Learys, Shawarma House, Toppi Vapa Biriyani, Manila Kitchen, and La Boulangère, making it a great family spot. For entertainment, attractions like go-karting, shooting games, and Fun Block games keep both kids and adults engaged.

With the Royal M 5-Star Hotel, Fujairah Municipality HQ, regular monthly events, and a wide mix of retail, dining, and leisure options, the mall is a convenient and lively hub for residents and visitors alike.

We’re proud to be part of Fujairah Mall at Life Spring Pharmacy. 💙💚 || Great location

The overall atmosphere is calm and pleasant, with great lighting and decor that enhance the experience.

The mall features a large selection of stores catering to all ages and tastes:

•	Electronics and mobile stores like Emax and Axiom.
•	Beauty and fragrance shops including Bath & Body Works and The Body Shop.

Staff throughout the mall are friendly and helpful, whether at the information desk or inside the stores.
Cleanliness is impeccable in all areas—from the food court to the prayer rooms and restrooms.
Security presence is professional and reassuring without being intrusive.

City Centre Fujairah is more than just a shopping mall; it’s a complete experience for shopping, dining, and entertainment. It stands out for its excellent service, diverse offerings, and overall comfort.
I highly recommend it—whether you’re a Fujairah resident or just visiting, you’ll find everything you need for a pleasant and enjoyable day out.

As we all know, UAE is always sunny and it can be more friendly to all audience. || I am writing this review with great disappointment regarding the club’s handling of our membership and refund request.

I have been a member of the club for almost one year. At the end of January, while my family was visiting, we purchased a six-month family membership for my wife, two children, and their grandmother for AED 3,471. We also paid AED 875 for a package of 10 swimming lessons for my 6-year-old son.

Unfortunately, at the end of February, my family had to leave the UAE abruptly due to unforeseen circumstances. In total, they were only able to use the facility twice, and my son attended just one swimming lesson. They did not even have the chance to print their membership cards.

Given the situation, I contacted the club to request a possible refund for the unused portion of the membership. On April 14th, the club responded sympathetically and agreed, as an exception, to provide a refund for the unused portion of the membership minus a 15% cancellation fee. The swimming lessons were stated to be non-refundable, which we were willing to accept despite only using one out of the ten sessions.

However, after more than a month of limited communication and follow-ups, we were informed on May 18th that “the refund request has been rejected,” and the club rescinded its earlier offer.

At this point, a mother, a 3-year-old child, a 6-year-old child, and their grandmother are effectively paying thousands of dirhams for facilities and lessons they are unable to use, despite the club initially acknowledging the circumstances and offering a reasonable compromise.

This experience has been extremely disappointing, not only because of the financial loss, but also because of the lack of consistency and communication throughout the process. || I value your club’s reputation and the services you provide, which is why I hope this matter will be reviewed carefully. I kindly request that appropriate measures be taken to prevent such issues from occurring in the future, and I would appreciate clarification regarding what happened. || This place is quiet and beautiful, they got gym, swimming pool, restaurant and good reception, the workers here are polite and kind. I LIKE THIS PLACE. || I booked the tennis court in advance and clearly informed the staff that I needed a racket since I didn’t have one. I was assured that everything would be arranged. However, when I arrived, I was shocked to be told that no rackets were available and that I hadn’t mentioned it—which is completely untrue.

This level of service is unacceptable and extremely unprofessional. It shows a serious lack of communication and organization. It’s honestly disappointing to see such poor management in a place that otherwise looks nice. Customers shouldn’t have to deal with this kind of confusion after confirming details.

I would not recommend this place at all unless they significantly improve their service and start respecting customers’ time and requests.

My recent trip to Dibba Rock in Fujairah was an absolute highlight of my vacation. The experience of scuba diving and snorkeling in the crystal-clear waters was nothing short of magical.

Name: Three Rocks Diving Site
Description: A group of reef formations popular with divers and snorkellers.
Reviews:
Had an incredible day diving in Fujairah with Reef Oasis Diving Center!

Huge thanks to our DiveMaster Sina for being so patient and knowledgeable. We saw so many turtles! The underwater videos she took of the whole experience are amazing.

One thing that really stood out was the gear; everything was high-quality and felt brand new, unlike the old equipment you often see at other centers. The staff were all super friendly, and the complimentary BBQ lunch after our 2 dives was a total win. Can’t wait to get back in the water with this team! || Highly recommend this company. Everything from the off was seamless. Great communication around transport and itinerary prior to arriving for my dives. The whole crew are very personable, great at communication and more than happy to help you in any way.  The dive center has male and female changing rooms, with showers available.  I had 2 dives with Sina, 1 at snoopy rock and 1 at Sharm rocks. There was an abundance of green turtles at both sites, as well as puffers, clown fish, parrot fish, huge shoals of fish and a huge adult black tip reef shark. Sina was a great dive buddy/guide, very happy to communicate, and answer questions from an inquisitive customer. She is a credit to the company. The BBQ lunch was nice and plentiful. If/when in the UAE again, I would definitely use this company again. || Reef Oasis is legit one of the best organized tours I’ve been on... good vibes from start to finish!

I really appreciated the patience, slow-paced dives, and careful approach that allowed for proper framing and shooting. It honestly felt like a tailored experience rather than a standard dive. Highly recommended for anyone into underwater photography. || I’ve been diving at Sandy Beach for the past three years and it has been an incredible journey. 🌊

My instructor JFK has coached and trained me through Rescue Diver, Self-Reliant Diver, DPV, and Divemaster, always with patience, professionalism, and a good sense of humour along the way.

⸻

Ajman Fish Market is located near Adnoc Service Station, along Sheikh Rashid Bin Saeed Al Maktoum Street in Ajman.3.
Ajman's bustling Fish Market is popular with visitors. || Visiting the Ajman Fish Market is an authentic experience, but it requires a bit of know-how to get the best quality and value. Here is a guide to navigating the market effectively.
1. Best Time to Visit
Timing is the most important factor in your experience:
• For Freshness & Variety: Aim for the early morning (5:00 AM – 8:00 AM). This is when the boats unload and the auctions take place. You’ll have the widest selection and the freshest catch.
• For a Relaxed Experience: Visit during the evening hours (after 6:00 PM). The market is very social and lively, and it is a great time to visit if you aren't looking for a specific, rare fish.
2. How to Spot Fresh Fish
Use these professional checks to ensure you’re buying the best quality:
• Eyes: Should be clear, bright, and bulging. Avoid any fish with cloudy or sunken eyes.
• Gills: Look for bright red or pink gills. If they are brown or gray, the fish is not fresh.
• Smell: It should smell clean and like the ocean. Avoid any fish with a strong, sour, or ammonia-like odor.
• Touch (Firmness): Press the flesh gently. It should spring back immediately. If a dent stays, the fish is likely old.
• Scales & Skin: The scales should be shiny and tightly attached. Avoid fish with dull or peeling skin.
3. Haggling and Purchasing
• Negotiation is Expected: Prices are rarely fixed. Walk around to compare prices at different stalls before committing. Always be polite and respectful while haggling—it's part of the culture.
• Bring Cash: Carry cash in small denominations, as it makes transactions much easier. Non of the stalls have card payments.
• Cleaning Services: Once you’ve bought your fish, take advantage of the on-site cleaning stations. For a small fee (typically 5–10 AED depending on the amount), staff will descale, gut, and fillet your purchase. It saves you a significant amount of time and mess at home.
4. Common Local Fish
You will frequently see these varieties in the market:
• Hamour (Grouper): Highly prized for its firm, flavorful flesh.
• Kingfish (Kanoo): Excellent for steaks and grilling.
• **Safi (Rabbitfish): A local staple, often small and perfect for frying.
• Jesh (Yellowfin Seabream): Great for grilling and very popular in local cuisine.
• Sheri: A reliable, year-round favorite with firm white flesh.
5. Practical Tips
• Footwear: Wear comfortable, non-slip footwear. The floors can get wet and slippery from ice and water.
• Transport: Bring an insulated cooler bag with you. Especially in the warmer months, you want to keep your seafood as cold as possible during the drive home.
• Location: The market is located on Sheikh Rashid Bin Saeed Al Maktoum Street in the Al Rashidiya area, near the Ajman Port. Parking can sometimes be tricky during peak hours, so plan for a little extra time to find a spot. Highly recommended! || An amazing experience! 🌿 We kayaked through the peaceful and beautiful Al Zorah mangroves, surrounded by nature and the sounds of birds — it was truly relaxing and refreshing. The equipment was clean, safe, and well-maintained.
Our tour guide, Mr. Ronaldo, was incredibly helpful, friendly, and knowledgeable. He explained everything clearly and made sure everyone felt comfortable and enjoyed the trip.
If you’re looking for a calm yet adventurous escape into nature, I highly recommend Quest for Adventure in Ajman! 🚣‍♂️🌅 || We went for a 2-hour tour in a double kayak and were amazed by the variety of bird species in Al Zorah - egrets, herons, flamingoes, kingfishers and much more. Even in low tide the tour route takes you on a 3-kilometer journey through the mangrove forest with a stop at the nursery/planting area. Our guide knew a lot about the mangrove ecosystem and shared that knowledge with us. Would definitely recommend visiting - just bring spare clothes and shoes, as you will get wet during the trip. || Had an amazing experience here, came to the mangroves to kayak, Mr Buddhi gave us an experience to remember. He is amazing at what he does, definitely require more like him. A big shoutout to him and his crew || We had an incredible time on the 2 hour kayak tour of the mangroves. It felt like we were transported into a magical paradise very far removed from the city. Our tour guide Ronaldo was super knowledgeable and friendly and taught us loads about the wildlife and importance of the mangroves in our ecosystem. Thank you so much to everyone at quest for adventure for putting so much apparent love and care into this little slice of heaven! Here’s to more mangroves and a greener environment for all

A serene natural wetland in Ajman where flamingos gather among calm waters and mangroves. Honestly, an awesome experience. || Perfect for families. A nice and serene place. We are excited to see the flamingos, but we weren't able to see them.
Also, the google map is not updated and we were brought to a different place first then went to Al zorah Marina but its quite hot so we didn't stroll more.
I really like the area especially if you want to meditate or walk. Maybe we will visit again when its not hot

Name: Ajman Equestrian Club
Description: A horse-riding and equestrian sports facility.
Reviews: A beautiful hidden gem in Ajman. If your kids are 7 years of age and 135 centimeters or above, they can learn here the horse riding. Flexibly timing and a very reasonable price. From the moment I arrived, the atmosphere was welcoming, and the staff was both professional and friendly. The instructors are knowledgeable, patient, and truly passionate about equestrian sports. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced rider, they tailor the lessons to suit your skill level and help you build confidence. I appreciated how safety is a top priority, without compromising on the enjoyment of the experience. || Ajman equestrian club near school zone || Anyone who loves houses should come here and experience this place

Name: Masfout Mountain Viewpoint
Description: A scenic mountain viewing area in Ajman's inland enclave.
Reviews:
Its an entrance to a small town. It has a nice view from the top, not at all crowded.
Has a museum.
Do visit if you are going to hatta. Only 15 mins drive. || This is more of a Watchtower than a Fort, but nonetheless offers a panoramic view of the greens/farms and the hills in the vicinity.

Best time to visit is during dusk/dawn. We visited during June-end (summer) and the climate was surprisingly bearable. || Al Bomah Fort is a historical gem in Masfout, offering a bit of adventure along with its cultural significance. The hike to the fort is a bit challenging, especially for kids and older people, due to the steep and rocky terrain, but it's definitely worth the effort. Once you reach the top, the panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and valleys are absolutely stunning, providing a rewarding experience for hikers.

The fort itself is a nice reminder of the region's heritage, and the peaceful atmosphere at the summit makes it a great spot to relax and take in the scenery. If you're up for a hike and want to enjoy both history and nature, Al Bomah Fort is a great choice! || It is not a fort but an old watchtower which might be used in old times for security purpose and deploying watchman, as the history in Masfout fort mentions about  some attacks from outsiders when there was shortage of food.
Anyhow, location is good for short stay. You can view Masfout area and Hatta mountains. Take care of your kids to not go towards watch tower as beside that there is steep curve and someone can slip from there if not taken care
Overall it was good experience to visit in winter season. Apart from scenery there is nothing else you can do there. A small cafe is also there where you park the car. || Definitely not a Fort.
Came visit after Hatta Dam. In addition to explore Hatta came to visit this exciting place.its a quick visit only.
This is a perfect  spot for camping also. I prefer in winter season to camp. Sunset view, mountains and the local village of Hatta is awaiting for you from the top  view.

Recommended for family and group of friends who loves to camp and explore. Rent Camp house is also available in winter season.
Must visit!

Name: Masfout Wadi Trails
Description: Natural wadi and mountain trails used for hiking and exploration.
Reviews:
Thank you, Dr Sunil,
It was such a good experience -great vibes, great people, and beautiful views! Really appreciate all your effort organizing this. || I'm very excited about what is coming in, Masfoot.
The hikes, the garden parks, the culture it all look amazing.

I'm definitely going back to explore more of the hikes & see the development of this town. || One of the best place for hiking in UAE. Moderate and easy. Trails are well maintained and easy to find the way while going and coming back.
Wonderful place to see Sunrise or sunset. Good view from the top of the mountain. Can see whole HATTA in one place. || A bit steep but this place is amazing. || Rugged terrain, sharp rocks. Steep at times and could be challenging for some. Signage reasonable. Some rest areas. Road can be heard from most parts of the hike on one side. 2 hr loop. Saw two of what we believe to be Rüppell's fox.

Reviews:

There is nobody to explain about the collections I felt as drawback.
All the items displayed on decent manner on the museums.

Name: Dreamland Aqua Park
Description: A large outdoor waterpark with slides, pools and family facilities.
Reviews:
Overcrowded and Poorly Managed During Public Holidays

This is the worst place to visit during public holidays due to poor crowd management and many hidden charges. The locker charges are AED 45 for a standard locker and AED 95 for a large locker, which is not acceptable because providing lockers should be the management’s responsibility in a water park. There was no proper crowd control, and with the huge crowd, the staff handling the rides were not managing the queues properly, with everyone trying to act like the boss. There was also a lack of clear information. We waited in line for almost one hour for a ride, only to be told at the end that it was not suitable for kids, which was very frustrating. The park has very limited rides, hardly 7 or 8, which is acceptable for the AED 99 offer price but definitely not worth their original AED 200 ticket price. The changing rooms were in very poor condition, with no separate shower area inside. The showers and toilets were together, making the area very smelly, and even the outdoor showers were very limited. The water cleanliness was acceptable for some activities, but for most of them, the water quality was very poor. I also noticed one lady staff member who did not seem to understand proper safety standards. Overall, this place needs major improvement in management, hygiene, safety, and customer experience. || Absolutely loved our experience at Dreamland Aqua Park!
The park was clean, well-maintained, and felt very safe for families and kids. There’s a great variety of rides for all age groups — from relaxing pools to exciting water slides — making it the perfect weekend getaway. The staff was friendly and helpful throughout the visit, and the overall atmosphere was fun and refreshing.

One of the things we appreciated most was how organized and family-friendly the park felt. A fantastic place to beat the heat and create unforgettable memories with family and friends. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a fun day out in the UAE! || Amazing water park with beach view ! Clean, safe, and full of fun rides for all ages. The staff was friendly and well-organized. A perfect place for a fun-filled day with family and friends. Highly recommended! Birthday offer was very good. || Everything was good regarding the place, rides, activities, and staff, but one thing was very, very disappointing—the food prices and quality. Overall absolutely amazing, I just wished it is connected to the small hotel just few meters  away for multiple days stay.
Only issue is cleaness of the male bathrooms is not always the best.
Also, we visited during Ramadan, so there was not very much people

Name: UAQ Mangroves
Description: A mangrove and lagoon area used for kayaking and wildlife observation.
Reviews:
The ambiance feels very unique, almost like you’ve been transported somewhere tropical, with its African-inspired design and natural setting. It’s perfect if you just want to unwind, enjoy nature, and take in the views.
We especially loved the calm atmosphere and scenic surroundings—definitely a great spot for photos and quality time with family. Activities like kayaking also add to the experience if you want a bit of adventure. || Visited The Mangroove Beach in Umm Al Quwain and really enjoyed the calm, peaceful atmosphere. The beach is clean and well maintained, with beautiful views of the mangroves and plenty of space to relax. It feels less crowded compared to other beaches, which makes it perfect for a quiet outing or a laid-back day by the water. The surroundings are scenic and soothing, especially during sunset.

Overall, it’s a lovely spot to unwind, take a slow walk, and enjoy nature away from the city noise. || This is a good spot for barbecuing and camping.

Location is quite far from the main road, so be prepared to drive on sandy roads. During public holidays, there can be long queues at the entrance, so it is best to arrive early to secure a barbecue or camping spot. Entrance fee is AED 40 per car with an additional charge for tents (around AED 100 per tent). If you plan to camp in a tent, make sure to purchase the correct ticket at the gate.

We visited on a public holiday. Huge parking area is available. It’s advisable to arrive during daylight hours to enjoy the scenery and spend some time at the beach. Lighting in the barbecue / camping areas is limited, so carrying a light is recommended. Also, bring enough mats or chairs, as most of the ground is slightly wet sand.There is also a restaurant available.

Entry fee may feel high, however it is worth for those who enjoy camping and barbecuing. Washrooms need improvement—they were not clean and were insufficient, especially during peak times.

Visitors deserve much better facilities than what is currently available. || Before i came in umm al quwain i thought wht m i doing here hw can i survive here bt whn time going slowly slowly i visit lots of area of umm al quwain n i feel wowwww really its a hevan for me here is a lots of beach the mangrove beach one of them bt here you get lots of adventures things you feel the nature.you can breath in your own way like you R a flying bird.😍🙂😊 || I will give a 5* rating to the beach area and 3* rating for the camping ground. All in all its a good place for family and friends especially the beach area. They have a nice and quiet sanctuary kind of setup with rentable kayaks so you can padddle between the mangroves. There is also a low-key/ discreet cinema setup on water which looks great but we did not have time to experience. Perhaps another time.

*We moved there during the day after packing our tent from the zone 3 camping ground witch we paid 111Aed so we could set up the tent and camp the night before. The price is ok but very noisy and toilet is badly maintained (See more details under the camping area review)

Name: UAQ Marine Club
Description: A waterfront club offering water sports, boating and leisure activities.
Reviews:
We had this beautiful ride for 3 people for an hour less then 400 dhs. Which is less than 100 euros. For the sunset. Around the mangroves. Amazing view. So peaceful. A bit different than Dubai boat cruise. No building around. Only nature. You come to UAQ marine club. Park there and at the reception they will guide you. However, advance booking is required. || A good place to relax and enjoy the beach, sunset/sunrise, family bonding etc.
The price for their challet/rooms is somewhat hight but expectable since this is a members only club. You can only enter for free if you have room booking, if you dont have, you need to pay extra. They have beach activities like kayaking, fishing, crab hunting, or you can rent their boats or you can just enjoy the private beach and relax with family and friends.
Worth it for travel and relaxation. || A beautifully located club that had many activities and gives access to a nearly untouched mangrove forests and waterways. For boat owners, they offer the full service for all your boat needs. || A low-key spot for kayaking, paddle boarding, or jet skiing. It offers basic but well-kept facilities. Ideal for beginners and casual water sport enthusiasts. Staff is helpful and safety-focused. Great for early mornings to avoid heat and enjoy calm waters. || Very relaxing, beautiful grounds, comfortable rooms, friendly staff. It's like heaven here :)

Name: Umm Al Quwain Beach
Description: A quiet public beach popular for swimming, picnics and camping.
Reviews:
A really nice and quiet beach with better waves compared to most beaches in Dubai. Umm Al Quwain has stronger waves, which makes it more enjoyable. It’s a peaceful spot, perfect for families. The only downside is that the changing rooms need improvement. || Beautiful and peaceful beach with clear blue water. A perfect place to relax and enjoy the calm atmosphere. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a quiet getaway. || 🌊 Very calm and quiet (not crowded like Dubai beaches)
•🌅 Beautiful during sunrise and sunset
•🌴 Natural and simple, which helps clear the mind
•🧘‍♂️ Perfect for stress relief, thinking peacefully, or just sitting near the sea
Escape stress, listen to the waves, and feel mentally fresh again. The slow pace of Umm Al Quwain really helps with tension release. || A rare kind of beach, the sort that feels like it has opted out of the noise. There is very little footfall, no competing music, no urgency to claim space. Just open sand, a wide horizon, and waves that arrive gently, as if they are in no hurry either.

The sea here is calm and steady, more meditative than dramatic. You can sit for hours without feeling the need to do anything at all. No adrenaline, no spectacle, just quiet continuity. It is the kind of place where conversations soften, thoughts slow down, and time stops announcing itself.

If you are looking for beach clubs or crowds, this is not it. But if you are after stillness, space, and the luxury of being undisturbed, this beach delivers that in abundance. || Ummul Quwain Beach is a hidden gem 🏖️! Crystal clear waters , soft sand, Not too crowded, perfect for a peaceful day out. Sunset views are 🔥!
NB CAMPING IS NOT ALLOWED 🫠🤧

Name: Umm Al Quwain Fort and Museum
Description: A restored fort museum presenting archaeology, weapons and local history.
Reviews:
Was not busy at all. A bit of a good research adventure spot. Really kind staff, the entire place is mantained well and also welcoming. There is not a whole lot to see but whatever is preserved is worth looking at and stopping by for. || UAQ Museum.

Entry free: 5dhs
Free Arabic Cofee & Masala Sulemani Tea.

The display rooms has AC.Toilets are nice and clean.

All the pictures speak for themselves.

Time spent: 1hour ++

UAE/UAQ heritage and culture.

Worth the visit || Umm Al Quwain Fort and Museum is one of the most important historical landmarks in the emirate of Umm Al Quwain. Built in the 18th century, the fort originally served as the ruler’s residence and a defensive stronghold. Today, it has been transformed into a museum that showcases the rich heritage, culture, and history of the region. Name: Kite Beach Center UAQ
Description: A beach club offering water sports, dining and pet-friendly areas.
Reviews:
Had a fantastic camping getaway at Kitesurf Beach Center with family and friends.

We booked three large tents, which gave us plenty of space to relax and enjoy the beachside atmosphere. The location is beautiful, with soft sandy beaches, clear waters, and ideal conditions for kitesurfing and other water activities. The sunset views were absolutely breathtaking and one of the highlights of our stay.

The owner has clearly put incredible effort into the boho aesthetic. However, the "No-Cash" policy is a major flaw that creates a massive "digital wall" for guests.
Banning cash is like building a luxury hotel and saying, "We don't need stairs because elevators are convenient." It sounds modern until the power blinks. Digital payments are that elevator—they are 100% dependent on roaming data, international bank links, and phone batteries. For a tourist whose roaming signal is glitching or whose phone just died in the heat, the hospitality simply stops. They aren't a guest anymore; they are just a "connection error" standing in the sand.
Cash is the stairs. It’s the manual, resilient "Plan B" that works every time, human-to-human, without a signal. By removing the stairs, the business is accidentally making life difficult for those who make the beach special:
The Tourists: They are the ones who complain most when international cards are declined or roaming data fails exactly when they want to relax.
The Families: Whose children want to use their own pocket money for a treat without needing a "system."
The Casual Swimmer: Who wants to leave their expensive electronics in the car and just carry a few notes for a water after being in the sea.
I share this constructively because the vibe is a 10/10. To be a true world-class destination, the business model should be as resilient as nature.
